dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Female.7
dialogue.line: Human... what want? Me... busy. Heh.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Female.8
dialogue.line: No... no... you leave...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.9
dialogue.line: Want... something? No? Fiiiine.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.12
dialogue.line: Summer... upon we...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Woodcutter
dialogue.line: Seed are...growing and... bah... I not remember....

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.10
dialogue.line: Sing, sing love bird!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.10
dialogue.line: Human! You like drink too, yes?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Woodcutter
dialogue.line: Human look so.... squishy.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.12
dialogue.line: You guest in village! We happy to see!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.UriashGuard
dialogue.line: What? He your friend?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.15
dialogue.line: Yes! I speak human. You start speak human, too. Or problem when meet human!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.14
dialogue.line: I... no want... problem.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Uriash_Male.16
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.xanthe_tavern_guest.1
dialogue.line: You're so shitfaced, mate, you couldn't tell your arse from a hole in the ground!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.xanthe_tavern_guest.4
dialogue.line: To give you a bloody nose!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.xanthe_tavern_guest.2
dialogue.line: You wish she were a whore! Only then could you get some, you pathetic knob!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.xanthe_tavern_guest.3
dialogue.line: You're so funny! Think your son's good enough for my Alia? Muahahaha!

dialogue.speaker: 545220B9496609C8AE6AB6A6B9949BCF
dialogue.line: All good deeds will be rewarded.

dialogue.speaker: 0B943C7642F64C0DEB7965BBE619309E
dialogue.line: Help...

dialogue.speaker: 22E51EFB4259E11121EF8397D411D18F
dialogue.line: Just a little help...

dialogue.speaker: 088C4C16471BE9F3CE9EFBA1BB44DC37
dialogue.line: Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: 99B0C6714AA1D54E234D409D0584D5B7
dialogue.line: You're a good man.

dialogue.speaker: 0BB7A3C94BC08CFB9BBCFE8DB8EF470A
dialogue.line: You're a kind soul!

dialogue.speaker: 4CB7B76A46C28A195567DCAA190B1019
dialogue.line: You're a saint!

dialogue.speaker: 3874FE9B4D7FBFB242593682CF345019
dialogue.line: Ahh... So cold...

dialogue.speaker: AA0E9AAC43F2F18655272CAD2B8BF6BF
dialogue.line: Have pity.

dialogue.speaker: 8A1C2491489B0963659A498203D37600
dialogue.line: I can't thank you enough!

dialogue.speaker: 5B242CEA4C320ADEC3CB76A2F01CABA6
dialogue.line: I need your help.

dialogue.speaker: 91C64C51402994ABFD993B8E5091E128
dialogue.line: It means the world to me.

dialogue.speaker: E6058C60463F8AEF28B7E2ABADD84D12
dialogue.line: My eternal thanks!

dialogue.speaker: C3AD7D5943FDCE71BC68AD912CCC9A7D
dialogue.line: Oh, spare a coin.

dialogue.speaker: EF109FB64B6A76F33B74D6BF409CA3FC
dialogue.line: I beg for your kindness.

dialogue.speaker: AF94161E443D9246F074CA98EADFE8EB
dialogue.line: I have nothing left.

dialogue.speaker: CC00C3AF4F1AA1EE883798A85B45864B
dialogue.line: I won't forget this.

dialogue.speaker: 3C3415AC4DA25BB6ABC100B2F9399083
dialogue.line: I'll pray for you.

dialogue.speaker: EB368C6C41EE28C5D7C011AC33ADD53A
dialogue.line: Lend me a hand.

dialogue.speaker: 625BDCF94051395295CAE28EEEF1D0A5
dialogue.line: Save me from despair.

dialogue.speaker: D9B67A4D4C2DB64C339F49B358538FA5
dialogue.line: Yes! Yes!

dialogue.speaker: CDD0E0554E4B104648556E8FE7446778
dialogue.line: Ease my suffering.

dialogue.speaker: A4E9F581437FFCB99D42A992099C29AB
dialogue.line: I don't need much.

dialogue.speaker: 1325E2924505451FE7DD529EBD71FE57
dialogue.line: I'm truly grateful!

dialogue.speaker: 0A170B414E4D5DDC125FC885ACF056BE
dialogue.line: Thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: CE1C177F441D51ED5A4AE6A704DD15E1
dialogue.line: That's most kind!

dialogue.speaker: 4AB185B44D876DC0FBFA3CA6508D159B
dialogue.line: There's no hope for me.

dialogue.speaker: CC3B976548FFD7206D2A84961ABECA63
dialogue.line: Won't you help me?

dialogue.speaker: 039EB3C147E1E3BE769C108C1AFF5804
dialogue.line: Hey, here...

dialogue.speaker: 068A27CB43BD09125103299E8390A995
dialogue.line: I'm at your mercy...

dialogue.speaker: 2D193CC843616F9006DB39B03EAEE920
dialogue.line: May you be blessed.

dialogue.speaker: EF800DF04B643BEB34D74486B1974450
dialogue.line: Please, anything...

dialogue.speaker: D151175E49287352CA8F3A81BA485E02
dialogue.line: Please, give me some more.

dialogue.speaker: BE1C58F54142E7EF9A62AEA73C5EB941
dialogue.line: Please, stranger...

dialogue.speaker: 7F3DFAFC400643331C82C3AEA0FC905D
dialogue.line: Thank you, with all my heart.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Coopers.1
dialogue.line: [whistle]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Coopers.2
dialogue.line: [hum]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Gossipers.3
dialogue.line: What is it with you and this manumit crap?! You'll get us in trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Gossipers.1
dialogue.line: Who's the man in the stocks?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Gossipers.2
dialogue.line: You think he doesn't know?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Patients.1
dialogue.line: Let's just wait a bit more.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Patients.2
dialogue.line: Shit... I can't... wait... forever.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Patients.4
dialogue.line: Well, at least he's... there.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Patients.3
dialogue.line: Where is he, then? Maybe we should tell someone.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Soldiers.2
dialogue.line: [yawn]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Soldiers.1
dialogue.line: You wouldn't believe the things one girl offered me to let her go, ha, ha!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Merchant2
dialogue.line: You hungry? Everything's fresh!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Buyer2
dialogue.line: Oh, I see.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Buyer5
dialogue.line: It's cheaper than two years ago. How are you doing that?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Merchant5
dialogue.line: Well, of course they are!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Merchant8
dialogue.line: Why would I be? I have to buy things, too!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Buyer8
dialogue.line: You're probably happy with this bloody lockdown, aren't you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Merchant10
dialogue.line: You serious? I'm cutting my own throat here!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Buyer10
dialogue.line: What's upstairs at the market hall?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Petitioner1
dialogue.line: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Magistrate1
dialogue.line: This way you – and other merchants – can help rebuild the valley after the plague.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Drunk3
dialogue.line: ...summer is upon us!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Drunk2
dialogue.line: We should join the choir!

dialogue.speaker: cc.Buyer1
dialogue.line: What kind of fish is it?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.ChildTout1
dialogue.line: Two pints of ale for the price of one! Come in!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Traveller.1
dialogue.line: You're right. Maybe someone will let us stay the night in return for work.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Traveller.2
dialogue.line: Would be nice to sleep in a warm bed for a change.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Noble.Lady.1
dialogue.line: You're right. That's what I would do.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Noble.LadyInWaiting.1
dialogue.line: We should go, my lady. Too many cold stares.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.1
dialogue.line: [cries and sobs]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.2
dialogue.line: I heard people come to him from all parts of the city.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.3
dialogue.line: Who does he even sell those trinkets to? No one here can afford them.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.4
dialogue.line: [sob]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.with_trinket
dialogue.line: Would you kindly bugger off?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.5
dialogue.line: Why is anyone? To avoid attention.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.30
dialogue.line: [hum]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.9
dialogue.line: We gotta wrap it up.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.8
dialogue.line: This part's mine! Don't touch it.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.7
dialogue.line: Uuh, this looks pricey!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.10
dialogue.line: Yeah, I know. They killed him! Good thing we didn't go.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.11
dialogue.line: Well, I've heard otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.12
dialogue.line: I don't think it was a dog.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.13
dialogue.line: What the hell is it?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.15
dialogue.line: [sob]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.14
dialogue.line: They won't. But we still need to keep our eyes peeled.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.17
dialogue.line: Yeah! One more!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.16
dialogue.line: [burp]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.18
dialogue.line: Umm... No. Ask someone else.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.19
dialogue.line: So what you heard in Saint Teotim's... Maybe it was just cats fighting?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.20
dialogue.line: You must never let it! Never, you hear me?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.21
dialogue.line: Over my dead body. I'd rather sleep in the woods than walk into the Middens.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.22
dialogue.line: What are you even afraid of? It's just a bunch of ruined houses.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.23
dialogue.line: Umm, I am? Why?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.24
dialogue.line: Why don't you leave us good men alone, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.26
dialogue.line: They don't look like the trusting type to me.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.25
dialogue.line: Well, we don't have any – and you know it.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.middens.dweller.27
dialogue.line: You sure there's nothing you can do? ? Can't you... I don't know, make me invisible for a while?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_MagicVendor_1
dialogue.line: There isn't. I'd know. But it's not meant to be.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.gambler.2
dialogue.line: To hell with it all... I should be going home, anyway. The wife won't be happy...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.gambler.1
dialogue.line: You've been saying that for a couple of days now.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.gossiper.2
dialogue.line: We should do something about those thugs. Get some weapons and drive the bloody goyim out of here! My brother-in-law -

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.gossiper.1
dialogue.line: Now, Jacob - we don't know that. Eli was a jeweller. And a smart man – he probably had some valuables stashed away.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.gossip.2
dialogue.line: One of them shoved old Ezra into a wall! Dislocated his shoulder!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.gossip.1
dialogue.line: Those thugs are here again! They rob people in broad daylight! And the city watch is nowhere to be seen, of course.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.mother.1
dialogue.line: This world... Before long, it'll show our children how dreadful things can get. So let them have these moments.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.mother.2
dialogue.line: Shame to end their fun... but I'd better call David back. His father needs help at the workshop.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.debater.1
dialogue.line: You can argue with me, but will you argue with the great Judah ben Samuel of Regensburg?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Neustadt.debater.2
dialogue.line: What... what about it?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Blacksmith_1
dialogue.line: That's it. That's better.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Drunkard.3
dialogue.line: I'll fuck you up!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Drunkard.1
dialogue.line: Yeah! It's not your business how I talk to my wife!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Drunkard.2
dialogue.line: Stop... Why are you... Like, what's the point?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Gossiper.2
dialogue.line: You think things will change now?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Gossiper.1
dialogue.line: You mean after the coronation? Not for us. Knyaz or king or... whatever. It's all the same.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Clerk.1
dialogue.line: Twenty five times four and a half... Less than a hundred and fifty, so – category five.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Rascal.2
dialogue.line: Yay!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Rascal.3
dialogue.line: Four points for me!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Rascal.1
dialogue.line: This is the best!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Hustler.1
dialogue.line: Three times. Every single day - or it won't work.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Fool.1
dialogue.line: So... where exactly is this magic well?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Newcomers.1
dialogue.line: What?! You said you found us a place!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.SideGate.Newcomers.2
dialogue.line: You sure, love?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.pilgrim3
dialogue.line: The knyaz doesn't deny the old faith. He shows us the true meaning of the prophets!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.pilgrim2
dialogue.line: The cathedral... It's even bigger than I remembered!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.pilgrim1
dialogue.line: Well said, brother. Very well said indeed.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid1
dialogue.line: Will he be wearing this stupid mask all the time?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid2
dialogue.line: Pff! And mine is going to become a blood guard!

dialogue.speaker: cc.silberkreis.guard1
dialogue.line: ...and sat down and started begging out of fucking habit? Off with you!

dialogue.speaker: cc.silberkreis.beggar1
dialogue.line: I was just... passing through, I swear. I got tired and, umm...

dialogue.speaker: cc.silberkreis.guard2
dialogue.line: This is not the Middens. Get your stinking arse out of here.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.soldier1
dialogue.line: No, captain!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.soldier2
dialogue.line: No, captain!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.soldier3
dialogue.line: No, captain!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.inn_patron
dialogue.line: Eh, fucking hell...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.inn_bouncer
dialogue.line: You made a mess. And it's not that kind of inn. Go find yourself somewhere else.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid3
dialogue.line: Oh, we'll see!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid4
dialogue.line: You're too slow!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_citizen1
dialogue.line: Didn't he leave town?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_citizen2
dialogue.line: Poor Sorin. You've heard, haven't you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.guard3
dialogue.line: You've been heard disrespecting the knyaz! Singing songs that mocked him and the faith!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_citizen3
dialogue.line: You're scaring my lass! What is it about?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid4
dialogue.line: You missed a spot. Again! How many times must I tell you to pay attention?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.servant1
dialogue.line: Yes, my lady.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid6
dialogue.line: 'I humbly...', umm...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.mother
dialogue.line: Yes. Very good.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid5
dialogue.line: I'm not cattle.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.worker2
dialogue.line: Well, if they don't, you can count me out.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.worker1
dialogue.line: The foreman said we will. But he's just putting on a good face.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_drunkard
dialogue.line: One, two, three, four... Brencis is a fucking whore.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.addict1
dialogue.line: We aren't looking for company.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.addict2
dialogue.line: You're sure it will work?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.1
dialogue.line: You must be off your head!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.2
dialogue.line: You need to look more pathetic. Maybe lose some weight – or better yet, a limb!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.4
dialogue.line: Why didn't they let you in, anyway?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.3
dialogue.line: The almshouse is already full.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.guard11
dialogue.line: Fuckin' hate this job. Vile, all of it.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.guard10
dialogue.line: Off to the castle later?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_05
dialogue.line: There was a monster there, that's what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_04
dialogue.line: Oi! Sod off!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_03
dialogue.line: Aye. A bastard princeling, who died unbaptised, then came back to life – gasping for blood!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_01
dialogue.line: You don't exactly give off the scent of roses, Schimko.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid9
dialogue.line: Like I have any!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.rich_kid10
dialogue.line: Just throw something at him. That'll get his attention.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.inspector
dialogue.line: You son of a whore!

dialogue.speaker: c.c.Silberkreis.tatar.2
dialogue.line: Bustling, eh? Compared to Tantari.

dialogue.speaker: c.c.Silberkreis.tatar.3
dialogue.line: Why? You mind your coin purse, or you'll find out soon.

dialogue.speaker: c.c.Silberkreis.tatar.1
dialogue.line: Oh? Why?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SilberkreisInnKeeper
dialogue.line: You've had enough, friend. Time to go home.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_ceremony_father
dialogue.line: What's the occasion?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SilberkreisInnKeeper
dialogue.line: The tables won't clean themselves. If you start now, you'll finish in time.

dialogue.speaker: c.c.Silberkreis.pilgrim7
dialogue.line: So what, we travelled all day for nothing? We're not going to get to see the cathedral?

dialogue.speaker: c.c.Silberkreis.pilgrim6
dialogue.line: Yes, but did you check?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.guard7
dialogue.line: What were we supposed to do? Sleep out in the streets?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.guard12
dialogue.line: Want to end up in the dungeons? No? Then scram!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.6
dialogue.line: Maybe that's what the knyaz really wants. Maybe this Coen of Laslea isn't even real!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.5
dialogue.line: This blockade – it'll be the end of us.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.7
dialogue.line: I have a bad feeling about this. Mark my words, there'll be bloodshed, and soon.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.silberkreis.homeless.8
dialogue.line: Word of advice, Mira.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Soldiers.4
dialogue.line: Mhm.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Soldiers.2
dialogue.line: Evening.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Soldiers.3
dialogue.line: We'll see.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.Kuferplatz.Soldiers.1
dialogue.line: Will there be more today?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TheSteps.Noble.2
dialogue.line: You'll have it back, one day. I promise you that.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TheSteps.Noble.1
dialogue.line: Whatever happened to Ilian? Do you have any idea?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TheSteps.Gallant
dialogue.line: The figure of a goddess! Would you like to walk with me?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TheSteps.Noble.Stairs.2
dialogue.line: You're not getting anything from me!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TheSteps.Noble.Stairs.1
dialogue.line: Poor soul.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Random_Post_Guard1
dialogue.line: When you block, don’t absorb the blow – redirect it!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Post_Soldier1
dialogue.line: Think Yenno would let me have a jug of mead on credit? Just this once.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Medic_3
dialogue.line: Need patching up? I’ve got you.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Medic_3
dialogue.line: You really know your herbs, don’t you, Sara?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: That nettle stops bleeding, but it can actually slow down the healing process if overused.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: You know, ever since you saved me… I’ve been thinking.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_Rebel7
dialogue.line: We’ll be better prepared next time.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_Rebel6
dialogue.line: We should never have gone in blind.

dialogue.speaker: DBFC64FE47E59EFE6C0B0EBF236C93D2
dialogue.line: Exit

dialogue.speaker: DDF27FBE4AFED7287CB7F297AAD412E9
dialogue.line: Fast Travel

dialogue.speaker: 1EFEAAB7414609D483B9668123B78C32
dialogue.line: Perks

dialogue.speaker: 01DDAB174D6DE2E4A370CA876BA4717A
dialogue.line: Storage

dialogue.speaker: DB9CACD74868C79A9D8CB99B69C356E4
dialogue.line: Wait

dialogue.speaker: 64530B58410DBC9A24B2CF9A0E71304D
dialogue.line: All eyes here, men!

dialogue.speaker: 342963A543F9E39EA5225986D9282A95
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: 5E20B81C4EFCFD3B10CC9F99B05E98B4
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: 71F52ED54B770CCF1D4172A277BD96C0
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: 791DCEA147CEA9BB53158DB21F5D1B7D
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: 8884127541EA357BCA544EB8F017A030
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: 8D35E2E74B6C9A856E2007B3C8C83BB3
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: ED4E85344D12A62DCB7645A97F22DCDA
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: 32F563AB46D91548F14C8DA9F895E2B4
dialogue.line: Drogos?

dialogue.speaker: 3ACB796D49EF9D73D4CBC0B109882B47
dialogue.line: Listen. None of us has any love for the vrakhiri. We’d watch them burn and call it justice. But this one… he’s different. The sun didn’t take him.

dialogue.speaker: D5B194E74D1DA7E8CC663788C9A748B5
dialogue.line: Nay.

dialogue.speaker: 271ABE4247054942F8976DB66A929410
dialogue.line: So, tell me, men… Should Coen become one of us?

dialogue.speaker: 15E1D3A248F46A542EEEB593A287550E
dialogue.line: Tell anyone about this – and you’re a dead man.

dialogue.speaker: 1ADF18CB48F793EE4000B0973EDA2B5C
dialogue.line: The half-vrakhir...

dialogue.speaker: FC9BB0854769607A3714F1AFD08DF1F7
dialogue.line: This is Coen!

dialogue.speaker: 4E94C0174EA2BCD15F3170931A2A1DC5
dialogue.line: We could use strength like his. And he has already proven his worth.

dialogue.speaker: 1DA2EEF94277BE8742A37C9CD5294317
dialogue.line: You've won the vote, Coen. You’re one of us now.

dialogue.speaker: A7DD749840B0002C5B352393AB98BD09
dialogue.line: Aaaargh! Stop!

dialogue.speaker: A31940824A261C3756383FAA668BB90B
dialogue.line: Be proud of yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 868CA36C465437C1A477CBAC645CC634
dialogue.line: Coen, go barricade the door.

dialogue.speaker: 7BE62F7248F158F881B590AF5506DC29
dialogue.line: Could've what?! Huh? What?!

dialogue.speaker: 5E68792F4710B713B71FC5BB39CC318F
dialogue.line: Crake, we could've –

dialogue.speaker: 100ED06F47B20FE7581E27BECD53F727
dialogue.line: I can't feel my arm. Crake, I can't feel it!

dialogue.speaker: 02E3863F4B653ABD5BD2D59DA0F24374
dialogue.line: I... I can't get up.

dialogue.speaker: 973E648841B0759CC48E48902C72AE6C
dialogue.line: Let's get the hell out of here.

dialogue.speaker: 263482AC40292C93D63BC583748A0063
dialogue.line: No...

dialogue.speaker: 8AE2F4564C272861E7423795A7D99895
dialogue.line: Oh God, oh God, no...

dialogue.speaker: 3EE74A614D590BE7CA1D8D8CF57E14F4
dialogue.line: Sara?

dialogue.speaker: BD67608D4BD432E4CD574184DB9C62FA
dialogue.line: She knew too much. And the guards will be here any time now.

dialogue.speaker: 63427E31416682CF63568D8D71456013
dialogue.line: She's awake.

dialogue.speaker: 33F0824D4414EA6773E52EA0D759C380
dialogue.line: Shh. It's fine. You'll be fine.

dialogue.speaker: 20DB6644425F0201A6D929AA3AC60295
dialogue.line: Shh. Look me in the eyes.

dialogue.speaker: 5C2F100E45E5F24E693EE5A8F87A948A
dialogue.line: Still here.

dialogue.speaker: 853ADF834C68B05CAA7B0DA3F66019AF
dialogue.line: Take my hand.

dialogue.speaker: C2FBF20D4616FCC4C3E05F9B28512057
dialogue.line: They’re close. We have to move, and fast!

dialogue.speaker: 1D5D58A24B89D63C0A1F3A82A39F9251
dialogue.line: We have to go, now.

dialogue.speaker: 323BC32D426399E7F36DA594A8407777
dialogue.line: What?! Why?!

dialogue.speaker: 4A5249844B9F99CF9CDA85848209ACDE
dialogue.line: You did well.

dialogue.speaker: 608A1A7A48DF725EFE9E9B9B62089E2C
dialogue.line: 'Aurelius'… Crake, I think I’ve got something.

dialogue.speaker: E9C8422F487D961038ED529C764E9DB8
dialogue.line: Coen!

dialogue.speaker: 726DE0BB4A9F95E7BD517ABED2F68E68
dialogue.line: Crake!

dialogue.speaker: 820272EA479687735980ACB02F230BF1
dialogue.line: Rrrgh!

dialogue.speaker: 301_1st_soldier03
dialogue.line: No, no, no!!!

dialogue.speaker: 301_1st_soldier04
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: B63F88264199CE14A2BAAF9662ACA4C2
dialogue.line: Not so tough without your master, huh?

dialogue.speaker: 481F16B0482F6346973981AC8E597A6D
dialogue.line: Out.

dialogue.speaker: 921A77A34D38FFA294CFF3BEFF3FF381
dialogue.line: They’re useless, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: 68C6BE854E8634EEDB3499B3EA44F03F
dialogue.line: Ugh…

dialogue.speaker: F6738A974267A93DB20B6BB6633056A9
dialogue.line: No!

dialogue.speaker: EB92077B44C366F6FD9EAF98B4A2973C
dialogue.line: Tsk. Had you taken a bit longer, I could’ve given you a proper welcome… my son.

dialogue.speaker: 3AA0237C4D876F49729B349B8B71E528
dialogue.line: Lunka...?

dialogue.speaker: F50D1AC04BEECCA0B236B59863A616BB
dialogue.line: No, no. God, no!

dialogue.speaker: BE6CDBA54F50BA8CB0F8AAB497060D98
dialogue.line: This is my final gift to you.

dialogue.speaker: B2BF7BF944BC54769D44E2A9A8D40F97
dialogue.line: [laugh]

dialogue.speaker: 582F14504D02369390ACA493B3A40856
dialogue.line: Ghhhhha…

dialogue.speaker: 959D941F48B9D8E9263BECA8BB77444C
dialogue.line: I promise.

dialogue.speaker: 2A50A3C24F467070C3708498B9933797
dialogue.line: I will fix it.

dialogue.speaker: 2DA9093C493EFE2DC377258F1F99731C
dialogue.line: Last goodbye…

dialogue.speaker: 189621734A4E64D5B766749EBBD959E0
dialogue.line: Shh.

dialogue.speaker: Xante
dialogue.line: Don’t. Please. Stay your hand!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.XantheDaughter
dialogue.line: [hums]

dialogue.speaker: F27D50E6480B857CF7FD0BAD6599D0A3
dialogue.line: Faster! Why doesn't it move faster?! Goddamn it!

dialogue.speaker: 3600536B4FCB7DC649C79381F0FAE937
dialogue.line: Hurry up there, Coen!

dialogue.speaker: 4377FEDB4568BA996A388BA2EE74D0B4
dialogue.line: Coen too? Shouldn’t he be flying or something?

dialogue.speaker: D8D974464944DB5FE4B44390F628F574
dialogue.line: Done. Go signal Catalin.

dialogue.speaker: C1015DD24787744E9DC2EEB474632F89
dialogue.line: Double check your knots. We only get one shot at this.

dialogue.speaker: BCE7550B4779A8E0A76D40B93A2AF306
dialogue.line: Enough talking. Focus on the knots. Both of you.

dialogue.speaker: 89E674014D81450C94320EB16CB378E7
dialogue.line: It's a long way down, Coen. Better double-check that knot.

dialogue.speaker: 8111CF4D4CB8105AE810DB950040BADE
dialogue.line: Mind your own rope, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 0CC9D91D4A47804583CD79A9C0F39FF4
dialogue.line: Mind your own rope.

dialogue.speaker: 0D85F89B47AB56D9D526B08E827DF0E0
dialogue.line: Not during the day, I'm afraid.

dialogue.speaker: 6E6BECE642EB376A82EDE4AB54B720F5
dialogue.line: Not during the day...

dialogue.speaker: 6416367044C2EAB0B83F5DB61D70DC65
dialogue.line: On it.

dialogue.speaker: B2E8C66F4F68F33910B90D8B2CB2E1B9
dialogue.line: Peace and quiet...

dialogue.speaker: F2227BFC467A88B480E58B8CEA89CB41
dialogue.line: Right, right... Sorry...

dialogue.speaker: 14817AD5481DC481F7150E8EE32572ED
dialogue.line: Shouldn't he be flying?

dialogue.speaker: EAF3410A4F70AD1AE8B6F28D913828CA
dialogue.line: They'll sound the alarm the moment we get down.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.POI.OB111.Soldier01
dialogue.line: This here – it's just rocks. Good enough for the goats!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What gold?

dialogue.speaker: 57B062144FAE3EF65FA20F824DF1991D
dialogue.line: I don't negotiate with vrakhiri's men.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.POI.OB111.Soldier02
dialogue.line: The real treasure... we hid it. And we'll tell you where - if you let us go!

dialogue.speaker: A285593F4835ACB1E8E485BD9199836B
dialogue.line: Supposed to...?

dialogue.speaker: 41D51869433DAC4EAF65C5BD0E3194C2
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.715_messenger
dialogue.line: Oyez, oyez! Listen now, and listen closely, for I am about to read knyaz Brencis's very words!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.hhpoi102_leader
dialogue.line: You've made some bad decisions!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.hhpoi103_witch
dialogue.line: Stop resisting.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.hhpoi103_knight
dialogue.line: You won't win this!

dialogue.speaker: 98D7DB2E4E7D5B695105F480DD70A288
dialogue.line: Shut your yap if you know what's good for you.

dialogue.speaker: F2569429411F4B1509B8728C89E7A428
dialogue.line: You want this blade in your guts?! No?! Then stop your fucking whinging!

dialogue.speaker: 09F14D804057843571AAC0A746832F7B
dialogue.line: You want to see your family again? You'll do as I bloody say!

dialogue.speaker: 3097FADF4922DF7EF0305AA0AECEC6A9
dialogue.line: Had enough of your guts? Want them out?

dialogue.speaker: 61254DBF4BD9859F3B574E97B243D75E
dialogue.line: What did you say? Huh?

dialogue.speaker: 83B0641D408DB75CB91A559DF0160059
dialogue.line: You'll get it if you want it.

dialogue.speaker: 362DEAEC4C589888138902B3BF8906C8
dialogue.line: Fuck this day and fuck you, too.

dialogue.speaker: 48A9A17E45DA77D68088BE8D998A85B0
dialogue.line: I might let you pick how you want to die, would you like that?

dialogue.speaker: D2DE5CD94390FB0349A959B4BE40A975
dialogue.line: I'll make myself a necklace out of your teeth after I kick them in.

dialogue.speaker: BD7C6CBF4CE23907654D05AB58CBB22A
dialogue.line: Careful, there.

dialogue.speaker: 07D3598A4D385C8AE1FE228E61013627
dialogue.line: I'll gut you without thinking if you piss me off.

dialogue.speaker: 00A6D21446CE2C5E6DC8CFB4FAAF72FF
dialogue.line: Who do you think you're dealing with here, huh?

dialogue.speaker: C94D149F4F9E175B1156C9953B2658E5
dialogue.line: Are you bored of your life or something?

dialogue.speaker: 541FE3634D5989CDC96247AFC5E47EA8
dialogue.line: Oh, isn't that cute?

dialogue.speaker: 49271583432B9B145F73FC9E980D7212
dialogue.line: What are you gaping at?!

dialogue.speaker: 56DB05C24291ADE56608F284545AAA5F
dialogue.line: I don't give a rat's arse about what you want.

dialogue.speaker: 8F1100CE490933059CA44FBEEB91424D
dialogue.line: Time's up, bitch.

dialogue.speaker: 8F5F3D3B416626912D7197BC1342AC38
dialogue.line: You can't talk me out of it. Don't waste your stinking breath trying.

dialogue.speaker: 13AA9F3148D4ACF3D35DF7A3BB7FA4B4
dialogue.line: Aw, you scared?

dialogue.speaker: E1509851468E4DD5E9D83B9EFF522B1F
dialogue.line: I think it ends here, don't you?

dialogue.speaker: 3DB175A54065F58452AD05AEDBC2D521
dialogue.line: I've about had it with you oafs...

dialogue.speaker: 3D5EFA394732F16E1045459F5CFDA498
dialogue.line: Let's see if we have anything... unsavoury here.

dialogue.speaker: 38E57B684570DA983C41158AB29AE5AB
dialogue.line: Oh, you better be carting some good shit here. I'm bored out of my mind today...

dialogue.speaker: 2987300F4E4311E7C76FE7AEDDD80FBE
dialogue.line: What do we have here?

dialogue.speaker: 605A952E4E123772845DDDA1190C12A9
dialogue.line: Hm... Maybe we could come to an understanding here...

dialogue.speaker: 1362BBCD4AB6C809B1902DA4189B1903
dialogue.line: I have a feeling you did not report everything on this cart. Isn't that so?

dialogue.speaker: 1AAEBF21439246C1185EC5AEDA48BBED
dialogue.line: Well, well, well... I guess this trip is over.

dialogue.speaker: 42818B0C426AD062A6FB48A2E61DAEF6
dialogue.line: Always.

dialogue.speaker: B107F58D440273C8B01FB0B5D85501C1
dialogue.line: Always.

dialogue.speaker: 6FFD087D4B7580F15682E48186D49C8D
dialogue.line: Be on your way now.

dialogue.speaker: A03CF633486B55E76535F4AE00339581
dialogue.line: Be on your way now.

dialogue.speaker: 7921C66E46320AD516729C8998B204E6
dialogue.line: Bless you.

dialogue.speaker: AF8CD4A84049D1FFE54093AE6C5BEA6A
dialogue.line: Many, many thanks to you. Good to know someone still cares to help us.

dialogue.speaker: B71E00594BAB2108E9D0C49861AD669F
dialogue.line: Of course. Good luck to you.

dialogue.speaker: D06E08F342C507B6F7888692C13076F8
dialogue.line: Coen of Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: 053E525F40A946E943FBAE9C9867C2D1
dialogue.line: Glad I could help you out in a moment of need.

dialogue.speaker: 669196AB40B1738B983C6095B6FDDB7E
dialogue.line: I shan't ever forget what you did for me. Thank you again.

dialogue.speaker: 6718279A40F4704D0C79949322ABB0F1
dialogue.line: I'm Coen of Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: BC28BA5846803E197999A49FA09125B0
dialogue.line: Important to me. But I'll respect it. Fare well.

dialogue.speaker: 403F5C2448A080A9E605CB9F6DAC04E3
dialogue.line: Laslea? Oh, God have mercy on all of you.

dialogue.speaker: 7554DEDE45C69E7D2E238E8EA7AB5A6E
dialogue.line: Nobody important.

dialogue.speaker: EEDF05CB44CF6260193F30BF1CFB639E
dialogue.line: Nobody important.

dialogue.speaker: 73B101E44AFD8A4EA38A8BAF3FA89703
dialogue.line: Oh, God! Thank you! I was certain I was going to die here!

dialogue.speaker: CC82C9C7477A4D893C5293B48BE600AA
dialogue.line: Who–who are you?

dialogue.speaker: 56285F894834BB7D6B8496B233111B4D
dialogue.line: But you did. Bless you. Bless you!

dialogue.speaker: BFB79C0E4A13347851D9B8B9FC98CD93
dialogue.line: I thought I was done for. Done for!

dialogue.speaker: 226685FF4CB77726CCB00CBC9ED561F5
dialogue.line: Oh, I've never been so glad to have been wrong. No, sir.

dialogue.speaker: 55AEDBD64C2E441E244E1287E70521CF
dialogue.line: So did I, to be fair.

dialogue.speaker: C68E999D4128F8822CA906A70010569C
dialogue.line: So did I, to be fair. Wasn't sure I'd get you out of this in time.

dialogue.speaker: 9D270AED4BBFBAFC2E7F85887CD17A94
dialogue.line: Well, you were wrong.

dialogue.speaker: C484194C4A30B7DE7AAD308217464AD1
dialogue.line: Well, you were wrong.

dialogue.speaker: B6D618E94E1DBB8433630AAFA09AEF38
dialogue.line: Ah, didn't want to muck up your fun. You seemed to be enjoying yourself. Cheers, lad.

dialogue.speaker: F1880D2646B2868A5C493CBB478213E0
dialogue.line: Could've joined me, you know.

dialogue.speaker: 589A833E449A32E6CB2D07BF259004EA
dialogue.line: Could've joined me.

dialogue.speaker: 372C3EED447A52AFA91264A8630AAAD2
dialogue.line: Hey! I was about to kick some arse here. But thanks, I suppose?

dialogue.speaker: 887DC64C464B8B67338A7DAD59FA5C33
dialogue.line: I'm sure you'll get another chance soon enough...

dialogue.speaker: 256A03BA4562A28C53B6DFA6B420284D
dialogue.line: I'm sure you'll get another chance.

dialogue.speaker: B5C7E7454F9BAE7E3745C1A66A96A1CD
dialogue.line: Sure, can't wait! Could use an ale first, though. Or two. Yeeeah.

dialogue.speaker: A32B71E545EF8762A700F3B6641FDCDA
dialogue.line: Go home, now. It's over.

dialogue.speaker: 135CB9654E714066B5FED19F8E4F5CBF
dialogue.line: Good luck on the road.

dialogue.speaker: E67D8F8E492FA483B585728280A61DE1
dialogue.line: Good luck on the road.

dialogue.speaker: 4AE252474E212310671ADA960F07FDB5
dialogue.line: I will, I will. Have to cherish every day. You never know...

dialogue.speaker: C92B4C194AF6328B75758EBBEB73D7C1
dialogue.line: It's over, you can go home now and be with them.

dialogue.speaker: 12066CB44A41EAFE0E6D89A89A3CD29D
dialogue.line: May God watch over me so I don't need it again...

dialogue.speaker: FB5B11A74DD4AFAFEEBB949BCE3595B8
dialogue.line: Thought I'd never see my baby again...

dialogue.speaker: 3F3639264132FE5F7255BD903B48DE94
dialogue.line: It is over, indeed.

dialogue.speaker: 745F6BFB41C6EEB894416D9DAD6A42FC
dialogue.line: It is over.

dialogue.speaker: 1261C09A4A53CDBD770AEAA2974E9713
dialogue.line: It's over? I can't believe it.

dialogue.speaker: 79443F874F9917BFBB2470AE204A7421
dialogue.line: Puts all the daily strife into perspective, doesn't it? Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: F1D0D6FB470C19D097AC908A840CBB6D
dialogue.line: Thank you. Yes...

dialogue.speaker: D106F79643C91884848B40A0EAA3AECF
dialogue.line: Well, I'll leave you to it.

dialogue.speaker: DAD1813A4325728CC73D7B84A79BDD94
dialogue.line: Well, I'll leave you to it.

dialogue.speaker: 95FEBF454CABA117CD20FB9DC9A49BC8
dialogue.line: Good for you.

dialogue.speaker: BE5A86154951E4B4D034A7B513F03ECC
dialogue.line: Good for you.

dialogue.speaker: 28937D1B4ADBA320955DCAAD399808C6
dialogue.line: How did you know?

dialogue.speaker: E260D32941D25DC5E3C024B22E292512
dialogue.line: How did you know?

dialogue.speaker: 9B38710A4CF58258635472A039D8DC18
dialogue.line: I knew it! I knew someone would help me!

dialogue.speaker: CF56F0744AC83000374C9BA9EFC001BD
dialogue.line: I've got to go tell my sister. Thanks, lad.

dialogue.speaker: F403D1664D2C9688928245B3E9577394
dialogue.line: My sister told me I'll live till sixty. She's got them gifts, you know. Seeing the future. I've got to go now. Many thanks.

dialogue.speaker: 9E00B7604CC53A69B2F8388A27BE0F0B
dialogue.line: Calm down, it's over.

dialogue.speaker: FFE489FE46AB1DAFA563209B783BF8DD
dialogue.line: Calm down, it's over.

dialogue.speaker: 9425D0154F2560F6ED93EF86C4A85249
dialogue.line: Calm down?! They'll come back for us! They'll know!

dialogue.speaker: E5CEAED84870F4AEB5FA2AB02C40F0C5
dialogue.line: Oh God... Oh God, you killed his men! You killed the boyar's men!

dialogue.speaker: 541C1498423454D975E6F0815CE07A90
dialogue.line: Oh shit, oh fuck... What are we going to do?! Get away from us! Get away!

dialogue.speaker: 171B9B8345126FCEFEF07D9FD59BDD03
dialogue.line: Welcome? You clueless oaf! You think the boyar won't know?! Leave it be?! You just dug our graves!

dialogue.speaker: AF4E62F14CCEE8DB49A40D8BE1C3CD3C
dialogue.line: Yes, you're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: BDB2A0654AAD0A8F7B30E0A5E12CBDE3
dialogue.line: Yes, you're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: 6046477A4068DED05AACC48EE8832045
dialogue.line: I just might. Farewell.

dialogue.speaker: 06B4F08B4170F6687C0E97A2367EADAC
dialogue.line: Life flashed before your eyes?

dialogue.speaker: 2893C5434E674354DEC679A28988296E
dialogue.line: Life flashed before your eyes?

dialogue.speaker: 246B24D04344001907CDBDABB5CE12CA
dialogue.line: Look, I don't like to be in debt to anyone. Come by my store in Svartrau – I'll give you something in return for your trouble.

dialogue.speaker: 29CBE39844E6DB07DB1463896913243F
dialogue.line: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: 36121E024809FDB122A201B351C30E4E
dialogue.line: Of course. I was nearby.

dialogue.speaker: 1F6526374FAFA5AA7723B1AFD8E78F92
dialogue.line: To be honest with you? No. Head was empty as my dog's dumbass stare.

dialogue.speaker: 9254F6E34368B119CB413EAC78BDED62
dialogue.line: Well, fuck me, I thought it was the end. Thanks, mate.

dialogue.speaker: CCD8E9B44CBC0BCA9B510B8C9276B0E4
dialogue.line: Yeah. Stay safe, mate.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Your daughter is dead.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Maragir_Armorer
dialogue.line: You will? I don't – Thank you. Please, let me know as soon as you have some news.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Maragir_Medic
dialogue.line: You look a bit rough, lad. Got a rash? Chafing armour? Weak from blood loss?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You might have something to help...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Merchants.laslea_blacksmith
dialogue.line: Well, for a price...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Unless you think you can slay four vrakhiri, then no, I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.InnkeepOutskirts
dialogue.line: Yes? Can I do anything for you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_MagicVendor_1
dialogue.line: Your family taken... In mortal danger...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What? That doesn't make any sense.

dialogue.speaker: 28FD905A4A4DDCF8D5CDF7B30CAAC674
dialogue.line: Gewandhausplatz... Heart of commerce.

dialogue.speaker: 8859E0B04C53366E1443DCA640789F5F
dialogue.line: Middens. Respectable folks give it a wide berth.

dialogue.speaker: B17AB3164D6796306E40DDB477AF2596
dialogue.line: Neustadt. Home of the Jewish community.

dialogue.speaker: D137549B465D8574539E3EA2FD31CC40
dialogue.line: Silberstein. Poshest quarter of the city.

dialogue.speaker: BE3BC6264D37E11158093791F4138680
dialogue.line: St. Rudel's cemetery... Filled to the brim with victims of the plague.

dialogue.speaker: 94AAD8604BD9F7A73DDE18BC2418A848
dialogue.line: Svartrau Cathedral... Dwarfs everything around it.

dialogue.speaker: 3425B3E74C3E78AF1DAD80837D7C5B49
dialogue.line: The keep of Greifberg looms over the city...

dialogue.speaker: E65CE6E84926D6B35EA8B5B21A75C3F9
dialogue.line: Oh, my God! Somebody! Please!

dialogue.speaker: 861C767B4CD073FB4F8218A5CDBFED6C
dialogue.line: You've got to be shitting me!

dialogue.speaker: D583A2754D308F911D09C1B42646417D
dialogue.line: Leave me alone! Please! God, why me?!

dialogue.speaker: 31CCAEE94B845264111FB68E1EF5C464
dialogue.line: You furry bastard, you want it? Come get it!

dialogue.speaker: 734010B84D3CD82C149FE4B3C73244AA
dialogue.line: Think I'm afraid of you?!

dialogue.speaker: 1128A21D4046F7177545638BD64EA3E0
dialogue.line: What – what do you want from me?!

dialogue.speaker: 7ABCA87A4FA1576527B93EB79D1D15A2
dialogue.line: Go away! Shoo! Shoo! Aaah!

dialogue.speaker: 9F27FE234028764B58F5B498ACA93424
dialogue.line: Oh fucking hell!

dialogue.speaker: 1A845FA249EB720290C5E8A003205F3E
dialogue.line: A stroke of luck when it mattered most. And I thought I had none in life. Be well, young man.

dialogue.speaker: 9AD0934F4348B94EFD16518301524FA5
dialogue.line: Dear Lord, what timing you had! Thank you, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: 6E477E4C48597F85AE7419943EC95F5E
dialogue.line: Don't mention it – I couldn't have let you die.

dialogue.speaker: DB68762249538D8E7EF293BFE8ACF353
dialogue.line: Don't mention it.

dialogue.speaker: B073A3E543B79798AFAFEDB2B0330A5D
dialogue.line: It's what I do – arrive in time and save the day.

dialogue.speaker: A460CDE647153FF5FC6592B7D8B3BB07
dialogue.line: Oh, but you could've! Many would've. May God watch over you, young man.

dialogue.speaker: 5B81BF2542B72884011C94BCCB5012C3
dialogue.line: You're fortunate I was passing by.

dialogue.speaker: AA6E5F764A8754470A4103B68FC19D0B
dialogue.line: Bleed? If only! The guts are everywhere...

dialogue.speaker: 60C2099442E2DCFD5813DDB9C69159B0
dialogue.line: Huh? What? Oh. Oh, the guts are everywhere... and the blood...

dialogue.speaker: 8E66DD5E40B101CF847F33AC8DE482A7
dialogue.line: Oh, stuff of nightmares... God Almighty.

dialogue.speaker: 1BFF04E24520A02DB1A5A5A8AE6D1F62
dialogue.line: Oh, whatever. You do you.

dialogue.speaker: DFB674DE46DFB9FC2EBC62B2B4960851
dialogue.line: Yeah, it's not pretty.

dialogue.speaker: 7864492F40D9B94FD0C0AAA509D47EE3
dialogue.line: Yeah, it's not pretty. But what can you do? Things bleed.

dialogue.speaker: A4C5D57F457780D556E8F4BBA09B587C
dialogue.line: Yeah... maybe... Oh, I don't know...

dialogue.speaker: DF520A7F4D5628734E3104B4EFC35903
dialogue.line: You'll get over it – at least you'll get to try. Being alive.

dialogue.speaker: 1B4AA597497F25932CD8208D73F4CB8D
dialogue.line: You're welcome?

dialogue.speaker: BB6D686C481077F43288CCAF2693AED5
dialogue.line: You're welcome?

dialogue.speaker: E355660A4F1D574390872FB6AFAD06B7
dialogue.line: Ah, but it's not your problem, is it? Thank you for your help. Truly. I... I'll get my things sorted. Always do.

dialogue.speaker: E587AB344A5051E766002C84B456FB3F
dialogue.line: And what for? So my rotten luck can torment me yet another day?

dialogue.speaker: 01A54B6E44689FE04A3B86917768B5C4
dialogue.line: Could've been worse, no?

dialogue.speaker: 1988EE55415FCF6A9F3915B90D4E8947
dialogue.line: Could've been worse, no? You're still alive.

dialogue.speaker: 0287470C4D9462043FE06DAB27B0EEA5
dialogue.line: I don't know. Life's unfair.

dialogue.speaker: 99D0B2F243B903687BE89DA6C8298F68
dialogue.line: I don't know. Life's unfair.

dialogue.speaker: 341108294C782065048702A9CB2CA2CE
dialogue.line: It's always the same. Day in and day out, something's got to go wrong.

dialogue.speaker: D1291E7244E51DAD894F38B2551CA097
dialogue.line: Why? What have I done to deserve this? Why me?

dialogue.speaker: 8141CC3C4F0BF49160E50C996D4BCF22
dialogue.line: Have to make sure it works, yeah? Be well.

dialogue.speaker: B13949B04AF1D1F417DDC6ACF0D3A065
dialogue.line: I hope that fate will reward you for it. I'll pray for you daily – to God and the vrakhiri alike!

dialogue.speaker: 14B136E94426EAF5C634BF8C5042B517
dialogue.line: I'm glad I could help.

dialogue.speaker: 5C07A6784DEA351E372ACE9EBC305D26
dialogue.line: I'm just glad I could help.

dialogue.speaker: F5916B4A4B2DCEC47F410E907897A5D0
dialogue.line: Oh, and am I glad you could help, too!

dialogue.speaker: DD0604954D0A30D61BAB74BE900BC696
dialogue.line: Why yes, I am.

dialogue.speaker: 21AC08BE4F39718EC1E93D82B2D77536
dialogue.line: Why, yes, I am.

dialogue.speaker: 10B721E5481067AD50E0808FB2F3DFCB
dialogue.line: You! You are a boon from the Heavens!

dialogue.speaker: A1CC374748F3BBF37C7A27A87463FD33
dialogue.line: I'm not used to getting a helping hand, got to say. What a pleasant feeling. Might just pay it forward.

dialogue.speaker: 53666BE34CCF3359927739AFCC84960D
dialogue.line: Not today, I guess, there's business to handle. But one day. Maybe.

dialogue.speaker: 39D4E09347E105B9F076A99174729AF8
dialogue.line: Oh, another bleeding heart? It's almost a shame I have to kill you now, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: 9191FBD049F613EC7D6D9BB098696C7D
dialogue.line: Thank you, lad. I shouldn't have got into this situation where I need help, but... eh. You know how it is sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: 2D4B6C914A0018A1021F47938CC79C6B
dialogue.line: I wonder how old these are… and who this hero was.

dialogue.speaker: BA131C914647A5600E34CB96354C3E3D
dialogue.line: Monsters come through these… magical rifts?

dialogue.speaker: DE7477F744CDD38BE79D9F9F5B8E6B54
dialogue.line: Perhaps this was some kind of trial for the hero.

dialogue.speaker: D3E73DF54C85237044DD899BA6CA313F
dialogue.line: What is this symbol? A snake, perhaps?

dialogue.speaker: D7F139554FFCEDFE4135E6BA5ED451C1
dialogue.line: A hero, long gone...

dialogue.speaker: E3D5199343722F677202F5ADD5C3AE3E
dialogue.line: Hmm. I don't recognise that creature.

dialogue.speaker: AB584876483E93A98B36D6BCF7EEA153
dialogue.line: The monster struck, leaving the hero bloodied, but he still stands. Ready to finish the challenge?

dialogue.speaker: EF5EB3554FCC6826339B158AB9E50C9A
dialogue.line: A large spider is creeping over her, yet she doesn’t seem to notice.

dialogue.speaker: B3AE3D39471855B7FD0117BAE73C7975
dialogue.line: I guess the sorceress made the mistake of celebrating victory before killing all the monsters.

dialogue.speaker: C72106124150F7089B27F7B906DB89AC
dialogue.line: I wager she has slain these monsters.

dialogue.speaker: 3544479A40C91FA7026914A274A0A563
dialogue.line: Red robes, an eerie aura. A sorceress?

dialogue.speaker: 168FFB5442A40A0F09EAE0A080D2D591
dialogue.line: Huh. What charming monsters might these be?

dialogue.speaker: 11281F9543AFF755E1D4409A9C51A645
dialogue.line: Those fallen wear the same armour as the three. Their comrades?

dialogue.speaker: AF429BED4E3A4481774459A71427B1FA
dialogue.line: Three warriors. All wounded.

dialogue.speaker: 78DDF7AE4D19C9AE1E57B98E43B01276
dialogue.line: Vrakhiri or wraiths...? Were the warriors at war with them?

dialogue.speaker: AE8504C14BDF8018B8B1A690D17E084F
dialogue.line: Could it be an ancient vrakhir?

dialogue.speaker: 112DE2FB45151DE3793928B001963146
dialogue.line: I suppose the hero was hunting the old vrakhir... and succeeded.

dialogue.speaker: 25116F5D480EE1B18C21888E3E60C287
dialogue.line: Quite the duel.

dialogue.speaker: 5B63FCF944787DCA6DBE11A4B0376D86
dialogue.line: A manumit place, I guess. But no trace to follow. Pity.

dialogue.speaker: C8186CFB4E10A53ED3D0139D28C59849
dialogue.line: Ah, so this is where they craft the goods for the weaver’s shop. And for my dear friends hiding beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: 3CF1FED8418A59E040598694C52DE5C6
dialogue.line: An interesting read – and a dangerous one.

dialogue.speaker: F986BA914AC7AA9D2604009B40231D2C
dialogue.line: Huh, what do we have here?

dialogue.speaker: DDBF1A14445E3252E3BEE292A9818C2E
dialogue.line: If I found it, Brencis's men might too. I'd better warn Drogos.

dialogue.speaker: 8EBC29294DF2DF340650F0AFC06AD869
dialogue.line: Just a weaving workshop... or is it? Those look like banners.

dialogue.speaker: 60F069BF4C62E6710683F99006238F55
dialogue.line: That’s Skender’s banner, freshly woven. Curious.

dialogue.speaker: 278F54984492AA6D5403C68825D270A0
dialogue.line: These sashes... the manumits wear them.

dialogue.speaker: 7DA228684519E29E19962E94CA66A12C
dialogue.line: A man of deep faith, huh?

dialogue.speaker: 55E9EBD24CF9874CA5CC21B3E6A46C47
dialogue.line: Better copy their locations onto my map.

dialogue.speaker: 23FD92894F71E15FD72840BDCBBD26D6
dialogue.line: Drawings of the shrines, calculations... He must have spent a lot of time on these.

dialogue.speaker: 3B2AA661460C4297F4E813AD9F4B90CA
dialogue.line: Drawings of the shrines, calculations... Someone must have spent a lot of time on these.

dialogue.speaker: E13C465E41BE52FDA8D4AA94F12288AC
dialogue.line: Dried up... Hasn't been used in a while, now.

dialogue.speaker: C6C3D34D4A727E8CC5EF9FBD18BB2040
dialogue.line: Guess I've got everything I need to know.

dialogue.speaker: DA57ED1C4C4BB15AB137729642CA54AD
dialogue.line: Hidden shrines... Interesting.

dialogue.speaker: 803B0161402250C8DE3560A0D4E66B47
dialogue.line: I should be able to find all those shrines now.

dialogue.speaker: 3CADF5814267C8D42E6FD487910BC38D
dialogue.line: Let’s have a look...

dialogue.speaker: A0722C3A449AE90FB0BA74BCBA6C11C8
dialogue.line: This quill looks costly. I guess the guy spared no expense on his research.

dialogue.speaker: D538AC274EFBDA9791D5F59DA0B603EB
dialogue.line: Guess this place’s been abandoned for a while now.

dialogue.speaker: D334040E43183BF6A0A63AA039998355
dialogue.line: It's a hex... I think I can learn it.

dialogue.speaker: 3CEA152B41327D64531395A198D9D617
dialogue.line: Let's see...

dialogue.speaker: F63DA11F434E2FA0CA101A9C7FAEF2AC
dialogue.line: Quite an eye-catching book. Latin, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 0F67CDF14AA7626066B45C88FDF2B766
dialogue.line: Seems like a pet's bowl.

dialogue.speaker: A6F64DB448EDCE8EA5518BB904FF69FD
dialogue.line: So, the owner was dabbling in the arcane... and she had a cat, huh? I bet it was black.

dialogue.speaker: F40661754F90934DA9E291807FD04A50
dialogue.line: Someone here was dabbling in the arcane. Wonder where they are now?

dialogue.speaker: 7E4973A649BD5342611A33971E55CF7C
dialogue.line: The clever lady managed to leave the valley... Good for her.

dialogue.speaker: 16ADCD9044EF3EEB1A80038099EB5BE2
dialogue.line: Think I'm done here.

dialogue.speaker: 65A2205A4FD7AF327F499C91E7513A3D
dialogue.line: Contraband...? I suppose the soldiers confiscated it from the rebels.

dialogue.speaker: D7F7062D435E359BCD3ECC93162A0512
dialogue.line: Guess that's it. Better move before the guards notice.

dialogue.speaker: 5962EF15494B39E015B2CCA7F70A6F13
dialogue.line: Heavily guarded. You’d think the knyaz himself was hiding here.

dialogue.speaker: 486A607644DB783E90CA89B6EBCD116B
dialogue.line: Not sure what this tool is for... Maybe I should take it to Drogos?

dialogue.speaker: BE172E674CAA697631F9A1A5F2F1BA62
dialogue.line: Not sure what this tool is for... Oh well, maybe I'll find out later.

dialogue.speaker: D68586D54F0610C92F838FB945014A58
dialogue.line: Silver, huh...? Looks like the soldiers got their hands on some of the manumits's stash.

dialogue.speaker: 55C4A7304AFBE6427DA044B91F7D282F
dialogue.line: Actually... that's why she starved.

dialogue.speaker: F944CCD34732CF9F2A3490A6EC897E97
dialogue.line: Can't say it makes things any better. Actually... that's why she starved.

dialogue.speaker: CDDEE733434795647AFFBB85DEF542CA
dialogue.line: Executed for treason, huh? Maybe I should check this place out.

dialogue.speaker: E8911F494C8D6B16CAF68A8C2463551E
dialogue.line: Executed for treason, huh? So her abuser is already dead...

dialogue.speaker: F99718374D0A8A0A0CAB7AA03E07995C
dialogue.line: Poor girl. Her abuser is dead already, but that doesn’t make it any better, does it?

dialogue.speaker: D27D389B4F65E90434B56091278F3DCF
dialogue.line: Poor girl. What kind of monster would do that to her?

dialogue.speaker: 324D118A4E291ADC393DED82686D55E5
dialogue.line: She... I guess she's been dead for a while now.

dialogue.speaker: 98C4DD304240CE732BDD33B037493D84
dialogue.line: Skin and bones. Was she starved to death?

dialogue.speaker: 250E053E41AF6FDC50EA6C99512AC7DE
dialogue.line: Teeth marks... She gnawed at it from hunger.

dialogue.speaker: 22270DB34DC4F4154F296F8F15339D85
dialogue.line: That's why she couldn't escape...

dialogue.speaker: 9B2940CC4D784823503D26AC7F5CFAB6
dialogue.line: Tried to claw her way out.

dialogue.speaker: 19B526124B5952B71A51C4A8B47BF7A8
dialogue.line: [grunt] That smell... Don't think these sheets were ever changed.

dialogue.speaker: 0EAC745F4EC60198CF5C718EA977A8FE
dialogue.line: Ah, yes, the manumits. A bunch of yokels with a death wish.

dialogue.speaker: DAB66C6C44FCB92D1F83FDB4EB63A9C6
dialogue.line: Ah, yes. My good friend Gheorghe Racovitza.

dialogue.speaker: CECC31F843E03BD964E631A858B4E45A
dialogue.line: Aha. You'll explain yourself to Him in no time.

dialogue.speaker: 3E6962AD40E302D88F6090BE4E012027
dialogue.line: Alright. I accept your offer.

dialogue.speaker: F4C398EB44E3B735EDEB2AA12137007F
dialogue.line: Alright. I accept your offer.

dialogue.speaker: A54A344C40CA7EB4D77C97BA11AAF421
dialogue.line: And if I had lost – would you have shown me mercy, I wonder?

dialogue.speaker: 85C124A348F9DFFEEC82B7859E34D2C1
dialogue.line: And it sounded like you have a strong opinion about him.

dialogue.speaker: F7788C8D4B24B289A2EE4AAA02A56AA8
dialogue.line: And let me tell you, lad... There were many.

dialogue.speaker: 512D40164AAC37860EDB6EBB7A5A439C
dialogue.line: And you think that's reason enough to spare you?

dialogue.speaker: 15B36E2A4A446D2C992FF4B5C2F3D5A8
dialogue.line: Aye. For twelve years. And then, one night... Everything went tits up.

dialogue.speaker: ACCFC5244B5E6E3C7E2378852D820808
dialogue.line: But age brings hard-won experience.

dialogue.speaker: 21A74BBF404BE92AA4BF789A7BAE6414
dialogue.line: But – you live by the sword, young man. And I used to be the head of the City Guard. There's a thing or two I could teach you.

dialogue.speaker: FDE2EED74609F1EBF03405AF6CCC6D96
dialogue.line: Come closer. Let's talk.

dialogue.speaker: 72CF28B04349E41376383CBB38C0677B
dialogue.line: Did any other noblemen go rogue?

dialogue.speaker: B313FBC6471E3D0D0E4574941EBCA248
dialogue.line: Did any other noblemen go rogue?

dialogue.speaker: 073713C74250E540C60ADBB205BFE8EB
dialogue.line: Eager to learn, eh? Good. But first, we practise.

dialogue.speaker: 7276D51D484EE574230EED8993102F99
dialogue.line: Enough! I yield!

dialogue.speaker: 967C2258437DF6A2E21B179DB507975C
dialogue.line: Fair. One's noble birth doesn't mean much anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 2DEE578B4A93583F8DE736B773021643
dialogue.line: Farewell.

dialogue.speaker: 913C6716489AB94796E2D1B65C05241C
dialogue.line: Gladly. I saw you swing your blade, you're good. But I do have a few pointers...

dialogue.speaker: DFB4A88F4CBD98B170D92ABE7017B5C2
dialogue.line: Had the pleasure of making his acquaintance.

dialogue.speaker: 207338C54A03039103226EAE9D4D02C5
dialogue.line: Hah. Who knew!

dialogue.speaker: 622472804CDE8D453193EE800BECE52E
dialogue.line: He holed up in the forests down south. Word is, he's grown rather fond of vrakhiri blood.

dialogue.speaker: 646502284B170BFD6FA3E79AF34A06EF
dialogue.line: Hm. Maybe he offered them something in return... He was Greifberg's castellan, after all, knew the castle's secrets through and through.

dialogue.speaker: C4A20C70495426A1A15C9D8356193EE9
dialogue.line: Hope he burns in Hell.

dialogue.speaker: 4E4BDD954ED5B9CB702F35919B99A103
dialogue.line: Hope you weren't too close... Otherwise, I might have some bad news.

dialogue.speaker: 00153AC74259F52972731897348686F2
dialogue.line: How did you survive?

dialogue.speaker: 7078AF2A42BE75C054E986BA54D48D68
dialogue.line: I am now, yes. But it wasn't always so.

dialogue.speaker: 05562DB2404A690F0320FA9F168441B2
dialogue.line: I fought in tourneys and in dark alleys, led armies and killed hand-to-hand.

dialogue.speaker: 7F348AED47F8AC9E75D9E2ABA8958D47
dialogue.line: I just bested you in combat - and you want to teach me?

dialogue.speaker: 111A29834E34B9E4AC77FBA36D675B28
dialogue.line: I just bested you in combat – and you want to teach me?

dialogue.speaker: 8EC901BF46720C5DDC6914B92EA9B51D
dialogue.line: I knew you would.

dialogue.speaker: 5B445CEA4153B4FAF61D3999E7AE47CC
dialogue.line: I ran. Not the most honourable thing to do, I know. But then, me and honour... It was always touch and go.

dialogue.speaker: 9A9CFF8B44A98C90FED7E29EE79008A3
dialogue.line: I remember the first time I saw these monsters, claws out, blood dripping from their fangs... Horrifying.

dialogue.speaker: 18DFEDD449A981641C895586B03955BE
dialogue.line: I'm trying to understand why the vrakhiri tolerate him – let him gorge on their blood.

dialogue.speaker: 77D7D59F4C8F3A68E61A79AA309BFA36
dialogue.line: I've an idea of what to do with your precious blue blood.

dialogue.speaker: 8ABE8D5D481ECB6ADA3E5FB5AD49AE47
dialogue.line: I... I would, yes. I swear to God!

dialogue.speaker: 3065626741F92708A79B9D9D9FA6A2FD
dialogue.line: Let's just say his loyalties were less obvious than it seemed.

dialogue.speaker: 1C02089D4427F1BF476355B8DA120925
dialogue.line: Let's just say there's more to him than meets the eye.

dialogue.speaker: 28B419A94925B70BBD1CE688FBE4978D
dialogue.line: Me? I have experience.

dialogue.speaker: 05CE207F456847D52AC299B1A65DB597
dialogue.line: My name is Constantin Vulpea. I was one of Knyaz Skender's most trusted men.

dialogue.speaker: 02C8A6EF48F5D7D4181D2EB27F8D999E
dialogue.line: No, thank you. I'd rather fend for myself.

dialogue.speaker: FC0D8A654D45CBE46741D692E28CD3FA
dialogue.line: No. So either he steals it, somehow... Or gets his fix through some back-alley deals.

dialogue.speaker: F17CE8964C881A212A55FBACAF482427
dialogue.line: Not really. He's just a bastard, always was. The things he did to his serfs I wouldn't do to rabid dogs.

dialogue.speaker: 78D849404B34E66FDB307DB3781193BA
dialogue.line: Oh yeah? How so?

dialogue.speaker: BDC05BC244BB2AB4CEC532B856EB6FE9
dialogue.line: Oh? And he didn't sell you out to his masters? Curious...

dialogue.speaker: DFD191B543F0FB767D937EAD86899145
dialogue.line: Orchestrated it from the start.

dialogue.speaker: 7791BB9B4E94F5A0DC86568A75585DED
dialogue.line: So I did. And?

dialogue.speaker: 0ADC415F4712A5EC78F323ABB3354FE4
dialogue.line: So you were the head of the City Guard?

dialogue.speaker: 59294F374BE2C1AA273E3798C252D00E
dialogue.line: So you were the head of the City Guard?

dialogue.speaker: 3E3437B94B35621C60A30F9DA24E13E5
dialogue.line: So, about Gheorghe... I killed him.

dialogue.speaker: 271DAE4B464BFC5D901ADDB6EE511B8E
dialogue.line: So, about your old friend Gheorghe... I'm afraid I come bearing some bad news.

dialogue.speaker: 75CB2D6E4D448686B41E7FB8CA30A17F
dialogue.line: So, you mentioned Iulian Codrin...

dialogue.speaker: E18DAD1048B26484DAD04CB07DE30A40
dialogue.line: So, you mentioned Iulian Codrin...

dialogue.speaker: 8819313B450BC4F79BD03DAF321C450D
dialogue.line: Some nobles fought to the bitter end, some ran away, like me... But Iulian? He just bent the knee. Vrakhiri lapdog.

dialogue.speaker: 1DBCA37B4C77E4D25C1777A8D7A7E455
dialogue.line: Sounds like there's a story there.

dialogue.speaker: A44D620D49A808CCEB2965B89C188778
dialogue.line: Teach me swordfighting.

dialogue.speaker: 02F85C2D4AD52965EAE558AA681E3FE9
dialogue.line: Teach me what you know about swordfighting.

dialogue.speaker: 4B33C1324B280E96EFBBAC8C98FCF1F7
dialogue.line: Tell me more about that Gheorghe fellow – I'm intrigued.

dialogue.speaker: D5B2DE1F492530F7497EE79CADC163A9
dialogue.line: Tell me more about that Gheorghe fellow.

dialogue.speaker: C18A2A2D4D1856075301319A7D63D76C
dialogue.line: That's not an urge that's easy to satisfy.

dialogue.speaker: 351D8A954A7D537565FFE89E7FEC12EC
dialogue.line: There are those who oppose Brencis's rule.

dialogue.speaker: F83DBEDA4DCAB930C92AAEB46E0DFB86
dialogue.line: This isn't about opinions. It's a fact: he betrayed us all.

dialogue.speaker: 9097BAC248EF542026A97EAEBF96A7BA
dialogue.line: Time for me to go.

dialogue.speaker: AC40BACA40FD82104F5094B9540FED88
dialogue.line: Until next time.

dialogue.speaker: E6F7FABB4F300034F12B59B756128E41
dialogue.line: Wait, wait, you mean that – Ambrus's death – he helped you?

dialogue.speaker: F61ACF3440422D72FE44C6943E40B6CB
dialogue.line: Welcome back.

dialogue.speaker: 81E9571242E317DAB57A99AB1E1DBC9D
dialogue.line: What would you have done in my place? Kissed the vrakhiri's arses, like Iulian Codrin?

dialogue.speaker: 48E928724022628291699D918DB61755
dialogue.line: Why did you turn to banditry?

dialogue.speaker: EF3B2C18487BCBA5A65024B455C1AC84
dialogue.line: Why did you turn to banditry?

dialogue.speaker: E07EE2E34C6BE714AE3C0486B2C26683
dialogue.line: Why? You have a soft spot for cruel pricks?

dialogue.speaker: B133086B43D0395273E197ACC079C384
dialogue.line: Yield? You're a bandit.

dialogue.speaker: 376C38CA4FBB5A0057D3D0902AC99332
dialogue.line: You deserve no mercy.

dialogue.speaker: 7B4761524EC310B0493DCD95A3B4D319
dialogue.line: You don't have the eyes of a killer.

dialogue.speaker: E2BD6DC34127952D091A1C946622E57A
dialogue.line: You killed him? Ha! Good job, lad. One bastard less to walk this earth.

dialogue.speaker: 94B0D59F4550167A6ADA059AF62DB2B1
dialogue.line: You let me walk – you gain something that might just give you an edge when you need it most.

dialogue.speaker: 82E1584D4FBBD002D7CB23BE5B6DBD2A
dialogue.line: You slit my throat – and all of that knowledge is gone, with no benefit to you.

dialogue.speaker: 378BB7A44F8EAE92E267B7A5143E1EA8
dialogue.line: You won, yes. Because you're younger, faster, stronger.

dialogue.speaker: ED758D7B42D58FF36D13F9AEE2B4806E
dialogue.line: You won, yes. Whatever you are... You're stronger than any man, I'll grant you that.

dialogue.speaker: 1B92F63F4D1E7C365EF54D81303914D2
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: F6BD3C454DF0A81EA27041864EEB209F
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 667B604340EDE57CD423B68F3CEAC3D2
dialogue.line: A lone traveller? We'll make short work of you!

dialogue.speaker: 98BD657647623FFF4F0F47802D081A81
dialogue.line: I'll gut you like a fucking pig!

dialogue.speaker: 6F3B79FA42BDE4A1FFCB969292603538
dialogue.line: Who – who the fuck are you?

dialogue.speaker: E775689E4FD4B99A6DA1D689C5FEA9D7
dialogue.line: [hide secret letters to the manumits here]

dialogue.speaker: BE9DCBEF45E87F0A09CA088F907E8C28
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: ED7355584FF910F0CFC1239D21B30576
dialogue.line: A letter...?

dialogue.speaker: FE5BE30647C4780181062490A0D46E32
dialogue.line: Ah, this 'Pale Lady' must be Lacra. Exactly what I’d expect her to do with a creepy stalker.

dialogue.speaker: 0F11A7B049566AEF4C0A4FB169092E98
dialogue.line: All right, I've seen enough.

dialogue.speaker: 7EB6BF4E4FB5679E5C2FC6B5E63CE958
dialogue.line: Already down to the bones... must've been here for months – if not years.

dialogue.speaker: C0C79F134DDDE8BAFEC4DDBD72E73EC1
dialogue.line: An astute observation... assuming it's true.

dialogue.speaker: 3554A52F4664F4469A70A88E5939F74B
dialogue.line: Bloody fingerprints... Someone clawed at it with their bare hands.

dialogue.speaker: 0F20EF13400EB585CDE735A8272391CC
dialogue.line: Certainly not a bird... What in the world is this thing? Did he just make it up?

dialogue.speaker: 7333B45543B76421F5E345A133C8F70E
dialogue.line: Drained by a vrakhir...? To the last drop.

dialogue.speaker: 6699AA004A24BECE162BD09AD752D75F
dialogue.line: Grasping his heart... in pain?

dialogue.speaker: C0E3B7964CF4CFA555EB96A90EC36E49
dialogue.line: Hang on... there's someone lying on the rooftop.

dialogue.speaker: 83BB14CC46C5E6008BFCC5A0A04888E0
dialogue.line: I guess it broke him to face the truth. Quite literally.

dialogue.speaker: 9BFC2D424E0EF546F50297ACCF7C651A
dialogue.line: I guess this 'Pale Lady' wasn't exactly charmed by her creepy admirer.

dialogue.speaker: 4E8547194E7A3B7E0A338685B073E3B6
dialogue.line: I reckon he had an observation deck above... and took a nasty fall.

dialogue.speaker: A5D9A61942E0E20F677F6287D3B4CE68
dialogue.line: Impressive loot... and skills. How did he even get here?

dialogue.speaker: 3F408C8744CAB2A9CB21958A218DEC32
dialogue.line: Looks like one of the cathedral workers.

dialogue.speaker: 994FA06144AD3B6617C0B784D324AFB0
dialogue.line: Looks like she crawled out through the window.

dialogue.speaker: FE375BAE48F1B20AAD5B28ADE6D74D73
dialogue.line: Oh, he was sick... that's why...

dialogue.speaker: 05353E6340882B0CC46BB5A7DF0F3162
dialogue.line: Oh, this is no bird. He must've seen one of the flying creatures...

dialogue.speaker: 687189E34F3CD6053A4479AEFCBB1F55
dialogue.line: Rest in peace.

dialogue.speaker: E5ADF1A145FBD7182E7E59B5029E3245
dialogue.line: Seems he was the one doing the renovation. Worked himself to the bone, then collapsed... Goddamn, I feel that.

dialogue.speaker: 6630CD734EB6E8547E617ABBEA5BAE1F
dialogue.line: Seems the guards shot him down before he could escape.

dialogue.speaker: C3BB23F649C0DCD569163695ABA7439D
dialogue.line: She sought love, but found a knife in her ribs instead. Tricked, stabbed, and robbed...

dialogue.speaker: 44766B624449BDE63A517C8486BA0349
dialogue.line: So, his family was sealed off because of the plague... and he died trying to reach them. Poor soul.

dialogue.speaker: 15BE03284840F5911EA52998E232A80D
dialogue.line: Switched your allegiance, eh? Guess God was quick to punish you for that.

dialogue.speaker: A9BF180A43708C3531EED0B3AE889862
dialogue.line: The guards must've shot at him from below.

dialogue.speaker: F3E08F5244D59FCC24FCA588E51E0B65
dialogue.line: Tools for mending the rooftop. But no rope to guard against a fall.

dialogue.speaker: EE4CB6BE4516DF40B69D849CF11044B5
dialogue.line: Turns out the rooftop passage wasn't so safe after all.

dialogue.speaker: 1ED6AA954FFD1060E61AA8AF8A1F1126
dialogue.line: Went down hard, by the looks of it...

dialogue.speaker: 8B7CECDA4446FC2FBBE45D8DE7653E06
dialogue.line: What was so interesting to look at from here? Birds?

dialogue.speaker: 352FF90147CE451C0225F1B9D4EE08E5
dialogue.line: A contraband control? This might not go too well.

dialogue.speaker: 27EF7D3845F11E3DF1E3E68328EBCE33
dialogue.line: Ah, these little creeps again...

dialogue.speaker: 2940BFCD42E2AAD53836C2937998D5E8
dialogue.line: All tidy now. Until something nastier decides to move in.

dialogue.speaker: 7B5565654736461A0E022D8231151D06
dialogue.line: Alright then. I’ll bite.

dialogue.speaker: 86C0F2394A61D140AD8579B1EB4CBE95
dialogue.line: Alright, just don’t lead me astray. Again.

dialogue.speaker: 9BBC76C7411C5479338FE59A2BCB2D3A
dialogue.line: Ancient ruins...

dialogue.speaker: 8B27FFD94613A897105718A00710CD08
dialogue.line: Bandits...

dialogue.speaker: 060BC5E44E8F77DD743E388C1E73F8AD
dialogue.line: Begone, now.

dialogue.speaker: 8685864D482A10C5E81A9C806B44A156
dialogue.line: Bet there's a bear inside.

dialogue.speaker: CF347B1047DD6ADAAAFBC092E74B5B79
dialogue.line: Better take care of their nests...

dialogue.speaker: 47B1E583425CCAC2E40E548DD9401773
dialogue.line: Better this way.

dialogue.speaker: 8ABE96E144F176B36F0440A9C7F6A10C
dialogue.line: Brencis is eager to make a statement...

dialogue.speaker: 99D1E2A941E741225CB2DB9AA76C8E9F
dialogue.line: Brencis's soldiers... Out on some sort of assignment...

dialogue.speaker: FE5F73284F7401161E4E3BBCF07D99A1
dialogue.line: Crap! Someone's here.

dialogue.speaker: 228DB7B24F1C31E799F26899211B0B77
dialogue.line: Desecrated...

dialogue.speaker: 37E5813A4B6AE76D71450A80F772AC64
dialogue.line: Done. Those little nuisances won’t be popping up again.

dialogue.speaker: BFDACE514B74FF25D7FF56B7EA96D786
dialogue.line: Dumped in a hole, like sick cattle...

dialogue.speaker: ACA140F248EEFF191B0E339D1CEB5053
dialogue.line: Easy life you had, eh? Fleecing helpless peasants.

dialogue.speaker: 225665CE42155BFA59446086A965D87C
dialogue.line: Eerie little things...

dialogue.speaker: 9C0FD94B465E7806390C62A483C2F4AD
dialogue.line: Foul creature.

dialogue.speaker: 6D512FA848C7334FB38FD185F99E0B15
dialogue.line: Fresh prints... I wonder where they lead.

dialogue.speaker: A1AA4E0F4BE28B71260FD999BD2A4528
dialogue.line: God, that was intense!

dialogue.speaker: F0AE2F964B29DCFDFA0670A63DD67D50
dialogue.line: God, this is gruesome.

dialogue.speaker: F05536254B9AD78D9E68EF8F9EB8BBAC
dialogue.line: Good find.

dialogue.speaker: DB8787DB4DF1F12D20E9EE8EBDA3E09C
dialogue.line: Good riddance.

dialogue.speaker: 9928DE7B4F3245215E2754B2BE7F8316
dialogue.line: Guides for the lost or lures for the foolish?

dialogue.speaker: DDE14DC24BA9EC3A588FBDB4DC4D8505
dialogue.line: Hmm. Is that a fresco?

dialogue.speaker: FDC35F0747D71E9A940E1A91B80799EB
dialogue.line: Hmmm, let's take a look up there.

dialogue.speaker: 94E699B6414FCD7C81E89E9CEE56C076
dialogue.line: Hope word of this reaches your master.

dialogue.speaker: ABECC7D143B8339EF00AC8A9965902BE
dialogue.line: Huh. This might just be my way in.

dialogue.speaker: 4D9E266147BDB2DC194748B2AAC14011
dialogue.line: I can sense magic… But what’s the source?

dialogue.speaker: 3576B6454905F7E7E07B4ABF445705CD
dialogue.line: I can't get past the spirits... At least not yet.

dialogue.speaker: FBBDAFA344DAB33BADDA6C88CF10C5BA
dialogue.line: I know what to do with this.

dialogue.speaker: 087F039B4E252D8EB3A380A6EF022AB7
dialogue.line: I need to think about it.

dialogue.speaker: 24E39A0645735FF399707FADDC0CFAB0
dialogue.line: I'll find use for this.

dialogue.speaker: 924BB0A64463F26374E535ACFD2DBF0C
dialogue.line: If I want the loot, I’ll need to calm these restless souls.

dialogue.speaker: DE16117145329A89AA2BC9B44FDD27D2
dialogue.line: Is this a reward for perserverance? Huh. Don't mind if I do...

dialogue.speaker: BD7B7D2C40461FD2A2A13092022BD568
dialogue.line: Knyaz's men... Wonder what their orders are.

dialogue.speaker: 061F85404AF8589754F7DE933817F2CE
dialogue.line: Lead on, little spirits.

dialogue.speaker: 3D3E0FD34AA7A539A73C46993657D339
dialogue.line: Let's make sure they don't come crawling back.

dialogue.speaker: 50412970429272356454F999E97D5A89
dialogue.line: Let’s see where you’re leading me.

dialogue.speaker: C40514A94C0D5BC20AB59699CB9ADC67
dialogue.line: Looks better without it.

dialogue.speaker: 9524C4474616F8BB97F964BBCB52D5B2
dialogue.line: Looks like a bear's lair.

dialogue.speaker: 09675DB24EAB75AA516E9AAA0705EB97
dialogue.line: Looks like the shrine’s missing its heart… but maybe I could restore it.

dialogue.speaker: 651B63924B54AC183C3A56B4777F71F2
dialogue.line: Maybe I’ll spot something interesting from the top? The climb should be simple enough.

dialogue.speaker: F23EC1C648943D8E1A09DE961E75E7AF
dialogue.line: No one's here... But the bodies are fresh.

dialogue.speaker: 0F4293E64B9305C8EADC058BD3BFB436
dialogue.line: None shall miss you.

dialogue.speaker: D1379E63469DB22FF4B2F287B2AFFBA8
dialogue.line: One fewer problem at least.

dialogue.speaker: 2B4D87234574163B09A98483BAC877D5
dialogue.line: One horror less.

dialogue.speaker: 1D5B0CB242E8E5D367A2B1BD400C4E44
dialogue.line: One step closer to victory.

dialogue.speaker: 7CB4848E491B0DF660021E83BCFC6B53
dialogue.line: Outlaws.

dialogue.speaker: 5902A60D43476E0F1739DCBE37AE3C89
dialogue.line: Should I follow them?

dialogue.speaker: 733A2C114785DDF0AF2CF58FDE1A5137
dialogue.line: So much death... So little dignity...

dialogue.speaker: 410B515E43E99031F97AF8859FFCECCD
dialogue.line: So they're done trying to kill me?

dialogue.speaker: 17077E1A43AEA60D0FDCE18DBB4546C4
dialogue.line: Something vile lives here...

dialogue.speaker: D1B1092742456900757EDF886A213719
dialogue.line: That tower looks like a fine vantage point. Might be worth checking it out after dark.

dialogue.speaker: 69FDFDA1466B0F2EBA7E578DDF4647C5
dialogue.line: That tower nearby, I could scale it now. Might be an great vantage point.

dialogue.speaker: C14E8B2B474C74E22B0766926C3D6B23
dialogue.line: That was a worthy challenge.

dialogue.speaker: 84D6373743BB69020FFAE4949147A47C
dialogue.line: That was quite a fight...

dialogue.speaker: 59C3DFAD436217225E9C1E82AFDE0EEE
dialogue.line: That's it! Maybe I can trigger it with the right spell?

dialogue.speaker: 33F57778427C78C2742CA4AB01E5DF70
dialogue.line: The little spirits... What do they want with me?

dialogue.speaker: 8A4D63E4405D1EDF8874C1880F6A2A16
dialogue.line: The spirits here are restless... Perhaps I could help them, somehow?

dialogue.speaker: 71627B55475A7314CC6F20A11A446AD7
dialogue.line: The spirits linger… Best I set things right before claiming the treasure.

dialogue.speaker: 91F240764E116471E6DC48A407C18EFB
dialogue.line: The wolves. They're on the hunt.

dialogue.speaker: F040CB584B4B747BD35ABF821CF66A48
dialogue.line: Their leader must be somewhere near...

dialogue.speaker: 3E1A8F444CBB68F1E40076A28105002C
dialogue.line: There's a way to keep them out for good.

dialogue.speaker: 68E34B444D4B407DEEF9DE8FCA937700
dialogue.line: There. Fixed.

dialogue.speaker: 6D09BDCD443912A9AE3379B7DBB82A07
dialogue.line: They hoped to run away, find a better life...

dialogue.speaker: FD752FA743B45777F6BC0DBADA82C68C
dialogue.line: They must've been trying to leave the valley...

dialogue.speaker: 115B72C44B45F2D843D5CFA47F2C49F2
dialogue.line: They'll get ripped to shreds.

dialogue.speaker: 36C531AC4E672B6F1110429060726940
dialogue.line: This looks like their main camp...

dialogue.speaker: 65D98BBA45301C59AC4DDBBD572D2CA5
dialogue.line: This looks useful. Hey! Did you want me to find this?

dialogue.speaker: AB8872B24DDFF8E06878A3B5D28003BD
dialogue.line: This will help.

dialogue.speaker: C38CAB5A4C3440483FF3BEB08C2EC13A
dialogue.line: To hell with you, Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 1B7407AA4BB07348D7AD579627CFAF9E
dialogue.line: Ugh! What goes on down there?

dialogue.speaker: C94174984338419B9E203993C6DA67E6
dialogue.line: Vrakhiri colours.

dialogue.speaker: 2C4F49FB421DADA56B90E0939955DE5E
dialogue.line: What an awful way to die...

dialogue.speaker: 385402004D39731BF6AA6B8C75E2D5E4
dialogue.line: What are they doing out in the open?

dialogue.speaker: A5ECB5F549168C51EEC94F95F1BD85B5
dialogue.line: What are they doing?!

dialogue.speaker: C18B1A5B464B97C242CF29927330F22F
dialogue.line: What are they trying to do here? Kill me or test me?

dialogue.speaker: E7D7337A4FF2E9DFC476C5B3249A9CEA
dialogue.line: What are those things? Are they... alive?

dialogue.speaker: B377487640410F8113397392F6ADFE97
dialogue.line: What could they have done to deserve this?

dialogue.speaker: FE155B1946EA7D28F26690A93DD3CBE6
dialogue.line: What the hell happened here?

dialogue.speaker: 5BD0A19E45A06E05AE9E01B8F852BBBF
dialogue.line: What was that? Is someone in trouble?

dialogue.speaker: 89C8A6354282348BDA811F99BE76EF6C
dialogue.line: Will-o’-the-wisps… Wonder what they’re doing here?

dialogue.speaker: 734F0AD6478E65063E0EE79E215B85DC
dialogue.line: Woah... I feel – I feel so much stronger, now.

dialogue.speaker: A5F311B34DB53FB89217C8B6BA9F3A81
dialogue.line: Wolves live here.

dialogue.speaker: E5DB76E0447A42CEDF2D448BCA59CE51
dialogue.line: Wolves's den.

dialogue.speaker: F713225B44113392A8A54D8B23810181
dialogue.line: Wonder if there are more of these ruins in the valley?

dialogue.speaker: 6F7E030046083CB96238CAA46D19E140
dialogue.line: You can rest now.

dialogue.speaker: 1988AFB6498A409CA46CDE9C9554EC65
dialogue.line: You want me to follow you again, huh? Play a game?

dialogue.speaker: D505C6E941EC4560F8B1B0AC991D4C08
dialogue.line: You won't be bothering anyone now.

dialogue.speaker: 0D8CA7D04575723D0BAD72B8D447C3B7
dialogue.line: You won't hurt anyone ever again.

dialogue.speaker: 6918E6A848F7A4EB2B4394AA3DD0660F
dialogue.line: You're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: OA101.Armed.Collector01
dialogue.line: We're busy here. Sod off.
