dialogue.speaker: OA101.Armed.Collector02
dialogue.line: It's not a bad job. Well, at least not the worst.

dialogue.speaker: OA101.Armed.Collector03
dialogue.line: A bucketful of leeches fetches a nice price, these days.

dialogue.speaker: OA101.Armed.Collector04
dialogue.line: The vrakhiri don't like their blood clotted.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector01
dialogue.line: What did you do?! Boyar Ambrus will be livid!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector02
dialogue.line: This is my spot! And my leeches!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector03
dialogue.line: You're with the manumits? Traitor!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector04
dialogue.line: Leeches like sweet blood. Eat a few spoonfuls of honey in the morning, and they come to you in droves!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector03
dialogue.line: No – but the vrakhiri do. And they'll pay us a pretty penny for them.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector01
dialogue.line: We spent hours wading in this stinking mire, picking them off our calves. No point in letting all that work go to waste.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector02
dialogue.line: You don't like them, just leave 'em, like we asked.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector04
dialogue.line: Whoever's in charge, we're fucked anyway.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector02
dialogue.line: Who does he think he is?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector01
dialogue.line: What a waste.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Collector03
dialogue.line: They'll come after us too, I tell you. The rebels.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Armed.Collector02
dialogue.line: Pretty sure boyar Ambrus would reward us nicely for it, too.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Armed.Collector01
dialogue.line: More than enough...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Armed.Collector03
dialogue.line: We're just trying to make a living.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Armed.Collector02
dialogue.line: You shouldn't have come here, traitor!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA101.Armed.Collector01
dialogue.line: We stand by boyar Ambrus!

dialogue.speaker: OA102.Armed.Collector01
dialogue.line: You better not cause any trouble here.

dialogue.speaker: OA102.Armed.Collector02
dialogue.line: Help with the leeches or get lost.

dialogue.speaker: 8FF8FFD34B2AD4BCC60407937DB8B796
dialogue.line: Boyar Ambrus needs these leeches soon!

dialogue.speaker: OA102.Armed.Collector04
dialogue.line: You don't look like a leech picker.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector01
dialogue.line: You must have a death wish! Boyar Ambrus won't let this slide!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector02
dialogue.line: What rhymes with leech... Each... Reach... Oh, teach!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector03
dialogue.line: You've just made knyaz Ambrus angry.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector04
dialogue.line: Oh no... The vrakhiri will think we were involved... Take us away, drain us...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector03
dialogue.line: Go ahead. Boyar Ambrus will make you pay.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector02
dialogue.line: The vrakhiri need their spit. Add it to the blood, lest it clots.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector01
dialogue.line: Might as well earn some denarii.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You do know what they're for, right?

dialogue.speaker: 25B41ECA48651EB2B693FF9A6C711474
dialogue.line: Take them. Hope they're worth it.

dialogue.speaker: 1F4E9FBC4CEF908FE9DA888B696FA07A
dialogue.line: You do know what they're for, right?

dialogue.speaker: 498518454966B602BD387EB104EDD9B3
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector04
dialogue.line: Boyar Ambrus must be desperate to get these leeches, paying as much as he does for 'em...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector02
dialogue.line: Oh, I should get extra denarii for this one! Big as a perch!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector03
dialogue.line: This is a bit like fishing, eh, lads? Only we're the bait!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Collector01
dialogue.line: It must've been the manumits, I tell you. They destroyed the other camp.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Armed.Collector01
dialogue.line: You keep your judgement to yourself, will you. And we keep the leeches.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Your threats don't impress me.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Armed.Collector03
dialogue.line: Or we cut you down. I swear to God, I'll do it!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA102.Armed.Collector02
dialogue.line: We'll see about that. Kill him!

dialogue.speaker: 62A7022B43A7811B2185DEA751B537FF
dialogue.line: Whose God, I wonder?

dialogue.speaker: D94CA06242E1DAFF42BF0EA3FDB6792C
dialogue.line: You can keep them.

dialogue.speaker: C96107D3437A35079175B3AF505C6D06
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: OA102.Armed.Collector03
dialogue.line: Boyar Ambrus won't let our camp get wiped out, too.

dialogue.speaker: OA102.Armed.Collector02
dialogue.line: If we're attacked, I won't just roll over.

dialogue.speaker: OA102.Armed.Collector01
dialogue.line: Sooner or later, that fucker will come after us, too.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA105.Uriash01
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA105.Uriash02
dialogue.line: Your head heavy. Get back to work!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA106.Prisoner02
dialogue.line: Please! No! Don't leave me here!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Traitor?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA106.Prisoner02
dialogue.line: Will you leave me be?! Just be grateful you're alive!

dialogue.speaker: 105343D24F39047E5F8E9B87BC88DFCF
dialogue.line: Anything to support these accusations?

dialogue.speaker: CAEB1EB546EE739058FD1EA3FACD48F0
dialogue.line: Branko - you're staying where you are.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA106.Prisoner01
dialogue.line: They paid him off! They must've! One day, he was poor as a church mouse, the next – he had a clinking purse at his side!

dialogue.speaker: 61D49EB644BFF3D80E5853973C64D0AA
dialogue.line: I need to think about this, look around.

dialogue.speaker: 157F0914456F58278CF58BA2B940D9A9
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: OA106.Prisoner02
dialogue.line: Get the keys! The jailer had them!

dialogue.speaker: OA106.Prisoner01
dialogue.line: Hey! You! Get us out!

dialogue.speaker: OA106.Prisoner03
dialogue.line: Just open the fucking cells!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What's that? Someone's inside...

dialogue.speaker: F1AFA5874237C42F355CA087DBEE3505
dialogue.line: Footprints...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're not going anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA107.Captain
dialogue.line: You – you drove him mad! Anyone who as much as displeases him – they end up in Maragir! Impaled on stakes!

dialogue.speaker: 523FA24B45B0D51B52C97386ABCC9844
dialogue.line: I know about your betrayal.

dialogue.speaker: 18BAFA274D4AFD5002BC4DB9C8543B62
dialogue.line: Out. Now!

dialogue.speaker: 14158BA24BD849C723DC5ABEED1A7D9C
dialogue.line: Pay me and you walk.

dialogue.speaker: 02FF410D4009F7F3EE603798D1D868EA
dialogue.line: What's with all the carts? Going somewhere?

dialogue.speaker: 1ACC937645517403C104739320ADF933
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA107.NecroSpeak
dialogue.line: The fallen tree...? B-but I went there to take a leak! I swear on my father's grave!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: D28681274ABC0E2D70BCC6B723323752
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: Characters.Background.OA107.Guard01
dialogue.line: Oi! careful, Don't spill a drop! You heard the captain, this blood is our bargaining chip!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA107.Captain
dialogue.line: More brushwood! You heard the orders! We can't leave any trace!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner03
dialogue.line: You're as brave as you are generous. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner02
dialogue.line: We... We served in the knyaz's army. But we've had enough, offed our officer. They sentenced us to draining.

dialogue.speaker: OA108.Prisoner01
dialogue.line: Hey, get us out!

dialogue.speaker: OA108.Prisoner03
dialogue.line: Let us out! Let us out!!!

dialogue.speaker: OA108.Prisoner02
dialogue.line: The jailer! He's got all the keys!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner03
dialogue.line: You'll explain yourself to St. Peter! Come, lads, high time to string them up!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner03
dialogue.line: No! Please, spare us!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner01
dialogue.line: You'll get what you deserve. Vrakhiri's lackey!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner03
dialogue.line: This will be a warning for the whole valley.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner01
dialogue.line: Shut up, worm! Or I'll rip out your tongue!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA108.Prisoner02
dialogue.line: Oh God, oh God, no, please!

dialogue.speaker: Characters.Background.OA108.Captain
dialogue.line: Oh, I can't wait until I get to bleed you dry. I'll make sure it happens slowly, too!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA109.Prisoner01
dialogue.line: You keep fighting the vrakhiri! Send them all back to Hell! And the uriashi too, while you're at it!

dialogue.speaker: Characters.Background.OA109.Swordmaster
dialogue.line: You want to learn a thing or two about swordfighting, lad? Come see me at my camp. Stone's throw from here.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA109.Prisoner03
dialogue.line: Sure you did, grampa.

dialogue.speaker: EC973D3944C961FDC0D4D185CDDBDBB4
dialogue.line: I did just free you, didn't I?

dialogue.speaker: A00B66C74388BAE54DBC7F9D64E44AD6
dialogue.line: My fight is only with Brencis and those who support him.

dialogue.speaker: 36C2455146DE1210924EE5B3FB8ED198
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 76BC4739474329C4E073C191AE2A0D59
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You mentioned you took part in quite a few battles...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA109.Swordmaster
dialogue.line: Well, serves him right.

dialogue.speaker: 2E31EF2C47C911D018C654B86883052A
dialogue.line: How did you end up in Ambrus's prison?

dialogue.speaker: 3A2F208046FA4DB02D85F8AD3E71CC0B
dialogue.line: Tell me more about your experience.

dialogue.speaker: 00F2F69E42FF92C12DFFA0A76408A649
dialogue.line: Time for me to leave.

dialogue.speaker: AE6A2FA44015C468095B20A04D44090E
dialogue.line: Why is that, you think?

dialogue.speaker: E3621D7B47EE62C446A416903C92AE96
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA110.SmithApprentice
dialogue.line: We've no other choice. But... Between you and me... We make sure the shipments for the castle contain as many faulty weapons as we can get away with.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Why did the vrakhiri imprison you, in the first place?

dialogue.speaker: 83FDEA70438407B55E825FBB7904D592
dialogue.line: Do you trade with the knyaz, too?

dialogue.speaker: E4CB58444FABD637F02015B6E3606309
dialogue.line: Why did the vrakhiri imprison you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA110.SmithApprentice
dialogue.line: Look who's here!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA110.Prisoner02
dialogue.line: May the Lord guide your hand, Coen of Laslea!

dialogue.speaker: 144F787041FE415EC1BF899A03CE8A16
dialogue.line: I don't do this to be rewarded.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're safe now. All's well.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA110.SmithApprentice
dialogue.line: You'll need all the help you can get... Boyar Ambrus, he swore to cut you down himself.

dialogue.speaker: 6E1177C24D60DA367089A5A7A5D9EF68
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: F45D71E646A522CA2C0602A2B868C400
dialogue.line: [collect the blood]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [destroy the barrels]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA112.Captain
dialogue.line: Who's this brave youth, sticking his nose where it doesn't belong?

dialogue.speaker: 0FFA63BF46A6B971F0B4E6BA88ADCC4D
dialogue.line: Just take my money and fuck off.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're welcome to try.

dialogue.speaker: 12240D044F83BE27303CEE8E89B585AE
dialogue.line: You've been here this whole time?

dialogue.speaker: FA0D3D2B4E003135F44D658F2C6E115F
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're free to do what you want, but... There's no way to leave the valley now. Sooner or later, the vrakhiri will find you.

dialogue.speaker: 09D0603D4C5937FB09DCF4926851E37C
dialogue.line: Ambrus – have you ever met him?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA113.Alchemist
dialogue.line: Yes, most interesting! Can I go now?

dialogue.speaker: 36CB684A44D5623096D2E3A390BA1B35
dialogue.line: I mean you no harm. You're free.

dialogue.speaker: 007E06114558A9F5EB31E3944570400E
dialogue.line: Stock up on blood? Why?

dialogue.speaker: 3F72DDF447FE42CE83DB72870348039C
dialogue.line: Who the hell are you?

dialogue.speaker: 79C971194F6013820C3C108E86E839CA
dialogue.line: You should join the manumits.

dialogue.speaker: 94AEBEC24BD8527B56316A84D03B8E5B
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB.UriashCaptain
dialogue.line: You. Tell what do. Now.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB101.RebelHunter01
dialogue.line: Wipe the floor with him, cap'!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Fucking knew it... Alright, you had a chance to run!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB.UriashCaptain
dialogue.line: No! Do nothing. I gave word!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB102.RebelHunterCaptain
dialogue.line: Keep on looking! We won't leave until you find it!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB.DeadRebel
dialogue.line: You think you’ll get anything from me? Fuck all, that’s what you’ll get!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 1A3FFA1D4958CF84B5EB57BE72B0F01A
dialogue.line: Burn! Traitors deserve no mercy!

dialogue.speaker: 7EB32FB1436AEFF1157E60AEFC729194
dialogue.line: Not so brave now, are you, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 545D229E4B9AE0A5EFD661BDB1777419
dialogue.line: Scream all you want! I'll piss on your ashes!

dialogue.speaker: B217E48F4F61B3E32B797EB6AE9AC817
dialogue.line: Help! Please, anyone! Khe, khe... I... I don't want to die! Not like this!

dialogue.speaker: C94453F2430AD591EA83CABA321D49B9
dialogue.line: Oh, Jesus! Someone, please! Let us out!

dialogue.speaker: CD3D700241DD6091BD4346B8769BF336
dialogue.line: And now they burn in Hell, thanks to – Wait, you're that fresh recruit. Saw you talking to Crake. Coen or something?

dialogue.speaker: 27610A85407B5C1442576C995E2C087E
dialogue.line: And those shitheads know how to do their jobs – once they're on your scent, they won't give up.

dialogue.speaker: EDE6361E4BF52D88D49D3E8DA1DAD115
dialogue.line: And who are you lot exactly?

dialogue.speaker: 863F26B444E073D14E8922B7D5D18A94
dialogue.line: Appreciate it. Stay safe.

dialogue.speaker: 80176748470183EFE0CCD6A1952137A3
dialogue.line: Are you going to be alright?

dialogue.speaker: F24C2EDC48AE7BCB78CE678818C6534F
dialogue.line: Are you going to be alright?

dialogue.speaker: 7D63858F4EA8DCAD2D2B289C1A0FD7BE
dialogue.line: Aye, could use someone like you. Always looking for new recruits.

dialogue.speaker: BE5C073A4CD29273B7DA7492878CE21F
dialogue.line: Bakir has really clamped down on the region recently – his soldiers are hunting us like animals.

dialogue.speaker: 93EA980F4F7F7B5861A97495C1B6A139
dialogue.line: Couldn't stand idly by while you burned to death.

dialogue.speaker: 93124FFC473528EFC35AA783FF621315
dialogue.line: Couldn't stand idly by.

dialogue.speaker: 7EE9FE404A5E29676777F99733AF5530
dialogue.line: Fuck me, a real hero!

dialogue.speaker: 3EB55D98446E0E38FBFA22AFE9FC22FA
dialogue.line: How did they even find you?

dialogue.speaker: F1E8A185467EAEF1E9E791ACA52D6DF9
dialogue.line: How did they even find you?

dialogue.speaker: 28DDBEBB46A6A1C8C15465B3ED7B79DE
dialogue.line: I'm no friend of Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: A20B3CA74086682764DE9AADB7B31DA9
dialogue.line: I'm no friend to Brencis. Or to anyone serving him.

dialogue.speaker: 47F770EC4AF62309EA9E7EBF9A0AE811
dialogue.line: If you want to learn more – there's a watermill, near what's left of Laslea. Go there, talk to Mert.

dialogue.speaker: 93B0A3F74DDF5C525006D8B4FC01757B
dialogue.line: Just a few bruises and a bit of a scare. And maybe a dressing down from Crake once we get back. We'll manage just fine.

dialogue.speaker: 1F61A4394F36D7EC441CA9B97220C542
dialogue.line: Speaking of which, time to go. Oh, and Coen – take this. We owe you one, brother.

dialogue.speaker: 32DF9DDE426C99F4CD8A99BFFDE20AEB
dialogue.line: That's right.

dialogue.speaker: D9F97CEF425B28435870B9B5ED7404D4
dialogue.line: Wait, you're Coen of Laslea, aren't you? Shit, no wonder you killed them all!

dialogue.speaker: B919C65843C0286384761EA0B983989E
dialogue.line: We're done bowing our heads to bloody monsters – that's all you need to know.

dialogue.speaker: AD0AD59D41EA4855D3E8949A100AF92C
dialogue.line: We're safe – thanks to you, friend. [cough] Can't believe you killed all of them on your own...

dialogue.speaker: 0B32DE644EC536BBB3C28E9A4E4EC63D
dialogue.line: Well, Coen – glad to have you on our side. This was a close one.

dialogue.speaker: BF78F76A406DA68FB7ADB39FFC7ECD4F
dialogue.line: Yeah... And not to sound ungrateful – but why did get into this mess?

dialogue.speaker: 1E4FF89546F4175D4CF15FAF18BE5049
dialogue.line: [chuckle] We can see that.

dialogue.speaker: 55A102834F9515791F061F8245E1A0FE
dialogue.line: [cough] Alright, time to split, lads. And you – take this. For saving our skins.

dialogue.speaker: 74DDD0D74E7E9FE67B9DB695D94AB8C9
dialogue.line: [cough] Fucking... bastards! Burn another man alive?! Sick fucks!

dialogue.speaker: 1A2DE3CC43B9C6BE72DCF19D27910748
dialogue.line: [cough] Oh... God... Thank... thank you! A few seconds more and –

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB104.Worker01
dialogue.line: Those who drink it aren't free of blame. No. They support the vrakhiri regime with each sip.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Poisoning innocents? What good would that do?

dialogue.speaker: DBDF877E4A3E1535F980D1873EA72303
dialogue.line: I won't let you do it.

dialogue.speaker: 4B5F719E40BDD5377D1A70900BCEB8FF
dialogue.line: Poisoning innocents? What good would it do?

dialogue.speaker: B13FBE2C4F9C95E3FC21AAB5C89272E1
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You serve the vrakhiri – so you die like the rest.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB105.Worker01
dialogue.line: What?! Oh, God be praised... Please, just let me go...

dialogue.speaker: F5DDB0784CED19D3A5D2068C7420813B
dialogue.line: Get out of here before I change my mind.

dialogue.speaker: 1BC3A5034353C3D35D29CEA203C5ECFB
dialogue.line: Why does Bakir care about alcohol?

dialogue.speaker: 2EDA0FBD423D0325CDE4F4910C9421BC
dialogue.line: Why not simply run away?

dialogue.speaker: AE31645541A979C080B3A98EA6DC662D
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 7FE5A2C5481CC5309BDB3091B50C1CAD
dialogue.line: Alright. Deal.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: I think I'll take my payment right now.

dialogue.speaker: 396EF63E487A265D4062DB826CF15DE7
dialogue.line: And Bakir won't mind?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB106.Soldier01
dialogue.line: Why fight, when we can all profit, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 2163A075429DEFD77AAC34A45BCEB380
dialogue.line: Bakir's dead – who runs this place?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB106.Soldier02
dialogue.line: We pilfered the equipment from other distilleries, set it all up here – a good distance away from prying eyes.

dialogue.speaker: E4AF74C94D59CB05E4A3B0A23BD2C904
dialogue.line: [give in to the urge]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB106.Soldier01
dialogue.line: With Bakir gone, there's little competition. And we make sure it stays that way, heh.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Until next time.

dialogue.speaker: C0ECEF7A4749BE3D96080E8B24CAD777
dialogue.line: How's the business going?

dialogue.speaker: 43C38913494646FB7FFF8BB9D7C6D8A3
dialogue.line: Until next time.

dialogue.speaker: F9B0FC184616C99761B508B81281034D
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB107.Onlooker03
dialogue.line: Yeah! Lash him! Let's see that blue blood flow!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB107.Onlooker01
dialogue.line: Hey. Make him do something!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB107.Captive
dialogue.line: No! I beg you, not again!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB107.Soldier01
dialogue.line: Think he deserves more? Go ahead. Kick his teeth in, for all I care.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB107.Onlooker02
dialogue.line: Thought you were better than us, eh? That us simple folk should be bled instead of your kin?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB107.Soldier01
dialogue.line: You can jeer him from a distance, like everyone else!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What has he done to deserve this?

dialogue.speaker: DA6208AE49FE7E81ED1341A4BEBE5169
dialogue.line: I want no trouble.

dialogue.speaker: 6EB4D9914A1DBF21F19416B239C20AD1
dialogue.line: What has he done?

dialogue.speaker: 54932E974796E1D5265B62BD9CB3A800
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB107.Captive
dialogue.line: You may collect it in my stead, just say Nelu sent you. Me... I've no further need for it.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Why would you say that?

dialogue.speaker: 9F4D1E734AF964C5963C8FA2F73F781D
dialogue.line: What happened to your daughter?

dialogue.speaker: 40852A5849BAC9A73AFEBEBCD8AF65B1
dialogue.line: Your life isn’t worth much? Why?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB108.Soldier01
dialogue.line: What did you say to me?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: My mistake, sorry!

dialogue.speaker: 706DD947481F6D650914DA97CC3ACA15
dialogue.line: Sorry!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Captive
dialogue.line: Oh, you'll see for yourself, one day. Just you wait!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Onlooker03
dialogue.line: How do you like them stocks, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Onlooker01
dialogue.line: I hope the vrakhiri track down all of you lot – and gorge on that blue blood of yours!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Soldier01
dialogue.line: Praised be Knyaz Brencis! Praised be Boyar Bakir!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Soldier01
dialogue.line: Yeah? What is it?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Step aside. Now.

dialogue.speaker: 4624A2FE44414536273EDFAAA737FB34
dialogue.line: Nothing. Sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 36039B414A6468DB35EF42BFDA20BF2E
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Onlooker01
dialogue.line: To hell with you! Scum!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Onlooker02
dialogue.line: Wait! Don't free this man! He deserved all this, and more!

dialogue.speaker: B84F98384BB51D673757A4851E663FAD
dialogue.line: Do what you will to him.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What was your role in Skender's court, pray tell?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Captive
dialogue.line: Yes, I served my lord! As was my duty and privilege! Dirty yokels! Monster-lovers!

dialogue.speaker: B41145CB4E98A85F5BEEE3876115FDCC
dialogue.line: What was your role in Skender's court?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You don't owe me anything.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Captive
dialogue.line: Oh? You don't look it. Maybe your mother made a, hm, favourable impression on knyaz Skender once, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 6D47E1E04F474B0F7C053A832CA8F7FC
dialogue.line: It's true you taught Catalin?

dialogue.speaker: 08C89367440F8D6B6AE80890161BC882
dialogue.line: Why, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Captive
dialogue.line: You rise against your God-ordained lord, you must be punished!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You taught Catalin. What's he like?

dialogue.speaker: 2775D02B4467D2ECFC09D1B9EEB24BAD
dialogue.line: I'll be on my way.

dialogue.speaker: 872B28914D6DBF74F0178E8D4DA11926
dialogue.line: What's Catalin like?

dialogue.speaker: 771089404E255F77B3FC949088B8D98A
dialogue.line: Where did you learn your craft?

dialogue.speaker: EC8E65B34876E195A324E784F5B19FFD
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OB109.Captive
dialogue.line: Show me some flair!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_innkeeper2
dialogue.line: Welcome back, lad. What can I do you for?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [character development]

dialogue.speaker: CAD431854CFB8174F4E4D7AFA9E9FC53
dialogue.line: [fast travel]

dialogue.speaker: 5CDDA9694358BB7902477DA45B427715
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: FFA3202644B113BD388A3B88085B2A99
dialogue.line: [skip time]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Poi_OX_digsites_boss
dialogue.line: You've caused enough trouble – it ends now.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You must be Armaya?

dialogue.speaker: 668D065147B9E8A83DE94BB72AF6668D
dialogue.line: Judging by that body - you've had some trouble already.

dialogue.speaker: 8E12167046D42CF72026E5A7CC9FBC33
dialogue.line: What are you trying to accomplish here?

dialogue.speaker: B98CEE3448E998C8A7EC1AA6BB380E3C
dialogue.line: What were you looking for here?

dialogue.speaker: 419FBB5A400EF71A1EB2E6BA10F234B4
dialogue.line: [drink her blood]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Poi_OX_digsites_assistant
dialogue.line: Yes, mistress. We should be able to break the seal now.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: C88F706E4E8249824E75DE867DA508F0
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Parlita_Blacksmith
dialogue.line: The vrakhiri saved me in the nick of time. And let me tell you - the problems I used to have don't feel like problems anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What makes your blades special?

dialogue.speaker: 6E17A13E425E3D08275C2E80DE0D16DB
dialogue.line: A letter? And the seal's intact...

dialogue.speaker: 843A00B749163BE9F4365DABA2E679DD
dialogue.line: More footprints...

dialogue.speaker: 68287012446461954603FA9CB03A293E
dialogue.line: Same symbol...

dialogue.speaker: 3AAE1C554DCFB09938830C90F39ACB8C
dialogue.line: The tracks – they're fresh.

dialogue.speaker: 5476055D4626FF2694B61DAF8B0E65EA
dialogue.line: This grave looks centuries old... But the flowers are fresh. Huh.

dialogue.speaker: 7FA977A346C461B08CE10ABA391914B0
dialogue.line: What's this? Something's carved in the bark...

dialogue.speaker: BD9663E447A6A64A44EE9EB0CCFA6009
dialogue.line: Burned down on a rainy night! How could that be?

dialogue.speaker: 2B9A548940997A9AE61764B36403FA86
dialogue.line: Hit by lighting, I s'pose.

dialogue.speaker: 318D61684B39B773759639AB452AD4A1
dialogue.line: Don't think so. I'm going upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: 880E0906409232C4B33F7EA8831169D6
dialogue.line: Good day to you! Anything you need?

dialogue.speaker: D503E8604408445658A0F9982A0055E6
dialogue.line: Hey! Stay out of there!

dialogue.speaker: 655EEB404CFCE92641441DB78B3EE577
dialogue.line: How about we talk business instead, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 18ADDBF94FE74897AEB08397BE063C14
dialogue.line: I'll be on my way now.

dialogue.speaker: 776D522E4DD9A5BBF9EC1A89770310C4
dialogue.line: I'll be on my way.

dialogue.speaker: 85EE794943384F571927D4A84354EFF2
dialogue.line: I'm going upstairs.

dialogue.speaker: 428BC67540E7789F30A5C2A08333BFD5
dialogue.line: It's coming from upstairs. Sounds like a wind chime.

dialogue.speaker: 83D736064A2FEFC6CD461FB5EE5FBDD0
dialogue.line: Noise? I don't hear anything.

dialogue.speaker: 904A792646CC0CA317A6C2A2DFEA8783
dialogue.line: Right. Never mind.

dialogue.speaker: D56D34A2497FD9F784AC749AE48A5A5F
dialogue.line: Right. Never mind.

dialogue.speaker: 095B6B1147F70DCF07D685898CFDD98A
dialogue.line: Show me your wares.

dialogue.speaker: 928D905146EEFD75F6184CA4E711BDBC
dialogue.line: Show me your wares.

dialogue.speaker: AF6B577C405818EF1FAB8DB5CBD82101
dialogue.line: Sounds like someone had one too many!

dialogue.speaker: C55C4A8C4ABC642E6E8ABFB65A0E4707
dialogue.line: What's that noise?

dialogue.speaker: E744A8434DB5089B1A407DB35D2F4F91
dialogue.line: What's that noise?

dialogue.speaker: 16927B204BA0B7EED43FB796EF1AB911
dialogue.line: Burglar! I'll teach you a lesson!

dialogue.speaker: 53E9E1BF457D464673D104996B65EDD2
dialogue.line: Hey! What are you doing here?!

dialogue.speaker: 1353A73044194A0DC4A9E295C9EF21B4
dialogue.line: My apologies.

dialogue.speaker: D8B3DDFD497D9ABC3931579A2C3F3896
dialogue.line: My apologies. I didn't mean to disturb you.

dialogue.speaker: 55007F5B43D08B947D19BC8860E8176F
dialogue.line: Out of my way.

dialogue.speaker: 95EBBCE74239456F5E1E67813E4E36F8
dialogue.line: Out of my way.

dialogue.speaker: 646CFF184A3EBD1F22664590939E2559
dialogue.line: Seems like I came for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: DF79810448459AC87A8A27B236CD0C7F
dialogue.line: What? No, no, no...! Let me go!

dialogue.speaker: EC20BDB5479186CFC245E7AFD7DBDF4F
dialogue.line: Who do you think you are?! Get the hell out of here!

dialogue.speaker: C210D57B49CEEAFC76B40C91A8E9B63D
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 7234797649EAF0CECBBB72912A2CB3B6
dialogue.line: Bah! Makes no difference to me, long as it keeps coming!

dialogue.speaker: 68459CD449A31F9E472B7DA48AEB036E
dialogue.line: But where does all this come from?

dialogue.speaker: 5724C640433CBD4E637550B3A0DE364B
dialogue.line: Ha! Look what we got this time!

dialogue.speaker: 5F8AB98E48A0A126148D5B9A32256BB3
dialogue.line: Ah! What do we have here? A weary traveller?

dialogue.speaker: B41CC5B24CB5EC020BE1798907850C19
dialogue.line: Don't get your knickers in a twist. It's the last time you'll have to go through it, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: B28BCA26475947EA8EE72CA35D96DB12
dialogue.line: Duly noted. I'll be more careful next time.

dialogue.speaker: 695083834986C737A7A7CD8B2A6E4C6F
dialogue.line: Duly noted. I'll be more careful.

dialogue.speaker: 41F0479F444224D228A44DBB6346DD68
dialogue.line: Get him! Now!

dialogue.speaker: 995BDB2A49A3E1EC63A2B5914A206D68
dialogue.line: Hm. I reckon there won't be a next time.

dialogue.speaker: 2C83F8484FE53D66B93EB5891FBBBAF1
dialogue.line: I don't like being threatened.

dialogue.speaker: BF6671AA4C0EDA5075DD4DA4086B3DA4
dialogue.line: I don't like being threatened.

dialogue.speaker: 4C023AE6453BE39020134387F4B8377B
dialogue.line: Might get lost in the underbrush... Or fall into a ditch and lose a tooth. Hah!

dialogue.speaker: 89E7838B42EE6B0A4A0332A180B2CA17
dialogue.line: No. But it makes me hungry.

dialogue.speaker: FA10EDEF4FAB79DCCCE2D29946FF4574
dialogue.line: Shit! He knows!

dialogue.speaker: 0118D4814AAE3D4C78B984BA50574981
dialogue.line: That a problem for you, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 4D2F268A41E0A90534FAB2B27944A55B
dialogue.line: The ditch? Ah. Makes sense.

dialogue.speaker: FCF25DCB48FE8268F349A5823CDF233D
dialogue.line: The ditch? Ah. Maybe I'll find something precious down there, too.

dialogue.speaker: 9BE0CDDA4446E0730A956384FAC688E5
dialogue.line: These woods are dangerous, my friend. Better not travel them alone.

dialogue.speaker: BA79DEC94EE72DD0418B3C8A3A2156F5
dialogue.line: You really should've stuck to the highway, friend.

dialogue.speaker: B5245EE54F6B9F50D155BEA77DDEEB54
dialogue.line: You reek of blood.

dialogue.speaker: E1CF227C45C0274F84A326BDF86FA05B
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: DA2B7A1A46C23D08B7F0A4A32484A291
dialogue.line: A sword... Wasn't some commoner, then.

dialogue.speaker: DC47B24C4162FC5640C0E49B5DE4FD24
dialogue.line: An uriashi soldier... Who's the poor sod he's beating on?

dialogue.speaker: 5D4139244B0BAD40E10EFBA49FACDA15
dialogue.line: And it looks like he was sent here by Catalin himself.

dialogue.speaker: C2169620450A611B1F4657A0EE6ABA11
dialogue.line: Blood... and more footprints. Looks like someone was attacked here... and then the attacker gave chase.

dialogue.speaker: 2493DB4A43B23EAD734A0487FE992BDA
dialogue.line: Hm. There is something hidden in the shank... A note?

dialogue.speaker: C800B1734B5C0E4F7C02498BCC18F7D1
dialogue.line: Is that... an uriashi horn?

dialogue.speaker: 8C819A6A4C1EF46B6DB4C7B83B8EA6E2
dialogue.line: Mert... Could it be Mert the miller? Haven't seen him in a while. Is he really working with the manumits?

dialogue.speaker: B5280E8E467438E3685871A9623026F7
dialogue.line: Not much left of the tent... As if something had pounded it into the ground.

dialogue.speaker: 255F1CE14CB0634FEE63CDAC10722511
dialogue.line: One fewer vrakhiri soldier... But who's his victim?

dialogue.speaker: 843D45E74E8F82EF6BA2AEBFE1CD28ED
dialogue.line: So this was one of the manumits that worked with Mert...

dialogue.speaker: 510A02F84F32639732222EBD5999F61B
dialogue.line: Someone must have been here recently.

dialogue.speaker: AAF38BB34689D9DCB8525CA4CE5DA169
dialogue.line: Still burning...

dialogue.speaker: 43F35CBA482EB98F667D86B010457244
dialogue.line: Still smouldering...

dialogue.speaker: 8461B5EC4FD166E46819C6ABD054FF1C
dialogue.line: Those are some big footprints... Went deeper into the forest?

dialogue.speaker: 8A9E555445707EB259C00D922684B0B6
dialogue.line: Tossed aside... but doesn't look like anyone rummaged through it.

dialogue.speaker: 1759A3F24458E82F16C0F9B5D5D28547
dialogue.line: Weird... Is this some form of code?

dialogue.speaker: D922747540BA26FF8E2A8196889624B3
dialogue.line: What a mess...

dialogue.speaker: C629BE744FF5686550617A9334585B33
dialogue.line: What the hell is that thumping sound?

dialogue.speaker: 1A057DFF42135155925831AF5A141BA7
dialogue.line: Whoever stayed in this camp... or destroyed it, shouldn't be too far away...

dialogue.speaker: 03EC12934397CAF33078C8B2DFBC5FF7
dialogue.line: Aargh, how do you like it, you fucking goat?!

dialogue.speaker: 69896709413348183885BF805E9790CA
dialogue.line: He hid something in his shoe? Huh.

dialogue.speaker: D90259834D6B161598890490645E3FF0
dialogue.line: I... I'm honoured, lord Catalin. But I'm not sure –

dialogue.speaker: 0933E471476FE5540F6A6CA5403D6C8E
dialogue.line: It's just... That's a lot of risk for one man. And that wife of his – Right, right. Everyone's got something to lose.

dialogue.speaker: B3BB84A64A1A95575017E59DCFFB036D
dialogue.line: Now for the other one – shit! I yield! I yieaaagh-!

dialogue.speaker: 256230374A1804C96DCC1298D0419CA9
dialogue.line: Of-of course. I will not let you down, my liege. That I swear.

dialogue.speaker: 2A875DCD43E7CA870B261180C66CB5DC
dialogue.line: Oh, don't you worry. I know how to get around the valley unnoticed.

dialogue.speaker: 205A2EB3453C85B10F82C3B1788C3204
dialogue.line: We're using Mert again? No, no, I don't doubt his loyalty to the manumit cause.

dialogue.speaker: 64F8ED324727198FA44DCBB464E00CE0
dialogue.line: Yeah, safe and sound. In my shoe, just like old Nenad taught us.

dialogue.speaker: 85CAACB14F8A08C45A1009BA40ABD045
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: 6A43C37D4C977707C22E67AB6350713C
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: AD395815417DC2E56312FDA672F8D63C
dialogue.line: Giving up already?! Weak!

dialogue.speaker: C7F9EE374DBA9E2D0FB3A38D28421B9C
dialogue.line: Look, I not finish! Tell where friends! Tell! Aargh, tell!

dialogue.speaker: 3332B05746B4099039D2CF9466C2D1B6
dialogue.line: You break horn, I break you!

dialogue.speaker: 51FD3B00454EA97D3476D6889D405FE6
dialogue.line: You! Rebel too? I arrest!

dialogue.speaker: FC19AC9B4BF8F0B32AADAA9A57A56506
dialogue.line: You... I know! Coen of Luh-slea-ah! I bring to knyaz, he happy!

dialogue.speaker: A173D970429B476587665E8264A30E2A
dialogue.line: '...and... go to... Svar-Svartrau for... basic... train... training.'

dialogue.speaker: 39F65AA846E0576C85B32A8AE137F776
dialogue.line: Give... it... to me! Jesus, I'm – I'm sorry. Come... come back...

dialogue.speaker: 6B3AE3C64FDDB81C8FC9B28E3D870045
dialogue.line: How's the wine? Wasn't easy to get it, you know.

dialogue.speaker: D348B3A5467D042B5136ABAAD748A71C
dialogue.line: I-I love you, Lujeta! There, I said it!

dialogue.speaker: 3DBE7750415768B5CB859F813D45A60E
dialogue.line: Listen. I'll be leaving soon and... and who knows what will happen. So...

dialogue.speaker: 69614325460FE1DFF928CB9FCAD86C62
dialogue.line: Mum! Dad! I got in! I'll serve the knyaz!

dialogue.speaker: 9E7DF6054F0E3F711472789756F28659
dialogue.line: Ple-please... Don't... I don't – aah.

dialogue.speaker: F00FD7184FCF92BD90941BBA0B0A661C
dialogue.line: Say something, my love. Don't let me – Aagh!

dialogue.speaker: 482E71C14E8DD0E156459791FBAC5CA0
dialogue.line: You like it? Good, good. You... we deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: 904D6BF54DE4E6DFCE50888D3FF38C08
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: CA6A599A44686E2D009C7FB5A805E972
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 2A9EF75C4BD6F6C35D283D83F7C6531A
dialogue.line: A bloodied knife...

dialogue.speaker: CBF116E444E0A73310CC179AFA97E5C8
dialogue.line: A fresh recruit to Brencis's army and a secret rebel went for a date... What a fucking tragedy.

dialogue.speaker: ED22E45845B8A3BCA33151AE36182295
dialogue.line: A piece of cloth... From a dress, maybe?

dialogue.speaker: F298DBBA444A94625D99E587079BC5D5
dialogue.line: A recruitment letter... And enough food to survive for a couple of days.

dialogue.speaker: ECF0E48447E0439834D8FBA96260FFF9
dialogue.line: Blood... shit.

dialogue.speaker: 3F825A444ABE9C0BFA530BA06274DC8D
dialogue.line: Christ... What happened here?

dialogue.speaker: 138E6A2740C44AFEFEA3D8BE2B480E18
dialogue.line: Didn't stand a chance. Poor girl.

dialogue.speaker: DB06B87741F4810BD446E099315AF5D1
dialogue.line: He was on his way to join Brencis's army.

dialogue.speaker: 4CF844134133FB468F0B1CA211A5D2C9
dialogue.line: Huh. She worked for the manumits...

dialogue.speaker: 805F46704A9F0457D1D7639F4A602FBB
dialogue.line: I bet he wasn't planning on dying here...

dialogue.speaker: 87136B924253DE0468D97BA91F1C0443
dialogue.line: Some flowers, a bottle of cheap wine... A date gone wrong?

dialogue.speaker: B68D8ABA4377DF1866FB6A9E883502A5
dialogue.line: The trail seems to be leading deeper into the forest...

dialogue.speaker: BD3FCF16439510DA6B982DBE7AD44882
dialogue.line: Alright, alright.

dialogue.speaker: 34B17B034BD0ACE256139A9813064854
dialogue.line: Calm down. Not the first time she's disappeared like that. She'll be back.

dialogue.speaker: 8E2E0279400BC2614A944DBB4AC0C5F1
dialogue.line: Dad, please... eat something. Anything.

dialogue.speaker: 6946735D46CF5D7029E3F8A700433357
dialogue.line: I told her I didn't like that boy...

dialogue.speaker: 5B30758B46A15454CE9EB5970CFCB1F9
dialogue.line: I will. After I'm finished with work.

dialogue.speaker: A3F28E524D4D4DF665336A97EC45D269
dialogue.line: Just... take a break, alright?

dialogue.speaker: EB83E75D41F3185A5E4B7B8D7A85DC20
dialogue.line: Leave me be, son.

dialogue.speaker: D6860D6745B52021C79F478D5F363913
dialogue.line: Listen... It's not your fault. She –

dialogue.speaker: D7290E62466D5BC7022E8D9A8E8F0575
dialogue.line: Lujeta should be home by now.

dialogue.speaker: F5DCC5F64FC90F617753CBB9B49A4C18
dialogue.line: Maybe she got lost?

dialogue.speaker: 9DE601254927C85F6FFDA29FCF1D2B76
dialogue.line: Or maybe she went on a longer walk – again. And forgot to tell us – again. Seriously, dad – you worry over nothing.

dialogue.speaker: D81262C34E04B00147C8C6AE5D71EA18
dialogue.line: Probably seeing what's-his-name again.

dialogue.speaker: 38E4F7A54A4FBC370E87109AD933508D
dialogue.line: Right. And you really thought that would work, dad?

dialogue.speaker: 2D7BCF164671D2D9E0B9CD8CFC35DFDC
dialogue.line: Soon.

dialogue.speaker: 9DFF3DDC475409BCB09358ABE5480C52
dialogue.line: Must be Lujeta, the armourer's daughter... Shit.

dialogue.speaker: C8A54AF34F0B8C73BE9807ADCD77B81D
dialogue.line: Poor girl, ran straight into a wolf pack...

dialogue.speaker: 5534015D4D51C7C45FAB8DB1F95F4074
dialogue.line: She got here after she stabbed that boy to death...

dialogue.speaker: 277E444B4FD45B58E7BB649B7E5E70F7
dialogue.line: She played a dangerous game....

dialogue.speaker: CB88865D41DDF464DC0B74AFC53A5BDA
dialogue.line: The dress is torn here. She ran through some bushes.

dialogue.speaker: 081D9A9E4E6D2B449217E0ABDFF058B3
dialogue.line: There are scratches on her face... Left by fingernails, I think.

dialogue.speaker: E2F4B5D7460E69C13980D1AC77DAED60
dialogue.line: Was she trying to escape the wolves? Or something else?

dialogue.speaker: C2B19F3A461E0A69939699B37C44BBAF
dialogue.line: I better leave this place, and quick.

dialogue.speaker: EA40FE14487BD1E112287F833B3119C8
dialogue.line: I feel sorry for her... But I've got problems of my own.

dialogue.speaker: BE5D16AF46CD4D627155B4A00D3EE899
dialogue.line: Some commotion in that alley...

dialogue.speaker: D73017884DF2704E15D1F6A5ABBBBDC0
dialogue.line: Why is the guard pestering this woman?

dialogue.speaker: F8F3F0D9449379A5EDCCE69E3940D246
dialogue.line: Alright, staying out of it.

dialogue.speaker: 8D08CF664F2DD47415C5799FB51054ED
dialogue.line: Alright, that's enough of your yapping. You're both coming with me!

dialogue.speaker: 53C2D7364E69040FE2AC63B10C17CA08
dialogue.line: But... but it's the only thing I've got left of him. Please, just –

dialogue.speaker: 5A459B514E8EC552E4FB2A989A9B023F
dialogue.line: Con-contraband?... It's just a small brooch, just a keepsake...

dialogue.speaker: 0D78EA9B4DBDC79E912222BA1DB3F145
dialogue.line: Enough. You leave her alone.

dialogue.speaker: 177572A24E34BAFF2C84ABA720BA9CFD
dialogue.line: Enough. You leave her alone.

dialogue.speaker: B5A2C657437B0E7CD7D4189DACBAC9D1
dialogue.line: Friend, you're as dumb as she is... Alright, eh... You'll both be coming with me!

dialogue.speaker: 459266784433BB761E253C9211F43A71
dialogue.line: I understand that. But he will arrest you.

dialogue.speaker: 77AAB46B482E6E06D28DC49BC2C91750
dialogue.line: I... I can't. It's the only thing –

dialogue.speaker: CA52D4814E521D02649DEF875EC6ECEE
dialogue.line: Is everything alright here?

dialogue.speaker: 5062878940198AE0DAA5A1A48C9A0AB7
dialogue.line: It. Is. Silver. Christ, how stupid are you? And you – stay out of it.

dialogue.speaker: 3C820435415CF85DAB0D7BBAD2323C15
dialogue.line: Just give him what he wants.

dialogue.speaker: D51B9ECA4F9CA3B64E2AA4944094D98C
dialogue.line: Just give him what he wants.

dialogue.speaker: 89C6D09049CF4ABA926F3CAEA1C45441
dialogue.line: Maybe... maybe we can still –

dialogue.speaker: 0921D1424EE9BE9B98602B8270DA82E2
dialogue.line: No! Please! I'll – I'll give it to you! Just don't –

dialogue.speaker: C836A568431712F4EF4871BE698F5678
dialogue.line: Smart. And you – I'm a patient man, wanted to give you a chance. But you had to be stubborn about this.

dialogue.speaker: D6B1515F49425A9597A214B1F07DE33E
dialogue.line: Stay out of it, or – Oh, shit! You're Coen of Laslea!

dialogue.speaker: 4F72AF0841FB273045C126A4E365163A
dialogue.line: Staying out of it.

dialogue.speaker: EE95E1B8481E5545BA0DE5B228A0619F
dialogue.line: This woman is in possession of contraband – she's breaking the law.

dialogue.speaker: 89A1A6294223E32ED8E84D86F91BD6EE
dialogue.line: Too fucking late. Move it!

dialogue.speaker: 015ACA414FBFF950ED535D88C8A7C13E
dialogue.line: You're a dead man!

dialogue.speaker: D978A7244DE8B04E3A0C6F82197A8F31
dialogue.line: You're coming with me.

dialogue.speaker: C6663A974886CFF1E9E8B28A7A2F24A2
dialogue.line: [scoff] All silver is to be confiscated. No exceptions. You understand that, right?

dialogue.speaker: 9AA585A24541E7B61BEB13BE4ABD4CBB
dialogue.line: And solve another of my problems. Thanks!

dialogue.speaker: 05BFFF9D40AF01E0C8048AB35FA4522B
dialogue.line: But you... you look like a shrewd fellow. How about I sell it to you on the cheap? I'm sure you'll be able to pass it on for a bigger profit.

dialogue.speaker: 0B26FC2B454AC54522FCA99D2505CCAB
dialogue.line: Can't pay what you want.

dialogue.speaker: FBA9FA8C4B891236C99985838DD51AC1
dialogue.line: Can't pay what you want.

dialogue.speaker: 107ED0E547DFD6CFA8382DB730939F88
dialogue.line: I see. So all that memento talk was a lie?

dialogue.speaker: 62E1EBDC4C002F9DF0E418A17D1772C6
dialogue.line: I'm sure it meant something to someone once. To me it means a few meals and a warm bed for a couple of days.

dialogue.speaker: EBBF40CE449B1EB40E69A38EE7BB02A1
dialogue.line: I've got enough problems as it is. Not interested.

dialogue.speaker: F79CE9E84819C4D16FE645B60307ED57
dialogue.line: Not interested.

dialogue.speaker: AD64328448AF4ABE1628F984D1077F2C
dialogue.line: Now, it's time for both of us to get moving. Someone is bound to come looking for this shitstain.

dialogue.speaker: D0751EE647994ECF80E597BEADA5D1B4
dialogue.line: Shame.

dialogue.speaker: ADACD0C546EE49E6BD199E97CB765D63
dialogue.line: Stay safe, hero.

dialogue.speaker: 84A3CD634A6D071F1212008B5925B932
dialogue.line: Sure, I'll take it off your hands.

dialogue.speaker: EC8E47FF4F478131167E4F9AA37DB944
dialogue.line: Sure, I'll take it off your hands.

dialogue.speaker: 8B53624249C36ECD02423EA861AC34EB
dialogue.line: That dog just wouldn't leave me alone... Appreciate you stepping in.

dialogue.speaker: 459B82C44248362D3431F19F18C341DF
dialogue.line: This bauble almost cost me my head... Got to get rid of it, and soon.

dialogue.speaker: 6C87E7D949FAFAB472A1B19037308FF6
dialogue.line: Was going to sell it to a fence. But honestly, I have no idea how to even start looking for one that's ready to trade in silver.

dialogue.speaker: 181D454A46895C58C89E218F2158BC55
dialogue.line: Your loss.

dialogue.speaker: 77C82F3B4CF003AA4EF63BB41557628E
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 067AAEAA40C14068C71A1EACEA4BB28D
dialogue.line: [scoff] You made a fool of me. Unwise.

dialogue.speaker: 7AE337BA4EF48D06B6E372ADAECDD568
dialogue.line: Are you deaf, woman?! Give it to me!

dialogue.speaker: 6784B14D400F6DB553FEB3A863A6F4CC
dialogue.line: I don't give a shit! The law is the same for everyone. So one last time – give it to me!

dialogue.speaker: 399C1BEE463988FED922FBA7438A2983
dialogue.line: Please... just... just let me go. It's the only thing I –

dialogue.speaker: D875FCCC4B0C79D88EB86F8E3333BEA2
dialogue.line: Am I a fool to even try such a thing? To make a pact with... with demons?

dialogue.speaker: 194255D3401A0C7074EB539D94727141
dialogue.line: Amantes amentes sunt...

dialogue.speaker: 3E93ECD841C6373A1CC98EA2EE3F9AB7
dialogue.line: Can't let that happen. If I succeed, this... this should protect you.

dialogue.speaker: 5F0A03C24D4228AB0E3682BE6C3F86EF
dialogue.line: Curse my hubris! Curse this - No. No. Keep it together.

dialogue.speaker: D4E3336E4B93E5466B0DD38621CADBEE
dialogue.line: I still have time. Still can stop it.

dialogue.speaker: 67C12C414CE2B7EE3F68BAAEE1682BA4
dialogue.line: No time to lose. Got to burn it, now...

dialogue.speaker: A09F91D14C967B8E2D0A9999709D3482
dialogue.line: Oh, Henrik... If people knew, they would gladly destroy what we have.

dialogue.speaker: 4CE6DC594ACAA216C544CC9FF408F70D
dialogue.line: Oh, you sly fox. You know I had my eye on this pendant since the first time I entered your store!

dialogue.speaker: 273FDDE7469612C09950139FA6FD5B87
dialogue.line: Wait, a dedication? Oh, my... Yes, thank you. It's... it's beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: 2A07979B477B42A063C28D8A3C16E22A
dialogue.line: What is this? Moths? Wait, I don't – Aaaaagh!

dialogue.speaker: F88078C146A93E41991309B31E1FA18E
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: 0A7EE00F4C174F99BA1C45A7AFB5D505
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 4FA705D5401D9F55CAC346B9C2A29526
dialogue.line: Ignis iste purgationem ferat, Haec lux omne malum deleat. Abi daemon!

dialogue.speaker: 4294183F47CC5A748D3A0991A063A956
dialogue.line: Not sure what I'm doing... But here goes.

dialogue.speaker: F4369C7F4B8BC488745A4D9322B3598F
dialogue.line: Some symbols have appeared on the bracelet... Similar to the ones in the book.

dialogue.speaker: 48524DEB4EBF7E00E5ECD8BABFFD3C58
dialogue.line: This might be the stupidest thing I've ever done...

dialogue.speaker: CDBD54EE4183DFF184A90381319371D0
dialogue.line: What should I do?

dialogue.speaker: 41D8942F4FCBB60C670CAE9F4901EA4C
dialogue.line: [burn the page]

dialogue.speaker: 120CE71245B1EA8734FD098C39D47F21
dialogue.line: [finish the ritual]

dialogue.speaker: FB4AEA854B53C0BEA485C38F598BD1A3
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What kind of hunger?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.POI111_WizardBeloved
dialogue.line: You would be surprised. True, there's not a lot of literate people in Svartrau. But those who are... well, there is a hunger in them.

dialogue.speaker: 6D57CE9142E96A7FF1271696B42ED4F1
dialogue.line: And who are you?

dialogue.speaker: EA2760A5473515D5F438268733350343
dialogue.line: And who are you?

dialogue.speaker: E0A44EF64947CD98AD283491148F7BF3
dialogue.line: Christ…

dialogue.speaker: 6D666E994E0F6F8F0CE9FEA1AE9FAF5D
dialogue.line: He’s... he’s dead. Someone broke into the shop and... Maybe Henrik startled them or... Sorry, it’s just so horrible.

dialogue.speaker: B0E77CF049D606A47F9512992BB7EA9B
dialogue.line: I live nearby. Saw you knocking at Henrik’s door. But he’s not inside.

dialogue.speaker: D09737194072CCD748405AA2D774F85C
dialogue.line: I... I don’t know. I don’t want to know.

dialogue.speaker: 5A70B23848681FDE5D12D4A9E90DFC42
dialogue.line: If he's not here, then where?

dialogue.speaker: CE5F93D24AB893E6A3E01DAA2AF3420E
dialogue.line: It’s not just that... When they came to take the body to the cemetery, I saw... him. He looked really awful.

dialogue.speaker: 29854D0441C58D726346ED8C05214F0D
dialogue.line: Looking for Henrik?

dialogue.speaker: 47E1FD594E6FA49480273AAB1CA2E0E8
dialogue.line: Murder always is...

dialogue.speaker: 3DFCE6B847CC53EC2E782FB6AEF0749A
dialogue.line: Oh, sorry – didn't mean to startle you. But if you want to see Henrik... well, don't bother.

dialogue.speaker: FD56763A443427346587F28592DE5E98
dialogue.line: Poor Henrik... I’m sorry, but I have to go. God watch over you.

dialogue.speaker: 2CBE99B24AECC3942B151D8E3E2E1897
dialogue.line: Symbols? What kind?

dialogue.speaker: 2F2F071E45BF06A2182D90A10FF12C05
dialogue.line: There were... cuts on him. Lots and lots of cuts. And they looked like... symbols.

dialogue.speaker: 54E28C6B4C4D7927FEB76F91529EC730
dialogue.line: Where can I find him?

dialogue.speaker: 1BFB059949CE0D1A098BE8B5A49A5A24
dialogue.line: 'De Vocatione et Ligatione'... 'On Summoning and Binding'?

dialogue.speaker: 073612594F23EB01F9E400B03F54F15A
dialogue.line: 'If one wants to banish the daemonic entity, its name should be tossed into a cleansing fire.' Huh.

dialogue.speaker: 1FF6AFDB4BFED19C3A87928A6989A14B
dialogue.line: 'Never doubt your heart - Henrik.'

dialogue.speaker: 36166D7F47C38433EB8A08A382115AD5
dialogue.line: A bowl... Is it for some offering?

dialogue.speaker: 27521A64467BF9B0D565B4AA4322B02C
dialogue.line: A pendant... There's a dedication inside.

dialogue.speaker: B68C427B42FCB618ADFA13A443ECCE5C
dialogue.line: A torn out page... there are some notes on it.

dialogue.speaker: D6B0D4764EC6B111FBA1F4A5FCFF7ED1
dialogue.line: A word... written in blood. 'Thamuherit'.

dialogue.speaker: FF83CF7F4EEAC339E2DFDC8458B84172
dialogue.line: Ah, the missing page! Maybe I can use it to break the ritual...

dialogue.speaker: E3D9E3F24B08DA685A438EA024738287
dialogue.line: Candles, a bowl... some weird symbols? Was this some kind of a ritual?

dialogue.speaker: 1161DF0B46F5D50F44E92BA58EA120C4
dialogue.line: Could it be connected to the bracelet?

dialogue.speaker: DF639C6F4B67CBFC78C32FACA7FA074F
dialogue.line: Don't know what this... thing was. But I hope that by killing it I've broken the ritual.

dialogue.speaker: F452138E4A4B9475F7BBDAA247D9C8E1
dialogue.line: Got all I need to complete the ritual. I could finish what he started...

dialogue.speaker: C2020E7442818DDAFBECCA9E760F3401
dialogue.line: Hm. The last page is missing.

dialogue.speaker: 6C845A214C293E1CC92376885B39A62A
dialogue.line: Huh, the last page is torn out. Maybe it's still somewhere around here?

dialogue.speaker: 489C26914B7343424A7CA092777E1D8D
dialogue.line: Huh. I can feel... some kind of power emanating from this symbol.

dialogue.speaker: 28022527481526EE4D61B8B235A65344
dialogue.line: Just one page. Maybe the rest of the book is nearby?

dialogue.speaker: BB85E76D47EAC618018DE18C6EDDAEED
dialogue.line: Moths? They seem to be attracted to the door for some reason...

dialogue.speaker: 343BC9294919A1172E68C59846FA3CC4
dialogue.line: Seems like someone tried to bind a spirit to this bracelet.

dialogue.speaker: 40A7FB314F5BBD2F25478DB0482B8340
dialogue.line: Some symbols have appeared on the bracelet... And I can feel there's magic trapped inside it.

dialogue.speaker: F25BC34842FBA38FC16AAFB14FE3CEBA
dialogue.line: Strange symbols cut into his body...

dialogue.speaker: 297312554DEA82DCB35269B586E0A8B0
dialogue.line: The fog feels weird. It's more like some kind of miasma...

dialogue.speaker: 393C33A34413C023B0E0E985FD27E3BD
dialogue.line: The question is: what does it do?

dialogue.speaker: E6EFBB59438F0516C03F919B37A050B7
dialogue.line: This bracelet looks valuable... who would just leave it here, in the open?

dialogue.speaker: 6486809343B5ED38684D8A8960474200
dialogue.line: This is the missing page from the book

dialogue.speaker: 2E704A2943D633FD59212DA8468A029F
dialogue.line: This isn't normal fog....

dialogue.speaker: 9762F864430B20D137C283A785EA9A83
dialogue.line: Vita et mors. Erige velamen inter eos, profer praesidium. Salva vitam, aufer vitam.

dialogue.speaker: EA2F4B674066E2ECDEFE528777963FE1
dialogue.line: Weird fog... and a dead body. Shit.

dialogue.speaker: 9FE659D44B4C4FC53A206B889C10133C
dialogue.line: A shrine to a pagan god? I'd better leave it alone.

dialogue.speaker: 4EEA24F7475E8D1600A4EE9FECB09A04
dialogue.line: Did someone pray to this... bone effigy?

dialogue.speaker: E81454764091AF86E60B9F837ADC921B
dialogue.line: Is this some kind of an altar?

dialogue.speaker: 62468CAA4BB1586BF2A6618A1CF00E18
dialogue.line: The candles are still burning. Someone must have lit them recently.

dialogue.speaker: 8D00477E4DF4954A6FB5219366AD193A
dialogue.line: There are some herbs in the bowls... Offerings?

dialogue.speaker: E00B1E664E185B487DE8FA8FC154204C
dialogue.line: Alright, high time I went to Oghasti. Did some shopping. Played the civilised man.

dialogue.speaker: 5079CA0541F2C5BED8CEDA8105097EBC
dialogue.line: Alright, time to get some food. Take the pack and go. I'll join soon enough.

dialogue.speaker: 2F542A614E86603397DDCE8A1AAF98A6
dialogue.line: Damn, really did a number on this shirt. No saving it.

dialogue.speaker: 2E485F6B46A99957F3DDD498C08CCC72
dialogue.line: Glad I stayed behind, aren't you? Yeah, me too. Someone had to.

dialogue.speaker: 617C3CB24AA3B17EDCD60F8A3ACDB2C7
dialogue.line: I can still... still take you. Even in this form... even... one-handed...

dialogue.speaker: A4765A2B41D3C935E8FCB49CEAF4DFD5
dialogue.line: I know it hurts, pup. You'll get used to it. Hell, some of us grow to like it after a time.

dialogue.speaker: F190F2324F246929290124BBCE581932
dialogue.line: Let's... get this over with. Raeeargh!

dialogue.speaker: 884AA8E643F60531966191B806C23D7C
dialogue.line: Now hold still. This balm will sting a bit, but it'll make you feel better soon.

dialogue.speaker: F4D48C0944ADD8D267BE9E8EDCB0ADDA
dialogue.line: See... yourself as... a huntsman? You're... a fucking joke, you leech.

dialogue.speaker: D1DF52EC4474C8D7631C738F16AD8F62
dialogue.line: The clan's safe, far away from the vrakhiri domain. Good.

dialogue.speaker: 149E3FB940A032C5C6E3119BABAD52E6
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: A5A487DF4F3E8F8EC24F0F9ABDAC11D7
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 3E15D39D4A098E9554E19081E3017644
dialogue.line: A cemetery amongst the trees... If the map is to be believed, I should go deeper into the forest.

dialogue.speaker: D959241D41531C9E4CC2938D4F72A68C
dialogue.line: A map that really leads to treasure. Heh. Just like in the stories mum used to tell me.

dialogue.speaker: B7D3D5ED43E28A5028EEB6B2B66E0D7D
dialogue.line: A mound? The wolves didn't make it.

dialogue.speaker: 6BBC3F134AD4703AFAF8038E8CDC6332
dialogue.line: A shrine by the road... Just like the one on that map I found.

dialogue.speaker: 95497B7C4F8896FFB571349DBBCBD0F1
dialogue.line: And there's a cave...

dialogue.speaker: 9FA67A2A4EDD0AABE46460B94EE99EE3
dialogue.line: Crossroads... Which path should I take?

dialogue.speaker: 9C9BA6614FCF0A6219FEA28C996079A9
dialogue.line: Hm. Some crossroads, a forest path... and a cave. Probably the one in which I found all that hidden silver.

dialogue.speaker: 5A3431A24106A57ABD934386077900DB
dialogue.line: That's... that's quite a lot of silver. If only we'd known about this place when we decided to challenge Brencis...

dialogue.speaker: DDE1BB2D4E401092CF6AD1BBAF1395FF
dialogue.line: But so it must be. We're all bound by the laws of nature, aren't we, my dear?

dialogue.speaker: BC43CAE149F8EC19291E37B014748EF2
dialogue.line: But this is not what I wanted. I had to build pyres... burn the bodies. All of them. Everyone I knew.

dialogue.speaker: 225778CB468A5BF6EF148ABACAEA67D9
dialogue.line: Drink my blood! Drink as much as you need!

dialogue.speaker: EE7D12F6440451E3AB2DCBA93A9C5008
dialogue.line: Fine, laugh all you want! But if this works, I'll be revered. I'll become a saint! Saint Eusebiu, who ended the plague!

dialogue.speaker: 900762824E4804967EA2AD81F72B8380
dialogue.line: I don't want this anymore. And I know how to end it.

dialogue.speaker: 6CD1A4314CA84C9FF27C71A0F79120F4
dialogue.line: No, it doesn't unlock anything. It's a myth. But it is potent!

dialogue.speaker: A88392DD49D4109EA54FAFB2E6E6A381
dialogue.line: Now all that's left is to make the potion! But... It will only work on me. The others... they will perish.

dialogue.speaker: A0B9074C4084B18835FFE1941317D678
dialogue.line: Razkovniche... The rainbow root... The hedgehog herb. I've found it!

dialogue.speaker: 827F977049F1027E8C137695BBA999E8
dialogue.line: Rest now.

dialogue.speaker: 82C619214A202E6E74F4149502C233C3
dialogue.line: Talk to me.

dialogue.speaker: 501F63AA460465AF998177AB8DD14D4C
dialogue.line: The plague didn't kill this man. He died not that long ago.

dialogue.speaker: CB509C5B470B49D97B9EDEB178E53B86
dialogue.line: There are many herbs in this world. Some, like you, give people strength. Others can suck the life out of them.

dialogue.speaker: 575C883A4BACB2D8980939A777DC18A3
dialogue.line: Yes! Yes! Grow! I knew water was not enough! I knew you needed something way more potent, my dear!

dialogue.speaker: 721E09854B4114338ED862B5366C4134
dialogue.line: You served me well, my dearest razkovniche. You've kept me alive long enough.

dialogue.speaker: F3944E8D4CFED725141D828A54721CA1
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: 053569AB40CD35AA4E73A58690F4D1C8
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 85867BCD451E4F5C61D2EDAE5F5B7F41
dialogue.line: But not now.

dialogue.speaker: 4F8581954BE50951203859A1C8CD606E
dialogue.line: Here you go. A few drops of my blood.

dialogue.speaker: 6C7B6DB343B11129878EABB28B4A9039
dialogue.line: I hope that is what you wanted. Now take your time. I'll check on you in a while.

dialogue.speaker: E833C58F40D9A900CC56208886FD8023
dialogue.line: I'm not doing this.

dialogue.speaker: 46E3EFFE41690B06173D3087A67D3D07
dialogue.line: Is that what you wanted?

dialogue.speaker: A4B87B7844EA0EF20EA276B5D72D80E4
dialogue.line: Let's see here...

dialogue.speaker: 046F24D34C1B38FB4ED40584AFC1A30B
dialogue.line: Maybe later.

dialogue.speaker: D6D072CC498267CC35351BB1A5CA49D7
dialogue.line: More potent... stronger... thicker! I get it! He meant blood!

dialogue.speaker: 5A551CD84AAEB69D4410E8BA44DD3E67
dialogue.line: Now let's make a potion out of you.

dialogue.speaker: E2711DB34B1752A375866A87F5E730C0
dialogue.line: Now what should I do to make you grow?

dialogue.speaker: 0593118A496CF7E89FA28F8E468F4075
dialogue.line: Seems like the right thing to do.

dialogue.speaker: 7B188BC5415C77922EB02E999DCFECD3
dialogue.line: So, from what the man said, this plant needs blood to grow. My blood, to be precise, if I want it to have an effect on me.

dialogue.speaker: 07AB3289449BD00D9AE4239D380C751C
dialogue.line: Water did nothing at all.

dialogue.speaker: CCFCCCED437ABE7D6D92958CB31111F3
dialogue.line: What am I missing?

dialogue.speaker: 55CA73DF450B6BF1CABAD0960B297D4D
dialogue.line: What's more potent than water? What did he 'give' you?

dialogue.speaker: 13E4933444B22A41AAC32E81B858276F
dialogue.line: You grew fast, little one. Disturbingly fast.

dialogue.speaker: A7CED66F49A462DED24A6A99DF048A31
dialogue.line: [check on the plant]

dialogue.speaker: EFA54E8847D4E29B908B5FB080C67603
dialogue.line: [give the plant a few drops of your blood]

dialogue.speaker: 4B1725D448A391A180B1A2BDA8265C2F
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 794162F84BEBCDA4A232C59BB9E48F39
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 9273E4A84421C610CC8AF58A9A428B69
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 5AE797B94713CA640ED5CC82C1C5EA01
dialogue.line: [pick the plant]

dialogue.speaker: 0B67C6984E7AF91954CEC087B2A500B7
dialogue.line: I can't believe this. Fuck.

dialogue.speaker: EB25509F432541A0BCEDFDAA322A8BA1
dialogue.line: I should have stopped you, Iancu.

dialogue.speaker: 543EE6654637670A3513F4ABBE97E53B
dialogue.line: I shouldn't have let you go.

dialogue.speaker: A9B620C540F70FA61679028EFA0106B1
dialogue.line: Please, be alive.

dialogue.speaker: C055644F48CF1E378D8E7585925247A3
dialogue.line: Shit, Iancu, what have you done?

dialogue.speaker: 4A2153F24B1BD1AB781C7EAD822B33D6
dialogue.line: This is not happening.

dialogue.speaker: 5B0BB7FD470579CE2AF1F3BDD87F212E
dialogue.line: A hound-like beast killed him. And I killed the beast.

dialogue.speaker: 1EBA74974C02D4A29D918881C664FA0C
dialogue.line: A hound? But… so many people disappeared there over the years. That hound killed them all?!

dialogue.speaker: 3F24C4B4467B20C867CBD2AD7F926418
dialogue.line: A hound? It killed all those people over the years?

dialogue.speaker: FDABD7904650051934FF97A5BB368279
dialogue.line: Actually, I did. Iancu is gone. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: C4013484422351D3AEB6C89680789E72
dialogue.line: Actually, I want him to know.

dialogue.speaker: 4B99CF364A16B065C4A47D9E7659BD18
dialogue.line: And I haven't slept a wink since he left.

dialogue.speaker: C20FDE614881C6FBD7A0BCA62362FEFB
dialogue.line: And he shouldn't have either.

dialogue.speaker: 2723224D44BA01EAA0DBF696F0CAA7CE
dialogue.line: Brencis?! The knyaz?!

dialogue.speaker: 9E6EF8FA4B9092777BD1E9AB7024AFF3
dialogue.line: But I know he can't cheat death forever.

dialogue.speaker: 2B5CA9AD40472D450EE895B8D5852353
dialogue.line: But we're both orphans. We became friends early on. And we've been like brothers ever since.

dialogue.speaker: 41E690E24E3E3F11E9DA0EB47679394D
dialogue.line: Do I... know you?

dialogue.speaker: 6E93CBF54C303D194BA6D3B29E7507AE
dialogue.line: Do me a favour, please. Tell everyone you meet that Coen of Laslea found the knyaz's old lair and discovered all of its secrets. Can you do that for me?

dialogue.speaker: 10CE01C64E1B99DBF131268BC52E5BB7
dialogue.line: God, I should have stopped him.

dialogue.speaker: CD66F5414B325BBAAAB9C6B68558737B
dialogue.line: Have you tried looking for him?

dialogue.speaker: F508E48C486C0BA71BE8CDBDD5B74416
dialogue.line: Have you tried looking for him?

dialogue.speaker: 1D05C04542CEA59B7E4780BD89EB7B4C
dialogue.line: He lived there before he took over. Seems like he hasn't been there since.

dialogue.speaker: ED7FD11E44A46A5F6BB16CBD8210BF6F
dialogue.line: He was supposed to be back days ago... but there's been no sign of him.

dialogue.speaker: FA4AC6064EFAEF8C843B20B0E8C05212
dialogue.line: He went to the Balaur. It's a nearby peak. A terrifying place.

dialogue.speaker: D18F610443C29C6C6AA7EFBA4AECA9CD
dialogue.line: Hm. Maybe you're right.

dialogue.speaker: CE0C2C6C497A8DB087E0C39FFE1EB8EF
dialogue.line: How?

dialogue.speaker: C94243104A1335A943FBF0993237D01F
dialogue.line: I can go search for him.

dialogue.speaker: 61DF27104F90DD7875DF528F52A5C841
dialogue.line: I could go search for Iancu. Maybe he's still there, waiting for help.

dialogue.speaker: DAF310904671CB7721DA7DB2A19A0204
dialogue.line: I found his body.

dialogue.speaker: 43C458854BAED93AFE1F9FA5AF7BB0D4
dialogue.line: I hope he comes back soon.

dialogue.speaker: 4C7B89384AE6B709B180F8A97436A735
dialogue.line: I hope he comes back soon.

dialogue.speaker: 1CD76FC7431975D618784CAC76204AA2
dialogue.line: I just thought that if it helped you find out, maybe Iancu's death wasn't so pointless. Not entirely, you know?

dialogue.speaker: 41F904124D4E757695FC8A9EC155ECEF
dialogue.line: I mean, I don't know. But maybe.

dialogue.speaker: 082D2F4E4F72622C5DF583AC6CCA9096
dialogue.line: I mean, we're very different. He's always been way more... adventurous.

dialogue.speaker: 297BEF4748FD1E4E3C089BA73EC4ED47
dialogue.line: I mean... Maybe it's dumb, but...

dialogue.speaker: 90D598154960C46622999CB29217778E
dialogue.line: I should be going.

dialogue.speaker: A1E861C945E565E98C28B3BA0897C19C
dialogue.line: I want him to know.

dialogue.speaker: 4D6A397B403DEEB7BA63B9BC72F76AB9
dialogue.line: I went to the peak. I found his body. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 7AA6FEE9410D872A190E688834205647
dialogue.line: I wouldn't dare to ask you this favour... but if you find him, I'll be forever grateful. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 99339FD840B7A44560722D83E618CC17
dialogue.line: I'm not sure. And I didn't meet them there.

dialogue.speaker: 96EC2FDE4420EC230789B2ABEC7B91B6
dialogue.line: Iancu wanted to see that for himself. If only he'd been a bloody coward, like the rest of us...

dialogue.speaker: 96C1C0264F1D2C34EDEFF7A26472C6C8
dialogue.line: It seems there's nothing we can do about it.

dialogue.speaker: 7839588242A8A43976F4F3B143F9237C
dialogue.line: It's about my friend, Iancu.

dialogue.speaker: 0367FB344A16DB5818FBB0A45801D865
dialogue.line: It's just how he's always been. Trying to prove himself all the time. As if he never thought himself good enough, brave enough, you know...

dialogue.speaker: 3D7933294DA8B2926CBCF4BC14FA48D7
dialogue.line: Me too.

dialogue.speaker: A95EE589425979AE8D4BE8BE4DFB3FB9
dialogue.line: No, I just noticed you're upset. What's wrong?

dialogue.speaker: A04C3A614C5418CF9835999670E8B4C3
dialogue.line: No, probably not. I don't want him to get furious and take it out on Parlita.

dialogue.speaker: 92632B01471A36BD89A5278CDFEAB74B
dialogue.line: No. There isn't. If only he hadn't been so bloody stubborn.

dialogue.speaker: 036261CC475595D2D358F5A269F635CD
dialogue.line: Oh, it's you. What is it? Something about Iancu?

dialogue.speaker: 1BEF543D4A19750B7110E0A27A2F01AB
dialogue.line: People have been disappearing there. For years. And those who got even remotely close... say it reeks of evil. So...

dialogue.speaker: 0437E06A469DE330AAED7D8355013845
dialogue.line: People have been disappearing there. For years. And those who've got even remotely close... say it reeks of evil.

dialogue.speaker: 55BCF5484DBC1B369ACA578A0D5E27A8
dialogue.line: Probably not.

dialogue.speaker: A1DB3A8441ED716FC1859089C872D86E
dialogue.line: Seems so.

dialogue.speaker: 259C756E465684745B1F27A4CE57D6AE
dialogue.line: Seems so. There were lots of bodies in its cave. But the hound is dead.

dialogue.speaker: 983E85F64F49524E365B5994B7CE9699
dialogue.line: Seems there's nothing we can do.

dialogue.speaker: E150A4D346091419484AE0809A8D8043
dialogue.line: So was it the hound all this time?

dialogue.speaker: B7E9764A4C1EDB54ED70AB840C58A562
dialogue.line: So... I guess we shouldn't tell anyone about this, should we?

dialogue.speaker: 539DD582414B7ACCC0BCEBBBA3AC57F7
dialogue.line: Somebody else lived in that cave.

dialogue.speaker: F2E0A86F44B519427C9A06834A0DF192
dialogue.line: Someone else used to live there.

dialogue.speaker: 59B210494CC078728A2C40AD37E9EF48
dialogue.line: Someone else? You mean a bandit? A hermit?

dialogue.speaker: 2C58F5CC45FB06E7217548ADA1C5B16B
dialogue.line: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 249656614A325F8E36F5AC99CE1FF059
dialogue.line: Thank you. Take care.

dialogue.speaker: 4A827C4749B65B66257170866AEF0D5D
dialogue.line: Thank you. We've all been so scared of it. All except Iancu, that is.

dialogue.speaker: 862D0E0547CD0BF9F149D2A9729B8182
dialogue.line: That cave was once Brencis's lair. Perhaps the hound had something to do with him. I don't know.

dialogue.speaker: BDF11DAE4F8A2F2E407FDDABFD05A18C
dialogue.line: The cave was once the lair of Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 0D3731574560DA144FD3E2848751C3A1
dialogue.line: There's something you need to know about the Balaur.

dialogue.speaker: EF10738A4937D684C64C5CBCEB3FCD80
dialogue.line: This peak, the Balaur – why is it so terrifying?

dialogue.speaker: 663423604A6E8AB36C9A259D0908F82B
dialogue.line: Umm... I guess so.

dialogue.speaker: 4FCBCA6F48A1F7D940D03486A81417F1
dialogue.line: Wait! Take this. In thanks for sticking your neck out.

dialogue.speaker: 3CF145894D2142D6EF104FBB91949307
dialogue.line: What does it matter?

dialogue.speaker: C619C9BA424A3E96AE600DADCC2C3D29
dialogue.line: What does it matter?

dialogue.speaker: 7927ACD14333515AC89E9DA2EF99080E
dialogue.line: What's the matter?

dialogue.speaker: A155C00549CC7F503563029AA67511A8
dialogue.line: What? No! No one in their right mind gets close to the Balaur!

dialogue.speaker: DEA77CB94D5B06A92BBD1A9B5E7D5B56
dialogue.line: Why did he climb the peak?

dialogue.speaker: D0A5D6274974E79553CA3BB944EA4E17
dialogue.line: Why did he even go there?

dialogue.speaker: F317030C45930BFD10E8FCBD32A09D4F
dialogue.line: Why is the Balaur such a terrifying place?

dialogue.speaker: E32A286345C0FE589C135B9E7B18527B
dialogue.line: You haven't found him, have you?

dialogue.speaker: F37454B64DBD12FDD425C390244C5A74
dialogue.line: You really think so?

dialogue.speaker: EBF95BE44E05067403E015B1272EA6E5
dialogue.line: You're good friends, Iancu and yourself?

dialogue.speaker: 2D3A96174F525614FD92AD8E9D2CBD74
dialogue.line: You're good friends?

dialogue.speaker: 2BF470314680D5A9B55CA88D54DA3268
dialogue.line: [Coen gives in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 04C4475D4450E2046C45DDA8EA24EE39
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: FC12190345BB22965F0A74BD1126EF4B
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: BCF7D6CD47CA1879F1FB6692A2D897DA
dialogue.line: [sob]

dialogue.speaker: 6BC61470497C0C1D07A0D0A371BE0395
dialogue.line: But when he became the knyaz, he never came back. He forgot her.

dialogue.speaker: 683CAB664FC2E947999A6CA3586CBBCB
dialogue.line: So Brencis used to live here until recently... And he still cared for his wife dearly... even after thirteen hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: 1E92379D4A5C85A4386E43880CEEE534
dialogue.line: So Brencis used to live here until recently... And he still cared for this woman... even after thirteen hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: FD67FA8843E135841E74148E01BF9990
dialogue.line: So someone lived here until recently... and for some reason they revered a woman named Helvia. But who was she?

dialogue.speaker: E8D939FD47F79575F0A6208E79328970
dialogue.line: But why not?! I'll be just picking berries! I won't go near the Balaur, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: 411C66A74C76774B27160CAB2E4655F1
dialogue.line: It never has!

dialogue.speaker: 7AD9B112416B021F5CAB74916B34BA41
dialogue.line: No. If the beast gets hungry, it may roam further from the peak!

dialogue.speaker: 4573FB43404C674945E737B2FF12AF81
dialogue.line: The water ran out. And I was thirsty. I just went to the well. And I'm not a little child anymore.

dialogue.speaker: F53ECE994C55D1C98B580CABBF9D110A
dialogue.line: Then you know people have disappeared in the mountains. Something's killing them! So I need you to be careful! Understood?!

dialogue.speaker: 7574776C494495217B270C85D04A403A
dialogue.line: What did I tell you?! Never leave the house at night!

dialogue.speaker: A4F982244D99340FA1D193A60E6A7D7A
dialogue.line: Yes, yes. I'll be careful.

dialogue.speaker: 19CAB1F9452012E96C4C92B5A86A9ED9
dialogue.line: You aren't going anywhere! That's it.

dialogue.speaker: F08C79FE49A36B250552AFAD3B2FC5D7
dialogue.line: Go away, human! We don't want talk anymore!

dialogue.speaker: 85FA3A67482DDD338530D7AF35215E64
dialogue.line: Go! Before patience leaves me!

dialogue.speaker: ABF2DB5446A7FA540F2CBC9F2F57A6C5
dialogue.line: Hrmph!

dialogue.speaker: 98B91DD34EDF3A396B29949E15EAB288
dialogue.line: Hrmph.

dialogue.speaker: 679C82B24771B779D361519DF0140EB7
dialogue.line: Human not do stupid.

dialogue.speaker: EB945649420B05C0E2EFA98D1991172F
dialogue.line: It's just me. No need to worry.

dialogue.speaker: BE63A51D4548AEF15D8191B738F68B0A
dialogue.line: Or we beat human. Beat hard.

dialogue.speaker: 77ABC1A34A1568CCFF0333842001CFE9
dialogue.line: These paintings old. Beautiful. Made by very old humans.

dialogue.speaker: B6CBC0A5477C92862A3F1BB0704E076D
dialogue.line: Ugh, ugh!

dialogue.speaker: 7A4098BD4C444EAB041510900AD4F8F8
dialogue.line: We watch you, human.

dialogue.speaker: 68DD7807436DDBD39A4B06875C42BB95
dialogue.line: Who there?!

dialogue.speaker: 91AC888C4583882F797073AAA04B65E7
dialogue.line: And there one punishment for thieves!

dialogue.speaker: 4A14E27C41ACDE119903669EDE27F72A
dialogue.line: All right, let's fight then.

dialogue.speaker: F85057314111554F9B92DD8B19F4423B
dialogue.line: All right, let's fight then.

dialogue.speaker: 8874E0E04A8AA3D9997A7BB3CC24020B
dialogue.line: And what are you doing here?

dialogue.speaker: 970372CF47B5813A1936D88D072D4BEF
dialogue.line: And what you look for?

dialogue.speaker: CCED4AA2410C5B958BE996B72E389E8F
dialogue.line: But humans learn slow.

dialogue.speaker: EF7504CD4A1A80EA9034249BBEA82591
dialogue.line: But we hear about humans. We know they thieves and liars.

dialogue.speaker: C02B6B2C4B54069B33EF71B6CD2C432E
dialogue.line: But you ask many questions. Too many.

dialogue.speaker: BDE95DA54C611A9975E003B8081050C4
dialogue.line: Calm down. I'm not your enemy.

dialogue.speaker: 54BE2251498B0C0A13525E832A0AA589
dialogue.line: Coen? Yes. I heard.

dialogue.speaker: 7C7C87654B3E3360E3ACE08A77B9BA9B
dialogue.line: Don't tell you.

dialogue.speaker: B28B09AD4341503147065890CB5698EE
dialogue.line: Ha! Why believe human?

dialogue.speaker: D535F5DA4C6D5A8039B384917A7C87B4
dialogue.line: Ha! Why believe human? Human thieves! They come here and sniff! Be-gone!

dialogue.speaker: F8C812D74577377795822AB4E96C5747
dialogue.line: Human have no shame! We teach him!

dialogue.speaker: 8D1B779D4982451C44EEB5B3D456BB3B
dialogue.line: Human say sorry? This new. We accept.

dialogue.speaker: 95B8EF8A46FA1E69DE2D7BB3C7168188
dialogue.line: I have, yes.

dialogue.speaker: 019E683C4DF55A380CF8E98800E8BC29
dialogue.line: I just want to look around.

dialogue.speaker: EA8FBF9D4FAF0E4B8543F9A8EDB94776
dialogue.line: I will not be threatened.

dialogue.speaker: F7DF635E4585BBD37758CA9E203FE825
dialogue.line: I'm friends with the uriashi.

dialogue.speaker: 4D9A4FBC43AC18CEBF1ECE9AEE62D168
dialogue.line: I'm looking for... a very old thing. Something that was here before you.

dialogue.speaker: 0D128D2D439C90A74F226D8D40BF7535
dialogue.line: I'm no thief, my name's Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 9C553FF94261BC9A6B7F8D86D2925D7F
dialogue.line: I'm not a thief. My name's Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 908A573245EDDCA4E0C4FFADE139D6CC
dialogue.line: If I were sneaking, you'd be dead by now.

dialogue.speaker: DEEEDC3B446E30C87876879731336394
dialogue.line: If I were sneaking, you'd be dead by now.

dialogue.speaker: 94072A5C4F1E14A6531AEBAE58FD6918
dialogue.line: It was wrong to sneak up on you, I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 1BFC84E6457F971484DDCF81D24D3096
dialogue.line: It was wrong to sneak up on you. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 4D6595A143BF62DD70FBDF83172DFF9E
dialogue.line: It wasn't my fault!

dialogue.speaker: 16FDDE814AAC122D4373268DEC6E8B0E
dialogue.line: Listen, I just want to look around.

dialogue.speaker: 9A684DE5469B16E9C00EC0B2C7B8EADB
dialogue.line: My name is Coen. I'm friends with the uriashi.

dialogue.speaker: 8BA59B6E435B0056C4AB80B057F98803
dialogue.line: Now, about you...

dialogue.speaker: 743F373C43D1DFB286045AA490DC7213
dialogue.line: So the landslide was your doing.

dialogue.speaker: 253110104B837A9C9EF52E8E81D35640
dialogue.line: So the landslide... the heavy rocks – it was your doing.

dialogue.speaker: 516D03714E14FF2AA7B8859D36A62523
dialogue.line: Stop! You thief? Here to kill us? Take our things?

dialogue.speaker: B06E60A74A4651977A7DB18C7801C84C
dialogue.line: Stop, thief! Come at night? Think we not see?!

dialogue.speaker: 6455803A476A82AB4FBCC9BC85DEBF0F
dialogue.line: Stupid. Very stupid.

dialogue.speaker: B424ADB8470170697C1ABD84D74908D6
dialogue.line: Then why sneak at night? Like thief!

dialogue.speaker: FD12E2F544D1977E1FB27B934373EA8A
dialogue.line: These are... old ruins. There may be some things here. Expensive. Important.

dialogue.speaker: BD7387F14A1114CA9C037FA4424A1F8B
dialogue.line: Uriashi always do heavy rocks. To scare humans away.

dialogue.speaker: 1B9E46764463CD1C5D0EF89916228FD1
dialogue.line: Wait... We know you. You kill many uriashi.

dialogue.speaker: 0A9BAB104A1CD7D7655B71A5436BFDE0
dialogue.line: Want to kill us? Steal our things?

dialogue.speaker: 554DD7BC43B1526DE2CB24BF526479FF
dialogue.line: We cannot let you go now. We kill you!

dialogue.speaker: 4494CFBA470F36FE608F859A6D8BFDB9
dialogue.line: We heard about Coen. Coen kill soldiers. Many soldiers.

dialogue.speaker: FE7C661B425837F33A7636A5A94E755A
dialogue.line: We listen – but we not believe.

dialogue.speaker: B28C98CB41589403560C05A6EA4F6375
dialogue.line: We never hear about no C-Coen.
