dialogue.speaker: 5B085C6B4490438BF441FDB40AC4A215
dialogue.line: We no use old things.

dialogue.speaker: C82905634720287D31AF068FA383BF6A
dialogue.line: Why are you here?

dialogue.speaker: 0EBAA5904FB4454A5D0DAB9DE5E4391C
dialogue.line: Why aren't you listening to me?!

dialogue.speaker: 06736F6E4B7F6C42E5398A9E78D803A9
dialogue.line: Why you humans lie all time?!

dialogue.speaker: 6F49566A40BF97E72F479A93956198FF
dialogue.line: You can look. But quick.

dialogue.speaker: C393E50F4D469A7E482610ADF0FBB58C
dialogue.line: You lucky we not send heavy rocks to kill you.

dialogue.speaker: 87CC7B4F4646574AB9DFF1B05DE0A5AD
dialogue.line: You said something about stealing your things. So you're keeping something here, right?

dialogue.speaker: C08B6CAF45184A2C3C07F8B799101F35
dialogue.line: You smart. We guard winter things. Supp-lies. Not for you.

dialogue.speaker: 1A9BC3DE430B8922C95DDB8E33AC296E
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 61134BC24CCFF66D452003BAE65BE65C
dialogue.line: Brother! No!

dialogue.speaker: 05ED6EE44A5515BF11345DAD3A3E5863
dialogue.line: You die, monster!

dialogue.speaker: D19995A6433ECD262E29D2BB73DF57E7
dialogue.line: About treasure.

dialogue.speaker: 323BA09543BA32634FE1B59742D21A25
dialogue.line: About what?

dialogue.speaker: BCB22DCA4FC254EB19C20288B05870C8
dialogue.line: And then tried come back. But he was un-lucky. Heavy rocks fell and killed him.

dialogue.speaker: 310DA18144D98417E3FF6CA689496244
dialogue.line: Don't be sorry. Be gone.

dialogue.speaker: 399405AC4BE85D9EC94E8D94716CF380
dialogue.line: He was no warrior. Too skinny. Had drawings and maps. Looked at them all time... and talked to himself.

dialogue.speaker: 7DA01C5D4E606DD7FCB640B7FBF50B7B
dialogue.line: It was long ago. A human came and left.

dialogue.speaker: 5F62CFEC400FE24905AD19BDF7D37E58
dialogue.line: Sniffing, yes. Like you.

dialogue.speaker: 8021E6E54CA7F9ED9C0A6E863617EE5A
dialogue.line: Sorry to bother you.

dialogue.speaker: AA4F635A46F86439EA39ACA8A5A0A414
dialogue.line: Sorry to bother you.

dialogue.speaker: 1B7D91244526DB66B0C371980136C6A8
dialogue.line: Tell me more. And then I'll be gone.

dialogue.speaker: 5DE3DEAF45180AFEEFC17A8D5AF06FFB
dialogue.line: Thank you. And... I may be back one more time... if that's all right.

dialogue.speaker: B84A1997441364E1D682CAB86A5AB7C9
dialogue.line: Thanks. See you soon then.

dialogue.speaker: 0B737ED44018E01146B663993412ABEF
dialogue.line: That man... Do you know who he was? Apart from a 'thief', of course.

dialogue.speaker: 7CBBBFCF4CEEED3E681628AD6F4CB060
dialogue.line: The landslide that killed him... Where did it happen?

dialogue.speaker: 5B3B9D834DC1686CDEA73A91D507F773
dialogue.line: Where did it happen?

dialogue.speaker: 9440E40C41EA16C33AFA76BE304E66AF
dialogue.line: Where did it happen?

dialogue.speaker: 35C392B842447CC578A3CBA201A7F827
dialogue.line: Where's the landslide that killed him?

dialogue.speaker: A1A8DA3E4A60DBCC89165B89DB99A10E
dialogue.line: Who was that man?

dialogue.speaker: F2887D464CA0C539C6E176BE7A3E0F65
dialogue.line: You follow the road down. You will see.

dialogue.speaker: F21159BB4BC4D84E9EAE90A5708459D1
dialogue.line: You mentioned other people coming here.

dialogue.speaker: FF639B4147521E1B01E39CBC63F1A254
dialogue.line: You said something about other people coming here.

dialogue.speaker: 0C7CAB6243F8CC10F26F10ADE1999ED8
dialogue.line: You said you look and then go away. So go.

dialogue.speaker: F10FD728449881A2B7049089AEB2D572
dialogue.line: You stubborn like ox. I am beginning to respect.

dialogue.speaker: 0328A4794B30C97B9DDDD984A180B850
dialogue.line: [grunt]

dialogue.speaker: 648F82584E8473D714A0AF8F329D898C
dialogue.line: Ah, it smells divine... And I got the foam just right, too.

dialogue.speaker: 862C581B4E5B777AD85BF4AF9B0B759E
dialogue.line: All the while, Brencis continues to bleed the valley dry.

dialogue.speaker: 56B07F9247E1B4A1BFA2C28F0202B012
dialogue.line: All the while, Brencis continues to torture my loved ones.

dialogue.speaker: C60147CA49802D9AA2013C8A96B675D0
dialogue.line: Always looking for a chance to get your dick caught in the door. Again and again! It's a wonder you're still able to piss standing up!

dialogue.speaker: 0034F51343C4822FD1651E8981AA6FAA
dialogue.line: And it's all Drogos, I tell you. He's the one digging his heels in.

dialogue.speaker: A3938EF844401AAE1567D7900E4A158C
dialogue.line: And yet, Drogos just drags his feet—reins us in.

dialogue.speaker: 0DA09EBF467979B374A61BADFA455372
dialogue.line: Bah! For now, maybe!

dialogue.speaker: EE939E7D4B9338464076438326139858
dialogue.line: Bah! You're no fun. Though, in your particular situation... Being able to rein in your appetites like that is a good thing.

dialogue.speaker: 2CED6E61442D0A7C6C19928B29783A5A
dialogue.line: Bah, yeah. Nothing but preparations, precautions, prevention.

dialogue.speaker: F6703E464ADABA0367860985F9AB6B14
dialogue.line: Because Brencis and his army are no joke.

dialogue.speaker: 137957D44B907956B30E7AA2EA8B9DA4
dialogue.line: Better safe than sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 6AE2761D403576E39153A6A69B0A5957
dialogue.line: Better safe than sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 49848E414DA2B859B52AD49D224F64BD
dialogue.line: But that Drogos fellow... Always nitpicking, finding holes in any plan.

dialogue.speaker: 1D8162C24907C31E42914E949BE3521A
dialogue.line: But that's no excuse to hum and haw now.

dialogue.speaker: F1FEA90A499FE05121DE5C87B18FC6DF
dialogue.line: But what good does it do, my crying over spilt milk?

dialogue.speaker: 2D024B924FD95E51E02FA6819B02C87E
dialogue.line: By all means, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: 696C4CA34AF6442A25F4AA8A4A73BB1F
dialogue.line: By all means, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: AB55D91F47E4DF2E564641843542681D
dialogue.line: Can't say he left a great impression on me, either.

dialogue.speaker: BF7815E942F9582D3FA1138F1892997F
dialogue.line: Crake, he's like me. Dogged, keen to fight.

dialogue.speaker: 94AA34F14C437F57C3F309A7B36A0399
dialogue.line: Don't particularly like him, either.

dialogue.speaker: BBB3E74D41F1FC522D0E5CB8CBA5CCF9
dialogue.line: Don't you worry. We'll get two birds with one stone.

dialogue.speaker: D5FA07EC43EF480CC840058F9509F74D
dialogue.line: Each day, the vrakhiri grow in power, solidify their stranglehold on Vale Sangora.

dialogue.speaker: D970C8004FF615E3D460B9B367EC6A07
dialogue.line: Eh. Wish I had more leeway to do things my way.

dialogue.speaker: D1092F84410DFA8D9CBA93A3CB44FFB9
dialogue.line: Enough with the childish dreams, enough with the stupid belligerence. Are we clear?

dialogue.speaker: A4E65B1A43AB648F9BB10CBCABDEA09C
dialogue.line: Frankly? I just want my family to make it.

dialogue.speaker: 3B35AE5A40E8B5B719949E9E8569B4FA
dialogue.line: Frankly? I just want to avenge my family.

dialogue.speaker: 7EDFC94447447EAEFE07FF8B53537204
dialogue.line: Hey! You take that back!

dialogue.speaker: E64F14404FDF00108815DC956126B9CD
dialogue.line: I get you, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: A9DF73B64E4B309CD6DD369C884D9431
dialogue.line: I get you. I'd be ready to go after Brencis right this minute – but somehow, there's always one more thing to do first.

dialogue.speaker: ACA531C04F866F98346280AA4E6AE175
dialogue.line: I just want my folks to make it.

dialogue.speaker: 9F4194B444F72682A6DF228F26443038
dialogue.line: I just want to avenge my folks.

dialogue.speaker: A87756D04D03703C6DED2E95BA896C1E
dialogue.line: I thought you learned something from Laslea. Not anymore.

dialogue.speaker: CF2ECB744F0CE08342FCC6A1BF0D410F
dialogue.line: I'd rather keep my wits about me, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: D0875DB44C7AEDB388AF88ADFF7F24CD
dialogue.line: I'd rather keep my wits about me, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: 0F5F141D4D81CE4100C9DCA83E441F99
dialogue.line: I'm sorry. Got carried away there.

dialogue.speaker: 41B120D34947DEC9202381B68A6EBE60
dialogue.line: I'm sorry. I got carried away there.

dialogue.speaker: 6029FCE04D1A6C8F8D8C70866239B380
dialogue.line: Inch by inch.

dialogue.speaker: F8F9280246EE2BA632B32BB7698ACC88
dialogue.line: Including my family.

dialogue.speaker: 41D9D0034C793CE9D01CBA87D4F87288
dialogue.line: It hurts because it's true.

dialogue.speaker: B0546F644BC49E897470838DF04F74A7
dialogue.line: It hurts because it's true.

dialogue.speaker: D582C97F4E8E13BCCA6F2F86C79537F4
dialogue.line: It's been a good while, eh? Can I pour you one?

dialogue.speaker: 5DD888C54C5C4FC7DD1EE3970E2EE514
dialogue.line: Jesus. You're dumber than a sack of bricks.

dialogue.speaker: 4CF4CEAD443D566B3B7F5886CA2C44EE
dialogue.line: Jesus. You're dumber than a sack of rocks.

dialogue.speaker: BB38951C489C6945B9D5A1AEF0F019B3
dialogue.line: Listen, now. Just because we're friends –

dialogue.speaker: A8460D524632DE97E932D8A33A8937F9
dialogue.line: May we live free of the vrakhiri yoke.

dialogue.speaker: A1D9AFCF4263313CA7EEB49DC66DB463
dialogue.line: Me? I'm out there, fighting the bastards. I know what we're facing – the horrors Brencis is ready to unleash upon us.

dialogue.speaker: 194C7D114E8689A574CD4E9540FC68DD
dialogue.line: My family – they were imprisoned because of you.

dialogue.speaker: 59A5900142AA2A4E99AC8AA802DEC17E
dialogue.line: Neither you nor that dunce Drogos.

dialogue.speaker: 6A9CE9E44BA3D89A263C45AFFCB283FB
dialogue.line: No, you don't understand. You sit in the basement, daydreaming about glory.

dialogue.speaker: 46F4961E41EFAA811877C7978D065936
dialogue.line: Oh, I'll show you what hurts.

dialogue.speaker: 512680C74C10B3AB9F7948A334210110
dialogue.line: Oh? And why would I do that?

dialogue.speaker: 52088F444E22D26164841981D48C7694
dialogue.line: Right? Yellow-bellied oaf, that's what he is.

dialogue.speaker: 9DCE8D134471FC0A68BBA0B53F38B61B
dialogue.line: So you listen to Drogos. And to me, for that matter.

dialogue.speaker: 6DC60482473A9551F707B7BE41658586
dialogue.line: Talking to you earlier, I thought you'd learned something from Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: 35F6B3C24934E88EE4E3B3A0C12E7701
dialogue.line: Thanks for taking a break from your heroic endeavours to dress me down.

dialogue.speaker: 5F954CB5484E769BA1CFA4B9B356AEB2
dialogue.line: Think we're getting any closer to liberating the valley?

dialogue.speaker: BB32420D45A9EB77C10FDA9C711F22D7
dialogue.line: Think we're getting any closer to liberating the valley?

dialogue.speaker: F261013C423DF7B9BA9FC9BBD2200996
dialogue.line: Uh, because he's your superior?

dialogue.speaker: 59FC4DE44E9B96B8EF3E59AE37FCE772
dialogue.line: Well, of course. But you don't understand—

dialogue.speaker: E97B61F343DFB7550736568E4B6046F7
dialogue.line: What are we waiting for? We're all fighters here, all sworn to the cause. No civilians this time, no bystanders.

dialogue.speaker: 1D8AC2E94663703375C378B7621E892B
dialogue.line: With time, I'll prove myself to Crake. He'll see that I've got balls – unlike Drogos.

dialogue.speaker: BE612D794956AD3BE533EB827629AEB4
dialogue.line: Yeah. Guess we are.

dialogue.speaker: AB29031842D2F5393C32969A5A7CF9E7
dialogue.line: Yes, yes, I know. We rushed it in Laslea, I'll be the first to admit it!

dialogue.speaker: DCB731C146809AD959E9CCB3347F1F39
dialogue.line: You better listen to him though.

dialogue.speaker: 996DAF2C4FCCAD79CFD2F781F9622F57
dialogue.line: You better listen to him, though.

dialogue.speaker: E14296B14402AA9702139E8DE672E44A
dialogue.line: You did, yeah. I may have made some mistakes, true – but I'm not taking shit from anyone.

dialogue.speaker: 388AA1C547C7E21C98C73D92228C90EC
dialogue.line: You don't sound too pleased.

dialogue.speaker: 1C1A278E4FA382C26238B4911927A4C0
dialogue.line: You think I don't know that? You think it doesn't keep me awake at night?

dialogue.speaker: 58D546DF4B20943C428AA3ABD14E3BE9
dialogue.line: Your hare-brained scheme with the mines – people died because of you.

dialogue.speaker: 95D503B740BCE54046410ABE8E1E211D
dialogue.line: Give it to him good, lads.

dialogue.speaker: 0E40D44741CECFE7ED7620882AC9DB41
dialogue.line: Gladly - this doesn't concern me.

dialogue.speaker: 892E7DD24C029CB01C1FB1AFC6FF506B
dialogue.line: Gladly. This doesn't concern me.

dialogue.speaker: 2FF111ED4003E252C64A609F3DCBC6EB
dialogue.line: Hey! What did you just say?

dialogue.speaker: FA430DB8406B73C8631C2F88DDDC872C
dialogue.line: Looks like you're all alone, Vlad. And in lots of trouble.

dialogue.speaker: C6638BD04E7B7782B12671AFCF07B75B
dialogue.line: Out of the way, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 4023E7874751E458132507B21102AD58
dialogue.line: Should've gotten out of the way when you still could, mongrel.

dialogue.speaker: 325885CB4A24CA3ECBC6EEAB99601711
dialogue.line: We did, yeah. And it sounds like you need a quick primer in military discipline.

dialogue.speaker: A2988A66483145301FDDFA8138D9BD52
dialogue.line: What? Coen!

dialogue.speaker: 74EC9D2D4D18948D30B4D891A155D0F8
dialogue.line: Wise choice. Step outside, now.

dialogue.speaker: 6D3957FE40C64330538BD8BF963E2429
dialogue.line: You give it to him good, lads.

dialogue.speaker: B9CBB914483F63F2F1DFDDAD158DD5B8
dialogue.line: You heard me.

dialogue.speaker: 184E60FF4E208CDDBF659D9709861E9B
dialogue.line: You leave Vlad alone.

dialogue.speaker: B2ACF4E342830D94B57CF5AF387A4580
dialogue.line: You leave Vlad alone.

dialogue.speaker: F84438F041DFA34A3E0CC8A28475C055
dialogue.line: Ah! Shit ...that's enough!

dialogue.speaker: 7DF6E61F425AD05E068B9EBA5A3B46C9
dialogue.line: Ah, nuh-uh. First you apologise.

dialogue.speaker: 51DC832140EE929EECF20B999D016909
dialogue.line: And you better make it extra pretty, too.

dialogue.speaker: 6D4966BF47CC488E7C47B9BD53B8726F
dialogue.line: And you better make it pretty, too.

dialogue.speaker: 1755A3DF403526122F577287F8A5CFDB
dialogue.line: Are all people from Laslea arseholes? Or just the two of you?

dialogue.speaker: 46240F53453836FA254824BE4CDE3A3D
dialogue.line: Cough it out, tough guy. Unless you want some help?

dialogue.speaker: D7B92ED54F7C057B2925CCAFBA21CAE5
dialogue.line: Don't be a dick, Vlad. Just let them go.

dialogue.speaker: F2AEEC7542EFE0F48BE18B850E963447
dialogue.line: Don't be a dick, Vlad. Just let them go.

dialogue.speaker: 78B902234B56C1DADCD50C841FDB8758
dialogue.line: For now. Come on, Cosmin.

dialogue.speaker: 3B3886EF4D11C67696373AB262045E46
dialogue.line: Fuck off. You had your fun, let us go.

dialogue.speaker: 62C8049B4CFA14E4142E1EA2B32C685B
dialogue.line: Ha...! Now we have even more reasons to raise a toast! Come on, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: BBBA4A4A43D8DF8B807AC7A1CE69F390
dialogue.line: Heh. Kinda, yeah.

dialogue.speaker: 2F14E24942AF25E6B10009842FF45902
dialogue.line: Is it, now? 'Cause I'm just warming up.

dialogue.speaker: A37A6AA6493264950AB67D9937C5E7D0
dialogue.line: We're all on the same side.

dialogue.speaker: 7ACA044C4EF6719411DECC8989E5D142
dialogue.line: We're sorry. There! Happy?

dialogue.speaker: F53E2B8F4C5880647104DEBD0FDA0FE4
dialogue.line: [scoff] What? They assaulted us!

dialogue.speaker: 2242DA5F41105CA6A6CEEEBFFEB81667
dialogue.line: Ah... My ribs... Fuck...

dialogue.speaker: 6AC3F1DA4C3B7FCE553955A7BEE22E9E
dialogue.line: And you... You think about your loyalties, half-leech.

dialogue.speaker: 6461B3C949CB7AB453405EA6D8CDC53A
dialogue.line: Call me that again and you'll regret it.

dialogue.speaker: 9A97E17D4A405E7EE96DC78C0072780C
dialogue.line: Call me that again and you'll regret it.

dialogue.speaker: E824770E49158E92C49DBABCE9F25401
dialogue.line: Hah. Still eager to bite? No wonder, with your fangs.

dialogue.speaker: 70904A6040192ED9E23C3CAB81B613E3
dialogue.line: Hope the lesson sticks, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: 325138C945B5244E52E7748FA7E8F7AA
dialogue.line: Noted.

dialogue.speaker: ECE1EA634538B94E7DFDD09B52FA5F98
dialogue.line: Noted.

dialogue.speaker: ED6D76DB45E586F7EF36A893077983AA
dialogue.line: Shitheads. Come on, Coen. Not sure about you, but now I really need a drink. Ah...

dialogue.speaker: C0F6CE054D70C1B0F11C848AEB0193CE
dialogue.line: There's a good lad.

dialogue.speaker: F580931E47EDCD53F809E7B34C17A181
dialogue.line: ...Had enough? Will you shut up, now?

dialogue.speaker: 2DD91D5545E81D094330F586DA1BFAAB
dialogue.line: Friends can disagree.

dialogue.speaker: A2106E804514038815D49D8E53605233
dialogue.line: Guess I was wrong.

dialogue.speaker: 73887FBC4573A4C99657D2B04B0E7DED
dialogue.line: I thought – I was glad to see you down here. Someone who knows me, someone who gets me.

dialogue.speaker: D72C04ED479321F6B6D3B68199F13BA3
dialogue.line: Oh, just fuck off.

dialogue.speaker: A61502D5471390E9A9B447BB94790192
dialogue.line: Sometimes, friends disagree. Fight, even.

dialogue.speaker: 7474F4B04E4B76A3BC07589B0FEBCDF4
dialogue.line: There! Enough to calm you down? Or should I smack you one more time, for good measure?

dialogue.speaker: 8B47547F4816E5225B73F592B7485E9A
dialogue.line: Ugh, I'll go finish off that beer now... Alone...

dialogue.speaker: 2476513E4B69B93ECC366BAC78940228
dialogue.line: Yeah. Like always.

dialogue.speaker: EBA4C80842BCDC5388EC1F9B78D6F9AB
dialogue.line: Yeah. Like always.

dialogue.speaker: DFF6D80245D57C250FFF738A31C0C0E2
dialogue.line: [scoff] Yeah, yeah. You can stop yelling now.

dialogue.speaker: FA596B104E37692746F6C7AB448A3C10
dialogue.line: And the best part? Dana knew. She helped prepare my aunt's body for the burial, must've seen the bruises.

dialogue.speaker: B500BB5C4DA175FE336D59B6D5DAABAA
dialogue.line: And y-your uncle...?

dialogue.speaker: 0BF933E74AAD2AFD8F91F9B2201C0B9A
dialogue.line: And you did nothing?

dialogue.speaker: 2D7B96AA4C18F9FF4D8445A98A2DB2D7
dialogue.line: And you did nothing?

dialogue.speaker: 10ACF93F4FF1BBA850439E86E8AD2EB3
dialogue.line: And your uncle...?

dialogue.speaker: 660A87B44623C76151A8BE8BA9A9A735
dialogue.line: Hah... Sort of, yeah, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: B6AF05A143ABC9900AF062B0199266AF
dialogue.line: Holy fuck, Vlad... I'm so sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 0D0E765543157565056946B5F8F4C48B
dialogue.line: Holy fuck, mate. I'm so sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 5C97E85D405CCF83F21F828710788AE6
dialogue.line: I do. But you won't salve your conscience that way – just make it worse. Deep down I think you know it.

dialogue.speaker: 24EA3F3247AEEAFD39CC298982962995
dialogue.line: I keep wondering – could I have saved her, h-had I spoken up? Had I acted in time?

dialogue.speaker: BC479494498A677571503AA3CA13A52F
dialogue.line: I knew it was happening... but I didn't say a word.

dialogue.speaker: DA3544CB46F65377A8DC7D8638A79B66
dialogue.line: I'll talk to Crake, after. Tell him we need to strike soon, before everything boils over.

dialogue.speaker: 1385F9EA482053C22919138150925758
dialogue.line: Jesus. That's so fucked up.

dialogue.speaker: 3B1885C14F62D0E84E3ED28470EA6A0B
dialogue.line: Kostel's mum? Sure I do. You two were close. What is it that took her? Fever?

dialogue.speaker: CC0E49B3475D682A54347097722E07FB
dialogue.line: Mm, pretty sure he won't. But I've got to try – even if it gets me into more trouble.

dialogue.speaker: 58B99C8042B0A118C397B18744033A3B
dialogue.line: My parents, they turned a blind eye to it, and I was just a kid then, so... Just followed their lead, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: 82BB3D0945E57F08EE18E090B9B32314
dialogue.line: My uncle – he beat her. For any wrongdoing, real or imagined.

dialogue.speaker: 5941AD38428FDB5F637514B9A1441EF6
dialogue.line: Never told this to anyone, but... Remember my aunt? Lina?

dialogue.speaker: A4FACA494CB823BBCBBA77AB33A9F978
dialogue.line: Now I get it.

dialogue.speaker: CE29CFB84B08C31F58EFD580D8409CED
dialogue.line: Pity Drogos doesn't.

dialogue.speaker: 61BA7D734ABB347691C776AB7CD3924A
dialogue.line: Real brotherhood of men we've got down here, eh?

dialogue.speaker: F1C7B9C94C3B4368041495AAA8059EDE
dialogue.line: So yeah. Not been a big fan of sitting on my hands ever since.

dialogue.speaker: 0806B6F04C47896D0454958B139E8814
dialogue.line: That's awful, but... What's it got to do with the vrakhiri?

dialogue.speaker: B288544840887CEDCA0E1AB53BD33106
dialogue.line: That's what happens when you sit around, doing nothing. Folks get real twitchy.

dialogue.speaker: 92713CA94827863E56FF48A08E47E087
dialogue.line: That's what we told everyone.

dialogue.speaker: 96C4B92B4A55D576E3B0978EB94E18A6
dialogue.line: Think he'll listen?

dialogue.speaker: FDE730B94B422E12703162B275C783F5
dialogue.line: Think he'll listen?

dialogue.speaker: 0BFFE84941B69DB6DE4213A6189F4633
dialogue.line: Until one time, he overdid it.

dialogue.speaker: 77E57B44450D7C3AD893A2A48BF1CEFD
dialogue.line: Went to mass the next day, as if nothing happened. Six months later, he remarried. Remember? To Elena, Dana's niece.

dialogue.speaker: C397362347200C1DFFCDE59BE1015DB5
dialogue.line: What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: 4FB59AD54A33083EC83451BEAC93ACE9
dialogue.line: What's it got to do with the vrakhiri?

dialogue.speaker: 20BE9A3F4F9C5E4849EF689D158FDF30
dialogue.line: World is. And it won't fix itself.

dialogue.speaker: DD08E2484EEF04484483FC80423190B0
dialogue.line: Yeah, I  guess... I guess you're right. [sigh] And who knows, maybe Drogos is, too.

dialogue.speaker: 4758BB0F43632E3E7983459ACE2921F1
dialogue.line: Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: 91FF8710496A20891778BAB3E198E947
dialogue.line: You can't keep endangering others to salve your conscience.

dialogue.speaker: A49675E64EB6D1F3CB1FB5AA619CD5E9
dialogue.line: You can't keep endangering others, though.

dialogue.speaker: 698D5A6147969D8D06FA2EB7E96369CA
dialogue.line: You have a deathwish, Vlad?

dialogue.speaker: 887D279642A45974DC9F9790164785B1
dialogue.line: You have a deathwish, Vlad?

dialogue.speaker: 82CC35D44697266C4BB0C5815206D1FE
dialogue.line: You will. And stay out of harm's way in the meantime.

dialogue.speaker: 2EFCA1AF4C2C83EF434DA59F7E13E0F6
dialogue.line: [exhale] Wow... Now I get it.

dialogue.speaker: 5D79C2C2417ED3D317720BAE1FF5B782
dialogue.line: [scoff] Why, Vlad? Why are you so hell-bent on all this?

dialogue.speaker: 9E71D94C47BD57C3BACE628940BC2548
dialogue.line: [scoff] You don't understand –

dialogue.speaker: 54CC2D1347CBD65B0C0983A751B64E71
dialogue.line: [sigh] Listen, I... I think I need a moment to myself, now. But I'll see you around, yeah?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.ox_101_guard02
dialogue.line: It's him! Strike him down!

dialogue.speaker: 1D0C2B174FAE5DE02EF05EBD3071F2BD
dialogue.line: And... And once you try it, there's no stopping, no quenching your thirst.

dialogue.speaker: B8E2AAE54C4AB1BAA0EA86ABBE1FFCF5
dialogue.line: Aye. I wore Xanthe's colours. Drank her blood.

dialogue.speaker: D5A144F14BA9FC0F86E362A12753B729
dialogue.line: Go. I'll let others judge you.

dialogue.speaker: 5CE6376A41E9FF7B39A024B074CF5D55
dialogue.line: I couldn't care less about Xanthe's soldiers killing one another.

dialogue.speaker: 3D0EF8424102E83AF08BB0BA06C6020C
dialogue.line: I had my allowance, but it wasn't enough. The quartermaster – he woudn't give me any more, and I... I just – I lost control.

dialogue.speaker: 08C37C35495365DA1CB51A9840A69962
dialogue.line: I won't let a murderer walk free.

dialogue.speaker: 95230D6C4C7732DF4F99D582C04E1214
dialogue.line: I won't let a murderer walk free.

dialogue.speaker: D39911F744C1BB90529AB0A0870036BB
dialogue.line: It's alright. It's over.

dialogue.speaker: B1673CA244358D3F6FBF578062881021
dialogue.line: Leave before I change my mind.

dialogue.speaker: DB5489BD4A7EFABC49CA87ADBCA408A2
dialogue.line: May Heaven bless you, Coen, son of Pieter.

dialogue.speaker: 65CFA35546B8528AFDCADF802722FEF6
dialogue.line: May Heaven bless you, stranger.

dialogue.speaker: 672E56114FEB6EC4E5415A8289DAC533
dialogue.line: No! No, please, don't!

dialogue.speaker: 319FE62D432B72E1C0A3CABC53672776
dialogue.line: Oh God. Thank you – thank you, I –

dialogue.speaker: 800C0B8C4902080E05FFB5999834A0D7
dialogue.line: Pick up a weapon. Let's make it a fair fight.

dialogue.speaker: B13ACCF246C7D10635A58DBCC44D1486
dialogue.line: So you're just like the rest of them. And deserve the same fate.

dialogue.speaker: AC0EE9C843EFDF5B4AA7B592836508CD
dialogue.line: That's a cruel punishment - even for blood slaves.

dialogue.speaker: 953797294EC88E83DA7D978BC1A99305
dialogue.line: That's a cruel punishment – even for blood slaves.

dialogue.speaker: B0DA26334F637D133F4C93B67FDBCC4B
dialogue.line: They were about to skin me alive! I saw them getting the blades ready!

dialogue.speaker: DD31C9E348AEE05724AA989AD2FD6A8E
dialogue.line: Wait, so you – ?

dialogue.speaker: 31627FCC41FCE0055C7F5E9E75BCEB20
dialogue.line: What are you saying?

dialogue.speaker: BF8C0B044933812E16A374A826A1631B
dialogue.line: Yes. One they reserve for their own.

dialogue.speaker: EB9EBB7D43CB33C4EA35A8A4D1D0318E
dialogue.line: You – you know what it's like, right? Being what you are...

dialogue.speaker: 894E3EE1444B7C7A001C7B918B6C6EA5
dialogue.line: You're safe now.

dialogue.speaker: 0AB7B1D14639F6555E9D498EF47C401A
dialogue.line: You're safe now. Go, find somewhere to hide.

dialogue.speaker: A8D0AC29405037352249BB8D3217C6B4
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.ox_102_recruit_01
dialogue.line: Aaargh... No, please! Stop it! Aaargh!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.ox_103_uriash
dialogue.line: You strong, Coen of Laslea. They right to fear you.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You trained my enemies. Taught them how to kill. That's not something I can forgive easily.

dialogue.speaker: D26C6B5F452BB134C98F869109E75B7F
dialogue.line: Why did you help me?

dialogue.speaker: 170564994886197B2C77F2B900DC4BC1
dialogue.line: You are free to leave.

dialogue.speaker: 6805F612470F6F8BCEAF228A4AD4D4EF
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.ox_105_civil
dialogue.line: I wouldn't feel pain? Ever again?

dialogue.speaker: 3E83B0B447D222ED2FA532B1B2DE688F
dialogue.line: [collect vrakhiri blood]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [destroy the reliquary]

dialogue.speaker: 3C1664FD4671165CCADD0D87A0744D76
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: ox_106_civil
dialogue.line: They say it makes you fearless...

dialogue.speaker: 39E6A3A54C6CE3C7E5D1B4B7B46AC7C4
dialogue.line: I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You'd like to keep it all to yourself, I gather?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.ox_106_anti_civil
dialogue.line: Yes! Yes!!! Oh, thank you, thank you!!! Take this, my friend. For all you've done.

dialogue.speaker: EF7735D84EB249933C23A7B3DD51E0DF
dialogue.line: You'd like to keep it all to yourself?

dialogue.speaker: 4129780E44107FEC19C0B98854266048
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.ox_110_bloodslave_01
dialogue.line: Step aside! Make way for Boyaress Xanthe's men!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.ox_102_recruit_01
dialogue.line: They recruited me... Promised me I'd drink Xanthe's blood, grow strong, become fearless.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're with them?

dialogue.speaker: 390284094682725C92A7C483002FE7D9
dialogue.line: Why did they torture you?

dialogue.speaker: F41889C7435C535060E89C977E4B58C9
dialogue.line: You're free. Go.

dialogue.speaker: F3051955430EA03E7C414EB01CE3A059
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: ox_103_uriash
dialogue.line: Baaah! We fight true, now!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.poi.ch.102c.Uriash_2
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.poi.ch.102c.Uriash_1
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.poi.ch.102c.Uriash_1
dialogue.line: [bleat] Human tough! We thank!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.poi.ch.102c.Uriash_2
dialogue.line: [bleat]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.POI.CH.102d.Witch
dialogue.line: You think you can interfere with Lady Xanthe's plans?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Yeah, right.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.POI.CH.103.Courier
dialogue.line: You see – in my line of work curiosity not only kills the cat, but also its family and close neighbours.

dialogue.speaker: 7CF34CCE46E0C340474A579507F879EF
dialogue.line: I think you've got me confused with someone.

dialogue.speaker: 85D6093841ADCCF3EF89A8B42F866A69
dialogue.line: It's impossible to get out of Vale Sangora.

dialogue.speaker: 9834204846FA287ABAD186ADAB10857E
dialogue.line: Who paid you?

dialogue.speaker: 552652F741781E4DE2AAC6B654596501
dialogue.line: Why do you ask?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.PoliceDlg
dialogue.line: You! You want to sleep in a piss-reeking cell tonight? You will!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You think you can make me go?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.000.soldier01
dialogue.line: You live and die by your sire's grace!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.000.soldier01
dialogue.line: You've given us quite the chase, young man!

dialogue.speaker: q.m.001.vlad_brencis_soldier01
dialogue.line: Hey! Who's there?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q002.scene.bloodcart
dialogue.line: You'll have a heavy load to pull! All these barrels, they'll be filled to the brim.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q002.scene.laundry
dialogue.line: Remember, look smart for tonight!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q002_church_cleaner
dialogue.line: The church needs to be spick and span for tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q002_patrol_leader
dialogue.line: What are you looking at?!

dialogue.speaker: Gatekeeper
dialogue.line: No one leaves the village until Mass! Knyaz Brencis's orders!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard4
dialogue.line: You there. Can't go into the Middens tonight. Turn back.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard7
dialogue.line: You! Nothing to see here. Turn back and keep on walking.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard6
dialogue.line: You're not supposed to be here. Go away.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard1
dialogue.line: Should've listened when you had the chance. Get him!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard5
dialogue.line: Let's try and kill some rebel bastards tonight, eh? For Imre.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard3
dialogue.line: Why do we have to guard this godforsaken shithole?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Citizen4
dialogue.line: That's our chance! Quick, run!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard2
dialogue.line: Yeah. But you know the captain – I'm not telling him it doesn't make much sense. Are you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.old_district_thug1
dialogue.line: Maybe. But not as soon as you hope.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You chose the wrong man to rob today.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.old_district_thug3
dialogue.line: We'll cut to the chase – give us a bit of coin, and you can carry on.

dialogue.speaker: 5FE33A5F439238938E490C90A49B98E2
dialogue.line: I'll be gone soon.

dialogue.speaker: 006B88F7410D6ABA043B31B5E5BF1465
dialogue.line: Wrong man to rob.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_blood_slave_recruit2
dialogue.line: Bound in blood.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_blood_slave_recruit3
dialogue.line: Bound in blood.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_blood_slave_recruit4
dialogue.line: Bound in blood.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_blood_slave_recruit5
dialogue.line: Bound in blood.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_blood_slave_recruit6
dialogue.line: Bound in blood.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Xante
dialogue.line: Your fellow Blood Guards shall become your new family.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.believer1
dialogue.line: O God! Thou hast sent forth Thy greatest servant, our knyaz, to protect us and bring us salvation!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.believer3
dialogue.line: Oh, can't complain. Parlita had its charms, sure. But here, inside the walls, so close to our knyaz... I finally feel safe.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.believer2
dialogue.line: You don't fear the rebels? Those... manumits?

dialogue.speaker: q102_cathedral_guard1
dialogue.line: The cathedral's closed, people! And it will stay closed until the streets are safe again!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.believer4
dialogue.line: So? What did the deacon say?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.believer5
dialogue.line: You threaten him, and you will find yourself jobless and looking for a bed to sleep in at the almshouse.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.believer7
dialogue.line: I imagine not having to give up your blood for a couple of weeks will be nice...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.believer6
dialogue.line: Oh, stop it. Can't you be happy for the new mother?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard12
dialogue.line: You there! Stop!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard9
dialogue.line: So... What does she do to them exactly?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard13
dialogue.line: Well, you know. Becoming one of them.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard10
dialogue.line: Wait, who's that?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Guard11
dialogue.line: Who gives a shit? Boyaress Xanthe was clear – kill him!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_04
dialogue.line: Well, his lot is a lesson to us all. Keep your head down, don't get involved in any shady business.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_courtyard_talker1
dialogue.line: You don't know that! Maybe –

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_05
dialogue.line: What for? I don't know him from Adam. And rumour has it, it was the manumits who gave him such a thrashing.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_courtyard_talker2
dialogue.line: Yeah, right. The deacon will be really glad to see dirty bums like us walking around his glorious church.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Praying_Mother
dialogue.line: Oh, Lord. Grant us wisdom so we can see Thy plan for us. Grant us strength to never falter in our faith.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Praying_Mother
dialogue.line: Yes, brother. What do you need?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [interrupt her]

dialogue.speaker: 06B7360342FAEA15180BE29451757EB6
dialogue.line: You seem very zealous.

dialogue.speaker: B684AB4849A9D5DAA559D185DEAC1773
dialogue.line: [wait]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Xante
dialogue.line: You're interfering with my task. Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: It doesn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: 3CF6EBEE4FCAB3F078DB039EC053CE2D
dialogue.line: Didn't come here to talk.

dialogue.speaker: 177210E747A5C78AD32F71BAA47A42F0
dialogue.line: It doesn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_01
dialogue.line: Your loss. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're talking about the abandoned wing, right? I've already heard about it.

dialogue.speaker: C530155F425804B83FA0CA90B8BA65CA
dialogue.line: And is it?

dialogue.speaker: 54ABEFA343712A9B1D77F48C9D96A646
dialogue.line: No chance.

dialogue.speaker: 15DE2C2C44A45605EEBF7AAEE20B9057
dialogue.line: Nothing.

dialogue.speaker: 7917951F4EA83F247BFBF89341F6A65D
dialogue.line: That's too much.

dialogue.speaker: 0983C43C48A6B7BFC10941B0799FDC14
dialogue.line: Why do you avoid him?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_02
dialogue.line: [hiss] Shiiiit... That – that's too much... Please...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [clean the wound]

dialogue.speaker: 656915874F102948868C3E9D989F0A77
dialogue.line: Actually, I don't have the stomach for it.

dialogue.speaker: 8C7E597F4CC7B30E32AEBCAD0E1792AC
dialogue.line: Any idea what happened to Radu?

dialogue.speaker: 27FF7A7B46B11B19D6863EB6271D9294
dialogue.line: How did you end up here?

dialogue.speaker: 527A116A46387E0DABACB3A241AB9CFB
dialogue.line: So, what happened?

dialogue.speaker: DBEDFC214698810F88CDF8B350CAB447
dialogue.line: Sorry, I don't have time for this.

dialogue.speaker: E3081B534E2976A30BC2D58DB84A45AF
dialogue.line: Think someone opened it?

dialogue.speaker: 8BB83D934B6E6E0EF648968F3510E5E7
dialogue.line: What happened to you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: What? No, I-I don't work here. I-I just wanted to –

dialogue.speaker: E161188844E836D276D885908CC0DF1A
dialogue.line: I'm looking for someone.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102.Asylum_Resident_03
dialogue.line: Please, I didn't do anything. I just want somewhere warm to sleep.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_cathedral_guard1
dialogue.line: Hey, you! What the hell are you doing?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.q102_cathedral_guard2
dialogue.line: Trespassing, that's for sure! Get him!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [drain Xanthe's blood]

dialogue.speaker: ADA450DA4D362EDAA6980285BBC24E00
dialogue.line: [kill Xanthe]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [drain Lacra's blood]

dialogue.speaker: 367982CF47F157E204B92182675DFBC3
dialogue.line: [kill Lacra]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Why did you join?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: [chuckle]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: [hoot]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: But I've still got –

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Post_Soldier1
dialogue.line: Then come back on the morrow. Off you go!

dialogue.speaker: AE62FE9B4F9282B717A1C29ECE55D83E
dialogue.line: Huh, you still here? The sun is setting.

dialogue.speaker: E31AEB0346C96F2A3CC2CBAFF0D962CF
dialogue.line: Now out the door! Before I chuck you out myself!

dialogue.speaker: 552C47344E63A0BE2E668C8E662CC8DD
dialogue.line: Tomorrow’s another day.

dialogue.speaker: 00FB6032402FEBD1EF0D819C22CAF39E
dialogue.line: Yeah, I haven't finished yet –

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're not in need of any aid? Or seeking anything?

dialogue.speaker: 62BB519B4C2068D7BA20BFA1BF6CC45C
dialogue.line: Are you sure there's nothing more?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: Sorry to disappoint you there. I'm just a plain boring girl working her arse off.

dialogue.speaker: 273210B44F8A00D91D397FBA763A0C33
dialogue.line: No, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: To hell with it... Make a meal of 'em!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Post_Soldier9
dialogue.line: Beat him to a pulp!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Post_Soldier10
dialogue.line: Now! Now!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Post_Soldier5
dialogue.line: Give him a lesson, sir!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Post_Soldier6
dialogue.line: No bloody mercy!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Friodo
dialogue.line: You know the way out... or do I have to arrange a little escort for you, hm?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Friodo
dialogue.line: Remember, I'm watching you.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Brencis_Soldier1
dialogue.line: I said get out! Are you deaf?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Friodo
dialogue.line: Stop bothering me. Or you'll end up in a cell with the others.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_PostCommander
dialogue.line: Ugh! You can't bloody trust anyone nowadays...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Friodo
dialogue.line: [sigh] Same old story...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You’re done with stealing from the prisoners. Your commander knows everything about it.

dialogue.speaker: 54ED20D24A77945127F2AEA189C88C94
dialogue.line: I have no business here.

dialogue.speaker: CB603A3049EDC42478079BBA29BB2824
dialogue.line: I know about your deal with Yenno and Cerbus.

dialogue.speaker: D616AE894E6B04DF4A2580AC467DC5A5
dialogue.line: I've beaten Cerbus.

dialogue.speaker: F02A161C404847B94FDF20BF34C3C3CC
dialogue.line: Is there another way I could persuade you?

dialogue.speaker: 6CF7364647591C1945F6D2AAB0FC3DCA
dialogue.line: It doesn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: B434598643A5FF00B3E50BAB1B9E6173
dialogue.line: Might say so... You caught the wrong man.

dialogue.speaker: 01E28BEB4E215176993811920FEF69C2
dialogue.line: No, do your own dirty bidding.

dialogue.speaker: C606EF2045A1708E2BA3A9A0C9C817D7
dialogue.line: Not yet.

dialogue.speaker: 5FFC22BE4CD7C24D5A83728E9F5AF443
dialogue.line: Please, Mert is, um... He's my family.

dialogue.speaker: 7CA8EE6B488DAF2F42620EBACB0CB03E
dialogue.line: Seems I have no business here.

dialogue.speaker: E18DA6B34476BD21E273B78A8ABA46D6
dialogue.line: Why did he beat you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [chuckle] Calm down. I'm not here to... drink you.

dialogue.speaker: 7211DFD643285EC2021EC19C8C5A2983
dialogue.line: A plain boring girl, was it?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: [sigh] That's not exactly comforting.

dialogue.speaker: AD8D55CA4EA207C3EF8DAC8C97E5550D
dialogue.line: And what if I said I was a prince?

dialogue.speaker: 4768467043EA5DA26DB9B2B86C5B94DD
dialogue.line: Do you know where Vlad is now?

dialogue.speaker: B5B1B113452179892CD863B1AC40C6B4
dialogue.line: I saved your life!

dialogue.speaker: E9ED65F246971DA654BF49A8C05C7732
dialogue.line: I'm a friend of Vlad's.

dialogue.speaker: 8F1DFDE44192E7EA9EF1C88AD45C4D9E
dialogue.line: I'm also friend of Vlad's.

dialogue.speaker: 0EA6F0C14E1281B14FF44AB4FB0EAC35
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 542F4E274ADE5CFE8CB81B85F1D9BAF8
dialogue.line: All right, I'm going.

dialogue.speaker: DE93B92A4006AB09E34EBAAC9242069A
dialogue.line: All right, I'm going.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Stop harrasing this man.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_Post_Soldier2
dialogue.line: Huh. Did you really say that? You want a beating too?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q105_PostCommander
dialogue.line: You’ve done right, bringing this to me. Here is your due. Now be on your way.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Your subordinates are stealing from prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: AAECF3D14C51D8AEB81E44AE3C3DF542
dialogue.line: I've came to see one of the prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: BDCBABE1464AA427A7A55A9110322875
dialogue.line: I’ll be on my way.

dialogue.speaker: D2BB841C4780143FF7041C975A18C1B8
dialogue.line: Let me speak to a prisoner.

dialogue.speaker: 706E36314613DC73254244B9358E8406
dialogue.line: Renegade?

dialogue.speaker: D8E4028B45404F1459E7D3B24198D325
dialogue.line: You should end this practice.

dialogue.speaker: 4BFA1BAB4B110A59C25DF28EDFC44E1C
dialogue.line: You’re running a tight ship here, aren't you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Q105_Mert_Soul
dialogue.line: [sob] My hand... What did you do to my hand...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: DD162E8941B558FAE116628E3DB171DD
dialogue.line: I'm sorry, Mert...

dialogue.speaker: 9AD576724BF85B37DC188F94E35297EF
dialogue.line: It's like you said, there was no saving her.

dialogue.speaker: DCAB11114AF24FC4F14C27AC10D722B9
dialogue.line: 'I'm so sorry she's gone' or 'you didn't have a choice.' It won't change what happened. What I did.

dialogue.speaker: F35F1ACD47F25AAB6D263F9417A3B32C
dialogue.line: 'You didn't have a choice' or 'she's not suffering anymore.' But it doesn't change what happened. What I did.

dialogue.speaker: 002897CF431531EA6393A49F74D03C5F
dialogue.line: 'You'll come visit every now and then', she'd said, 'and we'll laugh over a pint of cider'.

dialogue.speaker: BC794C0D4C897491B8ECCAB4289660DB
dialogue.line: ...horrible? Surreal?

dialogue.speaker: DA3E42824FD663A07929F5A2865BAF59
dialogue.line: ...raise a pint in her memory?

dialogue.speaker: B213799E43E65C16FDBD33998C181D54
dialogue.line: About...?

dialogue.speaker: 0756F23948668599EFFA6CBDA6AD4A27
dialogue.line: Alin loved apples.

dialogue.speaker: F9D60F144549781E8A16A0BA540448BC
dialogue.line: Alin loved apples. He would’ve eaten every single one in the pantry if mum had let him.

dialogue.speaker: 72F253F54111F28E315B4290D2004FFF
dialogue.line: Alin, my younger brother. He... drowned on my watch.

dialogue.speaker: 7C04D33C4DA2BB8AF91AF9A7B6842065
dialogue.line: Alin, my... My younger brother.

dialogue.speaker: 9BDCD98940CD0866B0A050A14483D1DD
dialogue.line: An inscription...?

dialogue.speaker: 7AED47F04284973C2642A590E56FF6DC
dialogue.line: And he used to be a friend of mine.

dialogue.speaker: 0EB365454B535AB273E4169B935B0FE1
dialogue.line: And here I was thinking this fucking night couldn't get any worse.

dialogue.speaker: AFFD2C324B0AD8E997D98E9D8072687B
dialogue.line: And why was that?

dialogue.speaker: 223A2E844FFC16F82233D2BF1F65ABC9
dialogue.line: Are you sure? You look pretty upset.

dialogue.speaker: 644200B840068A5E0F2E80BA7E148550
dialogue.line: As you wish...

dialogue.speaker: 2D05D6574EC2E9131081CF91F82FC21B
dialogue.line: As you wish... [show inscription]

dialogue.speaker: 9C46796E4B1E791DC58072AD6604285E
dialogue.line: Besides, we're not staying in this pisspot forever.

dialogue.speaker: E1E18B434B02CF68A54DDD9FDB314582
dialogue.line: Bloody hell. That's sick.

dialogue.speaker: 170D75A342C173A3AD3B8794F4FB8666
dialogue.line: Both.

dialogue.speaker: 5B6557CF425356D924CB4881CD1BEE97
dialogue.line: But I suppose many wicked men believe the same thing...

dialogue.speaker: E3D99CBE46BED42BE3C7319FC97A636D
dialogue.line: But it's not Hebrew. You said so yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 41ECC3E24B8905032948CFA703E214E1
dialogue.line: But that's my whole point, you didn't –

dialogue.speaker: 6C92094447A7C656E81177845121C6EC
dialogue.line: But you did have a choice to save her...

dialogue.speaker: 04DE2F0941136232ECE16DBA4D1CBB63
dialogue.line: But you didn't have to do it!

dialogue.speaker: 546D998249078122B53513AC8F411E53
dialogue.line: Can you fucking imagine it?!

dialogue.speaker: F7439CC14DFF716BAEE874AFC6DD99B1
dialogue.line: Can you honestly sleep now?

dialogue.speaker: E97E528640FD02A7E64347A4E51EDD3D
dialogue.line: Can you honestly sleep now? After... everything.

dialogue.speaker: AA0421B445265D828126D6BA980ACA63
dialogue.line: Can you imagine what it's like? Killing your friend? In cold blood?

dialogue.speaker: 6012F8D04941C05205566F9F7DA8BA6C
dialogue.line: Crake, if there's anything –

dialogue.speaker: 714F148B46E393658E10ABBDBB97402B
dialogue.line: Crake, you don't need to ex–

dialogue.speaker: 80B2408C491A4B0C98A074B0AE3BE0F5
dialogue.line: Did you find anything useful in the church? You examined that... That damned thing.

dialogue.speaker: D77FB07847254C89D0BC42943210A7D4
dialogue.line: Doesn't really help, does it?

dialogue.speaker: 381511B4476ECD5DE1772285C75BEC72
dialogue.line: Don't you want to talk about Sara?

dialogue.speaker: 00DCB11B492B344BCE25A5B731CA82FB
dialogue.line: Don't you want to talk?

dialogue.speaker: 403F9C2040CAC3D0A83BBC9C07413D12
dialogue.line: Duly noted. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: FE173CA04E33C113A3249CB3C07DD6A3
dialogue.line: Enough of this. I need some rest.

dialogue.speaker: 3322B737435BFE1C69C4D294FA7B7E2A
dialogue.line: Enough of this. Tell me what have you learned about that damned winged... thing.

dialogue.speaker: 19D0FCCE428353F2CCBE999ACDB062F0
dialogue.line: Exactly. Remember what Sara said? The city guards keep away from the ruins.

dialogue.speaker: BE2D763E49FC57D2AEBDB28F802182FE
dialogue.line: Figured I can let myself save at least one soul.

dialogue.speaker: 70F7113F4C880C5B23A1AC89CE9F9E5C
dialogue.line: Follow me.

dialogue.speaker: 25FF79AA49ECC45B2BC5358F0D2709A1
dialogue.line: For once, could you do what I’m asking? Hm?

dialogue.speaker: 2DF7AA5F4BA574B17085969104F8CE68
dialogue.line: Fuck! Fuck!!!

dialogue.speaker: 7F9B8AEB464AF2F492381EB0DA39E965
dialogue.line: Goodnight.

dialogue.speaker: FB23A9774036B6F4710D5CBC74D792E7
dialogue.line: Goodnight.

dialogue.speaker: E168756B4CED2B9ACD58C988F8318F99
dialogue.line: Got up to a lot of trouble?

dialogue.speaker: 793EAC3640D33D97DA1089A9BE95C7AE
dialogue.line: Has this happened before?

dialogue.speaker: 8915472A46CF90CFC55F949989EB7D46
dialogue.line: Has this happened before? Did you have to – ?

dialogue.speaker: C62DF507404F015A1D9EA5B35778C561
dialogue.line: Her family, they have an orchard. Apples, pears, all that.

dialogue.speaker: 01954F994EED6074BE676BBADC2B5A41
dialogue.line: Her family, they have an orchard. Apples, pears, and 'the best cider in the valley.' As she used to say.

dialogue.speaker: 7C0C44C7401E2C3534BBA58D4C901378
dialogue.line: Here, look at this. It was inside the gargoyle.

dialogue.speaker: 77BADF7D47CB447E5C3858BC693EA830
dialogue.line: How would that even be possible?

dialogue.speaker: 49BEBB9D435B54922F3F9FB80DAAB535
dialogue.line: Huh? Why now, all of a sudden?

dialogue.speaker: C235D0BD4ED4F04B1BC0A8A490322691
dialogue.line: Huh? With...?

dialogue.speaker: 1C0C132644CD5D4B34DEF99EDC54A0A0
dialogue.line: I already said we're done with this, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 34366D074F8DEC87EC876A8904500101
dialogue.line: I bet Sara could drink us both under the table.

dialogue.speaker: 2229CA7E43F4D88F11A0359184767D88
dialogue.line: I bet Sara could've drunk us both under the table. Laughing while she was at it.

dialogue.speaker: 931CA25A4AB68736CA690584B36A71B4
dialogue.line: I did what I had to, and I’m not about to hide it.

dialogue.speaker: F488B8A6464509E85BF564A0AB98A776
dialogue.line: I had this friend, Vladimir... I didn’t do it in cold blood, exactly but... But it makes me feel like shit anyway.

dialogue.speaker: C46B74D64E129B2A05521B9F05230651
dialogue.line: I imagine it's all part of some ritual.

dialogue.speaker: 513C040F49EE5F969832F680762F9E3D
dialogue.line: I imagine it's all part of some... horrible ritual. S-Still can't wrap my head around it. I-It's just too... it's too...

dialogue.speaker: 98A1E9FD4B8735EF4A923E932E8B2313
dialogue.line: I know Sara would have, without batting an eye. That's the real reason I brought her tonight – she understood these things.

dialogue.speaker: 645B2B724F924573AD4B44B7ECCC4A29
dialogue.line: I know the feeling. No words can drown out the guilt. Time only dulls it a little... just enough to make it bearable.

dialogue.speaker: 64E185044312A18445D57CA8CBA41D26
dialogue.line: I know what it's like to lose someone.

dialogue.speaker: 0E826FEC49B1EBB5E24C4AB9B67DB92E
dialogue.line: I tried convincing him to join us. But Mevasser eventually backed out.

dialogue.speaker: C939DCC84357EB96F220E49507EF9CCB
dialogue.line: I usually avoid talking about it. Or them. At all.

dialogue.speaker: EE43458446F07EBC2C6AF8AE2599C7C2
dialogue.line: I usually avoid talking about it. Or them. At all.

dialogue.speaker: CACD150E4B6A49F30D6D57B2C3069E51
dialogue.line: I'll keep watch.

dialogue.speaker: 7D9E92F647F4659D825539AAC0376B2F
dialogue.line: I'm going to set Layos free.

dialogue.speaker: F1783C8F4E9DB92E5B855DBE376E044F
dialogue.line: I'm starting to think you're not as bad as you make yourself out to be.

dialogue.speaker: BD7290144CD2067DC4BD6BB842B92DBA
dialogue.line: I... I keep telling myself...

dialogue.speaker: A9CEFE1C492DC0CBA10432BF9413226D
dialogue.line: I... I know what we can do.

dialogue.speaker: 1B1E15DE4186E5440208BB88AAEF5BEC
dialogue.line: If you say so... Here. [show inscription]

dialogue.speaker: 6CC49C1C4F19F325E60823AA8ED69894
dialogue.line: In its mouth.

dialogue.speaker: 6AD8374545BDDCF0D526FB8B6A686157
dialogue.line: It all went to hell, didn’t it?

dialogue.speaker: 1AB5ECEA4654EA8C338636B66D6F751A
dialogue.line: It was actually a human, baked in clay.

dialogue.speaker: B553CA264A1DD26A2322BF80F02EE8B5
dialogue.line: It's all gone to hell, hasn't it?

dialogue.speaker: A40BC39247EB295D8D185D9701B4C72A
dialogue.line: It’s not Hebrew either. Perhaps, some ancient tongue... Where did you find it exactly?

dialogue.speaker: EFECED8D4B7E084BEB7B8DB319737AFA
dialogue.line: Just one more thing – you can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: A46233D14CEF9597DF760485212B1A23
dialogue.line: Just one more thing... I want you to know that whatever happens next, you can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: 0877BE6545E5D3003F5907B7AA819012
dialogue.line: Know anyone who can speak ancient tongues?

dialogue.speaker: 68F690154A414B567DC9C9853BCDE365
dialogue.line: Know anyone who can speak ancient tongues?

dialogue.speaker: 4E7955A84A6DB7CCB094B3AE96228BD1
dialogue.line: Let them catch her and free her later, once –

dialogue.speaker: 4E28FA6243A58219AEE065B67529B5B1
dialogue.line: Let's just sleep on it, all right? I feel exhausted.

dialogue.speaker: 9D923F82400D19B19B2F129151F53367
dialogue.line: Lie down and get some rest. I'll keep an eye out – I don't feel like sleeping, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: FD299D5F41DEA8E6E875CC9D118F704A
dialogue.line: Lie down and get some rest. I'll keep an eye out.

dialogue.speaker: 7B3A7E1442EC00B324D22A87E7A35B4F
dialogue.line: Look at this. [show inscription]

dialogue.speaker: FC5FA9984EB1110C04A37DB221E8AFC7
dialogue.line: Look at this. [show inscription]

dialogue.speaker: 1D40945D40ECE0AB0650A3826F6ABA52
dialogue.line: Maybe I should go there when this is over. Tell her parents. And maybe...

dialogue.speaker: D9BAC25843CDF13852454B9AD1750158
dialogue.line: Maybe just try to get some rest.

dialogue.speaker: 9777957641B33F8894B785AB16C3B151
dialogue.line: Maybe we could talk about them, instead.

dialogue.speaker: 54DA774749E16301B9AD6BA3621902CB
dialogue.line: Maybe we could talk about them, instead. Remember the good parts.

dialogue.speaker: B89788594B1E50E2909D06BF2D0F9BDE
dialogue.line: Me neither.

dialogue.speaker: 2B183A4244E30523D5341BAA531355FF
dialogue.line: Me too.

dialogue.speaker: 3B8A32CF42A1A818E39767878163739E
dialogue.line: Morning.

dialogue.speaker: 9E38AB734B0EDBC321F99692F6A6F0BB
dialogue.line: Must be even harder to lead.

dialogue.speaker: B995B73A45DC8D3C3586558CC0926072
dialogue.line: No difference. I hope you’d do for me what I did for her.

dialogue.speaker: 43A9093941BB5281616381A328AB89C9
dialogue.line: No, not really. But he could be very stubborn.

dialogue.speaker: D9FAA10C471D135D23C86A9B046857A0
dialogue.line: No. Did you learn anything useful about that thing?

dialogue.speaker: 1CA97D8748043ADCBAA3A9BB59045C93
dialogue.line: No. Enough of this. Just tell me what you learned about that damned... thing.

dialogue.speaker: 1EA540514050F93BDA8EEC824AB10055
dialogue.line: Not quite in cold blood, but yeah, it's horrid.

dialogue.speaker: 8825D59449AF49049B41709F0666EFB5
dialogue.line: Now please tell me what you found out at the church.

dialogue.speaker: 2C111E42467137CD242DF8A5DCFAF898
dialogue.line: Now, I could really use some rest.

dialogue.speaker: 56BC9C88410B979396497395FDD3275B
dialogue.line: Off the top of my head? No.

dialogue.speaker: 39CDE27A4245A5B27B5E60B72EAFD2C8
dialogue.line: Oh well. Now’s hardly the time to fret over it, is it? Better focus on the matter at hand.

dialogue.speaker: AE2C1F384029DA258DAA8799E0EC7075
dialogue.line: Oh yeah? And how could we have done that?

dialogue.speaker: 00B924314F8B327F196114A489D2B3B3
dialogue.line: Oh, well... You know how his people are – they keep their distance much more than mine do.

dialogue.speaker: E4D57E94451ECD8317C0018F1849319F
dialogue.line: Once they'd already tortured her? Raped her? Once she'd told them everything?

dialogue.speaker: A65CE11443ACCC0DBE6E0E818CCBA8C8
dialogue.line: Sara.

dialogue.speaker: 075E981F43F9B5EA3E17179B7A147A1F
dialogue.line: Say what...?

dialogue.speaker: AB1868134C1D04CF8B0F768E8E888639
dialogue.line: She wanted to move back to Parlita. When it was all over.

dialogue.speaker: F6856FA748E43409111E71BB08ADDF89
dialogue.line: She wanted to move back to Parlita. When it was all over.

dialogue.speaker: 0533E15F4D8CF9154B1257AEE6080778
dialogue.line: Shit. There’s really no right thing to say at times like this, is there?

dialogue.speaker: F367CCBF48BD72508BF8EC95069D35D0
dialogue.line: Something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: 3F0AEB3A413A2DA68958B9B45386E1D6
dialogue.line: Still, Mevasser is a scholar. Knows a lot about ancient books. From different traditions.

dialogue.speaker: 3E1FF63743A1270A0B0142918E5CED68
dialogue.line: Sure they do. But I still hope he'll help us... for old times's sake.

dialogue.speaker: 5BE6B1CB430352BB72C832A17ABA698A
dialogue.line: Sure. I'll meet you there.

dialogue.speaker: 8CAFB54A480B84FCA88378AB58A75BF3
dialogue.line: That thing, that... That gargoyle... It was a human, baked inside clay.

dialogue.speaker: 0047AC5B46D742EE6A1FFE922A254FF1
dialogue.line: That thing... That gargoyle... It was human. Encased and baked in clay.

dialogue.speaker: D1E56C254C99AAE278019CB78B392051
dialogue.line: That's true... Nothing we can do about it anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 534D259F4C9748BC61326899D44EFBFE
dialogue.line: The Jewish quarter isn’t far from here.

dialogue.speaker: A83D68F4465C2AF3DE40B9A36D46D6AF
dialogue.line: The Jewish quarter isn’t far from here.

dialogue.speaker: 13FC664E40980DAB2C31FD98D8A1FE63
dialogue.line: The truth.

dialogue.speaker: E5EF10784116ED5ECBD3D2919EA5023D
dialogue.line: They have good reason to.

dialogue.speaker: 89CBAB89494D9677C557DA865C619859
dialogue.line: Used to be? But not anymore...?

dialogue.speaker: 7BB16E344DF114D3FD6145B546898685
dialogue.line: Used to be? Not anymore?

dialogue.speaker: A5391C2845474F6E8AEE3FB63582F9C5
dialogue.line: We're staying here.

dialogue.speaker: EBBB81B541D6D578BE11E981CF6AB736
dialogue.line: Well, imagine two years! Two years of – of this! Hiding in holes, running away, dying!

dialogue.speaker: F597761445BFA1DBDDF876A07387AF80
dialogue.line: What if it had been you? Injured and unable to move?

dialogue.speaker: 8F346EA94C20BBE4600D48B1D18425B5
dialogue.line: What if you'd been the one who got injured?

dialogue.speaker: 9C1A69284E5975D6AFA180B233E08398
dialogue.line: What will we tell the others?

dialogue.speaker: E2D1A37B45391A1E4AACDB84721E1B77
dialogue.line: What will we tell the others?

dialogue.speaker: 894404F842323C7D6BDA93A69824D260
dialogue.line: Who was it for you?

dialogue.speaker: 46D7D62746D4B0795703728246F9F7A4
dialogue.line: With the inscription. It dawned on me – I know a rabbi who might help… His name's Mevasser.

dialogue.speaker: 2842EF4046C4A6F7B8B1F8BD19E56D96
dialogue.line: Yeah, but don't forget the blockade. I’ve got a means of getting through the gates myself, but I can't smuggle you in as well.

dialogue.speaker: DF789DB04DCEF5AD7D76799D437D447E
dialogue.line: Yeah. I can read Latin, but this seems like something totally different.

dialogue.speaker: 15FD72D64D31E1460B5DEDBE50F1472F
dialogue.line: Yeah. I don't feel like sleeping anyway.

dialogue.speaker: 8D0CEA684D9A53E990787DBEA2967544
dialogue.line: Yeah. I'd like that.

dialogue.speaker: 327ABDD74511E03CC76363A68C4683B9
dialogue.line: Yeah. I'm sure I'll dream of sunshine and rainbows.

dialogue.speaker: B4181B6A4200137E631D99809923A3E6
dialogue.line: Yeah. We should go there right away.

dialogue.speaker: 74962CBC41D75E9EAC6F359ABC121AC9
dialogue.line: Yeah... Fuck. I'm so tired of all this hiding. And dying.

dialogue.speaker: E402BD984C9B12105AC46787DDA18451
dialogue.line: Yeah... You chose a hard time to join.

dialogue.speaker: 0823F1964A2510DA43435C9153B45642
dialogue.line: You don't know shit. Not shit! You've only been one of us for a few days. And what? It's already too much for you?!

dialogue.speaker: B7C12879439023D0AAE899B21BFFF274
dialogue.line: You go to sleep, I'll keep watch.

dialogue.speaker: D988EE54425742F50A575C9CD04F560C
dialogue.line: You have to get to Neustadt on your own, and by day, no less. While Mevasser's teaching at the school. Got it?

dialogue.speaker: D33F6D4E41EA23F9BBA2D697C844117F
dialogue.line: You know, Crake… I’m starting to think you’re not as bad as you make yourself out to be.

dialogue.speaker: C19CF20D476E58E4E4EEDE8FFF1AA802
dialogue.line: You know, I've actually seen these creatures before. But I'm not sure yet how to put all this together.

dialogue.speaker: 1F316194444EB94121ED648AC2838EE3
dialogue.line: You sure?

dialogue.speaker: A3B056DE487F8CB3CB04AFA4064C6ECA
dialogue.line: You sure? It looks like it's about to collapse.

dialogue.speaker: 038653424AA06AF30366D1B2EDAC86E9
dialogue.line: You sure? You look upset.

dialogue.speaker: 8D328F884FBABBD34F594596E1812FD8
dialogue.line: You're right, I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 9CF3CACB48F175771A01B6AE319B215E
dialogue.line: You're right, I'm sorry. It must've been hard.

dialogue.speaker: 564069AF4EC740B571798B97669AF681
dialogue.line: [scoff] Don't worry about me.

dialogue.speaker: FBB739DA484935225EC2569DBE259CC8
dialogue.line: [scoff] I simply don’t hide what I've done. And what I’ll do if I have to – while still believing it’s for a good cause.

dialogue.speaker: 93C39E244A0632280AF7BE977510C39D
dialogue.line: [scoff] Me? For sure. I usually don't drink at all.

dialogue.speaker: 49BB7D9740661012C4778F961E5C4373
dialogue.line: [scoffs] You did have a choice. We could’ve still saved Sara!

dialogue.speaker: EE4404FE43DC435BF820F2BE6B196112
dialogue.line: [sigh] I don't need you to say it, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 753810D945AC5E31798D4E9AE708F35B
dialogue.line: [sigh] If you say so...

dialogue.speaker: F7AE7C6D47B9EB90B46EDBA2472FAF28
dialogue.line: [sigh] Me neither.

dialogue.speaker: 320604C2489E8D136633E28CA6400B42
dialogue.line: [sigh] That's true... nothing we can do about it anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 367882F046EE59A46A0306B95C8DD7F7
dialogue.line: Huh. Who are you?!

dialogue.speaker: D4A9A37642DC750AE65A6B82AA23F9BC
dialogue.line: Master Aurelius! I need help with this one!

dialogue.speaker: 8AA011284C5AF12A0A27FFA44AE6EA41
dialogue.line: Master! There's an intruder! Master!

dialogue.speaker: 0365ECE54DFAAC01C55CF3B2E7D7F520
dialogue.line: My master will wipe the floor with you!

dialogue.speaker: 964BB4FA4C6818C6ED1844A64D2DE89F
dialogue.line: Take that!

dialogue.speaker: 0A0172524FB1B4DDCF975D955BC7299B
dialogue.line: You’ve no idea who you’re messing with!

dialogue.speaker: ABE8A2124DD9ECA851D20B841D1B4D9C
dialogue.line: Here! Let's hide! Now!

dialogue.speaker: EB5F5D9C44298FE8AB5DAE98D7C06D70
dialogue.line: Hurry up! They're closing on us!

dialogue.speaker: 7D1A03574BF917E5658923AD3C957073
dialogue.line: It's locked! Open it from the other side!

dialogue.speaker: F3B33F4A4B25822280E46DB0EB9A2D18
dialogue.line: Just follow me!

dialogue.speaker: 77E0F1114BE4A19AB6A79599C64AE1AA
dialogue.line: Keep close to me!

dialogue.speaker: 53D2CD3B47829FBB18D7DC9AB65B9F26
dialogue.line: Quick! Keep moving!

dialogue.speaker: 5D2F8DA7412736B03BA0D9A42C2A8168
dialogue.line: Quick, Coen! Over the wall!

dialogue.speaker: FF6E41C3455C47FFFD1B699778742C1E
dialogue.line: Shit! How many of them are there?

dialogue.speaker: 72D88A5D4D5A440272761C9A5807F898
dialogue.line: There, through the gate!

dialogue.speaker: 7CD27D3845D1DD5E8B38E9B1A1905902
dialogue.line: We need a place to hide. Come on!

dialogue.speaker: 816668CA4420D787D35E77A647E2CB0F
dialogue.line: Where are we going?!

dialogue.speaker: 05C5AC0C448EA41DB1C48B985D015A77
dialogue.line: A piece of clay...? Here?

dialogue.speaker: 487E217041CBFB2F641BCB9101C84B31
dialogue.line: Coen! Don't split up!

dialogue.speaker: 255A56A5435597DFE8CE2BA4FDA2D082
dialogue.line: Coen! Don't wander away! We must stay vigilant.

dialogue.speaker: EAAA5DB240BE5F67B96923A89DB84A36
dialogue.line: Coen! Where are you going? It's this way.

dialogue.speaker: 52289AF64E8B4133AFE04A898573579B
dialogue.line: Coen, think you could do something about it?

dialogue.speaker: 051F8C004B111874B41D248ED7EB3605
dialogue.line: Coen, this is no time to wander.

dialogue.speaker: A9243C4D4E0E17514D0F05A56D9013BC
dialogue.line: Come back here!

dialogue.speaker: 7E1E46874475EDD00363378DE1F5167C
dialogue.line: Come on, keep up!

dialogue.speaker: 38B378174C929D465BB3759C4ED9B11D
dialogue.line: Crake's body... Fuck! I'm too late.

dialogue.speaker: 43B1E7DC4D5CF60385860A8A34065399
dialogue.line: Does it look recent?

dialogue.speaker: A2985B244B7E7DAA4A363082C3813A26
dialogue.line: Don't dawdle, Coen!

dialogue.speaker: 057F6D3C4FADB9A61A877B829FB2916E
dialogue.line: Don't touch it. God knows what it is.

dialogue.speaker: 62571B354DEA98BB2E15A58E28C3ACD9
dialogue.line: Don’t fall behind, slowpoke!

dialogue.speaker: 970E2BAD4E6FBDF5982735BE1362DA7E
dialogue.line: Here you go!

dialogue.speaker: E9AA25F04AD60CFCC1E53BBDBDE2FD96
dialogue.line: Hey! Keep close.

dialogue.speaker: BF2CCD344D8229E69B5E0EB3A9739E5C
dialogue.line: Hey, get back here! Stick together!

dialogue.speaker: 282D02FF4AFFFD5937A25BB5861CC708
dialogue.line: Hey, not so fast! We should stick together.

dialogue.speaker: F5AC21DE405EF2C2C6302E80F1FA694E
dialogue.line: Hmm, this is even creepier than I remember.

dialogue.speaker: E6C373F84A7B501669CC078CF111B2C0
dialogue.line: Huh? Coen? Where did you dissapear to?

dialogue.speaker: 79C258C544AAC26E88E432A851916E86
dialogue.line: I think the tower wall's fallen down.

dialogue.speaker: CBB2908C498BE3E81588CB95C53C81B1
dialogue.line: I'll try.

dialogue.speaker: 824495D943EC6B2EDBD190A0C9AFE0EE
dialogue.line: I'm comin'!

dialogue.speaker: 74578599456EDABC41D7BD9028D9B1A5
dialogue.line: If you start moving faster, I won't.

dialogue.speaker: F91B08C3485F7C3718CC6F96EA7E71CF
dialogue.line: It's Sara. She was crushed by debris.

dialogue.speaker: F56F887F49CB2EC0A4DEE3A7AE9FA40F
dialogue.line: It's not blood. Too dark... That much I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: B4E6663F4E846AA8816FCC9FA8F66080
dialogue.line: It's the same dark liquid.

dialogue.speaker: CE3C835C43788B7235B4AE93F4F5903C
dialogue.line: Let's keep our voices down.

dialogue.speaker: 0911FCC14C0BBEB9F91A2C9EC66E6927
dialogue.line: Locked and solid. I won't get it open by force.

dialogue.speaker: 19048D3A410FF562E491DDA70094C4A2
dialogue.line: Maybe it's a broken pot. Or some old church vessel?

dialogue.speaker: 1BDA4F5E4EBDA974DEDFF799DCC5FE19
dialogue.line: No, doesn't look like it.

dialogue.speaker: 3297F4F24B82D195DE7A709F0B8DA03A
dialogue.line: Pfft, I'm not lost.

dialogue.speaker: 337CA2EF4E21600C5B43A5B6B09FB9A2
dialogue.line: Something tells me this isn't just from age.

dialogue.speaker: 0F74FE8B4040BBBB23565692C0EA8984
dialogue.line: Something's blocking the gate.

dialogue.speaker: 4FA900FD466013AF5CF03C88CD6E517F
dialogue.line: Stay close. I don't want to lose you.

dialogue.speaker: BBEF1673476B17B59D2C119619388C3B
dialogue.line: The stains form a trail... Leading all the way to the tower door.

dialogue.speaker: FD47BEAD456E9C0DBC21C986F829526B
dialogue.line: The top of the belltower has completely collapsed.

dialogue.speaker: 79AD0EAB486CE4FAB20A1C830F770373
dialogue.line: There's no dust or moss on these stones, so... Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: 71E27BEA42FDC82F2803978A05CDBFA0
dialogue.line: This way! Hurry!

dialogue.speaker: 4DAB8033458293E492E54F89093606B1
dialogue.line: This weird... ichor, it's still wet.

dialogue.speaker: 5A20984048526C9114145E837447E9C4
dialogue.line: Uh, right.

dialogue.speaker: 2B4A482442728CFC5B1E32AFA1B6F8D7
dialogue.line: We need to move. They’re right behind us!

dialogue.speaker: FFB8395E415FAD16E9E2B2B1C4419335
dialogue.line: Where are you going?! I said follow me!

dialogue.speaker: 0C452E214077A8591C4C47A347682283
dialogue.line: Woah!

dialogue.speaker: A2A56A034DE2D19FD97A0AA94A6E8B20
dialogue.line: Yeah, one moment.

dialogue.speaker: 20F9B40F4F8835D9EE6C028896BC917A
dialogue.line: Yeah. Something tells me this isn’t just from age.

dialogue.speaker: 6FE3C181486E09DB1A8792B3D360A2F9
dialogue.line: You alright there, Coen?

dialogue.speaker: 5FA5B7AB45F1115B46E8E489B4189319
dialogue.line: You calling a vrakhir slow? Really?

dialogue.speaker: 31A1839A436C46CEDC366BA7A134BE68
dialogue.line: You think we should check inside?

dialogue.speaker: 731898F64F42E491332093B16A27265C
dialogue.line: Aurelius works for the knyaz. No doubt about it anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 6D72D169479B10A4EF9F9A828B5D5A7F
dialogue.line: Blood and bones everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: 835E60DC44CB7C1FD5C18186668C1C3E
dialogue.line: Bloody hell. I’ve got a feeling it won’t be friendly if I get any closer.

dialogue.speaker: 12C1E8B74EB7ECB713784EAA0F60AC9B
dialogue.line: But I probably should look for another way in.

dialogue.speaker: 0942293D447549CF48C16CAA27048F30
dialogue.line: Could this be Aurelius's tower?

dialogue.speaker: 09D2E7C1490690A30318769726E3CE29
dialogue.line: Guess I have my answer. This is the right place.

dialogue.speaker: E248B1AF4C0CB96A46669E91A6C3529D
dialogue.line: He was taken apart, limb by limb...

dialogue.speaker: 98114BF9480C0A905BF8D3A95197081C
dialogue.line: Heck. What are they up to?

dialogue.speaker: 943460BB4B5401A95316A8AE53F3B570
dialogue.line: Hm, the crows are circling over one spot. I wonder what they’re so intent on.

dialogue.speaker: 4DF7519D45653761E48F59A392D3BF96
dialogue.line: Huh, a tower in the middle of nowhere... I wonder who lives there.

dialogue.speaker: 7BBB7CF2488FA54054B3ADB5099A80D5
dialogue.line: Is that... a severed arm? Fuck.

dialogue.speaker: 78CE8F0143B8F46012B7B1901644018E
dialogue.line: It was too much, even for trained men...

dialogue.speaker: 907115B846D3E353F0850A920231F596
dialogue.line: It's cut clean off. A human did this.

dialogue.speaker: FB5018564FB80C6430223DABF5E98BA9
dialogue.line: Let's see what we have here...

dialogue.speaker: AFA1B6B248A94726A1AB1C8486DE6E5F
dialogue.line: Locked in cages like animals for slaughter. But why?

dialogue.speaker: B007D6FF4508A3463BC2E5B82A98A52D
dialogue.line: Locked.

dialogue.speaker: F59619C349E12F71D7E91B9AB03FDECD
dialogue.line: Looks like a part of something... bigger.

dialogue.speaker: BCD27ABD41C9A2D2BBB32F8CD3360532
dialogue.line: Looks unfinished. One of... how many?

dialogue.speaker: 074FCAB742D20D436AF22D93336BD061
dialogue.line: So many corpses... Ugh, and the smell... Oh, God.

dialogue.speaker: 2E70C66E48E9DF957A39BF88676BFA1A
dialogue.line: That's a lot of weapons. They were ready to defend this place at all cost.

dialogue.speaker: 8985A44E49C49A25603A3D8510E35598
dialogue.line: That's where they covered those poor folks in clay. Ugh.

dialogue.speaker: 430D9EB44189AFBD72C4CB83B97AC37F
dialogue.line: The blood trail leads deeper into the cave.

dialogue.speaker: F9F692D6480B9BA6E6E025B6775D58BC
dialogue.line: The cages are empty... They must have transformed all of the prisoners already.

dialogue.speaker: CD97117642A56447D4D8A0949283305F
dialogue.line: The soldiers must have been quartered here.

dialogue.speaker: 2C8D933C48454F933155EC9625AEEF4D
dialogue.line: There's a path, over the rocks.

dialogue.speaker: D9FA1AD34C85ADFCDC706B97723EC887
dialogue.line: These were soldiers, not some hired thugs.

dialogue.speaker: 1DD26310448A78594C60E3AFDE6727B3
dialogue.line: This book stands out...

dialogue.speaker: C9B4F9534C529667AB84298CFA0F8092
dialogue.line: This is... sick.

dialogue.speaker: 759A89C64C64DB5516FE9896727224F6
dialogue.line: Ugh. Why do they need all this clay?

dialogue.speaker: 0CE6B76B4F2E27D33947FC8C9D5952E4
dialogue.line: Well stocked. I guess they were planning to stay here for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: B489D3794346575FDFBA4E9E7F3C73AD
dialogue.line: What the hell is that thing?

dialogue.speaker: A0C5E67E4794542264F38B927826D15A
dialogue.line: Ah, Coen! About time. Let's go.

dialogue.speaker: 609F86714495731336F5428B444F1E4B
dialogue.line: Do you know exactly which street he meant?

dialogue.speaker: 7BCD573B4100AABED01BBD84B5233AF9
dialogue.line: Good idea. We’ll look for someone once we're close.

dialogue.speaker: 664DA3CB4CED2EA491D175A02940D085
dialogue.line: Maybe we should talk to the locals? Ask around?

dialogue.speaker: 765B85304A55CC7742A47CBD3120FE41
dialogue.line: Yeah. But we still have to find the right building.

dialogue.speaker: 20EF447844786A7DB8D5A39B2EF66FB9
dialogue.line: Easy... We're just...

dialogue.speaker: 2A3938A84B591A925BD4D995111A9F6E
dialogue.line: Good question. We could've easily kicked that lowlife out. You're just wasting your money.

dialogue.speaker: 0BC109124734B5E567492E8D1E4ADF8C
dialogue.line: I said – get out!

dialogue.speaker: F99C897B4D2396420C09B18583BF7358
dialogue.line: Let’s just... go.

dialogue.speaker: 866528BD4C85E630979ABEAA4C9140C0
dialogue.line: My advice – put the axe down... unless you have a death wish.

dialogue.speaker: 32BC5A664A8E5974583F6DA4DA2C4FDA
dialogue.line: Nutters!

dialogue.speaker: 4750AE5C4EA5936557F0DB9350B62924
dialogue.line: Put the axe down or else...

dialogue.speaker: 898247C14B2FD3C2A45F829F900C63C6
dialogue.line: Take this and sod off before my mood changes.

dialogue.speaker: F36723B545F0236FAA9BF6BC51D96452
dialogue.line: Take this and sod off.

dialogue.speaker: E75042F446ADAF99AFA585896253006C
dialogue.line: The hell are you doing here?! Get out!

dialogue.speaker: 8B8D5F2B48FB6A02DCA4C89E8DA333E8
dialogue.line: Thieving scum! Just you wait! Knyaz Brencis will hang you for this!

dialogue.speaker: 3CBA92204E0AA222D6DF3EA026116E9F
dialogue.line: Want it to be your grave, too?

dialogue.speaker: 4247213D4183DC5AF91953B4C0C40248
dialogue.line: Wha?! Go fuck yourself! This is my house!

dialogue.speaker: A7B8722B4D281B2670202D9A08F1F8A4
dialogue.line: Yeah, still... we’d better move.

dialogue.speaker: 06C7DD41462442CF106572A03AFB0AE1
dialogue.line: You're paying me? For what...?

dialogue.speaker: D6415076450379817D53578FA29014A7
dialogue.line: [scoff] Not just for this... Luckily, I doubt the guards will listen to a lowlife like him.

dialogue.speaker: 17E73F18468AB91E38DEE2BE578B67FC
dialogue.line: ...boagoló uvizmán korív v’ímru: oméyn.

dialogue.speaker: 854E6B8040776D064847C29D8260404C
dialogue.line: ...boagoló uvizmán korív v’ímru: oméyn.

dialogue.speaker: 098AB6604435B4887F477E95E071257E
dialogue.line: A Slav and a Tatar come and visit a rabbi. Sounds like the start of a joke. An unfunny one.

dialogue.speaker: AB5ADBE74647E86AAD9491BA4EB9D9E5
dialogue.line: Ah. Not for long, I presume. You never hold onto them.

dialogue.speaker: F1C47B8A4078FBEF11670F8379B3B18A
dialogue.line: But you know how to get him on our side, right?

dialogue.speaker: 96A9491E4925C6AD0663FC99254FFADC
dialogue.line: Clear and simple... Isn't it, Marat?

dialogue.speaker: 583BB79F439E70D8B517CAACE0B95B1E
dialogue.line: Did you part on good or bad terms?

dialogue.speaker: 6D1037564F73106E5BE269AC76F89C17
dialogue.line: Did you part on good or bad terms?

dialogue.speaker: 4B13512347DBC8EEF59235A3EE711DF4
dialogue.line: Enough games, Mevasser. I need your help.

dialogue.speaker: AB7A1A0A4C1586BC18DC81AA99BD59CF
dialogue.line: Erm, who are you, if I may ask?

dialogue.speaker: AC86415F4AAF91DA518B6D9A89092918
dialogue.line: Even more reason for me to stay out of it.

dialogue.speaker: FB21A2BC487709BC70951485EB81B335
dialogue.line: Everything alright? You look worried.

dialogue.speaker: EDA6537C417846D05367BBA41B0A7C13
dialogue.line: Forgive me, friend. I cannot help.

dialogue.speaker: 0A5A0D9E4E0C224F76F9DB89D19B444E
dialogue.line: Good to see you too, old friend.

dialogue.speaker: C3400A9C4A7FB94DF8B8A19A938ADC7F
dialogue.line: Good. You can go.

dialogue.speaker: 045F320646796A2BBBD553AB6766F6FD
dialogue.line: Here to catch up, I hope? Ask after my health? Otherwise –

dialogue.speaker: F6CA09CA4A15A1158C7B3A9447B80724
dialogue.line: I don't bring any more trouble here, and Mevasser won't tell anyone who I am. That's the deal.

dialogue.speaker: 4ADDB5BE4B17A0F073A5E3A5E7529454
dialogue.line: I remember.

dialogue.speaker: ECB387744933363C44934CA26FF57D77
dialogue.line: I won't defy my God. Won't stop teaching the young. But that's it. I'm not risking the knyaz's retribution by aiding rebels.

dialogue.speaker: 3DA6657648DBD9918A0028B58CA74F28
dialogue.line: I'd have told him! Eventually...

dialogue.speaker: B8230CAE4634C9DA2B1D2A9392EF9A33
dialogue.line: If he knew you were teaching prayers to children, you can be sure he'd punish you.

dialogue.speaker: EB81E0A84547EDC34BDF78BB053D8DE1
dialogue.line: It’s been a while... He might not be thrilled to see me.

dialogue.speaker: 273EC8384450EE2C54849FB7E1A1CAE8
dialogue.line: Just look at this inscription.

dialogue.speaker: 2ECB0F1F42E68016759E888105375AE6
dialogue.line: Just look at this, please.

dialogue.speaker: 7643C57D4FF2E7EC6A7FC8ACC17072B3
dialogue.line: Just recently, two thousand Jews were burned alive in Strasbourg... for 'spreading the Black Death', apparently.

dialogue.speaker: 35C26CE64B102ED1213885AACDECEF33
dialogue.line: Let's just go talk to him.

dialogue.speaker: 928E5B334BE49B5B99FBC399044C7456
dialogue.line: Let's just talk to him.

dialogue.speaker: 4317C8704B145CF948BF3A85B0F2E3C4
dialogue.line: Marat?

dialogue.speaker: 4625E2B846354319068B94BD5382DA50
dialogue.line: Mevasser, please –

dialogue.speaker: 407EF8014E3585B5CBB04BAAA407C03A
dialogue.line: No idea. Looks like gibberish to me.

dialogue.speaker: 9E4056384B15E77E20A75C97BDBB2C69
dialogue.line: No. We had a deal.

dialogue.speaker: 3877A1C8497076B1F6E1E79E3F69FFCD
dialogue.line: Same in Saulgau, Erfurt, and Breslau – all the Jews gone, slaughtered.

dialogue.speaker: D1845EC14BDC88EC724F07BA08091A2B
dialogue.line: So that's your name... Marat.

dialogue.speaker: 413021F8478E93514748E4885DE2B595
dialogue.line: Tell him.

dialogue.speaker: 46DD464F410F39BF60A08B80B5B05450
dialogue.line: The inscription...

dialogue.speaker: 8F97849E4A4E1CBA0DBD4595EE4C4B45
dialogue.line: This 'gibberish' was used to create a powerful weapon.

dialogue.speaker: 5C9BEB4F4268936210F3749E8F03E1FE
dialogue.line: This is Coen. He's... my friend.

dialogue.speaker: 1A25BE2D45D0FFAFF4515FA284F6B9D0
dialogue.line: Um, we had our disagreements.

dialogue.speaker: DD591AFB43194301C34CFDB26976F8A3
dialogue.line: We get blamed for everything – from fires, to droughts, to missing children.

dialogue.speaker: B7FC7E774FD9FBA05BF903B1477B58CE
dialogue.line: We know for a fact this 'gibberish' was used to create a powerful weapon.

dialogue.speaker: E3CC964B408CA9D782742BBDA3CF69A7
dialogue.line: We'll see...

dialogue.speaker: 51BB02DF424940339E20EB850FA47ECF
dialogue.line: Well then! My health's good, improving again, thank you for asking. And you? How's your father?

dialogue.speaker: 6E5D45B245B2AA9D4C94C9B03F63F668
dialogue.line: What kind of a deal?

dialogue.speaker: DB089AC24B21D00165D08B899639D7B0
dialogue.line: What kind of a deal?

dialogue.speaker: 5C21E5EE4E92C2712B073AB5428DAFB9
dialogue.line: What language is it?

dialogue.speaker: C995BE2640C4FCB63AD7628BAD14E220
dialogue.line: Why doesn't that surprise me?

dialogue.speaker: E0D90CCF4F15DF65F2C1FFBCC8313AE9
dialogue.line: Why won't you help us?

dialogue.speaker: 4BD6A66649897AF5B5B1C78F7FE721C7
dialogue.line: Why won't you help us? Brencis’s reign is as much of a threat to your people as it is to us.

dialogue.speaker: C824D9FC48AD99990352B58EC162EB51
dialogue.line: Will you answer my question, please?

dialogue.speaker: CC7F27F648FE23BC61B5B2AAE2BB8F4E
dialogue.line: Yes, well –

dialogue.speaker: 094FCDA9404D083EF0D9DD8FD8BE3CEA
dialogue.line: You called him... what again? A friend? Yet he didn't even know your true name.

dialogue.speaker: 57B0D0C8492A7D463EE2B6A88FDFA9AB
dialogue.line: Aye, aye... Gents first.

dialogue.speaker: 53B34F574693176B443121A223354B80
dialogue.line: Cut it out, you two. We need to focus.

dialogue.speaker: FE9C44584CF25B37AD771DB53642C5C0
