dialogue.line: Good to hear the guards won't interfere.

dialogue.speaker: E2801DCD4D07D3095EDB86941175F45B
dialogue.line: Good. Should be easier to look without them sticking their noses in.

dialogue.speaker: E2DFA3C043C5FB58B1339088EB3C660C
dialogue.line: Guards might be the least of our concerns.

dialogue.speaker: 083F00E942CEA90CCE9455A34BBE381D
dialogue.line: Huh, I know this place, actually. Used to play here as a kid.

dialogue.speaker: 6EC299D9424C6AC8C0EF0F9A1F58881B
dialogue.line: Huh. You mean that winged thing, right?

dialogue.speaker: 159814884A6D7052801B27A5063007F2
dialogue.line: I'm surprised Crake told you about it.

dialogue.speaker: 3024F27843BABC4A853E4CA990F429E5
dialogue.line: It's an odd place to play...

dialogue.speaker: D6CF83DD48A70F063164CD925B2F0B5B
dialogue.line: Nah. I always land on my feet – unlike those klutzes in the city guard.

dialogue.speaker: 7A7394C14FCF986B358DDF92CC07CE3E
dialogue.line: Odd place for children to play...

dialogue.speaker: C62C4B5B4FB01D0BDF3AA8AF3913AD8D
dialogue.line: Oh, rubbish! It's perfect for hide and seek. The belltower, especially.

dialogue.speaker: DB2E4C684AF9378510D27FA28FD5D04A
dialogue.line: Our Crakie is quite caring. When he finally trusts someone.

dialogue.speaker: 4A9904274223789917BBF788EEE7BEC9
dialogue.line: There shouldn't be many guards around. They knew to keep away from the Middens even before the plague.

dialogue.speaker: 4706297244F0ABFA93D618951F35FBEA
dialogue.line: We're all here. Good.

dialogue.speaker: 550823ED412A4ECDA6EAD194895530E3
dialogue.line: Well, they might just be the least of our worries.

dialogue.speaker: 1898B35149BE37D8CC057DA487B67D02
dialogue.line: Yeah. I wonder if we'll actually learn anything about that winged creature.

dialogue.speaker: 199F7F5A472C05426DC90590BD2C7A45
dialogue.line: You weren't afraid of falling?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Why did you want to meet here? There's guards everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: 65F8A4BA411EB3B207FC53B84BC66C66
dialogue.line: Does this mean I finally get to join your... guild?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: [chuckles] All the members still need to vote to accept you.

dialogue.speaker: 18D42B6840F00659BC8B2E8B391D6C1D
dialogue.line: I hope this isn’t another trap…

dialogue.speaker: 0C0D901C4858A543385544A5D1AABB67
dialogue.line: Why did you want to meet here?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_Rebel2
dialogue.line: You’ve really pissed off the knyaz, haven't you? I'm impressed.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_Rebel3
dialogue.line: What?! How so?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_Rebel4
dialogue.line: You’re still holding your blade too low. Aim higher, like Drogos showed us.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_Rebel5
dialogue.line: With Brencis breathing down our necks, it's harder to get... anything.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Gossip_Person2
dialogue.line: There was this big shadow in the sky. Flying!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Gossip_Person
dialogue.line: That wretched noise kept me up all night...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Chase_Guard2
dialogue.line: No? Death it is, then!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Chase_Guard3
dialogue.line: We've got you! Surrender or die!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Chase_Guard5
dialogue.line: Seize them!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Chase_Guard4
dialogue.line: Ugh! Give up!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Pardon me, but I’m searching for an old cobbler’s shop. Run by a man named Silas, years back.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.POI111_OldWoman
dialogue.line: Hmm, no... I don’t recall anyone like that. But Henrik, the store owner, might know something. Try asking him.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_street_person4
dialogue.line: Nah, sorry. Doesn’t ring any bells.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_street_person2
dialogue.line: Oi! Can't you see that we're talking here?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q106_Random_street_person3
dialogue.line: Yeah! Get lost.

dialogue.speaker: 8304F05F483EA3DAB91D059D9C6B3F0B
dialogue.line: Alarm! Intruder in the tower!

dialogue.speaker: 448DB9994CAFE3AF54B3B8950AF64DB1
dialogue.line: Get him! The sorcerer’ll find a use for what’s left of him.

dialogue.speaker: 702AEB4241A6DC24DA559DB960901CC7
dialogue.line: Intruder! Get him!

dialogue.speaker: 7DF163D1489F292CAD279DA9E9A10E8D
dialogue.line: Someone fetch Svetlana! We could sure use her damn spells right now!

dialogue.speaker: 0F7C8F2643760666E456FFA91EB0E4F5
dialogue.line: Hmm, I can’t make sense of it.

dialogue.speaker: B5C1A45648E5BF6E2B2A1684848F0026
dialogue.line: It's a human baked in clay. Jesus Christ.

dialogue.speaker: 5C24C2E34D3A4E09DCF869A78D24EE4C
dialogue.line: Let's see...

dialogue.speaker: F76062EF46AA4B860D8F01BA4A28F2CC
dialogue.line: Never seen anything sharper than these scythes.

dialogue.speaker: B1ABF80A467907F2CCDED79745D84DD7
dialogue.line: Solid clay. Must weigh a ton, yet it moved so quickly. Flew, even.

dialogue.speaker: 7EA044C2498F7A641A9FFD91138F8238
dialogue.line: Stitched up with thread... Something's inside.

dialogue.speaker: 3DA51CA24889947DC4861C8323573DFF
dialogue.line: This inscription... Crake has to see it.

dialogue.speaker: 6814DAE0486A83DAE87AAC8B6807B687
dialogue.line: What's this? Blood? But it's thicker...

dialogue.speaker: 4BBCFDC74E87456012BFC881ED0169AF
dialogue.line: I'll look after her. You check out the beast. Quick!

dialogue.speaker: BC9595AD4C8A26E43BC980A7D41F5A5D
dialogue.line: She's alive!

dialogue.speaker: 737876A34F9304B9D3A515B7B603E6A9
dialogue.line: Aaaaaargh!

dialogue.speaker: 0B07FA9F416F0050DFD4858F3ADC619B
dialogue.line: All right, why don't I change tools?

dialogue.speaker: 398A7F524D49CF714F9E318976CBDDC0
dialogue.line: But I don't know anything, I swear!

dialogue.speaker: 6D9A0857436EC8743E913D90C7E9F0F0
dialogue.line: I don't fucking know! They weren't there.

dialogue.speaker: A336A61642A4D11A7CFA50A431F5D71A
dialogue.line: I know as much as you!

dialogue.speaker: CB36E5BA45F7014229CA0AB9B78F7D74
dialogue.line: I told you already!

dialogue.speaker: 2C45C35840AEB6E1327812942BD16822
dialogue.line: No, aaaaaargh!

dialogue.speaker: 32935B064070EB7CBA870197762BD9CE
dialogue.line: Oh God, no, please.

dialogue.speaker: EA4BCBB24D0F98A5A91CA08A50EB2BE7
dialogue.line: So why didn't you come back and report that?!

dialogue.speaker: FEA466F74B992080FF58B1A37C8BFDDC
dialogue.line: So, again, why were you talking to the soldier?

dialogue.speaker: C1B4535549BF5D1794C8BF8AFC20C8C2
dialogue.line: Ugh!

dialogue.speaker: 82FCDDE8426DBB97B46B86B4D8D46C3F
dialogue.line: We trusted you, Layos.

dialogue.speaker: 8DA4816F47B17B3D6D697285D1FC9A9B
dialogue.line: Where are the scouts, Layos?!

dialogue.speaker: 40F2F1AD4BCE588F47B101A5AB76DA68
dialogue.line: Will you talk, then?

dialogue.speaker: A703FCAB427DE866A4A012BF7FF346D3
dialogue.line: Wrong answer, friend.

dialogue.speaker: 8FEEA5DB49EFF8795D1C2F8D07059121
dialogue.line: You want me to stop? Then answer my questions.

dialogue.speaker: FB536D7E4D5841664A8706BB34131185
dialogue.line: You're making this more difficult for yourself, you know that?

dialogue.speaker: FCE330C44B57746A2E6396AA22E48FA8
dialogue.line: A bloodied cross... Did Crake strike that monster with it? Then he might be alive...

dialogue.speaker: 8CA1A9EA4CAF388E9038458938B54383
dialogue.line: Aah!

dialogue.speaker: 34B320BB4DD86C5FF2B1CBB3CBE8BAC2
dialogue.line: Aah! Fuck!

dialogue.speaker: 0E376AAC4A2223E62517C1B6395185BA
dialogue.line: Agreed.

dialogue.speaker: 72BEC8304EA14C2A9E09B0A4A315A55F
dialogue.line: Arghh... Let! Go!

dialogue.speaker: F9E54B7F430A064C69731DBD3E9EE6BF
dialogue.line: Bloody hell! Those cursed mongrels again...

dialogue.speaker: 7DE192F94FAB51B216D9E1BF990BEC84
dialogue.line: But it's just one page... The intruders must have taken the rest.

dialogue.speaker: F144F1C147EB61D55922D2B13E2BF536
dialogue.line: Christ! What the hell was that?

dialogue.speaker: 756141EE490457FC7D4F979E8A93CF77
dialogue.line: Coen! It's, ugh –

dialogue.speaker: A05AFE1B4BC64215F044BE9CDF1E08B0
dialogue.line: Coen! This thing – Argh!

dialogue.speaker: 8B7963DC4BFD2314E0C901831CDAA681
dialogue.line: Coen, help!

dialogue.speaker: 9F62451446D3B9443A588990C689F9D8
dialogue.line: Come on... Get moving.

dialogue.speaker: 5498AA114F1AD9B36DE7FD916D2B7C42
dialogue.line: Coming!

dialogue.speaker: 68028FAB47D835A7D60B909BC2EF4883
dialogue.line: Crake! Are you there? Can you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: 1DD037B248E311BB7B1FDEB020C603DC
dialogue.line: Crake! Here!

dialogue.speaker: FC6E3A144A3018FA82AB04B0FDD0DF83
dialogue.line: Crake! Keep fighting!

dialogue.speaker: 9FF4DB77486D64488B2896BD5BE3B465
dialogue.line: Crake?! Craaake!

dialogue.speaker: 29DA9DA04458DFB4257EB4BFC8CDA5C7
dialogue.line: Damned if I know! Better stay vigilant.

dialogue.speaker: A17905BF4E7F51633772AD91D82C7ADC
dialogue.line: Dead end. Fuck!

dialogue.speaker: FCA480214D7D4A40638D29B0B2F79B9D
dialogue.line: Don't look very human to me.

dialogue.speaker: ABAEFB774C836C34CF50AFA0DD14E71D
dialogue.line: Finally...

dialogue.speaker: 117A7F824E5945952DBA829B5A9B1175
dialogue.line: For sure. But what in God's name killed him?

dialogue.speaker: 1CAA0D344E7E3666B6E24499D8506686
dialogue.line: Fresh blood. I’d better hurry.

dialogue.speaker: 1C9997D44BFF2009244A4FAD5BCB5598
dialogue.line: Fuck are those...? More bloody monsters?! Just what I needed...

dialogue.speaker: 6A4097A649F6AF537250DBB2DC2D72ED
dialogue.line: Fuck.

dialogue.speaker: A06E2B64477766F8AA7AF38DF9791B50
dialogue.line: Fuck. Blood everyhere...

dialogue.speaker: 3F1C70DD44DF29365702E19113F52137
dialogue.line: Good. Means we're on the right track.

dialogue.speaker: 0F937734499058658DDA10A40EA43A1F
dialogue.line: Got to deal with them quickly.

dialogue.speaker: C55F1EA049833C364E27BE9F370FB1F9
dialogue.line: Guess it's one of the intruders...

dialogue.speaker: C6A5A6E7408AE6A028F99FA3F148FA87
dialogue.line: Ha. Looks like a library!

dialogue.speaker: E4C73AF243EA1E008E3B1EB935A7D8E1
dialogue.line: Hard to say. Why’d you ask?

dialogue.speaker: F739A2704D0A3B0B68B108B7C1F57002
dialogue.line: Here. I see the exit!

dialogue.speaker: CC77177B46FD938D29B26F8F44D57BA8
dialogue.line: Hey! I found a note. It matches the inscription!

dialogue.speaker: FFEBAFEA4C5265C46A2AC2AD49883100
dialogue.line: Hey, there's a body here!

dialogue.speaker: 0728DF70485FB94518C40CBCC365E104
dialogue.line: Hey, you! Leave him alone, you monster!

dialogue.speaker: 5CA00E5140C51E4E51AC72A184004D70
dialogue.line: Hmm, could be. These ruins seem even older than he is.

dialogue.speaker: 65ECE55F4F26A547ECC3EF9460652A60
dialogue.line: Hold on! I'm coming!

dialogue.speaker: E112159F4EF1E50DE660ED92F1022DB6
dialogue.line: Huh, what's this? An old rusty key...

dialogue.speaker: 68D16D7946A9D2AFA3BEFFB38ACF8F05
dialogue.line: Hurry, I need to hurry! Or he'll end up like those thieves.

dialogue.speaker: 12D5E27141E71B611EED75860C9DF8B8
dialogue.line: I don't see it lying around anywhere nearby...

dialogue.speaker: 0264A488452579EE8ED989A1FF3C8E9E
dialogue.line: I hear you, Crake! I'm close!

dialogue.speaker: 3F257A3549FEBEC1301F309437525F36
dialogue.line: I saw a locked door over there – maybe it fits.

dialogue.speaker: 5547E6454E7246405275BC95029A9B1B
dialogue.line: I'd like to breathe some air that doesn't reek of death.

dialogue.speaker: 5CC8D9FC43D87AAF9F35EFABAD1F2B12
dialogue.line: I'm here! Hold on a little longer!

dialogue.speaker: DBC0FA12453AA5225C9583A764BE9B41
dialogue.line: I'm starting to wonder if any of them are still alive.

dialogue.speaker: 07AFF6EE4843EEA448501FB077E00280
dialogue.line: Isn't it obvious? Someone has been here. And recently.

dialogue.speaker: F26750E14C8BE1F0B7F3EBBEED0B0B7A
dialogue.line: It just struck me – maybe Brencis chose Vale Sangora for this very reason.

dialogue.speaker: 40A6A10B4B4D35766DDEC8AD07D33118
dialogue.line: It worked! Come on.

dialogue.speaker: D5821A794C21AFC00FB029999550970A
dialogue.line: It's getting louder...

dialogue.speaker: 4ED4FAC3454C3F7F5116F988DBCD65A0
dialogue.line: It's locked. I won't force it open.

dialogue.speaker: 15DA820F49148C06AA7E578A7FAC7391
dialogue.line: It's only a hunch. We don't know enough yet.

dialogue.speaker: 38B0F9164892AF0BCE4531899C6444D5
dialogue.line: Jesus. What's that sound? Somebody... crying?

dialogue.speaker: 2757867B42C7F2B4850082A2DF502F9D
dialogue.line: Let's move on.

dialogue.speaker: DCF367F943915E51EFD62F8E57286AFA
dialogue.line: Let's move on.

dialogue.speaker: E1E80DCE4C57219F3F30FD8A1075BD31
dialogue.line: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. We have yet to find out who they were.

dialogue.speaker: CB68C734423D433EFC42E48775B2D37D
dialogue.line: Let’s take a look on the other side—figure out where they came from.

dialogue.speaker: 00AAB7C24D4795D017B387A5BCB37D59
dialogue.line: Look at all this bloody debris! They smashed right through the wall.

dialogue.speaker: 3CECD7F04B239C15BB65788B1819FEA7
dialogue.line: Look at these wounds – what could have made them?

dialogue.speaker: AA2A5C634375E8F0CF3817B8B964B888
dialogue.line: Look at this... Someone smashed straight through the wall.

dialogue.speaker: 32E75D7F4E0717D0A96FD8BDF4793CE8
dialogue.line: Look! The lamps are still lit. Someone must’ve been here recently.

dialogue.speaker: EF7912444A05786A138FA8A9EAAD2187
dialogue.line: Maybe we'll find Silas's notes here?

dialogue.speaker: 6CBF0C2B4F660ED3D3FCA9B3900363B3
dialogue.line: Mhm. Doesn't hurt to check.

dialogue.speaker: 80CE74A94B8C8352D358CEA3CB3E0EDA
dialogue.line: More than one person, I’d say. They wrecked the whole place...  But how did they get in?

dialogue.speaker: 4CB0B7504E0C13625DBAB4ACB219BC6A
dialogue.line: More? Huh, curious. And somewhat unsettling...

dialogue.speaker: 8E429FF64766DD7D61F283B3E8B7C4BB
dialogue.line: Much, much older, I'd say.

dialogue.speaker: 4819231F44CEBA598EA5D69038CB1A6E
dialogue.line: Mud footprints... Those intruders must have come this way.

dialogue.speaker: CFFCE35B49C236C9819741B0699664B1
dialogue.line: Not much left of this one.

dialogue.speaker: 5B32F2474AA8BC69030B8F9BB71C3C05
dialogue.line: Not sure about that, but it’s definitely more unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: 3479EF9F49FDA8BF41662FB8004670E5
dialogue.line: Not the way we came, that's for sure.

dialogue.speaker: 7D85547F4EE7FD573E320E9594D68216
dialogue.line: People who lived here centuries ago. Many centuries, I’d even say.

dialogue.speaker: 53874D934618AB708B3C68BFEF5C9BC9
dialogue.line: Remember the woman Mevasser was talking about?

dialogue.speaker: 44D4EBEF4219521ADDEEE5A0CBD11F94
dialogue.line: Right behind you.

dialogue.speaker: 8EA604AE453A25CD91693092B954EAA1
dialogue.line: Shame. Let's keep looking.

dialogue.speaker: 50DA2F2E4A95FA626EB6BAA3D7958B94
dialogue.line: Shit, even more blood... I hope it’s not all Crake’s.

dialogue.speaker: 1E03E7F8484BCA1C7BE8BEA7032A6847
dialogue.line: Shit, if they were looking for his notes too...

dialogue.speaker: 2F79E5B64C46ED8CC5F6C899C8FCAF9B
dialogue.line: Shit... Nothing.

dialogue.speaker: 100085244C8E45290577BBA1CEAE8FA0
dialogue.line: So many hand prints...

dialogue.speaker: 55EC99C6461927366F95E7AAF9B9BFAD
dialogue.line: Something took his head off.

dialogue.speaker: 2610CD4B4994A15D3F997ABF79423294
dialogue.line: Still burning... Can't have been lit long ago...

dialogue.speaker: C2C3EB764328171F7AAA82917D78DBDF
dialogue.line: Still, we can't be sure. There might have been other reasons, too.

dialogue.speaker: 8FAD35064091078A1FF24F97677FF320
dialogue.line: That's done. I'd better keep looking for Crake.

dialogue.speaker: F85949114C5F24E04AAF40A887550D5A
dialogue.line: The hell if I know.

dialogue.speaker: 617031FA41FFDCB46AFD4D93E80D159A
dialogue.line: Then we must try to catch up with them.

dialogue.speaker: FA3548DF4B9C9ADE4D2BEDBDE515E0C2
dialogue.line: There are more such places in the valley, you know. I've seen them myself.

dialogue.speaker: 7C047D3A40E422C9918190BF9FE078F7
dialogue.line: There's a passageway here. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: 5310A5924AEB9F53DA3C59A9DDE1A11F
dialogue.line: These murals… what do you think they depict?

dialogue.speaker: 0F9E5EC64B55F6D9AFA71FA06876BA94
dialogue.line: Think, think! Where to now...?

dialogue.speaker: 8717422A404604A58871E6B3F60E88E0
dialogue.line: This is Crake's sword. He must've dropped it in the struggle.

dialogue.speaker: 283555D0435ACE8F604D8290A6A211DE
dialogue.line: This must be Silas's workshop.

dialogue.speaker: 1D4152E948B46E1321C8CD981B3BF61F
dialogue.line: This part of the ruins looks even older...

dialogue.speaker: ED5D50A14187D8D8C155CAB10A9263AC
dialogue.line: Uh-huh. Though I’m not sure I'd call it 'good.'

dialogue.speaker: 54B8AF094E06519C0ABEF1B7D872BE16
dialogue.line: We should search him.

dialogue.speaker: 4C62E65D47BEF7FB34D7CD91756E6406
dialogue.line: Whew, I can hardly squeeze through.

dialogue.speaker: F773F8DC44DF3FE30804B681D5F2AD91
dialogue.line: Whoa. This place looks old.

dialogue.speaker: 37A39B5643298AA10457E291F51AE041
dialogue.line: Woah! What is this place...? It looks ancient.

dialogue.speaker: 53F647EC401D2433B8058DB360C3A119
dialogue.line: Would there be other places like this in the valley?

dialogue.speaker: 09FFC3954175FBEF98E1C79447F99533
dialogue.line: Yeah. Take a look at these murals... easily centuries old. Maybe older.

dialogue.speaker: D2AAB5A64794650DF3FFA3A8BD60166D
dialogue.line: Yeah. We should take a look around.

dialogue.speaker: 3321A3E946D2B8241FD0D38002447E65
dialogue.line: Yeah. You think she was the one who hired those thieves?

dialogue.speaker: F4EFAE424B778E25614BFD9826C0D018
dialogue.line: Yeah... But what caused all this damage?

dialogue.speaker: A64A57FC4BB77B42255383962100F046
dialogue.line: [groan] Let go of me, you wretch!

dialogue.speaker: A833392B4920D9634CC7FFBB29408FA6
dialogue.line: [sigh] None of this matches the inscription.

dialogue.speaker: 419E27F84E6D065CBD548B98B8F52A02
dialogue.line: Ah. Let me handle this. With Mevasser's help, it shouldn’t take long to figure out.

dialogue.speaker: 37B3C3A3466E5BF486197FAA5DA0490A
dialogue.line: Ahh. Sounds about right.

dialogue.speaker: 523AFA5F4E63ED9EE47371A50D9859EF
dialogue.line: Ahhh, a cemetery... Of course. All those fresh corpses, ripe for the taking.

dialogue.speaker: 0D10396244DBEE0413A42DBC08F4D3D2
dialogue.line: All right, I think I'm following so far. Except for one thing... Who is this master of hers?

dialogue.speaker: 5AF866E34D899DED995B189BBE6D9BC0
dialogue.line: All right. But where did you get it from?

dialogue.speaker: EE49C6FE43F4FD68B48ED7928FF30B89
dialogue.line: All right. The other preparations will take some more time. I suppose you're free to do whatever you wish until then.

dialogue.speaker: 4E91F3B74E74731842CDD6A5034EEA5B
dialogue.line: And Silas. Before that.

dialogue.speaker: DCC7626F45CDB94671A08EA91BDEC407
dialogue.line: Any idea where I should look for him?

dialogue.speaker: 292CE8E84951E094C61F3599FC33BABA
dialogue.line: Blimey... So this is it? We've got everything we need?

dialogue.speaker: 5D53C0A14A95107280409E8F720C7A7D
dialogue.line: Bloody hell... So this is it? We've got everything we need?

dialogue.speaker: 5E98975D4522E484A290F991815C1266
dialogue.line: But do come back sooner if you can.

dialogue.speaker: 3990FF3A49FACC2674C9599557C288A9
dialogue.line: Does the name Aurelius mean anything to you?

dialogue.speaker: 67BAB0EC4AC72EFD8CA44FAA77B93B0F
dialogue.line: Does the name Aurelius mean anything to you?

dialogue.speaker: F6D878274A8DDA85FDDDF1823834EBAE
dialogue.line: Does the name Aurelius mean anything to you?

dialogue.speaker: FCADA10A42B67CD6044A2690CA0B7049
dialogue.line: Does the name Aurelius mean anything to you?

dialogue.speaker: E0FBA2DC43F66AEA449B7B9AB2439365
dialogue.line: Don't you need to rest a bit first?

dialogue.speaker: 7AB5CDBF4B4701F3003FD6A22D4D11CC
dialogue.line: Don't you need to rest?

dialogue.speaker: B32E0B964BA76BB1F393C0AAAE6D64B1
dialogue.line: Don't you need to rest?

dialogue.speaker: 97AAF596405E664355FE9C8CD6982BC3
dialogue.line: First, I’ll walk you back to the hideout.

dialogue.speaker: A45C956E4062032E4F9018AC07A0AAE9
dialogue.line: For now, I'm going with you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: 1271F1E34DED9857DE5C90B80F15B307
dialogue.line: Hm, very well... Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 643603C4478A65D440D2309186D03E37
dialogue.line: Hmm, my scouts reported one location that would match the story.

dialogue.speaker: 15F42F314F9C4C6D2FF7FB94F68461C2
dialogue.line: I believe so. There’s a hex in the book that weakens the gargoyles. We should be able to defeat them now.

dialogue.speaker: 907E46874ACBC2D38BB49799E22873E7
dialogue.line: I couldn’t make sense of it, since it's in this bizarre language. But now that I have a translation guide –

dialogue.speaker: EB2CF78D42E823D41C1B55B351F35539
dialogue.line: I do, and I will… once you give me the deciphered text.

dialogue.speaker: 70CD81CF47949DC2E82EBF934289130C
dialogue.line: I do. Let's go... Marat.

dialogue.speaker: E9C189F742BB23F465A9829E588D8339
dialogue.line: I don’t take unnecessary risks. If we chased every tall tale, it'd be Judgement Day before we defeated Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 093F379743D26C7F8F4D2089AFD7277F
dialogue.line: I found a letter from an apprentice.

dialogue.speaker: F1E1DDE24F47CB3D0260C1AB96D365E3
dialogue.line: I told you I'd seen those gargoyles somewhere before.

dialogue.speaker: 3A99130F4248DAB8B015108954B79EC6
dialogue.line: I told you I’ve seen the gargoyles before. But only when we found these missing pages I linked them to the book.

dialogue.speaker: 2411D0D74FD267EC1AAE049D1EDDE9E9
dialogue.line: I went to his tower some time ago. I found the book there – next to a pile of mutilated corpses.

dialogue.speaker: 4E10A75647F2DB95C49786BCB74325BD
dialogue.line: I'm resting... Oof, can't you tell?

dialogue.speaker: CB82674A42170142D9F86A993D098AAF
dialogue.line: It contained a sort of guide – to help them figure out which book to take for her master.

dialogue.speaker: 3349B0E045EA075223F076BF17ACC374
dialogue.line: It's actually... me.

dialogue.speaker: A9CA85DF46196019A0A9BF88F0E1174B
dialogue.line: It's not that, Crake. I just have to take care of something in Svartrau first.

dialogue.speaker: E8234EE545041A4BD76136A5AA9C5952
dialogue.line: It's not. I went to his tower some time ago. I found the book there – next to a pile of mutilated corpses.

dialogue.speaker: 87E6EC0C4EB2BB8FBD5092A58E785760
dialogue.line: Just as you were attacked, I found a letter. It included a guide for the thieves.

dialogue.speaker: 445B96D24F9B8849FC8A5E89C8DA3E5A
dialogue.line: Just be careful. Don’t run about, charging headfirst into the enemy’s ranks.

dialogue.speaker: 411A58D2432D90CBEC952389B8F14342
dialogue.line: Just tell me where to go, and I’ll handle the rest.

dialogue.speaker: 5F74C7F14A1C6B321710189004B09CB7
dialogue.line: Just tell me where to go.

dialogue.speaker: 43B9DE5B420F30227DA25196E908EAD0
dialogue.line: My real name is Marat... if you prefer it to Crake.

dialogue.speaker: F86DED364B5E7F59B3C0F2972D2B2FD3
dialogue.line: No need to call me Crake anymore. My name is Marat, remember?

dialogue.speaker: B228195142ADACE756666C966E05E873
dialogue.line: No, you're not. As long as the city remains under blockade, you must travel separately. Just... focus on finding the tower.

dialogue.speaker: E8B6DBD84B6E5509754B3FB3D50DE334
dialogue.line: Not exactly... I believe there’s a hex that could weaken the gargoyles, but we’ll need to decipher it first.

dialogue.speaker: E072813645C781F6F2E65385AE1CFA33
dialogue.line: Of course I thought it was a load of crap. But now... anything seems possible.

dialogue.speaker: F12E50FA4687174A9482C3B6A8A525E6
dialogue.line: Oh, no thank you. Facing one deadly opponent is plenty. I don’t need another one behind me.

dialogue.speaker: 0ACA418E482C0D23B1C2718B986151A9
dialogue.line: Oh. One more thing.

dialogue.speaker: 1439BDEF435FADBF37211AAED55EB276
dialogue.line: Perhaps Drogos could go with you. I'd be dead weight in this condition.

dialogue.speaker: 090E2FD4497ABFE831043C9BD7D5A957
dialogue.line: Remember how I mentioned Aurelius?

dialogue.speaker: 7FF7397A47CBDD5DC46F7F9AA6A3DA5C
dialogue.line: Remember how I mentioned Aurelius?

dialogue.speaker: FD0C6F6D4278B45EE408E1B9930A4586
dialogue.line: Sara was right. I do care about those I trust, and at this point... there's no denying I trust you.

dialogue.speaker: C48730F647937D901A386FAFA46D5939
dialogue.line: So don't get yourself killed, eh? This time, I’m asking nicely.

dialogue.speaker: 353066054C6483ED77FEFB9ED58957D4
dialogue.line: Sort of... Old crones in Svartrau scare children with stories about him. He's supposed to be an evil sorcerer who can drive men mad with just a glance. Like a basilisk.

dialogue.speaker: 4B7E64E44AC4B50493512EA33944A20D
dialogue.line: That woman Mevasser told us about... Just as you were attacked, I found a letter she sent to the thieves.

dialogue.speaker: 793B0C5E4F0F77C83EB464BD1058F361
dialogue.line: There's a tower south of Oghasti... At the edge of the valley. Folks tend to disappear when they go near it.

dialogue.speaker: 8F38471640C01C56EFEEC2AC9B74D945
dialogue.line: Uh-huh...

dialogue.speaker: 756D4D7D421EDD6D88464092DDF6E556
dialogue.line: Very well. Just keep in mind what kind of power you’re messing with. I don't want you to get hurt.

dialogue.speaker: 7B029E6249E02F100C4148BE02480D99
dialogue.line: Wait, do you even know how to cast hexes?

dialogue.speaker: 6BD05B1047FEAB0C78EA29AA21CA8E44
dialogue.line: Wait, scouts? Why didn't you order them to check it out?

dialogue.speaker: E88D3AE94F195520D5AE5C846747CBE4
dialogue.line: Well, spill. Who took the book?

dialogue.speaker: 685A2B1A4F7EA3EEF298989B8EC43E56
dialogue.line: What about you, Crake? Can you walk to the headquarters by yourself?

dialogue.speaker: 3EC62C204F2F81FEC96E8A9E7609E078
dialogue.line: What about you? Will you be all right on your own?

dialogue.speaker: CAEB2DD04C5DBDA95A8C4297C54D7D64
dialogue.line: What?! If this is a joke, Coen, it's not funny.

dialogue.speaker: 818C5C3C49D0A60F872CCA86E0E75B68
dialogue.line: Whether the preparations are complete or not, I have matters to discuss with you.

dialogue.speaker: BAB3CBB74ECF7833E0832EBB427B3FA6
dialogue.line: Whether you find the book or not, I have matters to discuss with you.

dialogue.speaker: 023562CB48C287D6E3A72CAAEEE9D7B0
dialogue.line: Why didn't you order them to check it out?

dialogue.speaker: 3D6AB66045FDA98159624CBCEFEB3060
dialogue.line: Why do you care all of a sudden?

dialogue.speaker: 413E28EC42D299DFA91EB1AE94324EF1
dialogue.line: Why have you suddenly started caring? About me, of all people?

dialogue.speaker: 50EB4AA6418C731BEB3BF68FF8F05F12
dialogue.line: Yeah, no worries... I've been worse. Drogos will patch me up, and I’ll be as good as new in a few days.

dialogue.speaker: 90F03D8F44D4FAA4E0C1558CD456E25E
dialogue.line: Yeah. What about him?

dialogue.speaker: 449B1B1F4DB01ABBBE4C828A75CD6CAA
dialogue.line: Yeah... Old hags scare children with stories about him. He's supposed to be an evil sorcerer, but I thought it was a tall tale.

dialogue.speaker: BFB86152492BF151A8CC849534682ADA
dialogue.line: Yes?

dialogue.speaker: 05552122497358964F9A58BFF9001B87
dialogue.line: You have what? When did that happen?

dialogue.speaker: 9DE636234A578D50BEF4A2B54AED0B06
dialogue.line: You mean for the monsters?

dialogue.speaker: BE6AB34541A4775B5C9C09BE68BB67A1
dialogue.line: You’ve already saved my life, Coen... No need to keep babysitting me.

dialogue.speaker: 6CC0431542FEA50F5BBB529E1891867C
dialogue.line: [groan] So tell me... who has that madman's book?

dialogue.speaker: 9B18485E42710D2A764BF4BBE6825F36
dialogue.line: [scoff] Fair enough... Just be careful. Don't bite off more than you can chew.

dialogue.speaker: BA9A73E849C38DAA329BFBA227F589F7
dialogue.line: I'll be right back! Wait for me there!

dialogue.speaker: 9F7B041F407CB7B6493F0C92CFEF09E0
dialogue.line: Normally we would. But there's no time.

dialogue.speaker: 51174F3D4136A71D8AB6CCAB1E904FFC
dialogue.line: Not being particularly welcome. It brings folks together.

dialogue.speaker: 3F5124DD441CAF0DEE183C81438F204A
dialogue.line: Oh, you know – his people, my people... we share some experiences.

dialogue.speaker: D04343A64C0FD0A07DE951A737DB2834
dialogue.line: So, how did you make friends with that rabbi?

dialogue.speaker: 486F8074418709FFF7699EA7FC29AF2B
dialogue.line: Such as...?

dialogue.speaker: A7F2F63C4E23AEFEC0AB7AB164D715E5
dialogue.line: This way. Follow me.

dialogue.speaker: 319B7CA947E186E07B68A7ADE70B6A94
dialogue.line: We're here.

dialogue.speaker: 2670CB354CAB6BDA559B279D4289974C
dialogue.line: Where the hell are you going?

dialogue.speaker: F639113745A9B98462A1D8A2A282F678
dialogue.line: You serious...?

dialogue.speaker: 4869A0E14DE8D1ACD7A0509C7D79F1A2
dialogue.line: You sure we shouldn't lie low for a little longer?

dialogue.speaker: 5D61A9BE4D33447A1EF097A129769F35
dialogue.line: [sighs] Fine. Let’s meet at the square in Neustadt during the day, while Mevasser is teaching at the school.

dialogue.speaker: 82F93F4A4ECF2C52847E0B9DBD44E9A5
dialogue.line: ...v’yamlíkh malkhuséy b’khayeykhóyn uv’yoymeykhóyn uvkháyey d’khol Beys Yisroéyl...

dialogue.speaker: B125A42E4F406A953C50548816BD6457
dialogue.line: ...v’yamlíkh malkhuséy b’khayeykhóyn uv’yoymeykhóyn uvkháyey d’khol Beys Yisroéyl...

dialogue.speaker: 5E80E89346F1A24A2A2CE29E58E4EB67
dialogue.line: Yisgadál v’yiskadásh shméy rabó b’olmó di vró khiruséy...

dialogue.speaker: 787BC9224CF0C0B8ECA5ECAF32381A9E
dialogue.line: Yisgadál v’yiskadásh shméy rabó b’olmó di vró khiruséy...

dialogue.speaker: CDB5C3C346FE2D7D60F651868000D190
dialogue.line: I said what I had to say. Now begone, before the Lord’s wrath brings lice and boils upon you!

dialogue.speaker: 157788DE48168538FD029F9EF97F2E04
dialogue.line: I will. As soon as you help us.

dialogue.speaker: 54C5049348A8DB9D233D319B1A9BDD35
dialogue.line: Mevasser, wait!

dialogue.speaker: 4ACB46F5456A83FEAD5D38B7D6F67D9F
dialogue.line: We’re just asking for your knowledge. You don’t have to get involved!

dialogue.speaker: 9D035DA844956C9E1F3597B367317520
dialogue.line: What a load of mishegoss!

dialogue.speaker: 8F947B914E653DD1F667B6B7D12C82D4
dialogue.line: You being here is already bad enough. Leave!

dialogue.speaker: 1356928F4A9ACA8B01E1C8820B8D2441
dialogue.line: And you were about to leave it like this...

dialogue.speaker: FC6728FB4C8068377533E199DCE56692
dialogue.line: I'm serious. Changes are coming.

dialogue.speaker: F99BA5534DBF87C6003A3F9B3CFF0FA2
dialogue.line: No, Mevasser. This ends once we win. I promise you.

dialogue.speaker: AD3E42EE48B8825236C06BADFBFA1E01
dialogue.line: Oh! As long as we're dreaming, I'd like a pony too.

dialogue.speaker: 1404C906437F29E27A21729F41990DA9
dialogue.line: Oh, give your friend a break. He did a wise thing. They'll be back anyway.

dialogue.speaker: D018B21240369C0B9D1961837270DEAC
dialogue.line: Someone else will eventually, claiming we're hiding piles of gold under the synagogue or something.

dialogue.speaker: 1A703039456916DF52BE59AD229C95FA
dialogue.line: They won't be bothering you anymore.

dialogue.speaker: DBC641974B04CF019FF871B0CDD6E485
dialogue.line: They'll be a nightmare next time... but at least I’ve got a few more days to figure out what to do about it.

dialogue.speaker: 3CB4DF2040AF8F5E100A90A5DB750943
dialogue.line: You see? Always getting the short end of the stick. What a farkakteh mess...

dialogue.speaker: 12E753334123CAD2FE0FBB90AC41DAA4
dialogue.line: [sigh] Fine... come in.

dialogue.speaker: 1CAF7B2B4E607905176C5EB84A819EF6
dialogue.line: Fuck you, old man! The toll just went up!

dialogue.speaker: 16527576417156846CE924AFFBC8185C
dialogue.line: Piss off!

dialogue.speaker: 54657EC54BEE31619CA8E4B7594A8760
dialogue.line: You'll get it when you're ready for round two!

dialogue.speaker: D689DFB943A1549CBD725C8BC5AB625C
dialogue.line: ...we'll be back, old man.

dialogue.speaker: D9C2BE034202D2A03C07E6A90BE3423F
dialogue.line: Am I...?

dialogue.speaker: A40E65944320940C876C3BB66583CD45
dialogue.line: At a bunch of knuckleheads asking for a beating.

dialogue.speaker: E924D54448C666BA44D496AF5E9BBAB0
dialogue.line: At a bunch of knuckleheads asking for a beating.

dialogue.speaker: A35F78074C53C3084A1FA3A8FE7A82CB
dialogue.line: Begging even, I'd say.

dialogue.speaker: 66D86FB44B7F4820769D6D8263C8A519
dialogue.line: Bloody hell... I'm awfully sorry, mate.

dialogue.speaker: C58D321940EE1B526686E9B5D635CDAE
dialogue.line: Does Ocha know what you're doing here?

dialogue.speaker: C835763B415A8539CBD992A6626323B4
dialogue.line: Does Ocha know what you're doing? Doubt she would send you here.

dialogue.speaker: E55FBB10431C3659607DCFAFCBFA864E
dialogue.line: Give it a rest this time.

dialogue.speaker: 27A40C67443D107F0F05159AED096B91
dialogue.line: He's bluffing.

dialogue.speaker: 848E53554C1398B70B79638CF1889F11
dialogue.line: I am. But if it's fake...

dialogue.speaker: 26B298F3438DBEDEE0CAB08AED774AC9
dialogue.line: I'll just pay you.

dialogue.speaker: C896693C46225F0234FF44852BDD320D
dialogue.line: I, er, well...

dialogue.speaker: F7F30C2D44A8ED5555A82AB966334848
dialogue.line: It was three days ago. As you know perfectly well.

dialogue.speaker: 791E49D34DD6543DB1228CBA1B7DD09B
dialogue.line: Just take it and leave.

dialogue.speaker: 37C92FEE402E59B65E341FA077691216
dialogue.line: Maybe we can sort this out?

dialogue.speaker: A3913CF149BDCCCE4FEEC6AFD99D65AF
dialogue.line: Maybe we can sort this out? Somehow?

dialogue.speaker: 7723283E4C0060BBAE4001A97EA28880
dialogue.line: Ocha...?

dialogue.speaker: 776A1D2E499C3C84131FA48C34B3686D
dialogue.line: Oh, a lovers's tiff? We've got business to deal with, lads. Take it somewhere else!

dialogue.speaker: 7D80E96B442069F3B2418B993FB3E011
dialogue.line: Oh, for fuck's sake! You taking it or not?

dialogue.speaker: 1351A7C24B31BFCB0D7A629C383A7FB4
dialogue.line: Oh, is it today?

dialogue.speaker: 15817F644974A2AC7C63CF84778578E1
dialogue.line: Oh, shit. It's him! From the posters!

dialogue.speaker: 2C45874143ABFF44B573D29E312EFB8A
dialogue.line: Oh, shite! I recognise you now! You helped the boss become, uh... the boss.

dialogue.speaker: 058E8448441CEB07FA2B1F8A8759A5A5
dialogue.line: Oh, you do? Then watch this.

dialogue.speaker: 2891B6AB46F4F16AA38A44AFF47642F9
dialogue.line: Oh, you'll see who ends up begging!

dialogue.speaker: D131D9574913193645F01FB6867B4204
dialogue.line: Only with the coin, mate.

dialogue.speaker: F0D4508840711AC80CC6B3A9549A10AF
dialogue.line: Or maybe we'll tell the city watch that you're terrorising this community...

dialogue.speaker: D52A2F884962E343F31A9EA603AB2A0C
dialogue.line: Oy, just what I needed...

dialogue.speaker: 9CE27B324FAC2335955D938E60E6B72B
dialogue.line: Sorry, mate.

dialogue.speaker: FEB5CF264FF5841B7CD0959484CC43D3
dialogue.line: That's right, it's me. Now fuck off.

dialogue.speaker: A4F766474084C212A8AF51B9D6299018
dialogue.line: They know all about it! We split the money fifty-fifty.

dialogue.speaker: 1DCE08F14C7093D3782B9EBF86FDB4D9
dialogue.line: We should have broken their bones.

dialogue.speaker: B9BB5EF642262DD78B4DF69EFD7D70EE
dialogue.line: We'll get out of your way now.

dialogue.speaker: 06EF67AB4ADE1D0E985D9388F1174DD5
dialogue.line: We're just passing by, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: EE1B8F3B44B97705B63EB4815BBEE54C
dialogue.line: We're just passing by.

dialogue.speaker: 572A2B92439211AEE8E5C18989CC4E91
dialogue.line: Well, well... That was something.

dialogue.speaker: 4912CE7B416C65B977D436A265BFBEF3
dialogue.line: What's this, counterfeit?

dialogue.speaker: 9B55FAF643F6BF52306F5C86A752DED1
dialogue.line: What?! You want us to cower?!

dialogue.speaker: 3EF639A0475FF3A450EB8AA25B57DCC6
dialogue.line: Yeah. I think you are bluffing.

dialogue.speaker: B60F41094D019E4727AD36B61BFDE532
dialogue.line: Yeah. I think you are.

dialogue.speaker: BA98F77049CE6FD01D341BBDE2F573E2
dialogue.line: Yes. And I reckon she'd be pissed off, if she knew you were taking advantage of my friends.

dialogue.speaker: 276CDC584657D8A3348F63B5D85D71A5
dialogue.line: You forgot about something, old man. Again.

dialogue.speaker: 5E8EA6844B285A97492340ABAE7B2431
dialogue.line: You lot?! Ha! Poor my arse!

dialogue.speaker: 6396023643FD4BD8DE05BF99A82F87C0
dialogue.line: You two! What you staring at?

dialogue.speaker: E1D5E247462545E6DAF61A9EAB325A77
dialogue.line: [exhale] Listen... we can't pay so often. We are a poor community.

dialogue.speaker: 297339A843934A6890356680AC435A84
dialogue.line: [grunt] You can go, Coen. I'll take care of them myself.

dialogue.speaker: 31F1441344103660CD98B68EC2E3B03F
dialogue.line: And you – you all right?

dialogue.speaker: CF4244094C570BC8744532B6AACBF2E8
dialogue.line: And you – you all right?

dialogue.speaker: 87F4609D491704E6B52DBEB54FC65629
dialogue.line: Aye. I'd be missing a head, not just a sword, if not for you. Call it my way of saying thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 7D04991944EFB7E14586A498D908DE35
dialogue.line: Fair enough. I'll just wait and... try to remember what my name is.

dialogue.speaker: 4F5B78C743CDB060713C688DBCA74F73
dialogue.line: Found your sword, too. You must have dropped it while wrestling that monster.

dialogue.speaker: 5780FD1E4C38CDC305FCB58B40EF6656
dialogue.line: Good. I'm sick of this place. Let's get out.

dialogue.speaker: 638BF82F4B4B7DA3F0E61F90525E8B5B
dialogue.line: Huh, I recall... vaguely. But you know what? Keep it.

dialogue.speaker: A5F9BACB423A806E6ECEAF9A1769D06B
dialogue.line: I know who took Silas's book.

dialogue.speaker: 67481AB2491F3BF657200F951A5C3323
dialogue.line: I need to. You stay here, rest.

dialogue.speaker: 58DCBBCD4DBA3AAEEF2951A068356ECE
dialogue.line: I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: 1164170A45B9DE4B40F43DB8B0551FAE
dialogue.line: I'm fine. I know who took Silas's book.

dialogue.speaker: 8615D1DA436AF42495AB6492213CA0B2
dialogue.line: Now let's get out of here. I'm sick of this place.

dialogue.speaker: 4E835725404A231A08F5258C38B13D13
dialogue.line: We need to search this place –

dialogue.speaker: 2F930D4A470E880D1DDDD39D100EF760
dialogue.line: What happened?

dialogue.speaker: 4E03881843E20486FB9582B078C56712
dialogue.line: You cheated death. With a little help.

dialogue.speaker: B067CA964F7D0C353A486D8608401C9E
dialogue.line: You cheated death. With a little help.

dialogue.speaker: 180C33E44CB171F99D9E4D8E6DFD3139
dialogue.line: You sure?

dialogue.speaker: C28C29654C5EE9BBD70855AF9645681C
dialogue.line: [exhales] What happened?

dialogue.speaker: 4C4730C241640B9D546E4E8673F5A676
dialogue.line: Aargh!

dialogue.speaker: 4154E72D45C2B4663395C7AB36B20F79
dialogue.line: Any advice on the missing scouts?

dialogue.speaker: 5D7BE9DE460504D721503180187A6AD1
dialogue.line: Any advice on the missing scouts?

dialogue.speaker: 1989B99447EAD3B0F372DBAE1526C992
dialogue.line: Anyone ever tell you what an arsehole you are?

dialogue.speaker: 66F7B354462D5B3B580B7FBB45369000
dialogue.line: Best you stay focused on your job, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 71BF6FBA4B02A027E3C4828A69026C78
dialogue.line: Crake let me join. He trusts me.

dialogue.speaker: 545512BF486C281F91FA018BE73101B0
dialogue.line: Got it. Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: 657F6E1D4CA99258C0D6DBA5E04527E0
dialogue.line: I hate to say it, Drogos... but you were right about me after all.

dialogue.speaker: 0F9E2AA74BB4DAD9093FF4997C89A82E
dialogue.line: I need to go.

dialogue.speaker: ECC29EEF41804893125F0690442B07A9
dialogue.line: I'll always see you for what you are, vrakhir.

dialogue.speaker: EF79AA804A658218F8B65699187C7C9C
dialogue.line: I'm not your enemy – how can I make you see that?

dialogue.speaker: 420D391A4CB1057B4F639EA042E83646
dialogue.line: I'm not your enemy.

dialogue.speaker: 812FA937409F587D4670E5BEC08799EC
dialogue.line: It’s not what you’ve done, it's who you are.

dialogue.speaker: 1DF438414276C8E07FAD02ACFA4D8567
dialogue.line: Look out for Boyan – he was leading the group. I know him well enough... If the others wanted to scarper, they'd have had to go through him first.

dialogue.speaker: C59D53D84435595E03EB44AF996E37FC
dialogue.line: Need to go. I’ve got my orders.

dialogue.speaker: FAC4CAE84132377842C8FABDB0D75F66
dialogue.line: Once, you might’ve been someone to trust, a fine lad even. But now? Now you're just another monster.

dialogue.speaker: EF8CF7D647D232ED31E28BBDE8F693AC
dialogue.line: One of them just gave you an order, so maybe you should get on with it, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 3B017BFD4197F0041B2BB2871A6B5D42
dialogue.line: Or he had other reasons.

dialogue.speaker: 03D1C1E340C7D573EAC5E48ABC237097
dialogue.line: What do you want? Speak.

dialogue.speaker: C92CB82440E7EA928B11C9A17039A810
dialogue.line: What... Other reasons?

dialogue.speaker: 9C148DC44B338321E7C565B4B77C8625
dialogue.line: Why do you resent me so much, Drogos? I’ve done you no wrong.

dialogue.speaker: 84932CCC454E54AEFA7A8BA206CEA0AD
dialogue.line: Why you resent me so much?

dialogue.speaker: 825228D04540867AB8F152965ADD1B89
dialogue.line: Yeah, yeah... Away with you.

dialogue.speaker: 0EB7D05F4D641791561C299E3EE7F47F
dialogue.line: Yeah. Don't eat them, they're good people.

dialogue.speaker: E3B7E7114C740C42F6F57BA482F66CA2
dialogue.line: You're an arsehole.

dialogue.speaker: C735908B403F934A446D4F95A81FE797
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 3969D027471E5F6C18DDBFABAAD18EA9
dialogue.line: [scoff] Plenty of men better than you.

dialogue.speaker: B33D379444A42BD730D68686931C3549
dialogue.line: [scoffs] Very funny... Is that all?

dialogue.speaker: 2BB886604E4956A1A4DF7DB2BC6ACF3E
dialogue.line: Aaah!

dialogue.speaker: 5D13534D449A336FCAAAC9B493DCE8AF
dialogue.line: As for me, I prefer to keep my more troubling thoughts tucked behind a smile. It's... easier that way.

dialogue.speaker: 5E0688F34223A47B4DAD4EBED932798F
dialogue.line: By now you know my reason for joining. Care to share yours?

dialogue.speaker: 1312F4D7485D6E8AE9F05FA969BEF177
dialogue.line: Did you know the missing scouts?

dialogue.speaker: C55CA32A46A8BF2EB7E28187DF3E19E0
dialogue.line: Did you know the missing scouts?

dialogue.speaker: 0F5E956845DF495477A68DBF1B091F1A
dialogue.line: Exactly. I’m cheerful, Drogos is ill-tempered, Crake’s always on edge, and you... You seem kind, Coen. I like that about you.

dialogue.speaker: 61B19E6D4A12B7FFE75220ADDA758520
dialogue.line: Forgive me. I'm so hungry.

dialogue.speaker: 00ACE92D45FB45864F4A239EE38FCF5D
dialogue.line: Funny. Crake said the same thing when I joined.

dialogue.speaker: C283788D4242E28DFA8EC0AB31C5A179
dialogue.line: Ha, fine. Over a year ago... I saw a newborn. My wee cousin.

dialogue.speaker: 93AA8D1543CC33F048D727BF21CDECC7
dialogue.line: He's just not afraid to speak his mind – which isn't necessarily a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: 8177E208455B96F5C2A4AAA42DD8E19C
dialogue.line: I guess I’d better keep smiling, then. To make sure you don't lose it.

dialogue.speaker: C77D0DA34251706FEEDAA6930A709FB2
dialogue.line: I think you should be more serious.

dialogue.speaker: 90D887EF47B9CFB89E8E469384E254D1
dialogue.line: I'd say it's quite a lovely smile. It gives me... hope.

dialogue.speaker: D1EABABB41C8B0EEAC01DDBCB457BA1A
dialogue.line: It suddenly struck me – he would only know a world ruled by the leeches... Uhm, the vrakhiri. Sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 9211CCB540E6B3BEFC13D08CD9ACDB09
dialogue.line: It's a bit silly.

dialogue.speaker: 13B64B5F41114E4A549A3D8A22135C98
dialogue.line: It's a good reason. Not silly at all.

dialogue.speaker: E31B778E400ADA930DF270BEEA228560
dialogue.line: It's not silly.

dialogue.speaker: E21C1018424FE0BE7CEB388FDDBE8974
dialogue.line: It's quite a lovely smile.

dialogue.speaker: C9DC745B46A38B4A383AE5A5DEF7169D
dialogue.line: I’m not sure you fully understood what I said.

dialogue.speaker: 19A2327B43B26CD38863F983D096B1A1
dialogue.line: Like I said, it's silly. Doesn’t even compare to your reasons.

dialogue.speaker: DE5A993D49692F96FB82C987978871CD
dialogue.line: No, sorry... Drogos might tell you something, though. He's friendly with one of them.

dialogue.speaker: 13FD27EF40B85C759A358B8DACF680A3
dialogue.line: Now I'm even more curious.

dialogue.speaker: 614A9A8E4CDB6B738A92E9BA1B468D1C
dialogue.line: Oh no... no!

dialogue.speaker: C6D192544BE0E4C4FD4475AA33F32EB1
dialogue.line: Oh, it's kinda silly...

dialogue.speaker: 3F4649024E773EC7871A8DA861077510
dialogue.line: Risking your life like this because of one thought...?

dialogue.speaker: 2984D41F48D3CCDC652DFB90C933E8F4
dialogue.line: Sure. Until next time!

dialogue.speaker: 3C9B9B064D411DD32AF423BDE67FE3B5
dialogue.line: Time for me to go.

dialogue.speaker: AF414A0B4A8704E25EAF32B82967C70A
dialogue.line: Time to go.

dialogue.speaker: 0E07F5BD478993560DFA3BB98C1AEF9C
dialogue.line: To each their own, right?

dialogue.speaker: B1C03BD346BA2B2B4959FEACD1B0A014
dialogue.line: To each their own, right?

dialogue.speaker: 5F52C615483DE5F9C07BA8865943B341
dialogue.line: We're not here to have fun.

dialogue.speaker: C3F4CFD243068E92B1F09EB446AE4FF1
dialogue.line: Well, as friendly as he can be.

dialogue.speaker: 23F4E88E4F0F3C573086F882E0CA4481
dialogue.line: Well, well, if it isn’t my favourite rookie!

dialogue.speaker: 6264A26C43BD9947A1442485597E09FF
dialogue.line: What’s on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: 9C81C7154319E53C09974087D30309FB
dialogue.line: Why did you join?

dialogue.speaker: 1BFFDF0A47D0E4506A446D8E529364B4
dialogue.line: Yeah... It's just something that stuck with me, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: 4DBC9D5545D1FD31374F60AE5B984A71
dialogue.line: You can call them leeches, I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: D8408A2F446603F6C7CACA929F8CA615
dialogue.line: You’re awfully cheerful compared to the others here.

dialogue.speaker: 167B66A54A855BAC6715FEA328BD73CD
dialogue.line: You’re awfully cheerful compared to the others... Especially Drogos.

dialogue.speaker: 8CAB069D440921B65FDD0AA627F3968C
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: 4243F2E5486F9278B57DC69F927A20B5
dialogue.line: [laugh] Good! So anyway... I didn't want little Emil to grow up in the world as it is.

dialogue.speaker: 70E7F3C74805867A35977891EFD32B6C
dialogue.line: Guards. Let's find a different route.

dialogue.speaker: CDCBB39E49B6809D3F1B74831933D195
dialogue.line: How long have you been doing 'this'?

dialogue.speaker: 3D89F5474F58A30A6F6FDC93A0A8C2E6
dialogue.line: I've had time to get to know it.

dialogue.speaker: ED4A941C4DC597545BBED58D0206DAF5
dialogue.line: Not here, not now, goddammit!

dialogue.speaker: 9D69F3C14022391119C6AD86531EFF27
dialogue.line: Six months, but with everything that’s been happening... it feels more like years crammed into just a week.

dialogue.speaker: 06F6F66A4C958544705DF9AFD998DF40
dialogue.line: Well... aren’t we supposed to be fighting Brencis’ men?

dialogue.speaker: 74F0B142494EF11E731AA99A3364B205
dialogue.line: Why did you attack him?! That was reckless – and downright stupid!

dialogue.speaker: E4C8996E4CDC510AC3C45CBACFE83E9C
dialogue.line: You know the city well.

dialogue.speaker: E1EE1D5B408DBCE053E9ACBAEF5521E5
dialogue.line: [exhale] Let’s move before more of those bastards show up.

dialogue.speaker: 1C778BFF4E3B25BDD106138C501346DC
dialogue.line: Don't worry. He won't be for long...

dialogue.speaker: D32E00CC447692C1A3E59D825E7F16F5
dialogue.line: Shit. One's still alive.

dialogue.speaker: 730F2AA94A408C2882140AA29C59E518
dialogue.line: ...I wanted to give you this. I know you're scared for your first mission...

dialogue.speaker: 9F3E6FDD49A6167BCBAF7D903C44A99E
dialogue.line: Boyan, take a grip! You have to run, dammit! Get to Crake.

dialogue.speaker: 71189E4D48FCA60BFCF5F9ACACFA5E7A
dialogue.line: Brencis... building an army... Those things! Monsters! Must be killed...

dialogue.speaker: 085ED7B44235841D98C4F4AF994CDC23
dialogue.line: Crap! Someone's here.

dialogue.speaker: 8BE8ECE1465026C7F84D12BCAB901E74
dialogue.line: Dead like the rest but... at least in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: 6D5F06BD4DB524453ACF6581D78FBB60
dialogue.line: He always protects me, He will protect you too. Carry it with you and you will be safe.

dialogue.speaker: BD9A13B349926A8376086192F31D5FE6
dialogue.line: I hurt its wing. Weakened it. It won’t find us...

dialogue.speaker: BE853D144928C3527FBCD0B18EDD6A3D
dialogue.line: Press it against the wound. Hard!

dialogue.speaker: 178379704A2666154165ABB375D26F63
dialogue.line: Tell him about Teotim! Teotim! Teotim!

dialogue.speaker: 61F1F1FA427BB7444B4B0ABF4AF25539
dialogue.line: Wait. That sound... No-no-no!

dialogue.speaker: E7CBCBC34D1F144B46CC78BD01E675D5
dialogue.line: You won't die here. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: 5D521A9B41F8BD5E81E0BB83F60499A6
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: 30A630B643C923F0923C68980B7EBD08
dialogue.line: [search for a catalyst]

dialogue.speaker: 042522134C22A1E9A34059A4054779DF
dialogue.line: A manumit's shawl. One of the scouts must have dropped it.

dialogue.speaker: B083D4994AC17F43C9F909BD3BD1CC53
dialogue.line: Completely wrecked... as if it was trampled by an angry herd.

dialogue.speaker: 26D368374D80B3749A5EE79FA8B5383D
dialogue.line: Crake said there were four of them... So where's the fourth?

dialogue.speaker: 6AC620734061360CB3854AA628E7BE28
dialogue.line: Decapitated... A clean cut.

dialogue.speaker: F0842BF347CDD434F41CE8B43CCA2156
dialogue.line: During the fight? Or running away from someone...?

dialogue.speaker: 04E1EE6F4285C4494E341DBB8335C139
dialogue.line: He was crushed. With such a great force.

dialogue.speaker: 35B6A0BE4CF0CC8535C45991B68E6CC1
dialogue.line: Hm, there's something in the pool of blood...

dialogue.speaker: 92FB1A4A4E0A774E3B08C592EA5F6467
dialogue.line: Hmm. I don’t like this.

dialogue.speaker: 41F21D8B4DC0C3E9C18341A9C0F2AB36
dialogue.line: Huh, the wall is damaged.

dialogue.speaker: 569F1F16489CFA54CCDA93BFCA276B4D
dialogue.line: I... I don’t think even a vrakhir could have done this.

dialogue.speaker: AAB2FB9447A02E6CD5CB9BB8987CEA45
dialogue.line: Is it their blood? Or the enemy's?

dialogue.speaker: ADCE127A43DE7F5330434A9B88B0A094
dialogue.line: It... It must be them... Dear God, what did this?!

dialogue.speaker: 0BE8679840A55E93FD0ECDACF51AFDC6
dialogue.line: Looks like a sword cut. But what kind of blade could slice through solid stone?

dialogue.speaker: 5E4C8B614EE510A17921159ED3871673
dialogue.line: More damage. I'm on the right track.

dialogue.speaker: AB11292947C4F4D79CC0A986C32D3AE4
dialogue.line: No human could... A vrakhir, perhaps?

dialogue.speaker: 0AEB9BF54808518E1847188A84DB1A43
dialogue.line: Right, where now?

dialogue.speaker: 413DA7B24DA6F4F52715B59D82D3F72D
dialogue.line: Something cut him in half...

dialogue.speaker: 93FA0F084AA76976BB370D896CE66876
dialogue.line: Won’t budge. It’s blocked from the other side.

dialogue.speaker: 810AD64A411DB74E31333F8D72FC0A8E
dialogue.line: [sniff] The scent of blood... it’s coming from this house.

dialogue.speaker: C397BCF64BEC095F5375BABEC08C8D25
dialogue.line: A code, perhaps...?

dialogue.speaker: D0071E2749B751B2E1C4D2BDA4AE1014
dialogue.line: A dark pink façade... I think that's the place.

dialogue.speaker: C44855354975E386605C1AAE1614816E
dialogue.line: Hmm... this block looks like a broken off piece. Must be a part of something... bigger.

dialogue.speaker: 25764138475A3BFD404413A53088A31D
dialogue.line: I need something to make him speak...

dialogue.speaker: E5E3563F4A170407955D8DA65D4C6463
dialogue.line: It was shot from above. I guess the angle aligns with the hideout's window.

dialogue.speaker: E2AFDDD3439C51CB02090BB11EC0A990
dialogue.line: It's soaked with their blood.

dialogue.speaker: F4DBCE44460DB769FE4E0EAE324C28E9
dialogue.line: Layos... you poor fool.

dialogue.speaker: 94CC2F14421D70DD745C27ADC7266C5C
dialogue.line: Quite a mess. Seems something interrupted their meal.

dialogue.speaker: 5E59312F41C5A2CC2129FC999DCD5B5E
dialogue.line: Shame it didn't work.

dialogue.speaker: 700C241340873A214B35169EB870A59E
dialogue.line: Someone was definitely here. Very recently.

dialogue.speaker: C71CCE8B4B9158AB7DF97CB1FA6E3D80
dialogue.line: The Saint Benedict Medal. Meant to protect the wearer from evil.

dialogue.speaker: B3764E294D30BBB3532274AB05B43D79
dialogue.line: They clearly left in a rush, weapons in hand but nothing else.

dialogue.speaker: 3362E6374E16C6ADC1955B971F034AC2
dialogue.line: They had to stop at some point, didn’t they?

dialogue.speaker: 78ABB41045A2B161FEAB8AB7C40DDB5A
dialogue.line: Agreed. I once tried cutting the manhood off one of them, but couldn’t stop the bleeding. Got nasty real fast.

dialogue.speaker: F7B7F5E144E5102F2578C6952A609C3F
dialogue.line: Apprentice Svetlana herself.

dialogue.speaker: 565559E948EEF9AED7225C9F5A02453D
dialogue.line: Don’t you want to be a lovely monster-puppet?

dialogue.speaker: 596B6EE147A1843EF179AC9EF88B1BCD
dialogue.line: Good thing neither the sorcerer nor his apprentice gives a damn about a few extra corpses.

dialogue.speaker: 69FF6AF8490DFDEE4184899C65D56BAA
dialogue.line: Huh. Who the hell are you?!

dialogue.speaker: 6E1EDF6F4CCD5DCEE92489A500B44166
dialogue.line: Hurry it up! We don't have all day.

dialogue.speaker: BEBD680246FCD057C54F15AA74A4CE01
dialogue.line: I heard it's because their soul gets bound in that moment.

dialogue.speaker: 15991D09420AB399CC749A96BEFC4629
dialogue.line: I wonder how they still find breath to scream in the furnace... Even after all the sedatives.

dialogue.speaker: 70725AB94C2C6E96962167AF2408A262
dialogue.line: I'd say the hardest part is keeping them alive after cleaning.

dialogue.speaker: 6BE465E846F09C49D59AEC81EEE37A0B
dialogue.line: Oh, who said that?

dialogue.speaker: 97B3C0E242407947EE7685A6AAC18562
dialogue.line: The sorcerer will put your body to good use, hah! You'll see.

dialogue.speaker: 6DBF163A43DCCF7F06251BB9ABAFD81B
dialogue.line: We'll carve you up proper! Take your limbs clean off!

dialogue.speaker: F475FB2F4A8EBB0930C301B4E47E1777
dialogue.line: You'll regret sneaking in here, meat!

dialogue.speaker: 826805874F3837BA9E2739AB4AA7F752
dialogue.line: You'll squeal just like the others!

dialogue.speaker: 30441B2C4837D073E3D8349FC7727984
dialogue.line: Come on, come on...

dialogue.speaker: 69E4646B440BA05CE86EBCB7F46BB75C
dialogue.line: It's safe now.

dialogue.speaker: 6DD1CF9E40E59E1DF39CFC8237A1379A
dialogue.line: Open your eyes, Sara.

dialogue.speaker: 24A3571B479367BB2655CEB368E947A0
dialogue.line: Sara?

dialogue.speaker: 819C45E54DC4F2107E700F82002C8771
dialogue.line: We killed it.

dialogue.speaker: 98DFB419477FCD9A2F023F9FEFD4E786
dialogue.line: We won.

dialogue.speaker: 9274B12242B02091EE9E0FB095FD0A51
dialogue.line: Blood rained down from the sky! The shrieking, the mayhem!

dialogue.speaker: 6D7F573C4B5C277536D5E2A5C52E5B2C
dialogue.line: Hell is all around us, demons roam the streets. Beware!

dialogue.speaker: F16593434CA538885797AF93C33B2A0F
dialogue.line: Poor souls! The demon chased them straight to hell.

dialogue.speaker: 37ABFA11403D0B4BC3D039985B8A4D99
dialogue.line: Woe to us, nothing can save us from the demons. No God, no Knyaz!

dialogue.speaker: 300.SoldierGhost
dialogue.line: You don't stand a chance.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.303.Peasant.1
dialogue.line: Leave me alone, please! I'm just a stablehand!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q301_Prisoner01
dialogue.line: Leave me be. Please, let me be!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Xante
dialogue.line: Your time has come.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q301_Prisoner01
dialogue.line: You won't get me! No! Stop it! Get out of my head!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Q301_Prisoner02
dialogue.line: What is it?!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [drain Ambrus's blood]

dialogue.speaker: 62696DD54BD15812A9BDE7A2FD861683
dialogue.line: [kill him]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [drain Bakir's blood]

dialogue.speaker: 9C595CCA48ABB64A3AF085A869162A4D
dialogue.line: [kill him]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: We can't allow these things to escape into the city!

dialogue.speaker: 301_1st_soldier03
dialogue.line: What are these?! [scream]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [drain Xanthe's blood]

dialogue.speaker: AAEC6D8D4D3422C7CA8B22B4C97764D5
dialogue.line: [kill her]

dialogue.speaker: F779C63A4DEDCC0D36FE3B9F284C71AC
dialogue.line: Are you seriously concerned for the very people you would have no trouble torturing?

dialogue.speaker: 3EEA2B1E4F7C411F32B71EB3156545AC
dialogue.line: Do you really think it will be that bad?

dialogue.speaker: FCA6DFE54B0556F128ECE8992614F3D6
dialogue.line: Do you really think it will be that bad?

dialogue.speaker: 6104605F45D76894DEA24C8CD68F89E5
dialogue.line: Do you really worry for those you were so willing to torture?

dialogue.speaker: E0182ADB4972B5279AEBD4ACB80C4253
dialogue.line: For a while, I treated them like soldiers, forgetting they weren’t... But now… Now it’s as clear as the sky for me – most of them won’t make it.

dialogue.speaker: 651CCAF0411CFFA872EF609AB2EBB94F
dialogue.line: Half these men have never seen real combat.

dialogue.speaker: 970F9BAB43100B2A5DE989976588397D
dialogue.line: Huh. Kettle calling the pot black.

dialogue.speaker: C86DD99244E4FB5623D75F9B5CEDA5D7
dialogue.line: I'd never!

dialogue.speaker: A9739F43497C405162B3218299067394
dialogue.line: I'm nothing like you. I would never harm them.

dialogue.speaker: A97EA1AD40F913452CC077AE16C01B5F
dialogue.line: Ready for the big finale?

dialogue.speaker: 23560F1F4E39C1EA9D77C780E8E1FCE4
dialogue.line: Rubbish. I had no time or means to train them properly.

dialogue.speaker: A552F60F4E960CE3FB0F26B3E23F3D44
dialogue.line: Thanks to you they’re as ready as they’ll ever be.

dialogue.speaker: 64F0D4964F1FA0FD2C62C0AC6AA9759F
dialogue.line: That's why I come well-fed.

dialogue.speaker: 624B68F24EB0A59C621CDE816E28DE5B
dialogue.line: That’s why I come well-fed – to make sure it never happens.

dialogue.speaker: 122F999941E93118FDCAC5872653B2BB
dialogue.line: They’re as ready as they’ll ever be – thanks to you.

dialogue.speaker: 217775F54A7ED3A4AD081188FD5B2A43
dialogue.line: What do you mean...?

dialogue.speaker: 394F57EE4F3A60BBE72534A5E6C8BBDC
dialogue.line: You got something to say to me?

dialogue.speaker: 7FE11D434349E845B0F8ECBACE1EF995
dialogue.line: You'd drink them without batting an eye, if you were hungry enough.

dialogue.speaker: F474B43341198F47379B02A7FB2E6C14
dialogue.line: [sigh] I guess that doesn't really matter anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 55E6120342ABB12DCBA825970BF17F63
dialogue.line: Guess it's time to go back to Marat.

dialogue.speaker: FE4D04BC41A86F10D18B9D8088E44C37
dialogue.line: Heard we’re gearing up to leave soon.

dialogue.speaker: 3526419348EB2258E0243CB24BB8ACB0
dialogue.line: I hate waiting around idly. Better keep your hands busy.

dialogue.speaker: 403620B542340BC6F7FB54B52089BCF4
dialogue.line: I’ve been waiting for this ever since Skender fell.

dialogue.speaker: BA97BCFA4BF32B09A957BAB0D5D5607F
dialogue.line: Let's finish what we've started, eh?

dialogue.speaker: D64CB4734601291CAA8DF89058758E40
dialogue.line: No more hiding in shadows. They bled us dry long enough.

dialogue.speaker: 960D8F5546E65079C29A31A6AEAFC9EE
dialogue.line: Preparation is key. If you fail to prepare, you're preparing for failure, or so it went...

dialogue.speaker: 7D52E91D4F51F92A4DA6CFA7991E209F
dialogue.line: Sharpen your blades, lads.

dialogue.speaker: B721FE5D430AC62658FE238E296A0C91
dialogue.line: We’ll take far more than their bloody ears this time.

dialogue.speaker: 54DDFB5648AA8BEB3E23DC8A6DC4B463
dialogue.line: A just cause?

dialogue.speaker: 298500A14A9301080F30D380E929A276
dialogue.line: Do you think we can really pull this off?

dialogue.speaker: 383D3A124A3A515E95233A8170F0D0EB
dialogue.line: I know, I know... Just... I'm no soldier. I've never stood against a trained army.

dialogue.speaker: E9CE59FE48E64E7FC7EFD19C7FAC8985
dialogue.line: Training isn't everything, kid. Besides, we also have something they don't.

dialogue.speaker: B0B488644D9DCD19980561BE45C8EAB2
dialogue.line: We have no choice. If we don't act now, we'll be at his mercy forever. And that monster has none.

dialogue.speaker: FDE7215541954BA547B341A13CC00EF0
dialogue.line: [snort] Erm, yeah... That too. But I was actually thinking about the half-vrakhir. I have a feeling he'll tip the balance in our favour.

dialogue.speaker: 937E08164688477823548E9D4660442E
dialogue.line: As soon as I receive the order... But not a moment earlier.

dialogue.speaker: 72D1D7BD460125FF421369B62F907FCE
dialogue.line: Brencis doesn't even know what's coming his way.

dialogue.speaker: 0EDED4C24C4C24270858129410563563
dialogue.line: But cowardice? Not one of them.

dialogue.speaker: D932F7464DBF893384342B9DE6FFCE3C
dialogue.line: Champing at the bit as always, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 4DBA07A1418DD5796A169781BE993F3F
dialogue.line: Champing at the bit as always...

dialogue.speaker: 97E957434EA05778568F23B93E29FF7D
dialogue.line: Ha. See you learned your lesson.

dialogue.speaker: 4B2B8C214165858363BB8492552DAF5B
dialogue.line: Ha... I sure hope so.

dialogue.speaker: 2FE886934BB8C1862A498EBC6EC80980
dialogue.line: Heh, betrayal? Never.

dialogue.speaker: 19BAB12741A11962CD9662BE5B9CA7D6
dialogue.line: I don't care about your apologies.

dialogue.speaker: FB1E7EA14FCE53C88F8DAFBA8DCA27B6
dialogue.line: I have many faults, I'll be the first to tell your that.

dialogue.speaker: 5AD9BFE545716310D811A88C96F7FD81
dialogue.line: I may be a slow learner, but yeah, I guess you got the point across last time we talked.

dialogue.speaker: C2B760894E1E4940C8106691C111AE3C
dialogue.line: I see you learned your lesson?

dialogue.speaker: AF1C6D924FC08004FDC176956A5352CA
dialogue.line: I'll do exactly what I'm told – even if that means laying down my life.

dialogue.speaker: 1F00D9884159801F35524F8D91E20560
dialogue.line: I'm sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: EE2165FA4834B556AE95AD8CDE798F21
dialogue.line: I'm sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: 64E6B87A4F8A881FB0E1B99AD475F06C
dialogue.line: I've been ready for weeks.

dialogue.speaker: 31DB41164327DDD79837EB8A582E0546
dialogue.line: Just find the courage when the situation calls for it.

dialogue.speaker: 3B138AC544F2D9B06F29BCA5E3AD315A
dialogue.line: Or will you tuck your tail between your legs when things get serious? Like you did last time?

dialogue.speaker: 5AD2DA2D4355076C6B7C4CBDAAF2AE85
dialogue.line: Plans have the ugly tendency of going tits-up soon as you set things in motion.

dialogue.speaker: DC5BCAEB4AF1FF4E836946803D2B1A62
dialogue.line: Ready to storm the castle?

dialogue.speaker: 72EDD9D341B54FDC589618BADB872363
dialogue.line: Right. See you on the other side, then.

dialogue.speaker: 4EEC8A5E47125EA01070F889605F79BD
dialogue.line: So yeah, I'm glad we're about to stop wasting time drawing them – and get to the point.

dialogue.speaker: C7B156514C2FFCA77DECD187D89BD2F8
dialogue.line: Yeah. And you? Planning to fight for real, this time?

dialogue.speaker: FA8A556045C5F7D2C02AF9AB584B1EAE
dialogue.line: You don't forget easily, do you?

dialogue.speaker: A348866F4F6D2DBC061266A3BE6D6BEB
dialogue.line: You don't forget easily?

dialogue.speaker: B6FCD5C047B9D38A289E23BDDF499C08
dialogue.line: You're not scared?

dialogue.speaker: FC9E59A747B52C8036A52189F9594980
dialogue.line: You're not scared?

dialogue.speaker: 5611F1D34BB3AA81534E3CBF943384B7
dialogue.line: At least most of you, eh, Drogos?

dialogue.speaker: 27D5B1E044B8AE81E56EDA92F8103563
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: D39E0ED24106D2C0BE49C88985086132
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: FE2C1EEE4DB09A17EAD0FF80AD5EA0B4
dialogue.line: Aye!

dialogue.speaker: 06829F3D458A078D992BE58D14682D4D
dialogue.line: Aye, aye...

dialogue.speaker: EB6831674E50D9AD6969AB829AD0C417
dialogue.line: Death doesn’t care when it comes and neither should you. What matters is how we live our lives until it comes for us. That's the only thing we have control over.

dialogue.speaker: 285E9E9F49A5748F5EE814AA12ACB828
dialogue.line: I know that.

dialogue.speaker: E566A0714D00949FEA90CF8F3D1B31BA
dialogue.line: I know you're no soldiers.

dialogue.speaker: 7684376143191A1D96164AAAEBF83D70
dialogue.line: Jokes aside... Some of you might die tomorrow. It’s certain, really. But also... shouldn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: 3DFBBF584B7CAD82609848998C50F940
dialogue.line: Let's make it count!

dialogue.speaker: CF89B05E479EA45E006419A9B3A1C112
dialogue.line: Let's make it count!

dialogue.speaker: D0391CBA433A3E5A79663DB5620F09D7
dialogue.line: Let's move.

dialogue.speaker: C1A5091946D3A6B02C3EB49E16CB9347
dialogue.line: Listen up, men!

dialogue.speaker: 46D2B08B4DCDFF77A0D70995AADEADF4
dialogue.line: Listen up, men! I know you're no soldiers.

dialogue.speaker: B2A52BF4478E5808AA4B0ABE30FE31D5
dialogue.line: Most of you at least... Alas! You're good people!

dialogue.speaker: EDEE13DD4B3D4D2588338FA8B19702A7
dialogue.line: Most of you... eh, Drogos?

dialogue.speaker: 084856FB440FEC49B2E222927589BECC
dialogue.line: Rubbish! Death comes for us all. And tomorrow it may come for me... or you. But before that happens, we will make sure it comes for that bastard too. Aye?

dialogue.speaker: 967BEAFA43D43B1F5808729414A36629
dialogue.line: Sadly, some of you might die tomorrow. It’s certain, really. But also... shouldn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: 7439DC9545FEDEC1A7C76898F9CB5A21
dialogue.line: The best! We can do this.

dialogue.speaker: 7D438C7340E0D670EF377D8AF6504EF9
dialogue.line: The best! We can do this.

dialogue.speaker: E3755B6C48F121F0393A3191023D6BBA
dialogue.line: The best, aye... Sadly, some of you might die tomorrow. It’s certain, really. But also... shouldn't matter.

dialogue.speaker: 206EDDA14451E950824C7CBB0ABA1B48
dialogue.line: To make us think he can’t die.

dialogue.speaker: C48E16D24D386C14BDB76FB9D69894F5
dialogue.line: We just want to kill Brencis. Plain and simple.

dialogue.speaker: F8B5263247396D3738D94BA45C9857E3
dialogue.line: We only seek to kill Brencis – avenge those he’s taken from us. And make better lives for ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: 99F398864E12C78675A94E8AD606C7F4
dialogue.line: You see, Brencis claims to be both life and death, and everything in between. It’s just a lie he tells both himself and everybody else to delay the inevitable.

dialogue.speaker: 56C1D96744ABB72CC28D53B518A1A08C
dialogue.line: [chuckle]

dialogue.speaker: 19276CC34E94A0A42DCB11885A87500F
dialogue.line: [grunt]

dialogue.speaker: F11C1A214F9B1318DAD69B89A1F013DC
dialogue.line: [snort]

dialogue.speaker: 94D4C42D42BF1A47AC692681175C41CF
dialogue.line: [stay silent]

dialogue.speaker: BBB3E65043D44569E47D6D92476998EA
dialogue.line: [stay silent]

dialogue.speaker: 474EC637490C3701146818A30673F119
dialogue.line: And saving my family.

dialogue.speaker: 00E0F29341CFC76C119146A39BBB3066
dialogue.line: And saving your family, of course.

dialogue.speaker: 65AE67BA4C8155C10249078B1E977AC6
dialogue.line: And we have enough?

dialogue.speaker: 4283E57A498FA7621384E3BF014FF687
dialogue.line: But worry not. With Catalin’s troops, the odds will even out.

dialogue.speaker: F41DEF15491A2A4B654CBAA9E073922E
dialogue.line: Don't worry about the details, I’ve seen to them. You focus on the fighting.

dialogue.speaker: 2D6D2121481895605DEBC8B6EB7605BF
dialogue.line: Four to one, at least. Over a dozen just at the gates.

dialogue.speaker: EAF717224E8D99F7E9AD68B41F2AC3AC
dialogue.line: How are we getting down there?

dialogue.speaker: 3826E9FE4B98218D8B335DB359799D3A
dialogue.line: How are we getting down?

dialogue.speaker: D3990E554DDDF5DF724190AF63EDFA22
dialogue.line: Now, come on. Enough sightseeing.

dialogue.speaker: A5F02B7A430E271A2E5092BD68BD560B
dialogue.line: Oh, we're going down a much steeper cliff than this. Right above the outpost.

dialogue.speaker: 5475D333431FA19CDE4F0DAD487278B2
dialogue.line: See that cliff there? That’s our way into the outpost.

dialogue.speaker: 803385D34F430140406B13AF7713578D
dialogue.line: What’s their headcount compared to ours?

dialogue.speaker: E5EB6A6746317135D81C43BE346C406B
dialogue.line: What’s their headcount?

dialogue.speaker: 83DE060D473B16DBF620C98D377AEDB2
dialogue.line: With ropes, of course.

dialogue.speaker: 8DC790F5472D34F9EEF1C399BFB60BDC
dialogue.line: With ropes.

dialogue.speaker: 7F6A0E4746C535F15C68F3875E4512AF
dialogue.line: [exhale] We'll break our necks if we try to go down this way.

dialogue.speaker: 97D1B9094A9CE02904B5FB968A7E47CD
dialogue.line: All done?

dialogue.speaker: 249525B540E0F5FD816193AD12BFAE72
dialogue.line: Awaiting orders.

dialogue.speaker: A8512B31489970B3500843B88AC24FAA
dialogue.line: Aye.

dialogue.speaker: 39FC4FE54AC46313B481D4B73E197AFC
dialogue.line: Aye. Few men, few ropes to tie.

dialogue.speaker: D5108D76461B3E37104EB3809C6084D9
dialogue.line: Besides, they’re fighting because they have to. We’re fighting because we choose to. That makes all the difference.

dialogue.speaker: 4CFBD30540A15A2053A9E4AF578E525D
dialogue.line: Clear sky, gentle breeze, birds chirping... What a beautiful day to die!

dialogue.speaker: D17572654572D25FE9DC4591AF0DA032
dialogue.line: Coen! You stick close to me.

dialogue.speaker: 0C2C21BB46AD3B69DD390CB19D972C86
dialogue.line: Exaclty, Zoran. I know I said some of us might die, but it doesn't mean you should look forward to it.

dialogue.speaker: FCA5FC00485DAAA073E470AA95AE20D9
dialogue.line: Find the courage and just do it.

dialogue.speaker: 238FDE934ADA28E3FF7679810A38FF16
dialogue.line: Good. Stand by.

dialogue.speaker: E034AFE74E508C8C295A2AAD70F9D46E
dialogue.line: Halt.

dialogue.speaker: D083890C40A139E9F38882A46F54CFF9
dialogue.line: Hold up, this is the spot.

dialogue.speaker: 24A8E3424D4CC2CB6579C2B49ADEBFE0
dialogue.line: Hold up, this is the spot. Tie your ropes to something solid—we’ll only get one shot at this.

dialogue.speaker: 50DED9524D729F8A701DE29DF5500ECC
dialogue.line: I heard they're armed to the teeth in the garrison.

dialogue.speaker: AAA6C24D4A3F4F5D05CA00A9AD042E68
dialogue.line: Patrols below. Keep quiet from now on.

dialogue.speaker: 5C148B2648166DDA9864AAB0EB97D0F3
dialogue.line: Rope. Now.

dialogue.speaker: 2B28B97F40F9DA3A6C4D9AA23203A9F2
dialogue.line: Shut it.

dialogue.speaker: 627F9A974C897D20300ADE8BC0ECB84B
dialogue.line: So what are we waiting for, hm? The longer we stand here –

dialogue.speaker: E99B71AD42DAA0AD2E90239574D8D5D9
dialogue.line: That's why we plan to catch them off guard. We’ll break their spirit before they even know what hit them.

dialogue.speaker: 8563BFB749D637C811FF73A0ADDF910D
dialogue.line: We'll do just fine.

dialogue.speaker: D585B6AC4426DCEB7147BF885748102B
dialogue.line: What are you waiting for? Tie your rope.

dialogue.speaker: 18C1A0034682F09C21545D8FFE01BA26
dialogue.line: Yeah. I guess...

dialogue.speaker: E15760B9475048B07A29D0A9E2900245
dialogue.line: Zip your mouths. Patrols below.

dialogue.speaker: 2AD21FB44CA1DD977E51EEB185146C35
dialogue.line: [laughter] Or to win and live happily ever after, eh?

dialogue.speaker: 6463CB93496B325B28B6F4871D955C02
dialogue.line: A monster! Pull yourself together and fight it!

dialogue.speaker: 7D0D49B841848D3EA98EE3B73227BF38
dialogue.line: Aargh! What the hell is tha –

dialogue.speaker: 2ED2402C4B28F30E4260BD836657A5D9
dialogue.line: Attack! Down with Brencis!

dialogue.speaker: 2C9B87E64C82271D070058A5FED5E89F
dialogue.line: Bring it down!

dialogue.speaker: 32C9E5354E8BB37FE277C88D47166707
dialogue.line: Coen, come back! The outer gate is this way!

dialogue.speaker: 441AD2CC40FF48FAE98E8798302929EF
dialogue.line: Coen, go to the tower! We’ll hold them here!

dialogue.speaker: B9E33DB14BBBB2A4688E1CA290D02A01
dialogue.line: Coen, hurry! We can't hold out forever!

dialogue.speaker: E69D46C0440D98D294C2DB976EB7CFCD
dialogue.line: Don't let them swarm us!

dialogue.speaker: 174B9B194D0A157D414B23B77247C370
dialogue.line: Down with Brencis!

dialogue.speaker: 1B87E05F4248098C4772E59FA22BA80D
dialogue.line: Get moving! Let them through!

dialogue.speaker: A76D51904AADC0B1ACD715AB7F14E8AD
dialogue.line: Good! Now let’s kill that bloody thing!

dialogue.speaker: 2EC279F0401801EC4C2536B0F2DB92CD
dialogue.line: Heard that, men? Stay sharp!

dialogue.speaker: 501EFF5046032D986B50E6A4960F6EE3
dialogue.line: Hurry up, men!

dialogue.speaker: CCBCA3A8407A907936E5E592763E1E92
dialogue.line: Intruders! Sound the alarm!

dialogue.speaker: 3BF7CAD34700C4542CD32787DE88F5C2
dialogue.line: Keep at it! That thing is tough, but not invincible!

dialogue.speaker: 03C82B6C41E4D3603F3B12889A9FD8F1
dialogue.line: More of them! Watch out!

dialogue.speaker: ADF0872D442331090E7221AD38AACA3A
dialogue.line: On it!

dialogue.speaker: B3E53C524C1941268DF0B094F26F3BD7
dialogue.line: Push forward! We’re nearly at the outer gate!

dialogue.speaker: 05869F2343940F64366329A862A7ECA3
dialogue.line: Someone needs to open the gate for Catalin’s troops!

dialogue.speaker: 29C1C1824151A347032E29A0F037A014
dialogue.line: Spot the wheel? Turn it!

dialogue.speaker: 7677B737457348A3ACBB44A2352F89B6
dialogue.line: Stand your ground! We’re not done yet!

dialogue.speaker: E928A1004796FE26FA4C5CAC2A08D897
dialogue.line: That should do it!

dialogue.speaker: 7C7F3F1A431580D7B672A9852FFADF8F
dialogue.line: They’re at the gate! Defend the garrison!

dialogue.speaker: 36E10CC3486317A110FB8D836AB45D11
dialogue.line: To arms! It's the manumits!

dialogue.speaker: A482AB2946EF50ABD701FDA971331277
dialogue.line: To the outer gate! Catalin needs our help!

dialogue.speaker: 1E4003CA4F688A4BA7CCAD80BC6C08F2
dialogue.line: Up the tower, Coen! That's where the turnstile is! Go, go!

dialogue.speaker: 34AEE64A4EA96AEDA58F3A9AF801478E
dialogue.line: Upwards! Follow me!

dialogue.speaker: F23FCFF14E028015B87E98B42031A2FB
dialogue.line: Watch out! Damn thing’s faster than it looks.

dialogue.speaker: 46C5EDA2422AB39A892C52B16D21F9C9
dialogue.line: We are bloody trying!

dialogue.speaker: 3278AC5B4C8B307B2493339638719DAA
dialogue.line: [grunt] Coen, do your thing! Weaken it!

dialogue.speaker: CF48B445411C4E79E17A4DAE904E0D6F
dialogue.line: For freedom!

dialogue.speaker: CC570650442268EF0E3845852BDEE729
dialogue.line: Loved kissing those bloodsuckers’ arses, didn't you?!

dialogue.speaker: 7A52815C486C5A69FF2D0186111892D4
dialogue.line: No mercy for tyrants!

dialogue.speaker: 49642AD94FB4DF4582BCD4A713D32325
dialogue.line: No mercy!

dialogue.speaker: EC57C4FD4E056ADD1B88C2A795943577
dialogue.line: Now we will make you bleed!

dialogue.speaker: ED5616674BE17A542BF298B7ED1D1D5B
dialogue.line: To hell with the vrakhiri!

dialogue.speaker: F7A7F45A44C8A3DB3C31458B6B3013C5
dialogue.line: Vrakhiri lapdogs!

dialogue.speaker: 95F5B32944FA4AEA745B87A637A4EB7A
dialogue.line: We fight, we rise! For freedom!

dialogue.speaker: D5AFF5954E3D09C17A056CA1DDFEF1B6
dialogue.line: Your precious bloodsuckers won’t save you now!

dialogue.speaker: D3ACA0714279AC7F8008BD8B3D70E5B1
dialogue.line: Bloody rebels! You’ll die for this!

dialogue.speaker: 734FE4684D846DDED5A4BB80020C4BF1
dialogue.line: Down with Crake!

dialogue.speaker: 98307A6743130C3DF09F5A844F914DAA
dialogue.line: Down with Crake!

dialogue.speaker: 0032918A4ED02B01C045868116B1963D
dialogue.line: For the knyaz!

dialogue.speaker: 68504AA546D8D38D8CCC75A19F9A6090
dialogue.line: For the knyaz!

dialogue.speaker: 5308E5C841CE7CD3E718C4B1BA450491
dialogue.line: Hold fast! Bring these traitors down!

dialogue.speaker: BAB6C90A4FF96CB6B1FD67B4B4F6AF72
dialogue.line: Peasant scum! We won't let you win!

dialogue.speaker: B8EB18E34E2A8972EFF06BB61A4228C9
dialogue.line: And then? What?

dialogue.speaker: 5506F5A04F1B46F13A3AAE96B0DE9BB4
dialogue.line: Are you saving the valley from a cruel tyrant, sire?

dialogue.speaker: 5AE4E9C041DC64A88737BBA384242EEC
dialogue.line: As for you… You fucking traitors!

dialogue.speaker: F494A48C409A3F21DDBB8D856628486D
dialogue.line: But you did the same thing!

dialogue.speaker: AF3D85E648851C1B9FEF6DA424EBB3C8
dialogue.line: Crake, with me. We’re already late.

dialogue.speaker: 0B57552240F8E88FE36BBF9D1E392D44
dialogue.line: Hm. Good job. Well planned. Well executed.

dialogue.speaker: 0927476844F461897E9BE19278C6A5DA
dialogue.line: Huh. You? Really?

dialogue.speaker: DBC420B442E2EA4C267B559B93477347
dialogue.line: I did, yeah. Looked like you needed a little help finding your balls.

dialogue.speaker: 5405516E4A28F109AD886E9678364F7B
dialogue.line: I don’t care about your knyaz.

dialogue.speaker: 7341A003424A723AD433629A2BE88595
dialogue.line: I don’t care about your new knyaz. We needn’t fear some princeling.

dialogue.speaker: D790310C4FB7229FC2BDB19FBC51D5F5
dialogue.line: I know how to make them not only grateful but loyal... Well, two of them anyway.

dialogue.speaker: 080EED35480952BD9D8582BDE4BE1E86
dialogue.line: I'm sorry – but I couldn't stand idly by as he executed defenseless people in cold blood.

dialogue.speaker: A9B333C545E5E6BE8B980ABDB4048097
dialogue.line: I'm sorry. I just couldn't stand by idly.

dialogue.speaker: 273FFE9B49568D751EE5B5A9C6C592E4
dialogue.line: Keep provoking him like that and we'll all end up sporting second smiles, just like that sorry fuck.

dialogue.speaker: 9759046C4B89607ED84F57944C1654FD
dialogue.line: Let’s just focus on surviving this first, all right?

dialogue.speaker: BBD76FB7427AB7042EB116A5D243622A
dialogue.line: Me, sire.

dialogue.speaker: EF05711B461A203101E90C8C7ED6D704
dialogue.line: Mercy! We give up, sire!

dialogue.speaker: A1366AFA47A959E3EFE0E9B197D75735
dialogue.line: My balls are perfectly fine, thank you. How about your brain, though? Still there?

dialogue.speaker: 97FE6006466957AE50FD19954FA59D49
dialogue.line: Or just replacing him?

dialogue.speaker: ADDFF7F74694538EA77946A3D624CDFB
dialogue.line: Please spare these men, sire.

dialogue.speaker: F5B887C34DF2B842B8405F8870EE8166
dialogue.line: Silence! Save your excuses for the Almighty.

dialogue.speaker: 3C1B7B294FCA76E284B22A851CE87824
dialogue.line: Silence! Which one of you is Crake?

dialogue.speaker: BFEFA3934584FEC54EFCC9A59682CC57
dialogue.line: Spare these men, sire!

dialogue.speaker: C7AF2AD740CD3D21351E0FB82DFA20E0
dialogue.line: Take a breather, patch yourself up. We leave soon.

dialogue.speaker: 75302F014AB6B81CB5263C95E08394CA
dialogue.line: Thank you, sire.

dialogue.speaker: B13F8D9F4157AE56A3F628AC356DAD7A
dialogue.line: They had no choice but to fight for Brencis. But they’re still Sangorans. Show them mercy and they’ll be forever grateful to you.

dialogue.speaker: F32D02F64FF876E31ADDFA999F36287F
dialogue.line: Very noble of you. And very stupid.

dialogue.speaker: 500D963F4D0D87671E5A88B5DF9A6B60
dialogue.line: We didn't know it was you, sire! We'd never –

dialogue.speaker: 12AF383F408F36AAC4CC228C657A008E
dialogue.line: Well, you put me on the spot there, didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: FDE13902404ADD691AADED90D747C5F0
dialogue.line: Well... He made a clear statement.

dialogue.speaker: 721FEE8F46BE2E89EEFE50A5329A4B49
dialogue.line: What about Brencis, eh? We won't defeat him without Catalin's soldiers!

dialogue.speaker: B38D0D3C4FD93872C27C548CADC2A582
dialogue.line: What's wrong with you?! You have a deathwish?!

dialogue.speaker: 0D0C11674BA1822C81E2F5A6404767DE
dialogue.line: Who gave you permission to speak?

dialogue.speaker: 97EA203040A473A95716C287056E42B2
dialogue.line: Y-Yes, sire.
