dialogue.speaker: 50501EE946BC1EA6EC0FCA84016895F9
dialogue.line: Yes. Me.

dialogue.speaker: E41EA61943572C47D7478DB6CD6B5559
dialogue.line: Yes. Take a breather, patch yourself up. We leave soon.

dialogue.speaker: FE754E224530C3BA0A43F1B69A0FDE55
dialogue.line: You did the same thing. Stood up to him, too.

dialogue.speaker: D33CD60F4D3214D7C862DE95540B1057
dialogue.line: You needed help finding your balls.

dialogue.speaker: 63E47E7845875E74C62B4397035A0D01
dialogue.line: You should probably go talk to your liege.

dialogue.speaker: 5E1DFED9418F354B11123FBB256C5A6C
dialogue.line: You two! You’re my soldiers now. Displease me in any way, and you'll join your comrade.

dialogue.speaker: 68ECDD104794103265CD9380F741D859
dialogue.line: You were supposed to save us from a cruel tyrant.

dialogue.speaker: F0E48B454BF5DCC44B4DA4BD9F8CB375
dialogue.line: You wish to join them, brat?

dialogue.speaker: C8801FA7497BE5B746A84C936F7AC2C2
dialogue.line: You would have killed me. Your liege.

dialogue.speaker: A3011C064922AFDB4B2CDC84AD756C87
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: F26036104A334D5F350ED2BFC3D43CD0
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: 1E2918384AACD965282BB2B73F8B89E6
dialogue.line: [stay silent]

dialogue.speaker: B9274CD848C12BF2BB1BB5BEB9A26899
dialogue.line: [stays silent]

dialogue.speaker: 130A2DEC4B072254E3EE8A91DBCA65FE
dialogue.line: ...war breeds vultures.

dialogue.speaker: F4AFBA8E4543D68228AB48BAEDC61579
dialogue.line: A small village in the Holy Roman Empire, the name of which won’t mean anything to you.

dialogue.speaker: D9F9DAC141D3D5CEC2CB059C31FBAEE0
dialogue.line: Aye, it's true. The plague is sweeping through the continent like wildfire. Ravaging villages, small towns, and big cities. Everything... outside of Vale Sangora.

dialogue.speaker: F1BD7CF94335B9D7E3D491AA329FD777
dialogue.line: Better ask where he didn't... They come from all across Europe.

dialogue.speaker: 6B8FC05446005B21B8A542978DA4E081
dialogue.line: Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: 2B2D35BF482EB7B7ED87BD8C76DD297B
dialogue.line: I wonder... Where did Lord Catalin dig up this lot?

dialogue.speaker: 643B2D3945F043B08E0327BEE89FE0E5
dialogue.line: I won’t trouble you any further. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: C7DF7D224AF03E0FCF2A809C2929578A
dialogue.line: I'd use a different word... Raubritter... You see, Lord Catalin promised gold, and that was enough for most of them. Promised the city, too – free to loot, kill, take whatever they desired.

dialogue.speaker: 7F851EC945F0C88587F7B8B2F91807B5
dialogue.line: Is that all?

dialogue.speaker: 26ACF94F4DE8378C19F873936CA7323E
dialogue.line: I’ve been hearing rumours... about the Black Death still spreading through Europe. Any truth to that?

dialogue.speaker: 3E1B046A40CBCD142F53FD8F5BF7CAFB
dialogue.line: I’ve heard whispers about the Black Death...

dialogue.speaker: 1E0907B6419ADFEDD4D9F79121BE764F
dialogue.line: Ja, ja... Schönen Tag.

dialogue.speaker: EB2AF8B94EB6AC29197E9693EA9E001B
dialogue.line: May I ask where you're from?

dialogue.speaker: 841175AD44C2728D7197059772503E8A
dialogue.line: Need a bit of patching up. Can you help me out?

dialogue.speaker: 773763804F793A9D9FC9ECACF9CBD5F2
dialogue.line: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: 42816C7C4568F38DCCC76F8F59932E7C
dialogue.line: Perhaps. But we cannot be sure. No one can.

dialogue.speaker: 3D71FEF64747D45A3F5AB49612BB697B
dialogue.line: Show me your wares.

dialogue.speaker: 47FD706941FA8F33758AA2BCF8BBDAC8
dialogue.line: Show me your wares.

dialogue.speaker: 4CAAABB24623F296775C9D8A74418C28
dialogue.line: So, once we defeat Brencis...?

dialogue.speaker: D54B7A154164B89C275808B43696E9C1
dialogue.line: They're mercenaries?

dialogue.speaker: F8683F1446E0300F683736B34F5E18F9
dialogue.line: Tsk. What I want to say...

dialogue.speaker: 7A5B8DCD46F535869F685DBA21853C66
dialogue.line: Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: 4E44B52447696E428D669EB2C275E7E7
dialogue.line: Where did Catalin dig up this lot?

dialogue.speaker: 54BCF85B4CA4972D6426169CB1AC29AF
dialogue.line: You need something?

dialogue.speaker: FCABFE69432363AEE5C9C8BBF9FBF416
dialogue.line: You need something? Make it schnell – I don’t have much time for idle chatter.

dialogue.speaker: 10036C4D4C9C07C15451F69F57B3E82B
dialogue.line: And toss in a fair discount, should their deeds align with his favour.

dialogue.speaker: 03CA6AB1433F414136AEC78C340427DF
dialogue.line: Better watch your back with them lot.

dialogue.speaker: BE875B9148C0D9880395BDB5EDF3C042
dialogue.line: Born and raised in Norwich, a beautiful town on the west coast of England. Ever heard of it?

dialogue.speaker: F3C688B343FA700D8BE6139FFED4BF4D
dialogue.line: Can you tell me about this army?

dialogue.speaker: BB106F8B48E5B9492C286493A96C2750
dialogue.line: Eh, no... can't say I have...

dialogue.speaker: B97B21B849CEA181F07B2890F3AD68B8
dialogue.line: Greetings, Edmund.

dialogue.speaker: 2A12C42D449FC28F1EAA06A6A8BE8C03
dialogue.line: How are things outside the valley?

dialogue.speaker: BABDF47447177534B22B81B41252494A
dialogue.line: How are things outside the valley?

dialogue.speaker: B945057146071A00D2149E9C85A1667E
dialogue.line: I don't think I need anything right now.

dialogue.speaker: 457D91AC48CE444D7A7987B0F56DEAA5
dialogue.line: I don’t think I need anything for now.

dialogue.speaker: B6DA982644F68A5008B668A35FF21629
dialogue.line: If you change your mind, you know where to find me.

dialogue.speaker: 334757664F02A077663337A091E2CBCA
dialogue.line: Indeed. I'm Edmund, supplier to Lord Catalin. I provide arms and provisions to those who serve his lordship’s cause.

dialogue.speaker: 7055CBE245F09739D55A84A58B0294F0
dialogue.line: Interesting...

dialogue.speaker: 321DA1A140DCC0DD43D7DC9EDE910503
dialogue.line: It’s... not good, my friend. I’ll tell you straight. No lies, no jokes.

dialogue.speaker: 2B11D94B47D61F4A8214FC9C77EC0A9A
dialogue.line: I’ve heard about English humour, though...

dialogue.speaker: 837F05324AFF8FD4D40639AFF892B330
dialogue.line: Show me your wares.

dialogue.speaker: CCB11A2D439BECC9DD97D2A3E740C99D
dialogue.line: Show me your wares.

dialogue.speaker: 23A35F78459190F97B93AC83A4212A71
dialogue.line: The creatures of your land pale in comparison to the horrors brought by sickness and hunger.

dialogue.speaker: 3EFA2372431C266A4A59CFB040D47039
dialogue.line: Though there are some fanatics among them, drawn by the promise of a holy crusade against the vrakhiri.

dialogue.speaker: 86ACF7854C1C40E42869E595EA99F4F2
dialogue.line: Thought as much... [laugh] 'Cause it's neither beautiful nor in the west. [laugh]

dialogue.speaker: 6091C1BD43FEDE0349DAC897AFD47264
dialogue.line: We meet again. How might I be of service?

dialogue.speaker: 4CB3EE9D4602AED89F5734BD57526407
dialogue.line: What can you tell me about these men? Lord Catalin's army, I mean.

dialogue.speaker: 599B901F42F6B940C01F7082174EDD52
dialogue.line: Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: F5977ADF43EEE74DA2A91CB319BA30C5
dialogue.line: Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: 2AE607D441BCC2FC3A7001B928664C9E
dialogue.line: With pleasure!

dialogue.speaker: 00DA4A624EB85DDC79E570B9276F2351
dialogue.line: You're a merchant, if I am not mistaken?

dialogue.speaker: 795C0C3141E69B697DCD6BAD77DB0CF6
dialogue.line: [shrug] Sellswords, just like any other.

dialogue.speaker: E4A1D3784473FDD21E9FB1BBA9ADF769
dialogue.line: Hah! Only a fool would believe a nobleman. They're all liars and thieves.

dialogue.speaker: 853D3BCF4BFC58770F885D8C39B60403
dialogue.line: Oh cheer up, mate. Lord Catalin promised us a lot of loot and fun at the castle.

dialogue.speaker: 65A9CDD74E61D1F6658D57BFA3D65F03
dialogue.line: Oh, I’d bet on Brencis to slaughter them. He’s far better equipped.

dialogue.speaker: 0664CEF94C4B821C8C22849E5392D907
dialogue.line: Shhh! Shut it, you two. You want to get us hanged?

dialogue.speaker: D2002153489AF576B55AB999C8D7F340
dialogue.line: Sure. Just grab one from the first corpse you see.

dialogue.speaker: 7597B525429012C5A0858693F85EF240
dialogue.line: Wait a spell… we are getting weapons, right?

dialogue.speaker: D226F677434AA7790C36F9A63412C6CF
dialogue.line: What rubbish! Not a single thing worth nicking. Not even a broken denarii!

dialogue.speaker: 6E7E9BF74AFD62370D898EA8CCEF3CBD
dialogue.line: You’ve disgraced yourself, dog. Serving that monster… Now you'll wash away your shame with his blood. Or yours. Either works. Hah!

dialogue.speaker: 81BDA4B64139F1474F3EB99AE4D8DFD5
dialogue.line: ...and he turned his back on us, leaving us to starve for days, because one guy bad-mouthed him.

dialogue.speaker: B60A81B6428A919F36983D9854B5DDB1
dialogue.line: By the way, that idiot’s dead now – hanged by a noble hand. So... don’t count on me ever speaking ill of His Lordship. Understood?

dialogue.speaker: 57D138C04C56DDAFC1B70E91294EEF85
dialogue.line: Oh, he's just great. For instance, once we were supposed to get paid after a long campaign...

dialogue.speaker: 0885D2BC4112578349480BB487B3F9F8
dialogue.line: So, what can you tell me about Lord Catalin?

dialogue.speaker: 3C33A3044D9BAB5EEA5219A1D1A4CE66
dialogue.line: Yeah...

dialogue.speaker: AD9FC4754336AE6CF9B8A2B4F4EC7A23
dialogue.line: Aye. The castle will be a different story, but… Given what I’ve seen so far... I'm hopeful.

dialogue.speaker: DC899F5F42CF09336B6D7B9DDA7E46D1
dialogue.line: Aye. The castle won’t be easy. Not with the kind of discipline you’ve shown... eh, Vlad?

dialogue.speaker: 7F0045EC4DEBA9185E309DA8C0169125
dialogue.line: Damn. I was afraid you’d say that.

dialogue.speaker: 1BFEAAA1490E1350DC0D779BC990A8F6
dialogue.line: Take Vlad, for instance. Discipline like his is what wins wars.

dialogue.speaker: 741301804609FE3AFFE364B7C5873362
dialogue.line: We won, didn’t we? That’s all that matters.

dialogue.speaker: 57356F284B1BF62B7A94D6B4214C57B1
dialogue.line: We're doing good... right?

dialogue.speaker: EB0D11A047B1E1363E8381A4CC37580E
dialogue.line: Yes. But it won’t be that easy in the castle. We’re running bloody thin on people...

dialogue.speaker: 51722D114DEA5BE4C4D585A93874961B
dialogue.line: [grunt] Save the praise for when we’re still standing tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: 345D4549493496C06C26AAA37316AF8A
dialogue.line: [grunts] If you were looking for some bloody comforting, you should’ve gone to Crake, not me.

dialogue.speaker: 865D0916412BC5227E3BDAABC810D825
dialogue.line: [laugh] See? Fine soldier.

dialogue.speaker: 96C03E384A52241C9DEC309EDADCD540
dialogue.line: It’s no better than here. Towns are burning, roads crawling with filth, and every soul’s fighting for scraps after the plague.

dialogue.speaker: DF80898649BAF8CC4F718691CA51148C
dialogue.line: Oh, that’s... good to know.

dialogue.speaker: 7781C5E94B3FD5AD5055A0A63A847160
dialogue.line: What’s it like out there now? Beyond Sangora, I mean.

dialogue.speaker: 67BAB8294F3349DBE0BEB79B2F8F04CB
dialogue.line: And that's precisely why you should stay still, verdammt!

dialogue.speaker: 09A4C4E2469EC8640FC81382211D0B42
dialogue.line: But it hurts!

dialogue.speaker: 1E0EA426405171969B3D38A4ECCF5CF1
dialogue.line: Don't move... I said, don't move!

dialogue.speaker: 33E8B8654ACA96EBEC954BB71396E27D
dialogue.line: Oh, right...

dialogue.speaker: E3929DE042C23FEC134FCB855077F4FA
dialogue.line: That was quite unlucky.

dialogue.speaker: 79234F8D40A75510661C5781009A9866
dialogue.line: The fight ended quickly, thanks to the rebels's help. I don't think many others were harmed.

dialogue.speaker: 9E8431214996E66AD3CB7CB01E08CAAB
dialogue.line: [grunt] What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: D576183C485F3C5B7DC7ADB428512777
dialogue.line: Better than starving, that's for sure. And if we’re lucky, we might snatch a few coins off the dead.

dialogue.speaker: B243358E4B57D6E753112AB8D88879F0
dialogue.line: How much do you think Catalin will let us grab when we sack the city?

dialogue.speaker: 8B2721A54BB1CF2996DD8985AB861DC4
dialogue.line: Or he’ll throw us the bones and expect us to fight over them... But hell, that’s better than nothing.

dialogue.speaker: 385916CC44AE20DFDE575A9FAFAC3F7A
dialogue.line: Some scraps – maybe a few coins if we’re lucky.

dialogue.speaker: 255655A043A8C1F2B81D83BACA849317
dialogue.line: All right, I’ve got a question. Those bloodsuckers running the castle, is that true? Real damn monsters?!

dialogue.speaker: BC0D5FC647A9846045F08F85232CCFA1
dialogue.line: Can we go already? Looks like the others are having their fun.

dialogue.speaker: 2CCCC2144DAB5924A9E326BDB8FC7CA5
dialogue.line: For fuck’s sake... What did I do to deserve this sorry lot?

dialogue.speaker: 989F3B4A4DE1D3FCB56AA09315A1FFD9
dialogue.line: No, I... You're shitting me!

dialogue.speaker: 0F33E87249AB26C5E858FD84C3F022CA
dialogue.line: No. You’ll stay with me until I’m satisfied with your answers.

dialogue.speaker: 69702544493EFD5988337D939A0FCA42
dialogue.line: Oi! I bloody heard that! Don’t you forget, it’s me who’s responsible for your worthless arses out here!

dialogue.speaker: E4F515F84A6AA9B76F60AF95F42EDC6E
dialogue.line: Shut your traps! This cursed valley is crawling with unholy filth, but we’ll gut them all! End of story!

dialogue.speaker: 8999C986468FFEE34BD2E1A7F2036EE5
dialogue.line: Sure thing! We learned it’s a hell of a lot easier to take a garrison when someone opens the gate for you!

dialogue.speaker: 01ADD86F483ACF3AF05B2D8FFE8F3350
dialogue.line: Well? Anyone care to tell me what we learned from that lovely bloodbath?

dialogue.speaker: 8CBB39894264723491ECC9A9671C53CF
dialogue.line: Why not? Didn’t you see that flying monstrosity at the gate?

dialogue.speaker: F342B7924B04D875C219448FF138D64D
dialogue.line: You'd better start giving a damn, or you’re dead meat!

dialogue.speaker: 3ECEC35F488C9C2E4D259BA3618E66AF
dialogue.line: [cough] Prick.

dialogue.speaker: 7CBF302C4B7D549C58928EA4396420CD
dialogue.line: [laugh]

dialogue.speaker: 4E5F7A6044C4FA9135D4EEABD563F303
dialogue.line: A bit of shine always steadies me hands.

dialogue.speaker: 849B4C094295F680146DADB48BB1DB7B
dialogue.line: Aye, you're on! And the first round’s on me.

dialogue.speaker: B71B792545176AEB4A3FCC83823E567E
dialogue.line: Cheers to that, mate!

dialogue.speaker: 1DF31C4346F45902F47DAA8A0EC91683
dialogue.line: Ha! I won’t argue with that.

dialogue.speaker: 3D420D4C4A38F01F83B89FB5F425CA84
dialogue.line: Heh. Hope it makes the monsters smaller too.

dialogue.speaker: 861F4EFB4FBE14630D80E0A8D9068F34
dialogue.line: Hey, shhh... Don't tell the commander, but I poured myself a bit of courage before coming here.

dialogue.speaker: 3AF60E704420A639CBE7219F80D20AF4
dialogue.line: If I’m to meet my maker tonight, I’ll take those monsters with me.

dialogue.speaker: E4FE699A4F5AC3581CBA82BADB9132DF
dialogue.line: Nothin’ wrong with that, mate. I had a quick swig meself!

dialogue.speaker: D4B6D674467CCDD662B39094CD41D7FB
dialogue.line: We should grab a pint when this mess is done.

dialogue.speaker: 9A02F62F426C29CB172AA499558A0574
dialogue.line: Good, just like that! They won’t know what hit ’em once we’re done!

dialogue.speaker: 1FACE3B342AC8FF2E2F10CB565BF0442
dialogue.line: Keep it up, lads! We'll show those bloodsuckers what we're made of!

dialogue.speaker: DEE71A38498A4867E3A15CB20EBD99D4
dialogue.line: Less waddling and more charging! You can't show them fear, they thrive on it, bastards.

dialogue.speaker: 00BA461E47601EBB0E1D019C8E23CE48
dialogue.line: It's more than that! We might be meddling with... with forces we don’t fully understand.

dialogue.speaker: 0E3F6D72432A26C94FFFA2AD3042E1AF
dialogue.line: Listen to yourself, Crake. It's utter nonsense!

dialogue.speaker: 5133C73B4EEC0BFF2C9EFE97D1A748A7
dialogue.line: Please, sire... People might die because of this.

dialogue.speaker: 692998F84149FD2C7776CDB93552CDA6
dialogue.line: Then let them. This is war.

dialogue.speaker: 5C8567084D32D8B021052C812D88BAF4
dialogue.line: [scoff] No, no... It’s you who doesn’t understand.

dialogue.speaker: 2791C00F4EA0134B7161959B8790A901
dialogue.line: Again, I can't...

dialogue.speaker: 2697D5AB4EDF30C10F0F62B06AFF6E36
dialogue.line: Ah, a proper army... Like a bunch of peasants forced to serve a king they’ve never seen?

dialogue.speaker: F9E32EA14A305498F283EB95A9F2B795
dialogue.line: All right, but don't take too long. We're losing the day every minute.

dialogue.speaker: 44721F8E4B82F184949C3D99AFAF463C
dialogue.line: Among the captives, I spotted a familiar face. A trusted and very down-to-earth woman.

dialogue.speaker: 4EB0178B4D768E94BA04378783460409
dialogue.line: And it's almost midday already... Are you ready to move?

dialogue.speaker: 0EC5F2AB4E4701D68C67089094CF98A4
dialogue.line: Aye. But word of our assault will reach Brencis soon. He'll be furious, send most of his men to retake this post. That's our cue.

dialogue.speaker: E8E9762846C300DC492375A1E2CC84C3
dialogue.line: Besides, word of our assault will reach Brencis soon. He'll be furious, send most of his men to retake this post. That's our cue.

dialogue.speaker: 933E132C4735EC87590A31BD0B59AE19
dialogue.line: But you knew about the ritual itself...? Am I getting that right?!

dialogue.speaker: C65B82A94E19FBDF45727F964999B00C
dialogue.line: Enough, Crake! This is nonsense. I won't hear another word about it.

dialogue.speaker: 06E88BB54C4D7177D8536383DA51D7CD
dialogue.line: Fuck. I didn’t know they would be part of it.

dialogue.speaker: 522D11E74C6BBA396552F1AB87CEF1BE
dialogue.line: Fuck. That does sound bad.

dialogue.speaker: 67CCCC6D401814363606EB8F30D1915F
dialogue.line: Great. Come with me.

dialogue.speaker: 20F53643462295EA58060CBC8709521D
dialogue.line: Hmm. Then we'd better stop him before he can finish.

dialogue.speaker: 2349F9D2459DCBA7FE5655942365E8B8
dialogue.line: How?

dialogue.speaker: 31C020FA43EA5328241E44963F383999
dialogue.line: I admit, this isn't perfect. But I'd rather have people who want to be here than those scared out of their wits.

dialogue.speaker: 43D6D6CD4AB1BEFC55FD868D88AE8700
dialogue.line: I know, Coen. We'll do everything to save them in time, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: CE6D2955495B5636F1D4A693631D0379
dialogue.line: I know.

dialogue.speaker: 5B4E995C4E63E2AC06B4B58DDFFD25D8
dialogue.line: Mercenaries, huh?

dialogue.speaker: 34E811154F90171F326BC49C2C99A158
dialogue.line: Mercenaries, huh? I had imagined Lord Catalin would raise a proper army.

dialogue.speaker: E4A9EA89489DE8ECB073958B4E922970
dialogue.line: Not a step further.

dialogue.speaker: 336BFD5E4627AFD693A7819E7A7655EA
dialogue.line: Not as much as it used to be, since you killed Bakir. That should make things a bit easier.

dialogue.speaker: 0AC2A7544618894E8A8681A46FA0267F
dialogue.line: Not as much as it used to be, since you killed two boyars. That should make things easier.

dialogue.speaker: AEEE49C84DAB7D48510228BBF2B729AC
dialogue.line: Not exactly. My friend suspected Brencis is preparing something terrible. But I have no idea what, really.

dialogue.speaker: 4D0EAC2443D1527568FBE1916A46DE83
dialogue.line: Not yet, Marat. Please wait a spell more.

dialogue.speaker: 68284C424CA500CDBC5DD8AAC49D44C3
dialogue.line: Not yet, wait a bit more.

dialogue.speaker: 534862184D329295787E04A439FCD6B2
dialogue.line: One of Catalin's commanders, alongside Drogos, will lead a frontal assault on the castle. Meanwhile, our group will slip past enemy lines.

dialogue.speaker: 2637677E448329AC1F8AE48EC8C3FF15
dialogue.line: Seems like Brencis is preparing a ritual of sorts... using the prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: 0E899FF54830C54F5047439BE8195E45
dialogue.line: She told us she’d heard rumours about something strange happening in the castle.

dialogue.speaker: F7446C79466889D3015B578333ADF738
dialogue.line: So, Coen... Ready?

dialogue.speaker: C64D434B44E61570EA691097F5656441
dialogue.line: So, are you ready to finish this? To finish that bastard.

dialogue.speaker: F4B4F3CD40F6ED343A9F9CB168404E43
dialogue.line: That means... my family...

dialogue.speaker: 631C7C4F49C87520B58319AB4B447F20
dialogue.line: Then we find Brencis – before the sun sets. Cut him down when he's at his weakest.

dialogue.speaker: C1E5FB9446DE2C8553120BB32E183D0E
dialogue.line: There's a secret passage Catalin used to flee from the castle two years ago. We're going to take it to get in.

dialogue.speaker: A29BD33E4014C7BDD2613DAB46FB4AD8
dialogue.line: Well, I'd imagined Lord Catalin, with all his pride and nobility, would raise a proper army. Not a ragtag bunch of coin-hungry cutthroats.

dialogue.speaker: 3B63432A491EF37CF2E6A198C791CFAB
dialogue.line: What about them?

dialogue.speaker: DD1D751641B78D85DB20E7A92A44D96C
dialogue.line: What information? It’s merely the superstitious drivel of an old wench.

dialogue.speaker: 734949DB4BB667DB5FF174A55EA45CB6
dialogue.line: What was that all about?

dialogue.speaker: D48E345447347452A65A678DF9088180
dialogue.line: What was that all about?

dialogue.speaker: 45C966CA42D8D10D04BEAE8948AB3418
dialogue.line: What's next, besides arguing with his lordship?

dialogue.speaker: B8DB80CA4081DAACEB3AB0BEF8129FE5
dialogue.line: What's next, besides arguing with his lordship? The castle is heavily defended, isn’t it?

dialogue.speaker: EA6120434ED7342337F3F6A48FDF95B8
dialogue.line: With all due respect, sire, I wouldn't dismiss this information so easily.

dialogue.speaker: 13E050A54E50E944EB0F5B874C99C886
dialogue.line: Yes, but mostly by ordinary soldiers, since you got rid of all the boyars. It will make things much easier.

dialogue.speaker: 15B8B8154C3229918E6B44891029FADC
dialogue.line: Yes, willing and ready.

dialogue.speaker: 9BE4DF9242AEA218B467299BEB1B61B4
dialogue.line: Yes, willing and ready.

dialogue.speaker: F3A0591C402FF4D9CEAE0A93D82A7EDA
dialogue.line: Young scared lads who can’t tell the sharp end of a blade from the dull?

dialogue.speaker: B168DFC34D56C31F7B0945BFEB66A80C
dialogue.line: [sigh] Ignoring bloody disturbing intel...

dialogue.speaker: 2CAC971D4F62B32B39E170BF2623061C
dialogue.line: But they are not.

dialogue.speaker: 565270F14F907A454F2B93A94541FC62
dialogue.line: Coen is my right ha –

dialogue.speaker: 9A5D1E7B46DEE74BA6539E8276F0E3C8
dialogue.line: Coen. With me.

dialogue.speaker: 313A9A20427D982012F7329330ADA60B
dialogue.line: Crake, keep your pet under control. My patience for his insolence is running thin.

dialogue.speaker: 38C05DC745A6BF54C5F6489A2A41224B
dialogue.line: I did, sire. My scouts should be here already.

dialogue.speaker: CB534F5940FEA3813F72AF88142312E9
dialogue.line: I know my men. They'd never run.

dialogue.speaker: 5B4EB58B45811FFBC537DBB19EBC12A5
dialogue.line: I'll go ahead. Make sure it's clear.

dialogue.speaker: 156B946341269F9931D0F692A00E882F
dialogue.line: Just get the job done.

dialogue.speaker: D629F26E48C846B01949258AB5F720DE
dialogue.line: Nice chain of command you have here, Crake. Letting your subordinates tell you what to do.

dialogue.speaker: 2FC688784DCEFB83DB6461AE09914A09
dialogue.line: Now’s not the time to place blame on anyone.

dialogue.speaker: A44250A848C868F72C8D4CA2222C12CB
dialogue.line: Now’s not the time to place blame.

dialogue.speaker: 78EE98924BE37AABDE1E729A4510806D
dialogue.line: Oh, I don’t think fortune is to blame here. Your men, however...

dialogue.speaker: D426B03040EC96210BEFBC80477AAB63
dialogue.line: Understood. We'll ensure the passage is safe.

dialogue.speaker: FB62AD5A440E87D4E7C4CC9E3190EF4A
dialogue.line: Very well. Take your pet along – he's making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: AECB971843C118DC1CC0949BE7C4C4C4
dialogue.line: We'll check the tunnels. Make sure they're safe.

dialogue.speaker: FB0677E74BC012EF98B57BADDD55BD92
dialogue.line: We'll check the tunnels. Now.

dialogue.speaker: 97DA078547AED893EE316BB7CCBFAED8
dialogue.line: We're almost there, the entrance is... ahead –

dialogue.speaker: 70FEDB674A12FDFAB76260BF0D93AB7C
dialogue.line: Well, what are you waiting for? Go! The clock is ticking!

dialogue.speaker: FBF0A8A74F7E76DF43553993707D1D39
dialogue.line: Yes... unfortunately.

dialogue.speaker: E4420E254BBB4D44EBC3CF843101A341
dialogue.line: You were supposed to ensure the tunnels were safe.

dialogue.speaker: 946EDAA24DA9D624B8741B9738AFC6B3
dialogue.line: [chuckle] Lofty words. But what I need is results: safe passage.

dialogue.speaker: ED359C784536F4D393B46986E884D76E
dialogue.line: [stay silent]

dialogue.speaker: 0FF560C04D5B6EDD8998CFA70E8A7F45
dialogue.line: Are you bloody joking?

dialogue.speaker: C8470DD844848EC6DAF333BB5072BDBA
dialogue.line: Bloody hell! More?! Do these things never quit?

dialogue.speaker: 4367FBD64B15E940C8B627985C22EFE0
dialogue.line: Catalin’s a dick. A dangerous one, at that.

dialogue.speaker: 6F4CFB93499A63DA38B2A881577564F7
dialogue.line: Dark magic?

dialogue.speaker: 743D0789435372D0F70E48BE3018A61B
dialogue.line: Don't worry, sire... We’ll manage. We always do.

dialogue.speaker: A7B78D114CB26A493B7A108D517BEA9B
dialogue.line: Don’t give them a chance to swarm us!

dialogue.speaker: A5C985244D107084EFA8199A8D48337E
dialogue.line: Forget him. Let's just focus on the search.

dialogue.speaker: 2A776C9B424186C9697CCABA91D38830
dialogue.line: Fuck. I warned Catalin this could happen. I bloody warned him.

dialogue.speaker: B90C79B14DE17F32215125B3E2FAB9CD
dialogue.line: God. We don’t even have time to bury them.

dialogue.speaker: F3519C0B401A8D10D4D8D9A09317716F
dialogue.line: Good luck. You will need it.

dialogue.speaker: 8DFEB055438BD9156081EA818E56E043
dialogue.line: I see the way out. Let’s hurry.

dialogue.speaker: FF56CE794AC510702DE098B7D265FF4B
dialogue.line: It's one thing to lead, but the way he degrades us at every turn...

dialogue.speaker: EB3D5CCE486BCD19418FA7A3506429F0
dialogue.line: It's them.

dialogue.speaker: AC7993E24C20494D02CE12AE989E7A10
dialogue.line: Kobolds! Don’t let them bite your legs!

dialogue.speaker: A2AA109E4FA1E0855E941998D024CE6D
dialogue.line: Let’s hurry... I see the way out.

dialogue.speaker: 0BE7B9434F7C3AD785A7148F6E6942A9
dialogue.line: Marat, look! It's not over yet!

dialogue.speaker: DF715D324614E1F8352D13987F1F8620
dialogue.line: Maybe it's my scouts... Boris! Illie?! Are out there?

dialogue.speaker: 0193819247A2A5E7C2D9A5B51E166A4D
dialogue.line: Must be in a hurry.

dialogue.speaker: E6A0EDF9494E67E01495E5BE26AE71ED
dialogue.line: My scouts should’ve warned us about this. Unless they’re already dead.

dialogue.speaker: E59EC9C44542F302C3CE9D90F0F79BD5
dialogue.line: No, wait, look! They had time to set up that ladder. They must be further up.

dialogue.speaker: 582DAE2D4F993CF03028FFB172B4EBC8
dialogue.line: Oh, they’re not so bad once you get to know them.

dialogue.speaker: 65A4D43C492C949FE3A2A4A940F2DFE4
dialogue.line: Seems so to me.

dialogue.speaker: 337A16374E576EBF73F59590B0ECA200
dialogue.line: Stay sharp. Who knows what’s hiding in here?

dialogue.speaker: 4CF8A1404C9A8F06653DD487075ED849
dialogue.line: The hell?! What are these...?

dialogue.speaker: 12C8E66C4DDED3464BA2F9884A1279FB
dialogue.line: The sooner you realise it, the better.

dialogue.speaker: E6C506584548F32515987BB45D74BFCF
dialogue.line: These roots... Something's wrong with them.

dialogue.speaker: 4EB429C548A3AF942AE06CB0C65E849F
dialogue.line: They attack in waves, but it’ll end. At some point.

dialogue.speaker: 551DB0714968649767473CA31705A811
dialogue.line: They left their torch behind… and more.

dialogue.speaker: EACDE37F49382E3F6C4566A969D4D7B9
dialogue.line: Watch out! These little shits just keep coming!

dialogue.speaker: 50A2BEE44DC7DB4E022CDABFE76204DB
dialogue.line: We should get to higher ground, make sure we’re not walking into another... surprise.

dialogue.speaker: 3B3824F44D4B58CF7346439DC579B359
dialogue.line: What vile, nasty creatures...

dialogue.speaker: 429468A24ED357F118E59DB2C9430A21
dialogue.line: What vile, nasty creatures...

dialogue.speaker: B824A035499E7EC11EFC4D9F08C59712
dialogue.line: Woah. I suspected these tunnels were big, but I didn’t think they were this massive.

dialogue.speaker: D3C45CFB43B3122C7C9C048F17F430AD
dialogue.line: Yeah. Someone's here.

dialogue.speaker: 64BB9FB145A61F2CA10CA98F0CBB97F3
dialogue.line: Yes. Yes I am.

dialogue.speaker: F9753DB3433D5C8EEB2B13A5BC8696D3
dialogue.line: [scoff]

dialogue.speaker: 6A29F57C43D73B35646ABFA6BD92BE8F
dialogue.line: [sigh] Yeah, my skin crawls every time I encounter them.

dialogue.speaker: 52F166A14EED908B4A744AA49D346805
dialogue.line: …Did you hear that?

dialogue.speaker: 2E470F5A49E1AFFDD364FFAB692A75A4
dialogue.line: If you're done admiring the scenery, we have a usurper to overthrow.

dialogue.speaker: 5ADA9BDA4D40BDEC38E85B821A1B890A
dialogue.line: My patience wears thin...

dialogue.speaker: 693BB861465936BD706006ADF06BC03D
dialogue.line: We don’t have all day, remember? Quite the contrary.

dialogue.speaker: D6713CB64D6D177313E4A1BC694CC049
dialogue.line: Your pet seems lost, Crake. Fetch him, so we can move on.

dialogue.speaker: C3BE1C554C88C3EA252BE19D4C57D79A
dialogue.line: Getting cold feet? No turning back from here, rebel.

dialogue.speaker: D3D1F62D4FF2C194DB9BF68B22A4AECD
dialogue.line: Godspeed, lads.

dialogue.speaker: 7C389B3041EA0DF03B62B9B7E96012CF
dialogue.line: Good luck in the tunnels. The scouts are already waiting there for you.

dialogue.speaker: 58384AE94E163CF7349526A7832ECA47
dialogue.line: Quit stalling, eh? Too late for second thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: 5EB8354B4C98BDEDC87ECA9418038AFD
dialogue.line: [grunt]

dialogue.speaker: 98B6DE324F2E8597CAA914A6323E6990
dialogue.line: ...Chonk. He kill Chonk. He! He! He!!!

dialogue.speaker: E24B3D5247852C9506C0D5A9BDB96002
dialogue.line: And they want meat! Meat! Meat!!!

dialogue.speaker: B6F81B424CFB7B31688675A5A27F34BF
dialogue.line: Come on, you stunted shits! Show us what you've got!

dialogue.speaker: E917D87947C28B8687509AA1493DB6D3
dialogue.line: Exactly – so you know what I'm capable of. Let us pass!

dialogue.speaker: 552457E64E6782D35D16DABC43D0DE58
dialogue.line: Fuck. How many more will we lose...

dialogue.speaker: 431BC98D49E4480203B2E78D0E00AF8A
dialogue.line: Haha! Oh, we show. We show! Show, show, show!!!

dialogue.speaker: CEEC948B4D57580645ECC2A97557432B
dialogue.line: He says true! He helped. Helped big! We go. Go all, now!

dialogue.speaker: 5EAE833B49B5D7BF65BD80BD17E2AE75
dialogue.line: Hey! Look at me. Look at me!!!

dialogue.speaker: 7F9FD5F24DC4B7D13EA575ABF7DC1041
dialogue.line: Hey! You've filled your bellies. Now step aside!

dialogue.speaker: 5CE5EDE44497D31307E29A881DC9961A
dialogue.line: How did you even... with them?

dialogue.speaker: 39A2468F42BF8D8C42E1FFBFD5B58870
dialogue.line: I helped you before, didn't I? So help me, now. Let us pass!

dialogue.speaker: 14FF5B0641993160C6A1A1B033B64F88
dialogue.line: I helped your kin before – so now help me.

dialogue.speaker: 1E7F79A84664ECA07731188FD94967C8
dialogue.line: It's a long story, involving uriashi, an ancient vrakhir, and bottomless caves.

dialogue.speaker: DDB7709647DB14AC08CD2187E8F43215
dialogue.line: It's a long story.

dialogue.speaker: 0E353BBD4CD959A256341A861771DF19
dialogue.line: I’ll wipe the floor with you, you bloody little wretches!

dialogue.speaker: A75CE26E451926E93FE833A99BCCA1BD
dialogue.line: Let's go. The path's clear, now.

dialogue.speaker: DC8FF05049823F3AD226858AB4D0DDD4
dialogue.line: Let's go. The path's clear, now.

dialogue.speaker: 7E17D4D84ACC2B08D8A4F09C6405F73D
dialogue.line: Let's make sure they didn't die in vain.

dialogue.speaker: 2557310C4A868EFF2D3F6E8EC93C28FE
dialogue.line: Maybe we don't need to fight them.

dialogue.speaker: EC418E8E41E7373A356C568927B4EB6F
dialogue.line: Maybe we don't need to fight them...

dialogue.speaker: 03404A68411DEDDB7BEFCF9AFD3C46DF
dialogue.line: More... bellies in the caves! Little ones. Old ones.

dialogue.speaker: E1DC921F44764255BE2A33A7BC89E340
dialogue.line: More? Haha! More! More!!!

dialogue.speaker: 87FBF5A244B3EFA3BADF5D9AF85CB8B0
dialogue.line: Oh no. These shits again!

dialogue.speaker: 6896DB8E4C57FFAC0B33D6BDA819101F
dialogue.line: Pass meat...? No...

dialogue.speaker: CE8667AC45CC5C6B0D8509B2D85418B8
dialogue.line: Snap their bones! Lick the marrow!

dialogue.speaker: F83B4E424D1388300DED09B88C1F02F0
dialogue.line: So much for your diplomacy.

dialogue.speaker: 6437DE794160A5D3346138AED10CBACA
dialogue.line: Took the words out of my mouth.

dialogue.speaker: 9694BC5B484E1B24FA843299A5F599E6
dialogue.line: Took the words out of my mouth.

dialogue.speaker: 8280E4194DD0145BE0E88FA5CEFE8C31
dialogue.line: We won't bring them back to life – and we need to pace ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: 5A5EDAEF49ACB26D32B937A6647C51A2
dialogue.line: Well, I'll be damned.

dialogue.speaker: 26D95F84401ED986CDEC37BB82546E5D
dialogue.line: What? They killed my men!

dialogue.speaker: 187F453643C44207FA0C4EB1854B511C
dialogue.line: Wish we had the time to catch up on all that.

dialogue.speaker: F5E96ACC4381AA36C83D7C8AA1AE33D3
dialogue.line: Yeah. Paved with my men's bones.

dialogue.speaker: 71725A6849424808C9C6C0984CF1AB06
dialogue.line: You know what I'm capable of. Give way!

dialogue.speaker: 90317E5C4E63ACCF3C1ED98D081C4D6C
dialogue.line: Ah, yes. I worked hard to earn this reputation.

dialogue.speaker: 203C4E0B463BD1F213913188A4C1BEC9
dialogue.line: And, you knit your brows just like your little brother! Ah, such a small head... It fit between my fingers, like so.

dialogue.speaker: 36E7BF2C4900212EC63F9FA922ED414F
dialogue.line: Answer him, you swine. Where are they?

dialogue.speaker: D1012D594C24CB035169ADAC8B2F7BC4
dialogue.line: Bah, don't bother answering. I'll find out, myself. Lovers scream louder as they watch their darlings dismembered.

dialogue.speaker: 13D1DC73418DC53DCA8F7FA9B924A794
dialogue.line: Did you torture my family, too?

dialogue.speaker: BE1E784C4BBBFD0B38DF799E792E775D
dialogue.line: Did you torture my family, too?

dialogue.speaker: 7BC0553045D43F8D86198C88687AF49B
dialogue.line: Enough. You'll pay for your sins, now.

dialogue.speaker: B8F5E2B34BE8175BFF281885AA7CE82F
dialogue.line: Enough. You'll pay for your sins, now.

dialogue.speaker: CAB421AA457D94250995B6A7E867F9E4
dialogue.line: Haha! I love the confidence on you. Unfounded, of course, but it fits you!

dialogue.speaker: 47E6F1AA4500E4F4017782A7998C3C79
dialogue.line: Human bodies are just flutes, I found. Press your finger down in the right place... Ah, the sounds you can produce!

dialogue.speaker: 19AE89A04B55EEDBDD6056B75848584A
dialogue.line: I crushed it like a grape.

dialogue.speaker: 66DA3A5E426A5FC3E04C44BB6161AA55
dialogue.line: I've heard stories about you. Brencis's favourite torturer.

dialogue.speaker: 9479CA9D40B0F3E2AF2F679DBD1FC110
dialogue.line: Let us commence, then. Let us relish in pain and blood!

dialogue.speaker: A2E168114404EFECAB01A7BD5ECE5DB2
dialogue.line: Oh, but of course! They were guests of honour here. It was only proper I dealt with them myself!

dialogue.speaker: 30BEFAA14B41CC304083CD8DEF244EF5
dialogue.line: Oh, wouldn't you want to know! That must be torture, too, musn't it? The uncertainty! The worry! Haha!

dialogue.speaker: 9DB05801457988D8715017A02D199839
dialogue.line: What binds the two of you, I wonder? Just the joint cause? [chuckle] Or something more?

dialogue.speaker: 3FE63099457759973B435DBB524EBCDD
dialogue.line: Where's my family?!

dialogue.speaker: AD7A611D40532EB2969A7FB20F5591AA
dialogue.line: Where's my family?!

dialogue.speaker: 41B0999648479156EF137BB79D40B46A
dialogue.line: You sick fuck!

dialogue.speaker: 2449156E45968A58B90D1D8D3DBF5680
dialogue.line: And you think we need you because...?

dialogue.speaker: 32FEF3B949CC0AFDAEE2E192F1D55EAC
dialogue.line: Excuse me, sire, but I'll go with Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 50853E3C4CDE2F378A29DC90B9748EA8
dialogue.line: Finally.

dialogue.speaker: DDD21F474C86C312C59E13A9E654B79C
dialogue.line: Fine, fine...

dialogue.speaker: 0D508EC54AB71FFFA78E949F58F6F551
dialogue.line: Fine, whatever.

dialogue.speaker: EC4999824BAA0DEF6BCD1486555A6094
dialogue.line: Get in. We don't have all day.

dialogue.speaker: 5E5DE2824C062DB52930AD8E491E2208
dialogue.line: Get this disgrace out of my sight.

dialogue.speaker: 68CC51374647CC2FCAD5CCA404B84263
dialogue.line: Good. Next, we move to the prison cells—and then at last, the upper castle.

dialogue.speaker: 0F58F7E0440663A0DA01869B98B8C0C7
dialogue.line: Good. Now, past the prison cells, straight to the upper castle...

dialogue.speaker: E3F741D947A7955C5B9EB894E4C4B9B8
dialogue.line: Hm. I'm starting to like this plan...

dialogue.speaker: 851BA0324AF26CCD01A9BBAAC2F176F6
dialogue.line: Hm. What’s required here isn’t leadership, but a stick to prod the trap and see if it sets off.

dialogue.speaker: A0F078444B882A6C5A37BCA7F436CA6F
dialogue.line: Hm. You can go to hell if you wish, but don’t expect us to wait.

dialogue.speaker: 6C3A796F467B515624596AB62A4BF025
dialogue.line: I believe you'll be perfect for the role.

dialogue.speaker: 5831C587420F6887BD2298BC54B73A57
dialogue.line: I see. Another great example of your leadership... Crake.

dialogue.speaker: A060E1794BFF120563E6A1803BFB4436
dialogue.line: I'll go with Coen, sire.

dialogue.speaker: 3790F7164171BF4EDA4A578E94F81A51
dialogue.line: I'll go with him. To the prison cells, I mean.

dialogue.speaker: A0BFF3DD40A4BF788D504DAFD0D96CE0
dialogue.line: I'm only here because of my family.

dialogue.speaker: CC00B1C04B279A9AD7EBB6B077897276
dialogue.line: If it’s all the same to you, sire, I’ll stick with my commander.

dialogue.speaker: 804F64D74EDCEADEC0F55082C529FFAE
dialogue.line: It's a torture room... [sigh] No one’s here.

dialogue.speaker: 6F050AD24E5D488CE1DE26BD9825386C
dialogue.line: I’ll check the prison, with or without you.

dialogue.speaker: 9AF781294BB2FA8ABA533CB05C7BC6F7
dialogue.line: I’ll check the prison, with or without your help.

dialogue.speaker: 98406D3D4FC895624AF13BBBDC78DA6D
dialogue.line: I’ll stick with my commander, sire.

dialogue.speaker: 03274E184F879D33CDA948B5D3BF58F2
dialogue.line: Let me help.

dialogue.speaker: 750BC4894BDE9448CEBE68BD70B9E997
dialogue.line: Let me help.

dialogue.speaker: 88D0ED86487EE639567E6497D235B847
dialogue.line: My lord, and you think we need you because...?

dialogue.speaker: 92F436D34A841AD934D34AB62BBE8880
dialogue.line: No more prattle, Crake. Onward!

dialogue.speaker: 04B792194DEF0626EBA802886F38E07E
dialogue.line: None of my concern.

dialogue.speaker: 20E342FD4BC71B9259A0839C2CF69F87
dialogue.line: Not so keen to lead the way anymore... are you, my lord?

dialogue.speaker: 14B1D8C94EA7F3A5C23FDC8860301D32
dialogue.line: Not so keen to lead the way anymore?

dialogue.speaker: 43374566417628FF42D80C8AB7E7F141
dialogue.line: Onward!

dialogue.speaker: FA56226942AA3BCDF280E293D6673544
dialogue.line: Perhaps we'll be able to rally the prisoners to our cause. After all, some of them have already served under me.

dialogue.speaker: 09BC81304709C50D777AD3BF574E0894
dialogue.line: See there? I think this is it. I'll get Catalin.

dialogue.speaker: EE5F4DA34CC9F67F886124BEAFB2E2B9
dialogue.line: Thank you, my lea–

dialogue.speaker: 56E8C251402A7D7EEEDF7BABD08FF06D
dialogue.line: The only reason I’m here is because of my family.

dialogue.speaker: 36C0128040FC6AB3B974BD96AA51836C
dialogue.line: There's another exit from the prison—it leads to the courtyard. You can use it after checking the cells.

dialogue.speaker: 596A98704AEF589D9059CABB840C5B2C
dialogue.line: Torture chamber. Empty.

dialogue.speaker: CD15DA6A4D2A4423A66ECDB6E5B8AB94
dialogue.line: Understood. I’ll take no one but Coen.

dialogue.speaker: D1A1927140586712ECC3269D412E4A97
dialogue.line: Wait, sire. I'd like to check the cells and free the prisoners. Rally them to our cause. Some of them are my men already.

dialogue.speaker: 379A10274930E5A2C6A3739B141A8C63
dialogue.line: Wait. Prison cells? My family might be in there.

dialogue.speaker: C475E90846B0A2956BC50A86A2AF0D6E
dialogue.line: Without it it is, then.

dialogue.speaker: B7094EF5478F15D7B3AD188C1D4918BD
dialogue.line: Yes, sire.

dialogue.speaker: 37D5AAB94872B267AA3BF7B4925E44F2
dialogue.line: You can try. Just keep in mind I won't be waiting. Don't need you as much as you'd like to think.

dialogue.speaker: F91136B34E5F8F0DC72CE3BC75391F2A
dialogue.line: [look him in the eye]

dialogue.speaker: 8E313792455487BE9DAF508A4279C829
dialogue.line: [scoff] As you wish.

dialogue.speaker: 1547594742B5CCE9B1DBF1BB035E0C26
dialogue.line: [stay silent]

dialogue.speaker: 9AC5D005450B5F47927E3BBC56D6D0DA
dialogue.line: [stay silent]

dialogue.speaker: E59D0EF94CCD70464DC268B07DB2ECA4
dialogue.line: Agreed.

dialogue.speaker: 177C4D7F4F5C77D19D096E8939BA9AAC
dialogue.line: And you won't. But we must move forward.

dialogue.speaker: 8B3907F048DFC095B21195BAC6E032E6
dialogue.line: Are you sure Brencis didn't just kill them?

dialogue.speaker: 7649EE054BB18187FD41F1AFB8C6A066
dialogue.line: Are you sure Brencis didn’t just kill all of them?

dialogue.speaker: F30E9ACA466A2ADA575D938F0D7ABA02
dialogue.line: Aye. No point in looking further.

dialogue.speaker: 6854AA9040CA29FF6686528C972299B1
dialogue.line: Do you think Brencis may have rushed the coronation?

dialogue.speaker: 74FEA73C4795FD5AFCF87E85FD0F2125
dialogue.line: Empty. Every single one of them gone.

dialogue.speaker: B5AEDF384DF59CF91AE2CA931ECB4A56
dialogue.line: Has Brencis rushed the coronation?

dialogue.speaker: B04491CC4663BB8A276A1E9832811281
dialogue.line: Hear that? Footsteps!

dialogue.speaker: 9823D87D4790337D11CBB19C8AD342F8
dialogue.line: I can't leave without them... I just can't, Marat.

dialogue.speaker: 687835BB4104E0D97A8EF289022D8AF2
dialogue.line: I can't leave without them... I just can't.

dialogue.speaker: D521FAFE47DC479C9CF07C9B828D8DD5
dialogue.line: Nay. I would have heard about it if that were the case.

dialogue.speaker: 4E8737A745841FAEA5E26AB0F5939FDC
dialogue.line: Not out of mercy, I'd imagine.

dialogue.speaker: 265BD20E46B758C54AA7B7BE8647E4CB
dialogue.line: The people from Laslea, for sure. But last I heard, others were spared.

dialogue.speaker: F07416A84F1954D08A3AFFAF36B8A84E
dialogue.line: They have to be somewhere in the castle.

dialogue.speaker: E3668ACA4F2986E772954190D7C4D30D
dialogue.line: They have to be somewhere in the castle. There's no other option.

dialogue.speaker: 566D7C4A4C5CE8D313E2C08665AAEA50
dialogue.line: They must have been moved… but I can’t say where. None of my spies mentioned anything about it.

dialogue.speaker: 4C0F3E8D4B14950309BFE38EC51992D6
dialogue.line: We don’t have much choice anyway. First head to the courtya –

dialogue.speaker: 1C0358F14C22D45EE258E7ACEA8D5792
dialogue.line: We kill Brencis, we’ll find the answer, right?

dialogue.speaker: 030080B54DF749A49EF673AA7DAF8241
dialogue.line: We kill Brencis, we’ll find the answer.

dialogue.speaker: 43A8C46C489D006380CA8F82BA994095
dialogue.line: Yeah. The ritual my informant spoke of… That might have something to do with it.

dialogue.speaker: 14771F44451C350F717A0D9530F08D7F
dialogue.line: Your family is still alive, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: B8392F014E485F2D081A8AA8DC7312B9
dialogue.line: Family? [laugh] Oh, that's rich!

dialogue.speaker: 1E283F414D021B51EC475BBDA3DCD843
dialogue.line: Ha, that's rich!

dialogue.speaker: 7038C3AC49945C38C5B69996AB1F463E
dialogue.line: Out of the way! It's Brencis I want, not you!

dialogue.speaker: 5070DD834C348A11E68713B30B55C771
dialogue.line: There’s naught but darkness behind me, brat!

dialogue.speaker: E387C6D247CE32867A8855BEC8CFCF5D
dialogue.line: You won’t stand between me and my family!

dialogue.speaker: 49FA4FEB4FC7355858B0AFB25A4B416E
dialogue.line: You’ll never get near him!

dialogue.speaker: EDF93600447ED666B0B989B0DFBC565A
dialogue.line: Ah, look what the cat dragged in. One cocky bird and the runt of the litter.

dialogue.speaker: E69CB0764A8121359E58BCA3CBF5E8EA
dialogue.line: Answer me this – where have you taken my family?

dialogue.speaker: 86489256454608354A3A32856D484928
dialogue.line: Any last words before you answer for your crimes?

dialogue.speaker: 521D7E5B4AF16C0405B80F9847421D86
dialogue.line: Aye. And I shall avenge his death.

dialogue.speaker: C0B9972046DEDE6C0FEECFBA6DBE43C9
dialogue.line: Bloody traitors...

dialogue.speaker: E6D2594A4EEC1254C024F38CCAAC5C32
dialogue.line: Boyar Ambrus was honourable, fought you in a duel.

dialogue.speaker: 3A16A99E4553542D0C2F6FACF91DBD1C
dialogue.line: Brencis's rule won't last forever.

dialogue.speaker: 0F8B086847D3F600676A59B65069C9D0
dialogue.line: Brencis's rule won't last forever. Better to jump ship, before it sinks.

dialogue.speaker: 6E3C7E9B4D10F670C8DC779E00EBF627
dialogue.line: But if you're so mighty, why didn't you answer my challenge, I wonder? Why didn't you pick up the gauntlet I threw down at you?

dialogue.speaker: 663CA56A42F93C3BCCA9F8A24F675018
dialogue.line: Cutting words. Let's see if you're as good with your sword, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 560EB4B941BE2C62FCF48989E41B58D6
dialogue.line: Don't listen to him. He's just trying to throw you off your guard.

dialogue.speaker: 2EDEC8DE403C8E5BA4DBAB8449EF8342
dialogue.line: Duels are for men of honour – and you have none.

dialogue.speaker: E6ADD85C48763ED40A82B6B040E9E178
dialogue.line: Duels are for men of honour – and you have none.

dialogue.speaker: 64C6BAF84806A9BF11D39396A1AA5F07
dialogue.line: Get them!

dialogue.speaker: EABBBC294065DF85364F3285A0F01B44
dialogue.line: Ha, that must’ve stung.

dialogue.speaker: E94CE0DC47E52749430789A21C4F0BA8
dialogue.line: He’s set on matters far more important than you two.

dialogue.speaker: 929B174A4A29AEAE3D80319283543269
dialogue.line: Hiding?! You must be jesting. He would never hide from the likes of you. You’re the ones who were too afraid to face him.

dialogue.speaker: 73085D16400593DBBFDE558BBAF7E450
dialogue.line: I don't walk into traps willingly.

dialogue.speaker: D0C6CCC24DD9DB312C085DA68832477B
dialogue.line: I don't walk into traps willingly.

dialogue.speaker: 40B7064440F5DA2482EE3A9F2C266BF4
dialogue.line: I had better things to do.

dialogue.speaker: 6E35F6C943AD1965DF9CE5AF0D53311E
dialogue.line: I had better things to do.

dialogue.speaker: 67EB412848594E3195EF8A984FB20423
dialogue.line: I'll enjoy spilling your guts out.

dialogue.speaker: 30A84D5543A3E4C0916D56A52FF59222
dialogue.line: I've come here for Brencis, not you lot. Where is he?

dialogue.speaker: E2050DCD440EAE8151E3C98AC1107AD5
dialogue.line: Just save us the trouble and tell me where Brencis is hiding, hm?

dialogue.speaker: 6FFA826A46D8E68E932318A88C29FDF2
dialogue.line: Just tell me where Brencis is hiding.

dialogue.speaker: ED6FA7DD4989E4CD99F32FA9CB238B5A
dialogue.line: Knyaz Brencis blessed me, and I have every intention of paying him back for this gift.

dialogue.speaker: 70B046E94D4E841A1E27868694D1AE5A
dialogue.line: Knyaz Brencis is busy with matters far more important than this little intrusion.

dialogue.speaker: 86F87ED6437F4B424E93D6B150A09394
dialogue.line: Let's see you what you're made of.

dialogue.speaker: D6DAB8744844C7885635038343F3BC6F
dialogue.line: Like I need to trick you.

dialogue.speaker: 230C53D14D6A3EB1957EFDA2D99BFA43
dialogue.line: Like a rat? I don't think so. I'm done scurrying, dodging.

dialogue.speaker: 8B4A42C34C37121BD52B8C8BB1444DC8
dialogue.line: Lofty words coming from a coward who's spent all this time skulking in the shadows.

dialogue.speaker: CB48E6E645B780C1BC9D43997860B56C
dialogue.line: Look ahead!

dialogue.speaker: 2CADC6404CE10867816964815ACB22B5
dialogue.line: My family. Where have you taken them?!

dialogue.speaker: 74AD5C19480294F433C7B8A25A008315
dialogue.line: Oh yeah? Then why hasn’t he come out to welcome us?

dialogue.speaker: E72990D44CF10ABC2F2B7E9033B241C4
dialogue.line: Oh, don’t worry about them. They shall outlive you... though not by much.

dialogue.speaker: 786857BF4449A66FF10E6C97978DF9B7
dialogue.line: Oh, you will pay – with your slightly delayed death.

dialogue.speaker: E69B43A540F7B72DD8C7A6857B4880AE
dialogue.line: Said the little prick.

dialogue.speaker: 2226B75F41468A6250F24AB1D17ACA31
dialogue.line: Shit. That can’t be good...

dialogue.speaker: 62964AD041616F1BEC6A03BD927B6115
dialogue.line: Shush, little bird. Adults are talking.

dialogue.speaker: E5DF98F643F310F5CEC36F952650AE4D
dialogue.line: Taken? What makes you think they’re still alive, hm?

dialogue.speaker: ABD5393648053699CC3022B0AE1ECD04
dialogue.line: Tell me where Brencis is.

dialogue.speaker: 574D98864311F05A3A21258E847FD59D
dialogue.line: Tell me where you’ve taken my family.

dialogue.speaker: 22C340FF4870B656CD39EFB099CD5E0F
dialogue.line: There they are! Get them!

dialogue.speaker: 71FC954747490BDD0A0A5189FCB53D07
dialogue.line: There won't be any attempt at chivalry, now.

dialogue.speaker: B4EDC5784EC84332AC1B61A70DA2ECFD
dialogue.line: There's many a slip twixt cup and the lip... But enough of this chit-chat.

dialogue.speaker: D7831E23467608B23755F5A0F501FDC7
dialogue.line: Uh-huh. What makes you think you’ll fare better than your master?

dialogue.speaker: 8DB5C4A64D25DB29E617338493F6F214
dialogue.line: Where have you taken my family?

dialogue.speaker: 04E61BBE40CBE9220A2FC291976947CF
dialogue.line: You get in the wheels, rattle a bit... But in the end you just fall off to the wayside.

dialogue.speaker: 0E578BF44BD325059F11779C357BEAFA
dialogue.line: You know you're weak during the day, Ambrus. Step aside – or die.

dialogue.speaker: F099E8C4431138FEB441DD9D6184119A
dialogue.line: You poisoned him like a craven – and now you boast about it?

dialogue.speaker: CAB8A64647F5C75458ABE1A4F06BAB11
dialogue.line: You served under Ambrus, didn’t you?

dialogue.speaker: FE77FCEC48404F7201FD90A5B670AD3E
dialogue.line: You served under Ambrus, didn’t you? You were with him, that night – when I cut him down.

dialogue.speaker: 8E1EFB2C40180FE051442D8E449F0126
dialogue.line: You sound very sure of yourself, Coen of Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: 5CBFB48547A10417851CA184853350F0
dialogue.line: You there! Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: 8EAE7D074E45E02940618499F15AD7F4
dialogue.line: You're weak during the day. Step aside – or die.

dialogue.speaker: DD9C3D1B41227F847B6DCAAA867A13E4
dialogue.line: [sigh] Sometimes I wonder why I waste my breath on the likes of you... You’re but a speck in our grand design.

dialogue.speaker: 5281ED4F451E401C9432A7883E55A3DF
dialogue.line: Crake's gone, but you still have a chance... You can still avenge him.

dialogue.speaker: 7C36818F4FEC4043E9A3AABAF0B6D921
dialogue.line: Guh.. Finish him off... Kill Brencis for me!

dialogue.speaker: 7039093340F246BC658A84AB395205B3
dialogue.line: I appreciate what you did… and you'll be rewarded… but it won’t matter if Brencis lives to see another day.

dialogue.speaker: 7E5BE1364741C0DF947DD2815D682437
dialogue.line: If I could stand… I’d be right there with you.

dialogue.speaker: 7B1B256A48600F3486C08DA02C73530A
dialogue.line: As you wish, Dawnwalker. Good luck.

dialogue.speaker: E1770590483DEE53B193D6B97108087F
dialogue.line: Beats dying.

dialogue.speaker: BD0010774DC34682CA622BBF2B2DC7AA
dialogue.line: Haste? Is there something I should know about?

dialogue.speaker: DC68C0E74FF8478A7B2E93A3587DFFA9
dialogue.line: Haste? Is there something I should know about?

dialogue.speaker: B9DBEDF94B670790D6C7B1BFFA5FFA20
dialogue.line: It is... just not the one you hoped for. Good luck, dawnwalker.

dialogue.speaker: FBD9EE8E4D360ADDBD7C27931B31FC45
dialogue.line: It sure beats dying.

dialogue.speaker: 6B3A1BC84B4E0185782C0F947382FA36
dialogue.line: I’ll pass... thanks.

dialogue.speaker: 7D3E06F04FC44AC2BD2D2FA322553638
dialogue.line: Let me worry about that.

dialogue.speaker: 981E972F4A4A268A3739F0AE73B1DEB9
dialogue.line: Let me worry about that. Just step aside, Xanthe.

dialogue.speaker: 35ED45AA493DBF16330BE3AFED22C05C
dialogue.line: Many things, yet none that concern me anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 14D7F1B84A6609BCEA4589B3F375F555
dialogue.line: My servants will not stand in your way. But your path is dangerous still... And you must make haste.

dialogue.speaker: B67809F64299CAFA11D9E98FC0001F73
dialogue.line: Pacts with vrakhiri? Not sure I like it.

dialogue.speaker: 0BB6435542D6E197AC3E3AAE127D956C
dialogue.line: So you came. And made it thus far, despite all.

dialogue.speaker: D6F21AD14421C93C7D6F15963BBA2199
dialogue.line: That was... unexpected. Why's she letting us through?

dialogue.speaker: 911BFDFE48653E318802F29033AF9F99
dialogue.line: That’s not an answer, Xanthe.

dialogue.speaker: 809EB3DB45D165912FF82E81758FA7A9
dialogue.line: We struck a deal.

dialogue.speaker: 74393F3541F5413E648AD3BF9186A003
dialogue.line: You can always try to call her back.

dialogue.speaker: 9F68725D49676E2BCB05E1879669F6D0
dialogue.line: You cannot know if we'd... [grunt] nevermind.

dialogue.speaker: 7D53E33049E5656A22660882C42D0117
dialogue.line: You could always try summoning her again. Be my guest.

dialogue.speaker: BC808A6644843523021E818EC3E84D58
dialogue.line: Agreed. Let's move.

dialogue.speaker: F05BC0BC470C75B3E687E499D49D5EEF
dialogue.line: All right, I think we're out.

dialogue.speaker: B60ECF6B40ED44601CEF36A0F0662B7E
dialogue.line: And all the while, dusk grows nearer...

dialogue.speaker: 22F5724B4B01B707D912C7A32D3C0F67
dialogue.line: At this rate, we're not going to last much longer.

dialogue.speaker: 385F131643CF6D05F1F662A447DC055D
dialogue.line: Aye... I suppose you're right.

dialogue.speaker: 16FBFCB04C5B21B32112C7A7E70180CA
dialogue.line: Come.

dialogue.speaker: 10F06945446DAB0C7C0CE291B1029E60
dialogue.line: Damn it, that's Xanthe’s voice. This must be one of her traps.

dialogue.speaker: F061B6054AFE8EB1E51048A4B4F8FC4D
dialogue.line: Doesn’t matter. We won’t find my family here.

dialogue.speaker: E6DE8F3A4F6DC58B55B9C3B34B1E519F
dialogue.line: Finally, this nightmare is over!

dialogue.speaker: D54FCA19407C4D4710C48CAD025A668E
dialogue.line: Focus on defeating them! Ignore her!

dialogue.speaker: D7FAAC55482B35D6B56D27806C3DEC86
dialogue.line: Ha! Looks like we struck a nerve there.

dialogue.speaker: 1B0DD1B240B55D25143A64BD63B7DE8E
dialogue.line: Huh, this felt... different. As if the knot in my stomach had loosened.

dialogue.speaker: F99C607F4C318F57F5CFF9940E550227
dialogue.line: Huh? Wasn't this closed, before?

dialogue.speaker: 14D4084144A01EF528DBF2A15F391FF1
dialogue.line: I've dealt with a hex like this before. It's a cycle – a cycle we need to break, somehow.

dialogue.speaker: 621FD7FE4B4BFB6E24481BB875B24425
dialogue.line: Ignore her.

dialogue.speaker: F15EC43B4AC9E5F7D714D7B1D1A2F17C
dialogue.line: Jesus fucking Christ! Again?!

dialogue.speaker: 3F7668CC4BBC07F3D0170C9FB2BD0CE5
dialogue.line: Just focus on defeating them!

dialogue.speaker: EB0D36D741ACEBC245D73CBD34F0BFBF
dialogue.line: Keep going, Marat. It's not over yet.

dialogue.speaker: 5AD61B5D454A45FC0D74FBA43E1F31CC
dialogue.line: Let’s just hope we don’t swap one nightmare for another.

dialogue.speaker: 860B733D4A380BAD28CB6C971E78B2C6
dialogue.line: Look. All tossed-up, even more so than last time.

dialogue.speaker: 2D338B42455A14BE8BB2A5B4B6DED029
dialogue.line: Looks like it. But we’ll figure out a way through. We must.

dialogue.speaker: A73ED11748179F445D2416A0A90A1598
dialogue.line: Looks like she held her end of the bargain...

dialogue.speaker: D02D7501472F5629F4383E891358E925
dialogue.line: Means we must be close. Come on.

dialogue.speaker: F974DBE0462A5DF90FD03780D4915E0A
dialogue.line: More bloody monsters! Watch out!

dialogue.speaker: 3D4F42CD4B41DA95D82E02BA3A443790
dialogue.line: More enemies...

dialogue.speaker: 3500B675468EC5E72872B181CA768814
dialogue.line: Must be the first time trusting a vrakhir paid off.

dialogue.speaker: E73DB80B4B5E6CD62FAB11A63DD9B277
dialogue.line: No matter, ilíthioi. No matter... All paths lead to your demise.

dialogue.speaker: 5490D5754F1F20D6DD3B9996FE60AA17
dialogue.line: No matter, no matter... Kaka esesthai soi.

dialogue.speaker: 0546B8B643696586120F0A8685FA5320
dialogue.line: No path remains! No way out! Cast all hope aside...

dialogue.speaker: B381D90B47493E091D9ADA91D5E15584
dialogue.line: Not quite. Look – this room... it's different somehow, twisted.

dialogue.speaker: 9CD924744F69A0AE2D3ADA9A2A82F554
dialogue.line: Not sure. But this might be Xanthe's doing...

dialogue.speaker: 99A0241A48501ECB7168739AC6FD3713
dialogue.line: Not sure. Let’s have a look around.

dialogue.speaker: 4C42AE1748CC0FA4864748B51B040336
dialogue.line: Nothing good, I bet. Runes like these usually mean trouble.

dialogue.speaker: 177593F640D9787BACDCD387F5A815D8
dialogue.line: Now, let's find my family.

dialogue.speaker: EB8D3E634A68647B6E6424843FAA79E5
dialogue.line: Now, let's kill Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: AA6C8C764AB5EF7376571493A3D1B9E2
dialogue.line: Oh, I agree... [chuckle] I agree.

dialogue.speaker: B93FEC494F1424DC524CC1A9D871FC85
dialogue.line: Oh, for crying out loud! Back where we started.

dialogue.speaker: D6CBC62440D4B4D5BEBEF5A624AF6549
dialogue.line: Oh, great. [scoff] Just great...

dialogue.speaker: 321184CB4AA72F8B43705A8D9CB50C4E
dialogue.line: Oh, hell! I feel sick all of a sudden...

dialogue.speaker: 93F2CF4E423705E873172CA4FAFCB26E
dialogue.line: Oh, she's really getting on my nerves.

dialogue.speaker: BB2F23304641CA19EAF4CB971883087F
dialogue.line: Oh, this is pointless!

dialogue.speaker: 0DDDE141444AE262FA9D9AA787CEDB2E
dialogue.line: Oh, we need to find a way out – before we lose our minds.

dialogue.speaker: F9F8222B4AE3CCAF6BA3FD9ABD2AFCB2
dialogue.line: Only now?

dialogue.speaker: 88A22F354DCB9B2FE42455982EBD2093
dialogue.line: Rush all you will, but the moment for you has passed. Brencis has already prepared his... surprise for you.

dialogue.speaker: 9704E8F04FAB44484D09ACAC2FA23F50
dialogue.line: Seems like that’s the last of them... at least for now.

dialogue.speaker: BE7CC37244AF6005113BDFAA82E43A42
dialogue.line: Something tells me we’re better off not knowing what’s behind them.

dialogue.speaker: BFEC7D3E439D2AB00D3CB991958D427C
dialogue.line: Still, don’t like the thought of making any deals with the vrakhiri.

dialogue.speaker: 48A4E30E4B83A766B5F25E9A116966CA
dialogue.line: Struggling like fish on dry land. So pitiful.

dialogue.speaker: BFCB74C747530ACAAB0019A7B84D87E0
dialogue.line: The more you struggle... the more this amuses me...

dialogue.speaker: 16D88B10429D2984070515B0B464C159
dialogue.line: There must be a path we haven't tried yet.

dialogue.speaker: A3EF96F94B010AA2D066F597D8886BE0
dialogue.line: These runes...

dialogue.speaker: D1F172ED424043F6276BFA9036D5BBB0
dialogue.line: Think you’ve won, do you? Malaka! I shall have my way, one way or another.

dialogue.speaker: 789862894E215AB865B87DAAF90F0A78
dialogue.line: This should be the scriptorium. Though, huh... I expected dust and old books, not a maze of locked doors.

dialogue.speaker: 066BA97C447FECE4391ACCB397A7D940
dialogue.line: Typically, I’d say there’s no harm in trying, but now… I’m not so certain.

dialogue.speaker: 7EFC087846499403A9ED3FADCB8C0D83
dialogue.line: Ugh... Felt it too. As if the air itself had shifted.

dialogue.speaker: AFBC219B486228EA3C731B89583CE8EB
dialogue.line: Wait. Isn't she dead?

dialogue.speaker: E252D4F24DD335BA3E012F8790B03EA4
dialogue.line: Wait... this hallway... isn't it the same as the last one?

dialogue.speaker: 845B929D4A563AC0AEDECEBCFFD69126
dialogue.line: We're going in bloody circles!

dialogue.speaker: 9974C50A4BF8DF9CFE81DA8579FF10D6
dialogue.line: What are these things?!

dialogue.speaker: 6882F7914A83E577B099289CF2008DD8
dialogue.line: What do you think would have happened if you hadn't made that pact with Xanthe?

dialogue.speaker: A44F89C44629C4538AE439968B4DD764
dialogue.line: What if we try another path?

dialogue.speaker: F7ECCFE54394C5818557C9BC11D2F3FC
dialogue.line: What’s the matter? You both seem... weary.

dialogue.speaker: 24A2261D4E34365DEE0C8EA6F678C9B2
dialogue.line: Where are we now...?

dialogue.speaker: F3B2F72D4CD0EFE08A00DBA142A7A7F8
dialogue.line: Where to this time...?

dialogue.speaker: 4146911946DE54670737F5A360E6ABD4
dialogue.line: Yeah. I see them.

dialogue.speaker: EAC9A45C43A5791EFC4C77BEF798C93D
dialogue.line: Yeah. Laughing at us from beyond the grave, apparently.

dialogue.speaker: 80E280A24973DDCA8A94C48F8158B780
dialogue.line: Yeah. Let’s see if we can get further this time.

dialogue.speaker: D29773C14335BECC29964E9096E36DB4
dialogue.line: You had no place in this. A child pretending to play in an adult's world.

dialogue.speaker: AAAB996142EB88C6942AEB8B1EE8F0EF
dialogue.line: You know what they mean?

dialogue.speaker: B434071A47F59BF350FB5D8BE52C7C5A
dialogue.line: You shall perish here...

dialogue.speaker: FB561A754BE8A5089F1590944E41BD89
dialogue.line: Your struggle means nothing. It’s all futile.

dialogue.speaker: 9D6E3A284CF0F2D41007568E887EC642
dialogue.line: [laugh]

dialogue.speaker: 2F5117904F32AE5D1F260A8689D04666
dialogue.line: [laugh]

dialogue.speaker: 028F32AD43890B8B04CE9EAA5503A871
dialogue.line: [scoff] How disappointing.

dialogue.speaker: 6F4F3B284E1AB031FA66BFBF6170B552
dialogue.line: [scoff] There we go again.

dialogue.speaker: D040803140DB4574AAC0409202F71614
dialogue.line: [sigh] Doesn’t matter. We won’t find Brencis here.

dialogue.speaker: 82A2573144DA29CB67FA40AF57CE9860
dialogue.line: [sigh] I imagine we would’ve been facing something a lot worse than a few guards.

dialogue.speaker: 69527DCB44144F2421B9C8985E8566B6
dialogue.line: A wise decision, to strike in the day... Too bad you shan’t witness the sun evermore.

dialogue.speaker: 889CA57348C53E161DF1368E104C011A
dialogue.line: Is this the best you can do? I expected more from you, Dawnwalker.

dialogue.speaker: 3F03A89640FE1606E6E8C59F73F4103C
dialogue.line: Lost, are you? How delightful.

dialogue.speaker: 9A5344124EA55EF7A61A14B0E9A62DC3
dialogue.line: No more than helpless insects, trapped and awaiting the end. Pathetic.

dialogue.speaker: 76C50580410421592E29EAAB1483EFE4
dialogue.line: Struggle as you will, but you are already caught in my web.

dialogue.speaker: 983997E04678AA0E77612BB8792333FC
dialogue.line: [laugh] The more you squirm, the more I enjoy the spectacle...

dialogue.speaker: A915F7A344569754FF88BC810E65038D
dialogue.line: Escape? I'm merely setting the scene, as I did for Skender’s brat.

dialogue.speaker: 7FAEA3B84BB0645E3FFC439C46B39D5F
dialogue.line: Full? Great, now you'll die.

dialogue.speaker: AA359E23492D9D245C37469BD72C034E
dialogue.line: I'll just fuckin –

dialogue.speaker: F7690BC740784622F1A2708EEB946E3D
dialogue.line: I'll just fuckin –

dialogue.speaker: 96457EA14F4792F1C5B74EAB021BCDB8
dialogue.line: I’ll fucking rip you apart...

dialogue.speaker: CC90D2084002554E24A3E7AF22454075
dialogue.line: I’ll fucking rip you apart...

dialogue.speaker: 0C08C716469E2F4213349B8417F8FDFC
dialogue.line: No! I won't let you escape!

dialogue.speaker: 34F8106C429CC382795894A93D95ACE1
dialogue.line: Not so fast, you traitor.

dialogue.speaker: EC0344794C6FA9F0A76CD69666FF1C4C
dialogue.line: Now, if you'll excuse me.

dialogue.speaker: 1D8346544B41E63442B37DBDFC3A0EAE
dialogue.line: There shall be time for words, but until then... I have other guests to attend to.

dialogue.speaker: D6A085E4458BB61F356804BE23FC915B
dialogue.line: There shall be time for words, but until then... I have other guests to attend to.

dialogue.speaker: F87A2F6742489EF7D1F85AA9F7ABC201
dialogue.line: They’re already waiting for you, Coen. Now... if you'll excuse me.

dialogue.speaker: 9CF0D0EA4370103B4E1E4C8709B96577
dialogue.line: Wait! My family!

dialogue.speaker: CAD244BF45972F29476A4799CE9B79BF
dialogue.line: We finally meet... Dawnwalker.

dialogue.speaker: 77ABE0F04799F08003E34C90956E2078
dialogue.line: Why the boyaress spared you, I've no idea... But I won't let you slip past!

dialogue.speaker: A7EE080C46B2945D853533A77D971256
dialogue.line: You'll pay for killing the boyaress!

dialogue.speaker: DC3C01E84A884CD43CF3D7B509F58455
dialogue.line: You're no better. I hope you choke on his blood.

dialogue.speaker: 3CFA2E7441547AC4ACFEA8A3C760668A
dialogue.line: You're no fucking be –

dialogue.speaker: 34C5FB07467FB12AABE24998630CCAF2
dialogue.line: Your approval means no –

dialogue.speaker: C5AE5591454CD55B2DB2B3A0CF75CB7C
dialogue.line: Your approval means no –

dialogue.speaker: 6C139AAE4595839D008130B493CAE346
dialogue.line: Your approval means nothing to me.

dialogue.speaker: C2B7829B4551AB7145FE58AAC37CD492
dialogue.line: Your approval means nothing to me.

dialogue.speaker: 7A64D00C4C9771D1F81033AF6B7F5EE0
dialogue.line: The sun won’t protect you no more!

dialogue.speaker: 0D9ECBE647A2015E6FFC759A701CB97F
dialogue.line: Why resisting? Your little plan’s fucked anyway!

dialogue.speaker: F677EBEF49DC4CCF681DA2921667146B
dialogue.line: You made us starve, now we'll make you bleed…

dialogue.speaker: D78A499B40EB8F0819316E8287FCCAB6
dialogue.line: You're screwed! Face it!

dialogue.speaker: 068C19B54A19BCFCB1F1DEAA177137C9
dialogue.line: ...until you see what I have prepared.

dialogue.speaker: C89DB13B4EEE66BD7F4968B639FE83B6
dialogue.line: Almost there... Just a few more steps.

dialogue.speaker: AB2CEBE0474BB706C16C3C8BAFB62DB6
dialogue.line: Almost there... Your family awaits.

dialogue.speaker: D6A20F0848EA3181FDB909A6580F11E9
dialogue.line: Are you enjoying the darkness I have brought upon us?

dialogue.speaker: C1A101DB4EF5923E60B596B2C95E46F1
dialogue.line: But how did he...? It’s still day out, isn’t it?

dialogue.speaker: 8EFE47854C0F56A3C76EC8BE81B621E4
dialogue.line: Come and find me... Your family awaits.

dialogue.speaker: 3DE12FCF47C8BE0EED3AF98444A2DBBA
dialogue.line: Dammit... Did you know him well?

dialogue.speaker: 85C9770D4EE1861B9E0607A7E3E03DE6
dialogue.line: Do not forget about your precious family, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 5DCFB134404F55618CB2C3A4F02DCBF8
dialogue.line: Do not keep me waiting, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: B7FCB84248B94DE33759A285C479A74F
dialogue.line: Do not stop now. You are getting warmer.

dialogue.speaker: 452254344DCD8EF9F602C5A5FE1F4675
dialogue.line: Don't forget about your precious family, Coen. They're waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: 66130EB9414C50B0144C46A7E47AD330
dialogue.line: Focus, Marat. Others are still out there. We need to find Brencis, now!

dialogue.speaker: DBE5AFA44DA614489F6C899D47EF0202
dialogue.line: Fuck this! This is just... too much.

dialogue.speaker: BCF06A5D48A2E4E5E0C889BFDBB111AC
dialogue.line: Hell! This just keeps getting worse.

dialogue.speaker: 7B0BB64F4B381145298BBEA1BDF17116
dialogue.line: How did he do it? I'm sure the sun hasn’t set yet.

dialogue.speaker: 17AD57084E0F20DF8A69B393E628F925
dialogue.line: I don't bloody care anymore... Just want to shred him to pieces!

dialogue.speaker: E5F595A944EA9CC002CFF7B367558DCC
dialogue.line: I prefer to show you.

dialogue.speaker: D1C43A914DF0D92A10ADEFA8040E061E
dialogue.line: I'm so sorry, Marat...

dialogue.speaker: E1926239454A786994DDFA8126C7F0EA
dialogue.line: I... I can’t move. It's up to you two now. Finish this!

dialogue.speaker: D5DFD1934E06A098A08D8CB4C50843EE
dialogue.line: I... I let him die.

dialogue.speaker: 66A6E04A4D58CA4EC2D63FBFFB821147
dialogue.line: If you harmed them, I swear –

dialogue.speaker: FABFBDD143263D4FB2E30D8EB376B896
dialogue.line: Is it because of that dark mist...?

dialogue.speaker: E59C2AE24C9E847613CD50BC6574E8C4
dialogue.line: I’m right here, you bastard! Come out and face me!

dialogue.speaker: 32CE43684F6F396AC6135F9EC220618E
dialogue.line: I’m waiting.

dialogue.speaker: ED0416C14BEE10B1390DE4BC048C644C
dialogue.line: Just tell me where they are, you bastard!

dialogue.speaker: A7C8653E430366E90B21EBA8340E2F0D
dialogue.line: Leave him, he's no use anymore! You kill Brencis for me, understood? Now!

dialogue.speaker: B71F66C548B0DEA01375B395EF757B80
dialogue.line: Maybe it's because of that mist, or maybe we fucked up.

dialogue.speaker: BF4D72544FFDBCB493F75D85E35BAD92
dialogue.line: No. I would rather have you come to me.

dialogue.speaker: F224A90C441AB250065D60B734DD0A89
dialogue.line: Oh, God. They're all dead.

dialogue.speaker: 01A0773B45513D8D9C20B3B72312F277
dialogue.line: One of Catalin’s mercenaries...

dialogue.speaker: E40937EE416CD31C55CF12BF8D73D27C
dialogue.line: One of ours. Dammit.

dialogue.speaker: FFE9C7B24E18A63C1B29C1AD832538CD
dialogue.line: Patience. I have spent some time seeking you. You can wait for a spell.

dialogue.speaker: CCE06EC046113E48732C44808E6ABDAE
dialogue.line: Shit!

dialogue.speaker: F46489F34E6281B34F2F10B709DF4A00
dialogue.line: Shit! Where now?

dialogue.speaker: 85260F6E4FAEA24DE8F56497FBFDACFA
dialogue.line: Show yourself!

dialogue.speaker: FE4B9C68436C9B79B046C9AAC90DCF28
dialogue.line: Spare me the petty threats...

dialogue.speaker: BB1CBF424F2827F140E3CDAB5EC35F32
dialogue.line: They're all dead.

dialogue.speaker: 392B7AD04565142E6747B0AC40A9B9B9
dialogue.line: Ugh... run...

dialogue.speaker: FDB1E917438EDF372A5644917D371319
dialogue.line: Where in hell are you hiding?!

dialogue.speaker: F66076D141880B58635331A3D8BCB349
dialogue.line: Where now...?

dialogue.speaker: 06ACA4BF4F983412B93AA78CA055B562
dialogue.line: Where the hell did you hide them?!

dialogue.speaker: 0D295B794EDEC5FB8643E49D3766E6EF
dialogue.line: Yeah. I did. He was one of my men. I knew them all...

dialogue.speaker: 4D00050E48F66A5BA2A00B8944D1C042
dialogue.line: You deranged fuck! I will –

dialogue.speaker: FBD10211402631BAE7376092367346A9
dialogue.line: [laugh]

dialogue.speaker: 47C0272A4CE84EA74438F6965523ACB5
dialogue.line: Do you really hope that this pathetic gathering of mongrels can help you?

dialogue.speaker: 01350DBD43EB0F2E7DCD4981FB7FA656
dialogue.line: He's trying to mess with your mind. Ignore him!

dialogue.speaker: E38715FC40870FF6539DCD94B770B444
dialogue.line: No. It all began because of you. And now, you'll pay for it.

dialogue.speaker: D558CE574EB569573DB579A67E591108
dialogue.line: Oh, yes, what a wonderful life you'd have had. Skender would've killed both you and your sister, if not for me!

dialogue.speaker: E0BC1A1B4B18E72D1E329899AE2B4660
dialogue.line: Once we’re done here, Crake, I’ll bleed every last manumit dry.

dialogue.speaker: 3680D32A43CFC3346F188F83F3489338
dialogue.line: Once we’re done here, you'll be dead, you bastard.

dialogue.speaker: 0583A1994E774721FC82F0A797323F85
dialogue.line: This – you, your family, all of it – was the rebels's fault. And now you're helping them. Curious. And so pathetic.

dialogue.speaker: 4D4F478049AE38D7EC81EEB1502E2B27
dialogue.line: This... this isn’t how it’s supposed to be.

dialogue.speaker: 3D57FC4C4C60FC64EE8DBCAD994F9D9C
dialogue.line: Your efforts are in vain. You're fighting for people who despise you, including your own family.

dialogue.speaker: D1006F0A4ABA141DC12D92B03C8D9BAA
dialogue.line: Aye! You shall pay with yours.

dialogue.speaker: B88490244724B445582B1B86DD798CFC
dialogue.line: Hoped the sun would aid you? [laugh] Not anymore!

dialogue.speaker: 2C5B6F4847BD66D58DF1A7B4927278C2
dialogue.line: Mistakes... cost lives.

dialogue.speaker: BF6A73E94F8F1F2612CC98A985D88E2A
dialogue.line: Sbennuso eis ton panta chronon

dialogue.speaker: AFDD83694FBDB6FE11B40C85C830265F
dialogue.line: She needs me...

dialogue.speaker: 0F3EC3634FCBBB8DDF77C6B53301629C
dialogue.line: So comes the end.

dialogue.speaker: C5BB281541EA340CCA389E92B7A597F2
dialogue.line: This mustn't be. It mustn't!

dialogue.speaker: 55B997B94BF60421C1C138B9E91E2D81
dialogue.line: Too slow! Getting rusty, you old hag?

dialogue.speaker: B92201004C9F7C9C256C4D8360B54409
dialogue.line: Your end, you old hag.

dialogue.speaker: D8026C1643982044F8EFABAB137ED178
dialogue.line: Your foolish little scheme has fallen to pieces!

dialogue.speaker: EC65C2204B824CF1F819F5B3885A2130
dialogue.line: Your. End.

dialogue.speaker: 8C5B6B794C7A5411C0C0CC8C3A536633
dialogue.line: Come on, do better! You're wasting my time!

dialogue.speaker: A6A53DA94C767CC1ADFF25B285165EB0
dialogue.line: I didn't go through all this shit... to die at the hand of the likes of you!

dialogue.speaker: 45FD3EEB46185685E3A67BB06C9190A4
dialogue.line: Is that all you've got? Pathethic!

dialogue.speaker: vladimir
dialogue.line: Let’s see what you’re made of!

dialogue.speaker: E04826AB4DF96A2976D69095FBFDAE0E
dialogue.line: Never!

dialogue.speaker: 096D78A645F3C93DB63B6FB83348EBEF
dialogue.line: No. You did exactly that...

dialogue.speaker: FF0C042746423D9A271B6792BC21428E
dialogue.line: Oh, shut up and fight.

dialogue.speaker: E13487A9412C855E0856C18BB2D2D67C
dialogue.line: Prick!

dialogue.speaker: 9B459C56475B0A8C746D6C94AA18229E
dialogue.line: Quiet!

dialogue.speaker: 31D0F7C543FF217D688FD7ADF30B2EC1
dialogue.line: Sure of yourself, aren't you? Let’s take it outside... enjoy a bit of daylight.

dialogue.speaker: 1C172AAF42FE0FBD6DA9FFA9820FE805
dialogue.line: The sun’s still up, and you’re not exactly at your best… [grunt] Sure you don’t wish to surrender?

dialogue.speaker: 8935963F49F73036DE39B29359EECA23
dialogue.line: Well, what are you waiting for? An invitation?

dialogue.speaker: 47C99FEA4438EBA2E0FAD7A0344D7247
dialogue.line: Bloody titles, bloody stupid crown... I should've killed him the moment he announced that idiotic plan.

dialogue.speaker: 6DED38364F5A5BDF9AFF6B9C39E9FEEC
dialogue.line: But I... I'm not finished! Not yet!

dialogue.speaker: 405F405B49656526A612DEBE76A8A0AB
dialogue.line: Do you really think you make sense, little bird?

dialogue.speaker: 892C80B3470DBEF97202ADA52C0ED05F
dialogue.line: Don't let him distract you! Ignore his nonsense!

dialogue.speaker: C6A8A5224CAC844C0D3D3AA2039E222B
dialogue.line: Fighting for vermin? How disappointing... and dull.

dialogue.speaker: 077218EF4E76734DFD3615B6CE814687
dialogue.line: I'll claim your men, make them my little playthings. Eat whatever parts I fancy! Ha!

dialogue.speaker: 4CC30054496716F9F134199D3380ED71
dialogue.line: It's a gorgeous day outside. Fancy a sunbathe, Bakir?

dialogue.speaker: F313E68D46D30C1FFBD8068D974C5BB8
dialogue.line: Never understood why Brencis spared a pest like you. He's a bloody fool after all...

dialogue.speaker: 5C12A89F418C51155BD69DB9718F8D2F
dialogue.line: Not if you're dead.

dialogue.speaker: 536F28954115864CB1531A844D9B5045
dialogue.line: Skender's son wouldn’t even spare his spit for your grave! Yet you serve him.

dialogue.speaker: 978098B0479A1B30C94F69A8C1A69A0E
dialogue.line: Stuff it, you bastard! I don’t need your bloody lecture!

dialogue.speaker: 0A23D2D94E1E3D03C76C6893E4C6A7BD
dialogue.line: Sunlight won't help you here!

dialogue.speaker: B991E61344390C9A0FA4599BD6D129A6
dialogue.line: Think you're clever? Attacking during the day?

dialogue.speaker: DAE181354A363B9B4FD8C095A5EA93A7
dialogue.line: This is your grand army, oh great Coen of Laslea? A pack of mongrels, scrambling in the dirt? Pathetic!

dialogue.speaker: ADB2B2994D841D8B9C7F9895416D0B2C
dialogue.line: Castle ours!

dialogue.speaker: BACF3C134D6F6B43174DC0A2088DA79C
dialogue.line: Defend blood with blood!

dialogue.speaker: 9B15BD024A06B8FCC8CACCA978E0D4E6
dialogue.line: Defend the knyaz at all costs!

dialogue.speaker: 0B4ACC9445EC3A3FAF365BA74833092D
dialogue.line: Kill the intruders!

dialogue.speaker: 0A03535C4D41EE099F83318D23DAB6C9
dialogue.line: No to human rule!

dialogue.speaker: 5E291C234FB4BF74682DD69A7CD2119E
dialogue.line: Push them back!

dialogue.speaker: 4C563C32448551D3455897A1B5DA26BE
dialogue.line: They can't get any further!

dialogue.speaker: 7CC1349E4AC88E9B086735B9ECB0AE30
dialogue.line: We defend!

dialogue.speaker: A02722A1458B6BF9A458ECBBDBFD9BC3
dialogue.line: We stand ground! We defend!

dialogue.speaker: 429ABE254F87EB7ACED19B9B1DAA9F24
dialogue.line: We'll defend the knyaz with our lives!

dialogue.speaker: B5FA6318431E40560665A29D85E5D250
dialogue.line: We'll hang your heads above the castle's gates!

dialogue.speaker: 5853633743A50418C24679A0E777E3DD
dialogue.line: We'll never bend the knee to Catalin!

dialogue.speaker: E929297D4B6DD58BDD63368CF933938C
dialogue.line: You won't make it any further!

dialogue.speaker: 0EA6FB3249EC899A905E3E86FDF1820C
dialogue.line: You won't take Greifberg!

dialogue.speaker: 754D5BB741EB4AAD2D9163AF43FFECB1
dialogue.line: Hm... There's something underneath...

dialogue.speaker: 843658374B26518A36F80C95AD4FCB88
dialogue.line: Huh, tell me it's our way out of this bloody nightmare.

dialogue.speaker: 1B96DAD1442276B596D1CAB6973D2824
dialogue.line: It’s still better than staying here... Come on.

dialogue.speaker: ECB5A8F74D1B24EF611C069FED0A3C85
dialogue.line: It’s still better than what she has in store for us... Come on.

dialogue.speaker: E6704E7146C5FB95A9E68BAF31EA328B
dialogue.line: Well, we won’t know unless we check it out.

dialogue.speaker: 505CE4A54B6534E4875668A95F0CDCD1
dialogue.line: You think you’ve seen darkness? Just wait. The truth is yet to unfold.

dialogue.speaker: 88BC4A9744FADCFA67EB71AC84B2DBD1
dialogue.line: [grunt] This doesn’t look very promising.

dialogue.speaker: 67BB9A814507C3E31CF2F2915050FFCA
dialogue.line: Do you believe me now?!

dialogue.speaker: 435657F0450E7A461286B69AC77E77CD
dialogue.line: Don't touch it!

dialogue.speaker: CDA09EAB4D2FDA16037F04B6340289AF
dialogue.line: I've never seen anything like it.

dialogue.speaker: 5655368249F4A5EE75964E8387075FCF
dialogue.line: We must tell someone about it.

dialogue.speaker: F751A0504F0EF1B627C2CABABED9B8C8
dialogue.line: What in the Lord's name...?

dialogue.speaker: 12C503464D1FD120C350389AD4FA8BB8
dialogue.line: What the hell is it?

dialogue.speaker: E281961848B776C5BDB5599C81F5BAB0
dialogue.line: God... This never ends...

dialogue.speaker: 64E82ECC44C117776CA4B8B0F2620125
dialogue.line: Who the hell are you?

dialogue.speaker: F4039AF34287F01572AF0EBE0123876E
dialogue.line: I'm, umm... I was just sort... sorting them.

dialogue.speaker: AFDAB54344869C738ED125A866F004ED
dialogue.line: They won't need it anymore...

dialogue.speaker: CB37A3C64C46C10AF67F8C8F84DAF305
dialogue.line: This looks... evil, don't you think?

dialogue.speaker: ED2F9EDA45D479CF613D1F9D7570BDE2
dialogue.line: Who are you? Why are you here?

dialogue.speaker: 4B98BD9B420BA12408AF46866A6E509B
dialogue.line: This thing makes me feel dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: 66133CAC436A338ABBC3B3BD84BCA2FC
dialogue.line: You see that too, don't you?

dialogue.speaker: 0B067FC74E05AD48DE945B8ADCE5059B
dialogue.line: Ah... he must be here somewhere!

dialogue.speaker: AD311C684A3E69BD05782BBE0FFFD15D
dialogue.line: He'll have to go through here. We'll just wait for him.

dialogue.speaker: 5FD4F30B4CC0B68260BC28BB9A419019
dialogue.line: He's not here!

dialogue.speaker: 0DA14CDD42558B41ECEFD6ACBBB72214
dialogue.line: I knew we'd find you!

dialogue.speaker: 9481C5514186E1C63C29D59FD94C9DC7
dialogue.line: Keep searching!

dialogue.speaker: 179F227C410269837B7DEDBA6FCFCAA3
dialogue.line: There he is!

dialogue.speaker: 0AB65B4C45728B581669FD98BE958FE8
dialogue.line: We've been looking for you!

dialogue.speaker: 64E6D5C1477070DAF9447B83AF4AA191
dialogue.line: Are we sure he's alone?

dialogue.speaker: 1115F9624FD6F94ECB9301B0670B80F5
dialogue.line: Shut up and keep looking!

dialogue.speaker: D70F78364DFA4BEFB0C4C2B4582E2673
dialogue.line: Sooner or later, we'll find him.

dialogue.speaker: 6FF5DDA1453CCCD9E152EAB1BD31C842
dialogue.line: Where the hell is he?!

dialogue.speaker: BC46F25E4595300FD526C889FB7BCB12
dialogue.line: Yeah, just a single desperate fuck. We'll handle him.

dialogue.speaker: 04A70ECC4E86FB837D18B4BEBEFA4B0D
dialogue.line: Better to jump ship, before it sinks.

dialogue.speaker: CA20F6B3421EAF8C74B847BB35201F0E
dialogue.line: Brencis blessed me, and I have every intention of paying him back for this gift.

dialogue.speaker: 9AFD44EC43206A90BA753DA83101BF3F
dialogue.line: Busy doing important things I won't let you interrupt.
