dialogue.speaker: E72CCC274A51D8F17BAD088D1B1381A1
dialogue.line: But I think I'll cut your arms and legs first.

dialogue.speaker: 90B42C814AB96B59777761A3CC55C4DB
dialogue.line: But if you're so mighty, why didn't you answer my challenge, I wonder? Why didn't you pick up the gauntlet I threw down?

dialogue.speaker: 1FB5AE2B4CF8E26AF79AEB95A134BD84
dialogue.line: Coen of Laslea, isn't it? You have some audacity, coming here alone.

dialogue.speaker: AC337B414025EF839C34F6B80282999E
dialogue.line: Coen of Laslea, isn't it? You have some audacity, coming here. And you haven't even waited for sunset – for your fangs and claws to grow.

dialogue.speaker: 7BB5CB5E4B3B6A066FF8609CAD4E25AD
dialogue.line: Cutting words. Let's see if you're as good with your sword.

dialogue.speaker: 67A62C6948AAE7F4B51977BCA1B05B1C
dialogue.line: Duels are for men of honour - and you have none.

dialogue.speaker: 1331C71646F69ACEB95DA2B5C0BB2455
dialogue.line: Duels are for men of honour – and you have none.

dialogue.speaker: 1A367BFE40B616E18781A48AF41358AD
dialogue.line: I don't walk into traps willingly.

dialogue.speaker: 425C86D44EA4DB61B440AC8442206C8D
dialogue.line: I don't walk into traps willingly.

dialogue.speaker: 4CC8C4F741066C9654A3CDBEC8EF86FB
dialogue.line: I had better things to do.

dialogue.speaker: 52A78C5745CAA1A73CA0DFB5C09579C7
dialogue.line: I had better things to do.

dialogue.speaker: 37E57B744609C8453D00E3B239F5E504
dialogue.line: I'm fascinated. I feel the urge to ask who you are. And what pushed you towards such a mad deed.

dialogue.speaker: 47B71B2A415A32998746D2BEBA3FAC35
dialogue.line: Like a rat? I don't think so. I'm done scurrying, dodging.

dialogue.speaker: 52E97EA04B889347A81898BB153EA09B
dialogue.line: Listen to me. We don't have to fight. And Brencis's rule won't last forever.

dialogue.speaker: 9DC641934C909778AF6D35BEC998EB7A
dialogue.line: Neither of these things is going to happen.

dialogue.speaker: D98BB76046B761A1DD38DA82380A2BF7
dialogue.line: Oh, you want to topple the knyaz? Adorable... or very desperate.

dialogue.speaker: D5786BE64A017703CA46F9982A000952
dialogue.line: So you killed a few oafs and now you think you can face me?! Or him?

dialogue.speaker: 0D4303B94295FFE38924919005A58ABE
dialogue.line: Step aside - or die.

dialogue.speaker: 52E29CCA449F012BB1E2C1B3FDB7F371
dialogue.line: Step aside - or die.

dialogue.speaker: 17DCD72D4D81BB15E509F8B31D470FCA
dialogue.line: There's many a slip twixt cup and lip... But enough of this chit-chat.

dialogue.speaker: 221EB63F476D3E7864228CAAF8F67012
dialogue.line: Think he took them to a banquet? The blood bags are rotting somewhere in the castle, waiting to be of use.

dialogue.speaker: EF89CC1243CB67A0736C3AB0F3B20F41
dialogue.line: We don't have to fight.

dialogue.speaker: 6623AC3C427D6144C0F0488985B207AD
dialogue.line: We'll bleed you empty.

dialogue.speaker: 60AA8BAF471F2626C6929FAA432234C8
dialogue.line: Where is he now? Your master.

dialogue.speaker: 5723B61243CA1C490C0E5F8B27750D89
dialogue.line: Where is my family?

dialogue.speaker: F576D8584436AAFBD180FD956F2412BB
dialogue.line: Where is my family? Where does Brencis keep them?!

dialogue.speaker: 9D6A4FDE4EC0688D07180087067F7681
dialogue.line: Where's Brencis now?

dialogue.speaker: 2BDDF63D4F33137EF7A6089CBE394A16
dialogue.line: You want him? You've got to go through me first.

dialogue.speaker: 191FAF63438FD382AB50CF8D809F8DC9
dialogue.line: Ah, why not – I'll use all the help I can get.

dialogue.speaker: 2F17DEB1407DECF900113BBFE1FC7CB2
dialogue.line: All the boyars are here.

dialogue.speaker: 4780D92946252298213DA7811F4F8BF8
dialogue.line: Ambrus is guarding the inner keep, Bakir – the dungeons. And Xanthe and her blood guards are somewhere there, too.

dialogue.speaker: 2D743BBB423D0935B379BB93D65EF2D3
dialogue.line: Amen. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: A9987B394E51F015BB1F16B9F032D2B8
dialogue.line: And then... there's Brencis. The devil himself.

dialogue.speaker: D1395E8E43C7E1B44613118254DDF769
dialogue.line: Bakir and Xanthe are dead, thanks be to God...

dialogue.speaker: 6C217AE44FEDF18BD34AB8971E6B9BC1
dialogue.line: Bakir is dead, thanks be to God...

dialogue.speaker: 1462C44C4F8C78FB4EAC58A9B56AC07E
dialogue.line: Better make myself scarce before they see me...

dialogue.speaker: 4EAA654D4900A8E015342F89384BF7DA
dialogue.line: But Ambrus is guarding the inner keep, and Xanthe is somewhere in there with her blood guards, too.

dialogue.speaker: 5E9888A04E36F8DD5994E3A194A5093D
dialogue.line: But Bakir is in the dungeons, still. And Xanthe and her blood guards are somewhere, too.

dialogue.speaker: C9BE11314361D23FC4EB12BE3FE4854D
dialogue.line: But Xanthe and her blood guards are still somewhere there.

dialogue.speaker: B9B8F17D403F4CD4FFA96F97FDEF5CC7
dialogue.line: But her blood guards still run unchecked. Ambrus is guarding the inner keep, Bakir is in the dungeons...

dialogue.speaker: 26BCFEE14BB8301E97DF81BCE7138431
dialogue.line: But the boyaress's blood guards are running unchecked. And Bakir is in the dungeons.

dialogue.speaker: D1A89DED46ED7511B52D3497AE032925
dialogue.line: But the boyaress's blood slaves are running unchecked. And Ambrus guards the inner keep.

dialogue.speaker: A2C1560C45DD76C0F4C8A3A2512FA2D2
dialogue.line: But?

dialogue.speaker: 8BF4F054449BE6A5D8C25DA5580A9C30
dialogue.line: Coen of Laslea... I've been praying for you to Saint Jude the Apostle. Come, quick, before anyone sees.

dialogue.speaker: CCB7A7124F2973A5B1515FB65DE91FF9
dialogue.line: Dear God... What else?

dialogue.speaker: 83BCB46A43D01EFA2D59168C61991E63
dialogue.line: Dear Lord, you let David strike down the mighty Goliath.

dialogue.speaker: 16F949A340467FEBBA7A8292530E1D8B
dialogue.line: Dear Lord, you said onto Samuel: 'Man looks at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart'.

dialogue.speaker: 00E73E70464233AFD5CAF38526710D66
dialogue.line: For though his eyes are like their eyes and his claws like their claws, he may yet become their bane.

dialogue.speaker: 69FD2DBC419EA08EFF302AB2AA2BED7F
dialogue.line: Grant this man the strength and will to end the vrakhiri rule.

dialogue.speaker: A60F362644DFDB2C7D51C8949AD948F6
dialogue.line: Grant this man the strength and will to end the vrakhiri rule.

dialogue.speaker: 863FDA3D45B1BA071025F69502391E35
dialogue.line: Have you seen my family?

dialogue.speaker: 8F990F754E3F1E06F057F193060BBCA9
dialogue.line: Have you seen my family? They're prisoners. Three children and their father.

dialogue.speaker: 0E2CFE534E6371733AE6468C16E97030
dialogue.line: Have you seen my family? They're prisoners. Three children and their parents.

dialogue.speaker: F6F55A05437D99A30C68659EFF869DC0
dialogue.line: Hello...?

dialogue.speaker: 722C7EA14F700FE8F0A48FB52E65C1EB
dialogue.line: Hello...? Anybody there? I'm a friend!

dialogue.speaker: 5BEB0CAB468FC9995ADF6B864C83A26E
dialogue.line: Hm, as you wish.

dialogue.speaker: 0EBF669A43CBD626DE409D904D6D43F8
dialogue.line: I hear the screams.

dialogue.speaker: 39BB16C54835AE2174B805A8C6DAC812
dialogue.line: I shall be back soon.

dialogue.speaker: 7B1EBDF840510F793F95E19CD1F3660B
dialogue.line: I shall be back soon.

dialogue.speaker: A4D99EC147915B6793EA36ADD217B4AF
dialogue.line: I'd rather count on myself.

dialogue.speaker: 1873CA054CA456D06D139486E8399CFD
dialogue.line: I'll use all the help I can get.

dialogue.speaker: A7AE5E8F4A23EEF1AEE794970ED878AA
dialogue.line: I'm here, brother. But know this – once I open this door, there shall be no going back.

dialogue.speaker: E8F66D6841F51DC2758DFDB81EEEC67C
dialogue.line: I'm not sure. No one's seen him in quite some time... And I-I'd bet it isn't a good sign.

dialogue.speaker: 24DD71E546A7EB4C160DAD924BD9E035
dialogue.line: I'm sure you shall prevail.

dialogue.speaker: 9C79295043E992524441B9A6D2E15A3C
dialogue.line: It fits... The moment I walk through this door, all Hell will let loose...

dialogue.speaker: 52BEEB7344024A46A794299E4F683F12
dialogue.line: It's true, I swear!

dialogue.speaker: D587F01C485705C7DC33EFBC22E84020
dialogue.line: Let's see here...

dialogue.speaker: 5C50E946401F7C2621A7369917D0018E
dialogue.line: May the Lord protect you.

dialogue.speaker: 65CD971A4360AAEFA9175DA857007B75
dialogue.line: May you be the light in the darkness he's descending into.

dialogue.speaker: B66105DA4C571ABFA4073BA744F7BF57
dialogue.line: May you rid our valley of this devil. God bless you.

dialogue.speaker: 4811FE5D43A3782A730F43BE9370376D
dialogue.line: No offence, but I'd rather count on myself.

dialogue.speaker: 0BEC7068438987E982AEB4AEE9922878
dialogue.line: No one is allowed to go to the dungeons, except for the guards, of course. But...

dialogue.speaker: 3E0BCF934D1E7BCB10248AA49626488F
dialogue.line: Open up. I'm ready.

dialogue.speaker: DE7424B748C59F65B7454FBDFAB126E9
dialogue.line: Open up. I'm ready.

dialogue.speaker: EEB479CE487908684D99ACB3D27AE59E
dialogue.line: That may not be enough.

dialogue.speaker: F4DCDE574E327AD76BBAADB915CFD53D
dialogue.line: The castle is swarming with soldiers. Better draw your sword.

dialogue.speaker: BB63E486496F6C372CDEA09379A42408
dialogue.line: The worst. Brencis, he made these things... Winged, with scythes for arms...

dialogue.speaker: 90B50BB544F2B7AAA12E95A77975B34F
dialogue.line: Well, with Ambrus and Bakir dead, the regular forces are in dissaray.

dialogue.speaker: 13D20130469B5433777DE2B9B9DCFF74
dialogue.line: Well, with Ambrus and Xanthe dead, the regular forces are in dissaray.

dialogue.speaker: E77C7B6B43FDF288DE2232B9CE4AE27B
dialogue.line: Well, with Ambrus dead, the regular forces are in dissaray.

dialogue.speaker: D4BA2F2E41370F847CB6ACA96DB4D67B
dialogue.line: Well, with the boyars dead, the regular forces are in dissaray. But Xanthe's blood slaves are running unchecked.

dialogue.speaker: 5F0AAD55428392215FC10287E37332F4
dialogue.line: Well... Wish me luck.

dialogue.speaker: 048FF40B427697A23512C9A6B3A80390
dialogue.line: What can I expect?

dialogue.speaker: 9463B1754F023087A4D7329DF1B4A2D4
dialogue.line: What can I expect?

dialogue.speaker: 43020AB145F0CEFE71CE838AB8B27802
dialogue.line: What?!

dialogue.speaker: 7BCDFDE140CA0766B4D0CAB6BAFA53F2
dialogue.line: Where is he?

dialogue.speaker: 6C05CE064B47AA42A9D1F08BF00A86D6
dialogue.line: Why did you pray to Saint Jude, in particular?

dialogue.speaker: 80D2BD724E35DCC44E5FFC8D56849379
dialogue.line: Why did you pray to Saint Jude?

dialogue.speaker: 9ECD1C0B40D32F9B3EC9A98EF4552CB6
dialogue.line: Why not?

dialogue.speaker: D1C4045341CB062C229E95B0369FFD0E
dialogue.line: Wish me luck.

dialogue.speaker: E07513824FF25AE2655407BEBFD9D4E1
dialogue.line: Would you like to pray with me before you go?

dialogue.speaker: D33DF4C849FF2B89248F32B13D7C7D65
dialogue.line: Xanthe is dead, thanks be to God...

dialogue.speaker: 1531EDE5477974E837352DAC69EB8D78
dialogue.line: Yes. I've faced them before. What else?

dialogue.speaker: FFE36D3644A039F25ECDE6BAE705803D
dialogue.line: [go inside]

dialogue.speaker: 35F4DC0F452E4C08F2FF498AEE946AC8
dialogue.line: [knock using Florin's signal]

dialogue.speaker: C92CDD964545562F7A935AB3FBA9A95B
dialogue.line: [knock]

dialogue.speaker: 3F7899DE419520E5C6886ABD2A1FFEBF
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 4D818E2949B243BA7B887A9D30B97192
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: 27332ABB4B5B439C5140BC99C8ED9A41
dialogue.line: [scoff] Well, isn't he the patron saint of hopeless cases?

dialogue.speaker: 2ED07FA946CFF5C9FC1456880BE7AC52
dialogue.line: [sigh] Come on, come on...

dialogue.speaker: E91477D34B044418729FA0BF746090E8
dialogue.line: [sigh] Either I don't sound convincing enough... or nobody's there.

dialogue.speaker: AF9F88514A16796580B15C9DB292E0AA
dialogue.line: [sigh] I guess it's not that easy.

dialogue.speaker: 7468E33C45ED1C68BBB59395FBDB29C2
dialogue.line: [sigh] No going back now...

dialogue.speaker: 0B0DC57142425C7B861A2C95A968653E
dialogue.line: [use the key]

dialogue.speaker: E8B67A57484CC316E87072860B75B4C8
dialogue.line: Can't you see the gate is shut? Off with you!

dialogue.speaker: 753EC94040E3828E16E4DEB1E3929B2F
dialogue.line: Do you see that? On the wall.

dialogue.speaker: 688E1BF343233C95728790AC789A0D10
dialogue.line: Eh, just a shadow. What else would it be?

dialogue.speaker: AC10B32940E9BB7E7CA199B315DC295A
dialogue.line: Huh? Nah.

dialogue.speaker: E8C2C6B4422436C9C365F4AC4EEBBF80
dialogue.line: I didn't. And you're half-blind.

dialogue.speaker: 4749B070462E4E0256C990B0E052CF40
dialogue.line: I think I saw something.

dialogue.speaker: AF69205441F2A8B3644095BE47F0040C
dialogue.line: No entrance! Go away!

dialogue.speaker: 1C71AEB541BB25257E7C7FB7FBABD1C8
dialogue.line: Nobody enters the keep!

dialogue.speaker: 09689B0C411CB812901B0E99E1467A87
dialogue.line: Something moved on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: 09065C4E4E8DADE87B5E1E971B522FE8
dialogue.line: Intruder! Sound the alarm!

dialogue.speaker: 429274074A98D9A1857BF9B76EA1015E
dialogue.line: Farewell, Ambrus.

dialogue.speaker: 49518D984200E7851799F29EB49C15E8
dialogue.line: Farewell, Ambrus.

dialogue.speaker: 1DCC9DF149F3DD2207445790309BFC34
dialogue.line: [drain Ambrus's blood]

dialogue.speaker: 39425CE74F516F826C83B5BF18AE3A49
dialogue.line: [kill Ambrus]

dialogue.speaker: 202A4A834D1561B1226C5D8F85E538A5
dialogue.line: And the prisoners?

dialogue.speaker: 4FE066F74EEC84F78A2EFFAD11573D20
dialogue.line: Burn in Hell.

dialogue.speaker: EA4D414A40113FB4F4D9F5B37CB128A3
dialogue.line: Ghhkkk! And now, I'm holding you to your promise.

dialogue.speaker: 69040D34488442B8F4DBAEAEF345274E
dialogue.line: Ghhkkk! Oh, do it already. Kill me!

dialogue.speaker: 7EA364E544A10D366BA4F5A5DAF7EDF2
dialogue.line: Go on. Kill me!

dialogue.speaker: F2AB475C44D1F81AF567258864BD9BCB
dialogue.line: Grrrr...!

dialogue.speaker: 8A6F91FD438A0636D950A7B5A65B77BB
dialogue.line: He went to the dungeons. To the prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: A3390B1648B1E9309D19BE909C174EDE
dialogue.line: I can't be bothered dealing with you now.

dialogue.speaker: E051F1D04E8ADDBED14E95B3EF447AD5
dialogue.line: I can't be bothered dealing with you now.

dialogue.speaker: 3D15368546D3613E48222ABAFB09EA37
dialogue.line: I don't know. But it isn't the first time. Each time he comes back, he seems stronger.

dialogue.speaker: F217F84849023FEA0A33319B3E561178
dialogue.line: Only the knyaz comes back.

dialogue.speaker: 7DDE99B34D06366645C9D2A77F1B3C33
dialogue.line: Tell me where Brencis is and I'll do it right away.

dialogue.speaker: 54A992B0479A3D8145820887ED20D08D
dialogue.line: The prisoners? Why?

dialogue.speaker: F4660B154190ECD4D83FDDAAF5452F77
dialogue.line: The prisoners? Why?

dialogue.speaker: 6F83422844544EB3B93C1585EACA0DDE
dialogue.line: [kill him]

dialogue.speaker: D2C8EBA94C07C3F4DFC377AB048016B6
dialogue.line: [drain Xanthe's blood]

dialogue.speaker: 8019B03B40DC52960E40F6BA7936A0AE
dialogue.line: [exhale] You've lived long enough, Xanthe.

dialogue.speaker: C76725374426066CD4E8E88D2DA89578
dialogue.line: [exhale] You've lived long enough, Xanthe.

dialogue.speaker: 02D973AD47B40444F63BD7A4253E433F
dialogue.line: [kill Xanthe]

dialogue.speaker: F59BBAB546C4F2AA7C197A869E4C21FA
dialogue.line: Don't listen to him!

dialogue.speaker: AA1D26F84042C1D1022644B6E8C82413
dialogue.line: Kill him and I'll grant you freedom! And gold! And whores!

dialogue.speaker: 579EB1F04E0DDE032E88B7BB024A8F77
dialogue.line: You'll regret this, Bakir.

dialogue.speaker: 3A8D3B65410803EEEEF395AFFE480316
dialogue.line: And this was just the right time.

dialogue.speaker: 390A9CF2423D4DF75259C0B0E23C1673
dialogue.line: As you wish, then. But we aren't spending a minute more in this hellhole. Farewell.

dialogue.speaker: AC954D7F467554FFED9FADB26DC9C52D
dialogue.line: But... they didn't know that we'd been planning our escape since Bakir had given up the ghost.

dialogue.speaker: BEB2B4AC4D8C0FDF6D520BA104A869ED
dialogue.line: Do you know where Brencis is?

dialogue.speaker: E85DDAA34D9A0A0616FF76BE0C9F1FA5
dialogue.line: Do you know where Brencis is?

dialogue.speaker: 7C9D469D421D4FF20A98CEA8ED6EBB51
dialogue.line: Get out of our way.

dialogue.speaker: B2A8C3D1487B2079150D5A9B251C0E86
dialogue.line: How did you get out of the cells?

dialogue.speaker: C8DA626E4C1C6E991752328EFFEF9701
dialogue.line: How did you manage to get out?

dialogue.speaker: C93C3573416FC34FD9C940A95B051AF3
dialogue.line: I can't. I have to get Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 2AEB8E804B44B8674AF7619EB8190E06
dialogue.line: I can't. My family needs me.

dialogue.speaker: B3C1162C42FFE416400F7A9F5BAEACD3
dialogue.line: I have to go there.

dialogue.speaker: FF66F1954A6F18E4728CDCB46EE4C113
dialogue.line: I need to find my family. And you're free because of me. I'm the one that killed Bakir.

dialogue.speaker: 2DF1E0F94C039F44CEA12281930B1222
dialogue.line: I need to kill Brencis. And you're free because of me. I'm the one that killed Bakir.

dialogue.speaker: 37B5A6564E383E2B121DD5A585277EF7
dialogue.line: I need you there with me.

dialogue.speaker: 159A63704FB8C084CE9AE1B601F82C0D
dialogue.line: I've got to go there.

dialogue.speaker: 7744114D42FB08292A6CD99B43C4DCDB
dialogue.line: In the pit, probably. He orders the prisoners to be taken there.

dialogue.speaker: F64C480A4C8D5EC99E6571BF5C06EF52
dialogue.line: It's deeper underground. A place people don't come back from.

dialogue.speaker: D917654B45B21F134F9E4F8553AD285F
dialogue.line: Leaving this fucking prison.

dialogue.speaker: 7F7800DB4F759B0AFE39C5A3CE79B883
dialogue.line: So if you'll excuse us, we're leaving this hellhole. Farewell.

dialogue.speaker: 6C706D0445A8A8AF113374A81F5589F2
dialogue.line: The guards tried to move us from our cell, along with the others.

dialogue.speaker: DB12DF8B4313FB19984AD59107533203
dialogue.line: What are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: E22C38474268F1AF700B1BAE619794FE
dialogue.line: What is this pit?

dialogue.speaker: 1391342E4C102739B9AE1DAD6AAF3FBC
dialogue.line: What? Did you fall of a horse?! Just go with us!

dialogue.speaker: 1FAD7A1A490BE768AE572BB45E84EA3D
dialogue.line: What? Did you fall off a horse?!

dialogue.speaker: 9095E8C44024468F7CE36EBC0DD03C12
dialogue.line: Will you go there with me? I could use your help.

dialogue.speaker: F246B78E47BDAD12B2FCAE97A47082E2
dialogue.line: Yeah, mate, don't get me wrong, but... I've seen my share of mad people in these dungeons. You sound like one of them.

dialogue.speaker: 09D50A76408430C7B73B5CBAD661ADAF
dialogue.line: Let me out of here!

dialogue.speaker: 673D4DAD4DF27F67A62AD494E9442778
dialogue.line: The hound handler had the keys last time I saw him!

dialogue.speaker: FAA2A35D4D4504978742F290643F06BA
dialogue.line: Brencis was here?

dialogue.speaker: FD60E62C4B26FE4FB7467FA6324A2D62
dialogue.line: Brencis was here?

dialogue.speaker: A960E560454D41D9487F7992209D54DF
dialogue.line: Can you find a way out by yourself?

dialogue.speaker: FC47BB9443F316D04F3767A9A2D09EE3
dialogue.line: Can you find a way out?

dialogue.speaker: 2FF9BF9A45D762A7B4851C932D3FA3C4
dialogue.line: Children? Yeah, I heard some crying, I guess. But there's nothing you can do for them now. Let's get going!

dialogue.speaker: 98AE5C1242DF457C2BEDC88C40FB18E4
dialogue.line: Each time he comes back, he's covered in blood from head to fucking toe.

dialogue.speaker: 6A0547424CCF8DEC38D67CA43631E181
dialogue.line: Go. I'm staying.

dialogue.speaker: 06D6456543DAE4CB43C8CBB404067826
dialogue.line: Have you seen a family? With three children. Did he take them there?

dialogue.speaker: 2883F12A4078DB24380BC4A8EB21C6DB
dialogue.line: I have to get there.

dialogue.speaker: 351F1DD8499C0574619E059E1DF3897A
dialogue.line: I have to go there.

dialogue.speaker: B44554E8407D16E7AA0A1A926882D984
dialogue.line: It's deep. Very deep! The prisoners... They scream... No one comes back!

dialogue.speaker: D4B0AED448EA45566DEC05B90B6A9A82
dialogue.line: Let's go! Quick! Before he comes back!

dialogue.speaker: CAB789934EF13EA31690A6888A9A8E67
dialogue.line: Listen, I don't know and I don't want to! Some dark shite!

dialogue.speaker: C5AF0C324FBC9027D7FCB2B4BB157B7B
dialogue.line: So unless you want to bump into him, let's move!

dialogue.speaker: 19AFD217488F786224EE0BA3126214A1
dialogue.line: The pit! He went to the pit! It's our chance – now or never!

dialogue.speaker: 7B83585C4ED2B0A77DD5BE9BE22738CB
dialogue.line: What is Brencis doing to the prisoners there?

dialogue.speaker: DE97673845D0D4E4A86700B4510C7456
dialogue.line: What is he doing there?

dialogue.speaker: 3FB783174AA29D0EA5EAD7B9A8937823
dialogue.line: What is this pit?

dialogue.speaker: 6412E0E242359A2648E780B805B01C58
dialogue.line: What is this pit?

dialogue.speaker: 9E64C3A6418ED64ED8FC60B58F420BA8
dialogue.line: Yes! I'll show you. Come on!

dialogue.speaker: 8C94910846FD606BE0B759B8AA661AEE
dialogue.line: You'll lose your mind! But if that's what you want – go ahead! I'm out of here!

dialogue.speaker: FFE4A42047F5740438FE4D86BBA3433D
dialogue.line: You... what? No. They'll kill you! You've got to come with me!

dialogue.speaker: 2FB24C2F446409163EA9FBAE8986DF63
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: E51474B443776BCC5358C1A4F8CFC425
dialogue.line: Aaaaaaaaa.... aaaaaaaarhg.... aaaa!

dialogue.speaker: 70B02EFB4DAAA8F837557294D070342D
dialogue.line: Aaaarg... no, no, have... Have mercy... Don't... Don't take me to the pit!

dialogue.speaker: 251552DA43D9BFF1B6B34C84959002F1
dialogue.line: Free? Go... but where? Ah, I don't... remember.

dialogue.speaker: 1C6F03474976AE9AF63037814960B192
dialogue.line: I'm not taking you anywhere. You're free. You can go.

dialogue.speaker: A630E4FE456F4751924D5DBD251D6EEE
dialogue.line: No. No! You aren't taking me there! Aaaaaarg!

dialogue.speaker: 7D9D9F904B2A3AFE6A642284F14A39C4
dialogue.line: This pit... What do you know about it?

dialogue.speaker: 260BE3C74493F041DDBA269C77AC562F
dialogue.line: What is this pit?

dialogue.speaker: E35CD98E452E8B9EA969B1A245CE452B
dialogue.line: What's the pit?

dialogue.speaker: 2B70BB924921586BEEE175AFFECCCF9E
dialogue.line: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: 6B439EC24648FD532427F791CEBF993A
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: A5283EBA400E365709B466926A41F36B
dialogue.line: [inhales] It's ancient. The guards... they s... they said... old spirits speak... They want blood...

dialogue.speaker: D35E0E4544F09D007FEFA2B02FBA5E9B
dialogue.line: ...and start all over again – and again.

dialogue.speaker: 5550F7C24E841B4B95D4529950CE4D2F
dialogue.line: An, you knit your brows just like your little brother! Ah, such a small head... It fit between my fingers, like so.

dialogue.speaker: DB933905494804A7AA898895D1569268
dialogue.line: Answer me!

dialogue.speaker: 07A318A34DE5254424938682025C57EC
dialogue.line: Bah, I've heard that before – from men three times your size.

dialogue.speaker: E4CBC7E7406F613E0E2E5C8B2340EC9C
dialogue.line: But of course! They were guests of honour here. It was only proper I dealt with them myself!

dialogue.speaker: DB1356304829DDA6D512F39C1A63263E
dialogue.line: But that's the past. I am vermin no more. Nor will I be insulted by one.

dialogue.speaker: 88F7A7E04D7D5DBA5D44E1A0C031FB0E
dialogue.line: But trust me – you don't want to see this. Just crawl into a cage and wait for your turn.

dialogue.speaker: BECB49814B87B369B16A86AAAC289543
dialogue.line: Did you torture my family, too?

dialogue.speaker: C251EE08413D345E4AE8A0B1E4E5E097
dialogue.line: Fight you? Don't be ridiculous. I'll just squash you and wipe my boot on a rock.

dialogue.speaker: 55ED42C943C450B03AC43DB3752FB520
dialogue.line: How about you find yourself a cage?

dialogue.speaker: 7548C9F74D2D764E3F793BA56DC443A2
dialogue.line: How about you go find yourself a cage? I'll beat your arse, lock you up and let you rot here. You'll see what it's like, huh?

dialogue.speaker: 6CE14219424307B927DC1B93847696B0
dialogue.line: I came here to kill you, Bakir.

dialogue.speaker: 3550A7B44512B53BD57367A122B889C3
dialogue.line: I crushed it like a grape.

dialogue.speaker: A7F75A6548A251848AC6E69ABA5B104A
dialogue.line: Maybe you thought I'd be asleep? Wanted to sneak up on me? Well, not this time, little vermin.

dialogue.speaker: A0AD0A5B4C2CF364157A959E36FF271D
dialogue.line: My family... Did you torture them, too?

dialogue.speaker: B5DECAE2487F100BAF27D9814F56530E
dialogue.line: My family... three children and their father. Did you torture them, too?

dialogue.speaker: 3FF070C44FF9467CFE060481C3565D0B
dialogue.line: My family... three children and their parents. Did you torture them, too?

dialogue.speaker: 5565E5A24AC056169344CB8BBF422D83
dialogue.line: Oh, hello, little vermin! You should be in your cage.

dialogue.speaker: 973309704ABAA5A95527BD96E1B986A7
dialogue.line: Oh, no. No, no, no.

dialogue.speaker: 8235530E4F794EB47C2B6AA9337FC211
dialogue.line: Oh, we'll have so much fun together.... I will torture you, then wait for your wounds to heal...

dialogue.speaker: 3416A8084A045E9E75A3018BAE444BE0
dialogue.line: Oh, wouldn't you want to know! That must be torture in itself. The uncertainty! The worry! Haha!

dialogue.speaker: 39B4AC17475DCDD3E8F9E3B0B20E7BA2
dialogue.line: Oh, yes, yes! Children, you see... they never act tough, don't pretend they can't feel the pain.

dialogue.speaker: 4F642D124DB7F2AC4CD462868E5CB651
dialogue.line: Oh, you think I haven't had my share? The steppe was a cruel mother to me. The orda taught me a hundred kinds of pain.

dialogue.speaker: DC72544945989A2A9E54F09FF14C98DA
dialogue.line: Or wait... I know who you are.

dialogue.speaker: 6B98A1F94577413A7FBE8290C33A84BC
dialogue.line: Or wait... You aren't just vermin, are you? You're something else, as well.

dialogue.speaker: 257D17D344E603B80265E79BA48DF48E
dialogue.line: Shut up and fight me.

dialogue.speaker: 7FB435DB4F7C61A22157888FFE0334F5
dialogue.line: Shut up and fight me.

dialogue.speaker: 4C5BD75D4A06EB5F2B64BBA88DA966C3
dialogue.line: They are a part of something bigger now! Or they will be in a moment.

dialogue.speaker: 66BA68E14C28EE3A2407159A33E98AB7
dialogue.line: They're... so natural. I love that about them.

dialogue.speaker: AB627E3C40855B61514FC4ADD808F9A8
dialogue.line: Where are you keeping my family?!

dialogue.speaker: 242E60B2453FDF83914845BCAD9747A4
dialogue.line: Where are you keeping my family?! Where's Pieter of Laslea?!

dialogue.speaker: 536B651C45F347DE8E3B12BBF4C64AB3
dialogue.line: You sick fuck!

dialogue.speaker: 271CEC6541C36255BE2DEC98595F6DB1
dialogue.line: Your liege did this to me.

dialogue.speaker: 4E153FE04F924B68D1ADCA833A4EF07A
dialogue.line: You won't be missed, Bakir.

dialogue.speaker: 8BFF94CA47ED8C0DFBE5F2947EFA32BC
dialogue.line: You won't be missed, Bakir.

dialogue.speaker: 0E5D91BC46107E414F44ADB6C0F50371
dialogue.line: [drain Bakir's blood]

dialogue.speaker: 428B661548D9232A31AFEF9E90A14419
dialogue.line: [kill Bakir]

dialogue.speaker: 373C3EB74EDDAA0CE58345BCEF671D6A
dialogue.line: Aaaaaargh!

dialogue.speaker: FB7E575C4B3B3E1955DC8EA01110EA22
dialogue.line: Don't do this!

dialogue.speaker: 46BDFEDE42EAC58FA4735892C70D3D58
dialogue.line: He's mine!

dialogue.speaker: CBA7FE5E417DE0748A68B0B33ECA9506
dialogue.line: Let's make it quick!

dialogue.speaker: F3706CBB4CD163C4E87A1FA3CA406530
dialogue.line: Sorry, lad!

dialogue.speaker: CB892F6E486BB109563A0FA1D12E054D
dialogue.line: Stop it!

dialogue.speaker: 5F4A2CA64DF5C830EACC64A190360161
dialogue.line: Help me! Help me finish this!

dialogue.speaker: 413B674940D72044D7DC4DB5045BD843
dialogue.line: I'm not done yet! Help me!

dialogue.speaker: B60E0453411B5052CA1D9598C9AD1A2B
dialogue.line: No! You ruined it!

dialogue.speaker: 0898C25049B15B2B82FAD3BB4FE914E9
dialogue.line: He left me... Said my blood's too thin now... That it's of no use...

dialogue.speaker: ECEA0B3D4AEA80C92538619EF6E29121
dialogue.line: I'm... not leaving... this place, am I?

dialogue.speaker: C9EBAB184B0C628DE36FFDA2E7EA492E
dialogue.line: Let's see where this leads.

dialogue.speaker: 611A6E274C24F0917FA98F8A6A191B95
dialogue.line: There's something here.

dialogue.speaker: F9D7602E4D51F65D298FA593A3B70DE1
dialogue.line: Ah! Good to see you again, Coen, son of Pieter.

dialogue.speaker: F95ABE494148599E1B49F2B978ED495C
dialogue.line: Ah! Here comes our hero.

dialogue.speaker: BB9E22AE4322A6BF7FE3968F450B46D7
dialogue.line: Ah, of course. Without the Lord's mercy, we're... we're sure to be doomed.

dialogue.speaker: DE9A260D45564BF8840A1C8853F83024
dialogue.line: Ah. A most generous gift.

dialogue.speaker: A0EEB4BF45D276075835C9BD09E6B89E
dialogue.line: Ah. I understand. Certain memories are hard to erase.

dialogue.speaker: 20AF794A41A9347ECCD6049B40150772
dialogue.line: Ah. Pity.

dialogue.speaker: 10892F984023DF54F40E739F864C5DCF
dialogue.line: Ah. The church needs a new paten, a corporal, not to mention fixing the lavabo... The costs add up.

dialogue.speaker: 17CA278148C98BB99794DB973436E085
dialogue.line: As you can see, we're making good progress.

dialogue.speaker: 18369CA5455A5064C0C77F9DB7C72EE4
dialogue.line: Be it with prayer... Or in more tangible ways.

dialogue.speaker: 6DC9056B48AE19DE69781F95AD47F9E9
dialogue.line: Blessed be His name, today and for all eternity.

dialogue.speaker: 2AB6EE2D44560DFE1CD9D780F86926C4
dialogue.line: But for our prayers to be heard, certain rites need to be observed.

dialogue.speaker: FA8CB89F4E578460D54FC9AF98D01FCC
dialogue.line: But we must try to rid our souls of the stain.

dialogue.speaker: B838FE74458706A1D770C7A5829135D5
dialogue.line: But, to answer your question... I came to oversee the preparations required for the church's reconsecration.

dialogue.speaker: 2B7B03A74525DA94A46176BD4DAF9A34
dialogue.line: Congratulations are in order, then.

dialogue.speaker: 5DA751BD407271973FEE93A72E39F927
dialogue.line: Congratulations are in order, then.

dialogue.speaker: B42EEC4A4FF1E793EF42ED908CFC77A8
dialogue.line: Consider the fate of your eternal soul.

dialogue.speaker: BBC9741B495AB2B916B64193E055D308
dialogue.line: Father Florin? Didn't expect to see you here.

dialogue.speaker: 57C22D934280D15A75C799BC77AE325F
dialogue.line: Father Florin? I didn't expect to see you here.

dialogue.speaker: B36BA2A44349E7797582F69B90C2D340
dialogue.line: For me, this place will forever be cursed.

dialogue.speaker: D92E9E724D54F30F400A7B825F7EA616
dialogue.line: For me, this place will forever be cursed.

dialogue.speaker: 0BFBB56D4C06F89C5CA04BB3E77841AD
dialogue.line: God works in mysterious ways.

dialogue.speaker: 6E45673C4A7A2940544882AFBD95B970
dialogue.line: Greetings, father. How goes it?

dialogue.speaker: B8668C9A4A69014967049DAD8426E9A7
dialogue.line: Hah. God truly works in mysterious ways.

dialogue.speaker: 3EB5ED1744A704B21127A4A196DC4DE7
dialogue.line: I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: E3899D5C4B066EFBBB5A6EB1579E1837
dialogue.line: I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: 512CE6F1432AC07A587A1F9CA2C4E5BC
dialogue.line: I'll make a contribution, then.

dialogue.speaker: 8871203149C0F8F2A287D4BDFA119124
dialogue.line: I'll make a contribution, then.

dialogue.speaker: CE706B024189BA5F5865A6B4FFC3D36A
dialogue.line: Indeed. In recognition of my struggles against the Adversary, I have been elevated to the rank of bishop.

dialogue.speaker: 494D2C62486C8BC1D113CA8128B719EB
dialogue.line: It brings me joy to hear that.

dialogue.speaker: 8A6D275B41CCC50CB16EC790EEA19789
dialogue.line: It brings me joy to hear that.

dialogue.speaker: E1029D4042C4AE72250F2D8EE732B2A3
dialogue.line: It's 'Your Excellency' now.

dialogue.speaker: C3818D2F4586D3C560B0D7BFDE7F49BF
dialogue.line: Like father, like son.

dialogue.speaker: FB99BDB84601DD7221D818A5A41EF8C9
dialogue.line: May God watch over you.

dialogue.speaker: D5354DB840A42E5CC85D6790A32E542F
dialogue.line: Of course, there's much yet to be done.

dialogue.speaker: B8BE31314B93200A17F7E18EBBB9C0D0
dialogue.line: Peace be with you, son.

dialogue.speaker: 44D6B238488A52A48752D98C6821EC58
dialogue.line: People are worried about starvation - and you're after donations?

dialogue.speaker: C144B35A4645998FE54119B619F3DB7D
dialogue.line: People are worried about starving when winter comes – and you're asking for donations?

dialogue.speaker: 5770154946E380288D5E728C774CAC1E
dialogue.line: So he does. Hence the need for guidance from the clergy.

dialogue.speaker: 237C8D6F43359C0C14E220ABC0C75C8A
dialogue.line: Some apples fall far from the tree, it seems.

dialogue.speaker: 37C3D2B04C2E644F967FAFAEC0F9C741
dialogue.line: Soon, the church shall be cleansed of all evil and we will gather here to praise the name of our Lord again.

dialogue.speaker: 3DCB1DAD47722B1C4A127AB16155A7E9
dialogue.line: Soon, the faithful will wake up to the tolling bells again.

dialogue.speaker: 22E611624260A306E05DBDBA4FBBA8C1
dialogue.line: Thank you, son.

dialogue.speaker: F8073BD649340E913F45FC9AE12479F0
dialogue.line: Which reminds me... We were wondering if you'd be willing to support this humble congregation.

dialogue.speaker: EC21CA3D42C66F2F03D160BCDA40F03E
dialogue.line: You may arrive at Heaven's Gate later than most... And it might take special convincing for St. Peter to let you through.

dialogue.speaker: F1023F3A4B81747409599EBF56769F45
dialogue.line: Again? Mirto, I think you already know everything by heart.

dialogue.speaker: A242F37B4FD2FDA8F520B99651FC1CCC
dialogue.line: And even now... You're still doing it, aren't you? And we don't say anything... I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 4843520543CDA703D734279917B050A9
dialogue.line: And it's not like I'll leave if you need me!

dialogue.speaker: 2E155A904239F7BD03ECE29D6A77D203
dialogue.line: And with... with mum. But she's more... more like a ghost...

dialogue.speaker: 9003D95B4ADF2ECC235C7A94CBD31D83
dialogue.line: And you... you've just told Mirto that it's alright for him to leave too!

dialogue.speaker: E07281D5429231243DBD8587D0DB7E85
dialogue.line: Coen! Tell us about your adventures!

dialogue.speaker: F79F4C2246E21C1CCE2867BC8D2E06C7
dialogue.line: Coen! Tell us about your fight with the knyaz!

dialogue.speaker: 30213C2947B240174DA9CCA5D36BAE33
dialogue.line: Come on, Mirto. Let's leave him to his business.

dialogue.speaker: 2F21384244EF32DB344CDE81E9465622
dialogue.line: Come, Mirto. As soon as we're done here, we can play for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: A0EDC0CA40E03D313DAA788AFF949ED9
dialogue.line: Don't be silly.

dialogue.speaker: EF3EBA114BDF8C4CB2C6E69F497E2BF7
dialogue.line: Don't let anyone stop you, Mirto.

dialogue.speaker: 83177486474A0DEA0FDE3A8D43266B2E
dialogue.line: Don't let anyone stop you, Mirto. If you want to leave – go, and don't look back.

dialogue.speaker: B7A26515425B0A4A7AE857B530955AE5
dialogue.line: Family... It means a lot. But it can mean too much, too.

dialogue.speaker: FD593FDF46B55B3A31144DA69F205860
dialogue.line: God, you're right. For so long... you've been there for us. You took care of Mirto... Of Lunka.

dialogue.speaker: 0C2DB2554629D3A6714598BDA3B292EC
dialogue.line: Hey, don't talk to him like that!

dialogue.speaker: 8B9094EC4B39ABF3030512A2A585EB3B
dialogue.line: Hey, don't talk to him like that!

dialogue.speaker: A74A14D146F697B7AAFFA8861DBCC1CF
dialogue.line: Hey, hey. Look at me. Don't build a prison for yourself. Please.

dialogue.speaker: 8E864B8F41397C4087D2A4A06E6F46A8
dialogue.line: I just said I'm not.

dialogue.speaker: 0E35A5A34BB2EED33141BC8ACEF08952
dialogue.line: I know it won't solve everything... but I hope it'll help.

dialogue.speaker: 12715B464B0B97F48690D3A4D1637186
dialogue.line: I know. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 978A699F458A0601D9F9E894C4DD6778
dialogue.line: I know... And I'm sorry. I wish things were different...

dialogue.speaker: C0B265BE454675AB46B2F28025C33B79
dialogue.line: I put some denarii aside... More than I could possibly need. Would make a nice dowry.

dialogue.speaker: 27EB6EA64B86D25207189E8BED1A3452
dialogue.line: I'll always find time for you – hero or not.

dialogue.speaker: C74473A44F4CBF828294A280C22E6B93
dialogue.line: I'll always have time for you.

dialogue.speaker: 91F69D3047F8CA9816AA0EB277B0E4E6
dialogue.line: I'm not a hero, Mirto.

dialogue.speaker: 9392BEBE4D40DADF024E55867E7CDDEB
dialogue.line: I'm not really a hero, Mirto.

dialogue.speaker: 6430F05F472E0AAAF651D2B2DCDB9CF8
dialogue.line: I'm... I... [sobs]

dialogue.speaker: D979D30045F8041BD7CE579265E6518C
dialogue.line: It will only be me. With dad.

dialogue.speaker: 351B9ACD480519FDD31825851588070B
dialogue.line: It's fine. Come, Mirto. Coen has important things to do.

dialogue.speaker: 405BACA744FBA88180375F99CD274064
dialogue.line: Just take it. Please. Use it to build a future for yourself.

dialogue.speaker: CFE1ED8F482B46A67BE979AEFE1D5A87
dialogue.line: Listen, I didn't mean to –

dialogue.speaker: A6206C1D41B258A7BB564699E6941FDD
dialogue.line: Me too.

dialogue.speaker: B18BA6D241B84E268C8C20A183E89A3D
dialogue.line: Mirto! Shut up already!

dialogue.speaker: 5AEAFE8D42BB18838D7186A9DE5DF3CB
dialogue.line: Mirto, you can't just –

dialogue.speaker: 74742FDC4B32E4AEDD30A9BD4FE19599
dialogue.line: No, no. I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: DC5FB42F4A79B541C13937B8E6D80799
dialogue.line: Not soon, but yes.

dialogue.speaker: FEF38DF64187DF5B525805844BCDBEC9
dialogue.line: Of course you'll have a dowry.

dialogue.speaker: 960F38704615EF4AD9D57EA5C8C668FD
dialogue.line: Oh, Coen... Shouldn't you be going?

dialogue.speaker: 1EE372B94FE1A3230B32FC90BE30CB22
dialogue.line: Oh, don't bother him. You know Coen doesn't have time for us. He has important things to do.

dialogue.speaker: DB2C0667402FECEF04B228851F909D60
dialogue.line: Oh, stop it Yanna! You're not my mum!

dialogue.speaker: D854C92847B87E7FEEBC26A57EDBC593
dialogue.line: Right. I must be strong.

dialogue.speaker: 55EE18FA40FA669FDD3F7281286B80BD
dialogue.line: So much has happened... You see it, right? Both of you? That... that I'm different.

dialogue.speaker: 4FFA22244291CF89A9CE61B672F3832D
dialogue.line: Sure you are! You fought the vrakhiri and got back our home!

dialogue.speaker: 71A4CEC445DE05D5AD8966A1AA2A6804
dialogue.line: Thank you. I just wish – Ah, it doesn't matter. I know you have things to do. Go, we'll manage.

dialogue.speaker: CFE7EA484036EAE2403DC1A1A98C9586
dialogue.line: That's no reason to give up.

dialogue.speaker: B092E4FB4D2D99EA653EF2ACE9E4C37A
dialogue.line: That's why you must be strong. For our family. For me.

dialogue.speaker: C864F97F4B65E843010611AAFCED11BF
dialogue.line: This world of ours, the hand you've been dealt – it's rotten, I know. But that's not a reason to give up. Right, Mirto?

dialogue.speaker: EE60F5594249B1DD563B16A9A35617EC
dialogue.line: Well... yeah. But not anytime soon.

dialogue.speaker: 7D227E5C48F5F0768B31F69C21AB7502
dialogue.line: What? No, I can't –

dialogue.speaker: 20AC59B247349934BAF7FFA358DC6117
dialogue.line: When I get older, I'm going to travel the world, just like you! Have my own adventures. Maybe better than yours!

dialogue.speaker: 305B3A5E417DE4C90CAB7D9408C801AC
dialogue.line: Who'd take me? No dowry, family who – [scoff]

dialogue.speaker: 9A5B807F4690589A9BB62CB205B4A64E
dialogue.line: Why do you care, Coen? All this crap – it won't be your problem anymore, right?

dialogue.speaker: 12CCE8C94E38DEB924032F8DE43C432E
dialogue.line: Why would you be worried?

dialogue.speaker: 40D77D864A98DC5D8FDD43B5E77A75F3
dialogue.line: Yanna said that you're not staying in Laslea. She said that because Lunka –

dialogue.speaker: 7B4A5777408E9F3E58210DB523D2FC27
dialogue.line: Yanna, is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: AD6828684713BC296C560F8A73CCCA89
dialogue.line: Yanna, is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: D08DA00E4B41345CEFE721B8A65110F6
dialogue.line: Yanna, what's going on?

dialogue.speaker: F9666FC24DA9B3E5F8A133A55BA3DC61
dialogue.line: Yanna, what's going on?

dialogue.speaker: F78BA6FB4DCFE4EA4943708C02EDD68D
dialogue.line: Yanna, you don't need to worry about the money.

dialogue.speaker: 664775DA4979F34BFF1BE9851DD25189
dialogue.line: Yanna. Live your life.

dialogue.speaker: 7C89F83E484A97456EC0528C6F6F78F3
dialogue.line: Yanna. Live your life.

dialogue.speaker: 8760F6FB44FCE96D13280DA6F18C52DA
dialogue.line: Yanna...  You're scared, aren't you? I'm scared too. Truth be told... I've been scared for a very long time now.

dialogue.speaker: 9939BD2F4A18070D0185D8A4C0D03DF4
dialogue.line: Yeah!

dialogue.speaker: 84000E1F41AC1FCCECFDF4AD68E425E1
dialogue.line: Yeah, he does! Because he's a hero!

dialogue.speaker: 6CFBDD6B451BBF1FF51EFBBA2B2DD21C
dialogue.line: You must be strong.

dialogue.speaker: ECD3FFC34A13A11DA38287928A685C7E
dialogue.line: You say that because you're planning to leave soon.

dialogue.speaker: 4A83EA984BC2F5A5B18A80BC32F695DC
dialogue.line: You sure?

dialogue.speaker: F83EE9D54B60BA13961FBFBA49B436FD
dialogue.line: You're a very responsible little guy.

dialogue.speaker: 412C40444B4222BD011584A96506511D
dialogue.line: You're a very responsible little guy. With a man like you around, I don't need to worry about the rest of you.

dialogue.speaker: 1274BE3D4C3D5D0B2CAFD7949CDFA412
dialogue.line: You're right, Yanna.

dialogue.speaker: 7D3A078A48DE15181679ABA1B70D7889
dialogue.line: You're right.

dialogue.speaker: AA39FEDB45BBEFF77B0E06AF6B4744B6
dialogue.line: [scoff]

dialogue.speaker: BBF08A6B47D2840B843753A4AB26CE4F
dialogue.line: [scoff] Don't be silly, I'm not going anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: CC2AFCC54206767293040896E914B31D
dialogue.line: [sobs] Easy for you to say. I'm not a hero. God, I'm not even a man.

dialogue.speaker: C9643B3742BAC9720F570F9976D9D4E9
dialogue.line: [sobs] I just... I'm not sure if I can...

dialogue.speaker: ED9707994BA5D84624099989E4C0B8AA
dialogue.line: Coen... Oh, Coen...

dialogue.speaker: F2A7C5194F649D6369406CBA6D2D1665
dialogue.line: Dad and I will take care of everything.

dialogue.speaker: C75C74004365524BECC75DAE939D1D58
dialogue.line: Goodbye, mum.

dialogue.speaker: D9CA3AEE48302B4BDE084D8BA3ED8E4F
dialogue.line: Hello, mum. Enjoying the fresh air?

dialogue.speaker: F0DC89344DEBC7D2E5067E9315B5107F
dialogue.line: Hope you're feeling better.

dialogue.speaker: 67145F954C0E95ABEABE9284DE9BBAEB
dialogue.line: Hope you're feeling better. I... I know you went through hell. But it's over.

dialogue.speaker: 95E25AAE406CD43380C853A1230FFE7D
dialogue.line: I killed Brencis. Vale Sangora is free again.

dialogue.speaker: 0A9595774DAD99CF828D13A4DDA8344C
dialogue.line: I love you, my son. I've.... always... loved you.

dialogue.speaker: 8B0A00184BFCE48A6E5211899FFDAB72
dialogue.line: I might leave Laslea soon.

dialogue.speaker: 76C1DFEA434B9C59F9D4839D499AD420
dialogue.line: I try to help out as much as possible. Be a good neighbour. Just like you taught me, mum.

dialogue.speaker: 9C9E8B524E7608C3B736919D546DCAFC
dialogue.line: I'll come back later.

dialogue.speaker: 53FE05BA41D4153A6456E9B5EED1F7C4
dialogue.line: I'm glad to see you out of the house. Make the most of it, before the winter sets in.

dialogue.speaker: CDC37C7E484E76503B6AE3B18A2E4553
dialogue.line: I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: F49E31A9461EA76388AB608B2DFD6B06
dialogue.line: I... I'll come back later.

dialogue.speaker: 2FC6001B4DDACBFBAC1A4E8B0CD4A0C3
dialogue.line: I... I've changed, mum. In more ways than one. And there's still so much of it I don't understand.

dialogue.speaker: A99906D04EEF1A9E68F8D6B9262B1F7F
dialogue.line: Jesus. Why am I doing this? You can't even hear me, can you?

dialogue.speaker: 0696D63C49201389985F0FA9348AEDA8
dialogue.line: Knyaz Brencis will leave us alone. I made sure of it.

dialogue.speaker: BB7EBC1445FFF17F9EC97AB83876BFD5
dialogue.line: Laslea is getting back on its feet.

dialogue.speaker: A79FF4804F8E82A31A075CACA3434AF2
dialogue.line: Mum - I'm changed.

dialogue.speaker: A09E16B147D85818127E54844DF30602
dialogue.line: Mum, I know we've just got our family back. But - I might be leaving, soon. For good.

dialogue.speaker: AB1EE82D4B6911A15CECC7954E93950A
dialogue.line: Mum...?

dialogue.speaker: 361DC6A348371023C493AC925108B4B3
dialogue.line: Mum...? God, you're.... you're back! I have... so much to tell you and –

dialogue.speaker: 870CF2194893245CB85540AB33A1A268
dialogue.line: Mum? Mum, please! Just stay... stay with me...

dialogue.speaker: 281721E74EFBB149A7F8B6A3D2063DFB
dialogue.line: Mum? You're.... you're talking again! I... I can't believe it. Please -

dialogue.speaker: 3D278399411EA1BD682680BAEBB66DA4
dialogue.line: No more masses. No more fear.

dialogue.speaker: 0B534C1F4793BBC79A8E82BA6CDCEDB0
dialogue.line: Oh God, I've got so much to tell you!

dialogue.speaker: F1BC55B24DF000DCD5B8158E46FEF0F9
dialogue.line: Remember what I told you?

dialogue.speaker: 08F8A6CC4C9B853A78A96E8023F579FB
dialogue.line: Shh... Shh... Rest. I need to rest.

dialogue.speaker: 5E7C42EB4ED4FD54C2CE0F8203EF9BDA
dialogue.line: Shhhh... Let me... let me...

dialogue.speaker: D9A2393743F30CE483570186918E609F
dialogue.line: Sometimes it scares me. Mostly I try to accept my fate. But truth be told... I'm not sure who I am anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 46C5EE78445C831F5D1059B65BADBF31
dialogue.line: Thank you... For everything.

dialogue.speaker: 74EAD68A4A48F0D50575ADB3B30C2041
dialogue.line: Things are finally looking up.

dialogue.speaker: F75E8A9B48EE735E41C17BA4E7CE5EE0
dialogue.line: You're safe. We all are.

dialogue.speaker: 878B991B46EDFFFAA8222DA27DFA9C45
dialogue.line: You're talking?! I don't believe it!

dialogue.speaker: 0D98490446FF1F9BEFF4599F2F345D3A
dialogue.line: And now we'll never be free of those monsters.

dialogue.speaker: 11F74BDF493E3636498AD1B8D7E14422
dialogue.line: And was it respect that stopped you from severing Brencis's head?

dialogue.speaker: 96DA0E384F1305C81017E394B8E6C0B1
dialogue.line: And we're grateful, Coen. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: C4AE004E44493A4C105BADBE5E76E108
dialogue.line: Are we to pretend it's all water under the bridge now?

dialogue.speaker: F901AA1D404D8FFF5EDBA5B824FC496F
dialogue.line: But how can we if some of our neighbours openly worshipped monsters?

dialogue.speaker: BD463CE543980A56304816806E06BE9B
dialogue.line: From what I heard you had Brencis at the tip of your sword – and then you made a bloody deal with him.

dialogue.speaker: 2A4CA0914BA0C37BF69EFB90608D5F52
dialogue.line: Have I done something to offend you?

dialogue.speaker: D6AF3C0A4D9984C27F4D70B67499E5C5
dialogue.line: Hopefully we'll see some real justice.

dialogue.speaker: A114EC334BF7C94A23BAADB38B337ADF
dialogue.line: I did what I had to.

dialogue.speaker: D3C7615946528E979D495BA1379B9DF5
dialogue.line: I did what I had to. To save at least some of you.

dialogue.speaker: 9144AC3A4F33C543128EF291B2882C4C
dialogue.line: I'm just telling you the truth. Showing you the consequences.

dialogue.speaker: 42457FF44427A75963541DAE4F6838AD
dialogue.line: It's not that easy, Coen. To forgive and forget.

dialogue.speaker: 3FE9C3D440CCB7DDC97E0CA8D939D44F
dialogue.line: Laslea got a second chance. It should apply to everyone in here.

dialogue.speaker: A83C9A0E489B64C897C008AA28BF6AF7
dialogue.line: Laslea's got a new start. To make it work, we need to trust one another.

dialogue.speaker: 08AC1D194E1C1A4AA31313889DD2CFD8
dialogue.line: Me? I'm fine. It's some of the others you should worry about.

dialogue.speaker: 046087634628B9476AFDB3BC1B1BE95F
dialogue.line: Mighty pleased with yourself, aren't you? Feel like a true hero?

dialogue.speaker: FBB8B39F40EF09706CB188B20698046B
dialogue.line: No, lad! You made sure that they will stay in the valley forever!

dialogue.speaker: FD5958044627ED167905CAA00359FD48
dialogue.line: No, nothing like that.

dialogue.speaker: 17B85421491B189658DFBDA77E0502D9
dialogue.line: No, nothing like that... I just did what I had to.

dialogue.speaker: 349BC71940B5E63C59613A895D6D3277
dialogue.line: No. I don't suppose it is. Just think about it, alright?

dialogue.speaker: 9E0F51A44992F4F45B2B37A411DA64A2
dialogue.line: Not what I meant.

dialogue.speaker: B88DC0DF45DE17778185CE93E567751F
dialogue.line: Now... now leave me, please. I'm old. And tired.

dialogue.speaker: 255F01BC4342F612506F2DAECE94FF52
dialogue.line: Oh, I would hold the traitors accountable.

dialogue.speaker: FED691AC4923D32D1948C58C6400EE10
dialogue.line: Or we could just tell the manumits. They know exactly what to do with vrakhir-lovers.

dialogue.speaker: DCB465FD4FA146FE75F1A29A592890D9
dialogue.line: People do a lot of crazy things, especially when they are afraid.

dialogue.speaker: 3367CE1146DE02A9BB14D6BEE9DEF7F5
dialogue.line: Premysl, how are you faring these days?

dialogue.speaker: 902FC0DB4163E38E8625C4A6560644A2
dialogue.line: Premysl, just let it go.

dialogue.speaker: C93AA1E641062B2504F5E89FD666B951
dialogue.line: Premysl, just let it go.

dialogue.speaker: 090DCAA646DCC7E8983E3694AD7D2404
dialogue.line: Right. Farewell then, Premysl.

dialogue.speaker: A79A1B3E4CE2B1A4B383DCBD9DDE326A
dialogue.line: Same as you did when I filched Gremla's banner, as I recall.

dialogue.speaker: F868245B4A81B61EEB3EADB21D8E0070
dialogue.line: Thank you, Coen. When we choose the new elderman, I'll tell him what you and I think should be done.

dialogue.speaker: E5A4F0ED40CA8B737725BA82CD3EBD78
dialogue.line: The vrakhiri will leave Laslea alone, Premysl. I made sure of that.

dialogue.speaker: 3B238D0D44E78949284B69A922E17B67
dialogue.line: True. And I'm not judging you, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: C7E55FFF453E64E6BAED68B01A9A200C
dialogue.line: We got rid of the vrakhiri. But what of those who were all too eager to do their bidding?

dialogue.speaker: 73B478D14CF2640D27A3F0B5C9262A74
dialogue.line: We know exactly who they are. Round the bastards up and drive them out of the village, I say.

dialogue.speaker: E22C334E4FF490E32C28499F3E9E7E5B
dialogue.line: Well, I did save you all. Don't expect gratitude, but at least some respect.

dialogue.speaker: 39C18A694ED9FEEB3BB0459EEABC6372
dialogue.line: Well, I did save you all...

dialogue.speaker: 51A6D9FF4249E902ECB448B564A185C9
dialogue.line: What do you care, lad?

dialogue.speaker: BF4FA23749E8C35B50002A8F173AEC6E
dialogue.line: What would you do, then?

dialogue.speaker: 5959184D49D7A64D976C2BB6DE1AB156
dialogue.line: What would you do?

dialogue.speaker: B8114CA3493BC28B820834A0ED41DDDB
dialogue.line: What? Don't be daft! People –

dialogue.speaker: DEF37B1E4CC05E695CD4019420A5734C
dialogue.line: With winter so close, everyone's on edge.

dialogue.speaker: ABE9FEF042B29A24EB8905A27D44F9ED
dialogue.line: You have no idea.

dialogue.speaker: 4499E999489A3F14D65174B4A0E4BEC0
dialogue.line: You sure it's a problem?

dialogue.speaker: BF55A21843E563497312A5B9F6AB46C2
dialogue.line: You sure it's a problem?

dialogue.speaker: A6B36E9B477A538D46FC95A0748847DF
dialogue.line: You're right. They should be punished.

dialogue.speaker: DA831F4B4B67971F0A1EF6ACCA99D479
dialogue.line: You're right. They should be punished.

dialogue.speaker: 95F4D14E403384C0BA8B7789B6795F44
dialogue.line: You've no right to judge me, Premysl. The things I had to do... that I had to go through.

dialogue.speaker: BF6D47C943477791007BB1848BA15E30
dialogue.line: You've no right to judge me.

dialogue.speaker: 6599FE034A00D59F9F6F77B88A3123E3
dialogue.line: [sighs] Maybe I will. Now... leave me be. Please.

dialogue.speaker: C2EC4CAC43B8131525ABC0AC45687754
dialogue.line: All of it. Laslea. Our neighbours. The... the vrakhiri leaving us alone. It won't last.

dialogue.speaker: BBC931174142D7C5F730029224271C2C
dialogue.line: All right, no pressure.

dialogue.speaker: F0881C064B5B908933DC4B8014F5F515
dialogue.line: Alright, Gremla. I'll leave you be.

dialogue.speaker: 7FEB6EF847A84FC2D3C969870BCE09E4
dialogue.line: Alright, no pressure.

dialogue.speaker: E7DE0B104DF4D3797204D287EC82FE81
dialogue.line: And... and some of those Manumits passed through Laslea a few days ago.

dialogue.speaker: 9DEB08BB4FE3B5D841AE24BE5ADB5348
dialogue.line: But it won't last.

dialogue.speaker: A6CC95A54A5127439F9142A2CE2CE1B5
dialogue.line: Come on, I haven't changed that much.

dialogue.speaker: 9CF55C5A464D069E72A7B684941053B9
dialogue.line: Gremla, what are you saying? It's me. You don't have to be so formal.

dialogue.speaker: CC99EE4C457B8318C732D097574EF043
dialogue.line: Gremla... Brencis will keep up his end of the bargain. I made sure of it.

dialogue.speaker: F7D0E1AA4DD59922A900C480EB218BA8
dialogue.line: Gremla... Jesus, that shouldn't be happening. I will –

dialogue.speaker: 1F0F057E4C8AC00F911227AEB2FA6A7D
dialogue.line: How's preparation for winter?

dialogue.speaker: B6974BBB40DCBC714D9C21B2C05ACA16
dialogue.line: How's preparation for winter?

dialogue.speaker: D1CC93394EC3A75E9D90BDB1226645CE
dialogue.line: I haven't changed that much.

dialogue.speaker: C1C3A0C9454DDB948D03968ED734EA02
dialogue.line: I'll leave you be.

dialogue.speaker: CACA7C5141D70E51E3935497A9664907
dialogue.line: I'll... do my best.

dialogue.speaker: ABBD1FE24582E7DA9C93DE9C37CB1825
dialogue.line: I'm making things to keep others warm. Scarfs, gloves, caps. Giving them away.

dialogue.speaker: F359EB6C4EBF459C3C8B7FB523D33EB0
dialogue.line: I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 1AF964694F667EE081C3158C7338655C
dialogue.line: I... I don't want to cause any problems.

dialogue.speaker: 5093A6D548C26C078EF89982B1C724C6
dialogue.line: I... I don't want to get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: A946F50542F92752FFF08582DF547A2E
dialogue.line: I... I know you think so. And I'm grateful... for all you've done.

dialogue.speaker: 1CC5E11E46B3EC5DDD781C8FA4BE5538
dialogue.line: It's none of my business, but... I've noticed you've been keeping your distance. From me and others.

dialogue.speaker: 0934FF5E485F64B8CF16EE8CDE411F70
dialogue.line: It's not for me to say. I just... Just want to show my gratitude.

dialogue.speaker: 702F8321494F8FDADF5056B18F425FE2
dialogue.line: Knyaz Brencis treats you like an equal. We should show you the same... respect.

dialogue.speaker: 2686B36342B51A8DF365CFA6C385B4D9
dialogue.line: Oh, I... of-of course. Meant no offence.

dialogue.speaker: 4F0684E541BD0AA6365276BED413CBE6
dialogue.line: Oh, master Coen. Hello, I... I didn't expect that you'd talk to me. Please, let me –

dialogue.speaker: 647EBCAD46566F81CE6E149729522E38
dialogue.line: People... My neighbours... They – they say that I was too eager to serve the vrakhiri...

dialogue.speaker: 5D2FB42D4BE2A4C2D77BB8AEFAC5A672
dialogue.line: Please, don't! It will... it will make things only worse. I've already... got used to it.

dialogue.speaker: 12C919D54AFBDFB1D8CDA29F1131A0C5
dialogue.line: Please, tell me.

dialogue.speaker: A1E61522409A4305EEA0C2B7D436A4AD
dialogue.line: Please, tell me.

dialogue.speaker: D7FFBC6A4748C9C61A0DE1A8AFFB637D
dialogue.line: Right...

dialogue.speaker: 41BDDF4E4ADC40EA319993B23932498A
dialogue.line: Seriously, stop it.

dialogue.speaker: 4D96DBE640D29FFA2453AE8460ABBC4C
dialogue.line: Seriously, stop it. You treating me like this... it's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: F1304B40407DE6CD96FDD2B9F9EC6A9A
dialogue.line: That's not what I – Listen, just talk to me like you used to, alright?

dialogue.speaker: E22CAB4F42193AAC7860DF95E89292F1
dialogue.line: They said... God, they said that they'd like to cut off my ears... and they laughed.

dialogue.speaker: 4B14471249F654DA6A7A65932534CD2B
dialogue.line: They spit on the ground when they see me. Threw rotten eggs at my house the other day.

dialogue.speaker: 3CA6B6CF4F0CB4E994372CB62DAD2D53
dialogue.line: To what?

dialogue.speaker: 7E74642F40F44458BD1A43BE44278BD0
dialogue.line: Very generous of you. And it makes sense - you're really handy with that loom of yours.

dialogue.speaker: D77BD0B440FA49864A12FFAEB73590B1
dialogue.line: Ye-yes? Can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: 766930B743B59CE5FB69EB98FF65B56E
dialogue.line: Yes. People... remind me of that all the time.

dialogue.speaker: 4C7F699241560114F27A2293CC54A4A7
dialogue.line: You slayed the vrakhiri... You're... you're not like the rest of us.

dialogue.speaker: 97FAA45249E8C245CE555D82FB3C2ADE
dialogue.line: You've been keeping your distance.

dialogue.speaker: 553A616643687201E29E1AAD02A802E3
dialogue.line: Ah, it is to be expected. A stranger appears in your village? People are naturally curious.

dialogue.speaker: 632C925B48FA77CC21BBC6B95120A45D
dialogue.line: Ah, you don't know the half of it.

dialogue.speaker: A12D450C49D2110502456290A9B6285A
dialogue.line: An aimless one?

dialogue.speaker: 9003A2954721B3580839BA90FB4D8CCD
dialogue.line: Besides, a person's birthplace doesn't decide their fate. Wouldn't you agree?

dialogue.speaker: 28557715448A0D9A6366E2A3788F9F5C
dialogue.line: Business.

dialogue.speaker: 605317DE45B6E8FE9BAF718DDBA03E1D
dialogue.line: But I much prefer smaller, calmer places - like your Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: 70D18F9143F636358F6C5BBD84E91B63
dialogue.line: But the names wouldn't mean anything. They'd just be noises to you, foreign and unpronounceable.

dialogue.speaker: 828809884850C7591D29DEB5A57F64BF
dialogue.line: Frankly, so am I. What brings you here?

dialogue.speaker: 78B0F4EB4E5C728D420E778E5C4524DD
dialogue.line: Frankly, so am I...

dialogue.speaker: 1C4E6F864249F92CC6F1F4B2ED2ADD5C
dialogue.line: God willing, we'll meet again.

dialogue.speaker: 0A9BA877467B1C17D62B98B7077FEB71
dialogue.line: Haven't seen you in Laslea before, friend. I see you've sparked some interest.

dialogue.speaker: E274D411420629BB58DA289A7CED81C5
dialogue.line: Hi. My name's Coen.

dialogue.speaker: A5C4E78B46606701C3C87E8B8DB5F865
dialogue.line: Hm. From far away.

dialogue.speaker: EA54503E4262F7E4E9252B99CD2CCB1A
dialogue.line: How did you even get here?

dialogue.speaker: 0AFD89E74A57AC4AD9195693E50041DE
dialogue.line: How did you get into the valley?

dialogue.speaker: C51A371D46179C4EBB284A9FBA2ABE81
dialogue.line: I could give you the name of my village, or the mountains that tower over it.

dialogue.speaker: 747D84EC4683CB37F0F092BA79225A69
dialogue.line: I don't trust you.

dialogue.speaker: A6E4CF7D4628AB2CCB39519D133A80CA
dialogue.line: I don't trust you.

dialogue.speaker: 476CDB2B4F7C4A927119FFB3EEEE6C63
dialogue.line: I felt they deserved something for their hard work.

dialogue.speaker: 329BBB394213764522FF368DAFDCA89B
dialogue.line: I imagined you'd be older.

dialogue.speaker: F5629B384407CF6AA4F71EA26C843BC8
dialogue.line: I know.

dialogue.speaker: EAF82FD3465B218ED14E04882AB9FC0D
dialogue.line: I walked.

dialogue.speaker: CEA2CA5745ECD829FD52559468362CDC
dialogue.line: I went to Svartrau first, took in the sights.

dialogue.speaker: 305A3DFA4238AEA6330D9C916AAD4DF8
dialogue.line: I wouldn't believe everything you hear.

dialogue.speaker: D674965340C85C13077E3885F16930C7
dialogue.line: I wouldn't believe everything you hear.

dialogue.speaker: D72F2F7E41C1378D23110F8A44D46D4E
dialogue.line: I'm a traveller.

dialogue.speaker: 0C5481E54CE843118BAAF5A6D13A6D16
dialogue.line: I'm flattered you find me so interesting.

dialogue.speaker: F58EE102466F39B0A02F5395BFA5D5B7
dialogue.line: I'm flattered you find me so interesting.

dialogue.speaker: 3794A01D4F5585C6148975BCC4F0B1EB
dialogue.line: Isn't it obvious? A valley overtaken by monsters, a hero who stood up to them... Had to see it for myself.

dialogue.speaker: 196036E44460797CFE9C979A6A0A9E46
dialogue.line: My name's Coen.

dialogue.speaker: CBD50D254B2632E63E8B25A9AF52BA58
dialogue.line: Neberu.

dialogue.speaker: 44C3F60B40A4814AAA755599E2234A5D
dialogue.line: No, of course. Such tales need verifying.

dialogue.speaker: 40BC141E4DF94B4F37F04F9AC9496B95
dialogue.line: Nothing like a few gold pieces to banish doubt.

dialogue.speaker: 976FB7924EAA12AAAD6FDCB5321EDABB
dialogue.line: Oh, it isn't just me.

dialogue.speaker: 3873E79F42BE60E39B195F94FBA39F14
dialogue.line: Oh, it was no obstacle. The new knyaz wants trade to resume. Travellers like me are most welcome.

dialogue.speaker: 9322C0E4476738C7E645ECB3D4EF1710
dialogue.line: Oh, there's always an aim. It's just different every time.

dialogue.speaker: 6C576E844133B7C11B71C6A600A0D8BE
dialogue.line: Oh, they asked me some questions first. Weren't quite sure what to make of me.

dialogue.speaker: DB47A63D483959D58CEC2C882A0D3633
dialogue.line: Oh, yes. You're on the lips of many.

dialogue.speaker: 5703409A44B33B0592C192AB7749F412
dialogue.line: Prudent. I'm wary of stangers, myself.

dialogue.speaker: AAAE51274A4CA3951EEAFCB4615A3F41
dialogue.line: Really? They simply let you pass through the guardpost?

dialogue.speaker: 24E4853E4EAC38C694B5F19D24DA04E5
dialogue.line: So you've heard about me?

dialogue.speaker: B6C9250D4800B4297197E7A329F394CB
dialogue.line: Some call you a hero. Some a traitor. And others yet - a monster.

dialogue.speaker: 2B83763D4A193ED15E6D5FA0C3652F3E
dialogue.line: The soldiers stationed there... Dutiful men, very loyal to Knyaz Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 90CB2DFC4C21C78DFCE3448A276E523D
dialogue.line: What about now? Why come to Vale Sangora, of all places?

dialogue.speaker: 5120719541768F7183C07EB52BDCCE96
dialogue.line: What is it that you do?

dialogue.speaker: A7C683E84944FD3B475231AD97E5E04F
dialogue.line: What is that you do?

dialogue.speaker: 140A559D4BEDCC4AD1F7D1B486E70E6D
dialogue.line: Where do you come from, if you don't mind me asking?

dialogue.speaker: 3D9EE4354E919D2C455BAC915CB32084
dialogue.line: Where do you come from?

dialogue.speaker: D9C52A6440E296C5816E6990D0AE6344
dialogue.line: Who will they turn out to be? A friend? Or maybe a foe?

dialogue.speaker: BA876C0A4F064179F59EE586F6BC105F
dialogue.line: Wonder who's right.

dialogue.speaker: D39B2A1A429C7A560976E994CB373A36
dialogue.line: You don't say.

dialogue.speaker: 17D15D924001B817C477F78076098004
dialogue.line: You must be a busy man. Go, tend to your duties.

dialogue.speaker: 6288AAFB44496D253E03E9951B8FC1AA
dialogue.line: You must be a very curious man indeed.

dialogue.speaker: 4E5EAE2D4E983F473C32FEA4640B31E9
dialogue.line: You've heard of me?

dialogue.speaker: 9A5B78C443F4CF574E5DB4A53903EFE2
dialogue.line: Ah, it's alright. I get it. All small villages are like that.

dialogue.speaker: C8C68C98423FC6E921A96E957352AF59
dialogue.line: And what will it be? He'll let them join his army?

dialogue.speaker: 0261E02445FA0CC850FC8A9D4DAEB3C9
dialogue.line: Anyway, you wanted to ask me something?

dialogue.speaker: FEA73CF14B14A996CC718CBD71001B35
dialogue.line: Besides, I don't really care what they think of me.

dialogue.speaker: 50C8587942A8D53EC4A365867A5B1A79
dialogue.line: Brencis might be burning in Hell right now, but there are other beasts haunting our valley.

dialogue.speaker: 4C387CBE45DB163A70A15EAAE6B3C57D
dialogue.line: But for many... This struggle – it changed them.

dialogue.speaker: 316D94994907EA44EFFE83B6E8190B8A
dialogue.line: Can't blame them, right?

dialogue.speaker: DFDE54C441ABC15B3726519A7D5779B6
dialogue.line: Coen. Need something?

dialogue.speaker: 4CBD2F324CCCA1D8F73FB3A355213F09
dialogue.line: Doubt it... But I'll think about it, alright?

dialogue.speaker: 7910E7CB43716F94D785448B24AB3CEB
dialogue.line: Doubt they'll get a chance – I'll be leaving soon.

dialogue.speaker: E9119EBE49F37AD395F65291BBF911D4
dialogue.line: Give him a chance.

dialogue.speaker: 38B29D4F459785309675F3938B6F3C17
dialogue.line: Give him a chance. Might surprise you.

dialogue.speaker: 8617F26741B203E34E1D82AE17A9978A
dialogue.line: Got more important things to do.

dialogue.speaker: A6EFDDB247C6B70204C80BACFCC4A929
dialogue.line: Got to go.

dialogue.speaker: FEC726FC453EEF4D8BFACBAB90036B43
dialogue.line: Have you talked to Ascar?

dialogue.speaker: 6A24BD994DE11827D50C2395E72422FB
dialogue.line: Honestly – don't know.

dialogue.speaker: ACAFC7A8425BFC9F9F8BDE8C088E28FE
dialogue.line: Hopefully, most of them will find peace. Return to their lives. To their families... if they still have them.

dialogue.speaker: 11283EE441DB975BBF7213A6B9AAADA7
dialogue.line: I already talked to the knyaz about it. He'll find them something to do.

dialogue.speaker: 97F0272E4554C59621235F9F9595AA29
dialogue.line: I know, Coen. You need to take care of – Yeah, don't worry about it. I'll manage.

dialogue.speaker: 5E1310F14436351609DBEFAAA4E22BB0
dialogue.line: I understand. Probably not even worth it.

dialogue.speaker: F4BE28EA47DFA3CAF09E529079E99B9E
dialogue.line: I'm sorry, they should know better.

dialogue.speaker: 7D71A1D54DB96DEF83A8DA87631DC010
dialogue.line: I've got to go. You stay safe, alright?

dialogue.speaker: B45DE281459D2509DB9210B20C76AF5D
dialogue.line: Knyaz Catalin wants someone to eradicate them.

dialogue.speaker: B724F7E04BA2DFE57731E298710FE67B
dialogue.line: Let me guess – that someone's you?

dialogue.speaker: FB39870947581888DC52C58649ACDBF3
dialogue.line: Listen, I would, but –

dialogue.speaker: 8A2C05304D3AEB4BF5A5CCB2487BE125
dialogue.line: Me? Coen, I'm a warrior, not a fucking carpenter. I'd only get in their way.

dialogue.speaker: 0C7DD9834FEB1B30BBB6C4996997639D
dialogue.line: My thoughts exactly.

dialogue.speaker: 4DD8A3E940500DE076537E82D6632852
dialogue.line: No. He's safe back in Tantari and I...

dialogue.speaker: 88786470439352410F6354A1CF3A95A0
dialogue.line: No. I offered. They politely but firmly declined.

dialogue.speaker: D7BC85044E69C82CA7C062B153A5BD82
dialogue.line: Not easy to go back to toiling the fields after facing a few Blood Guards, right?

dialogue.speaker: F514A688454926E384053E9F39B382C5
dialogue.line: Not helping out?

dialogue.speaker: C5ABF9514C7139B117AB38BBB17DDDCB
dialogue.line: Probably not worth it.

dialogue.speaker: F15752144C32AB60127814A26F25E7A1
dialogue.line: Seriously?

dialogue.speaker: 4871036F4415483BAA9FB3A0AC56D071
dialogue.line: Sharp as ever. Yeah, I've got a few people willing to help. Could use you, too.

dialogue.speaker: 1607086E4C9F4149E2DA33A4FFD3E5F2
dialogue.line: Shit, I... I'm sorry. They should know better.

dialogue.speaker: 5312AE4B41AE9E7E7AAC0CAC71196CF9
dialogue.line: So what will happen to the manumits now?

dialogue.speaker: E84959C843E75AF046C51199C33768A9
dialogue.line: Someone needs to get rid of them.

dialogue.speaker: 3141C3B44AA53588141D7294A07077C6
dialogue.line: Sure. Not holding it against them, just answering your question.

dialogue.speaker: 66577C6B46A0A001E796A0A579C89CC6
dialogue.line: Take a guess.

dialogue.speaker: C2F8077B467AE7C0EE8D719271653776
dialogue.line: That would be the dream... but no, I can't.

dialogue.speaker: 6247F3BE47B9746906E2889078CCB700
dialogue.line: The knyaz... wasn't clear about that. But I know he won't leave them behind.

dialogue.speaker: EFB2F7B74A54A9624C558F83204B3E7A
dialogue.line: They will warm up to you, you'll see.

dialogue.speaker: E4BA6BD14BA336DE81482DA055681327
dialogue.line: What about the manumits?

dialogue.speaker: B3B2370645F7B387E789EBB71975807E
dialogue.line: What's next for you?

dialogue.speaker: 2FCE4D4E4BDA8F18D3C4828E2B4EDEEB
dialogue.line: What's next for you? Finally going to rest for a while?

dialogue.speaker: 29A44CAA441039F5FF2FDB9BE8CAD22B
dialogue.line: What? Why would they?

dialogue.speaker: 6EC500CE4539BF4B972D6CAA786FF1F9
dialogue.line: Will do my best, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 8E62EDF14DE64F7598232487CB82BC9C
dialogue.line: Would be more fun with you, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: 44E781B94DD6377397AC069F58EC06C4
dialogue.line: You what?

dialogue.speaker: 85F35D744452F3B18AFD348FBF58C92E
dialogue.line: Your father... had a chance to talk to him?

dialogue.speaker: BFA160E343344D9A5E72C8AC8EDB57F8
dialogue.line: [sigh] Can't blame them, right? You're a stranger, and after everything that's happened...

dialogue.speaker: 9ABB1B7A470E548A56BCFAA8A4C638AF
dialogue.line: Coen... I haven't told this to anyone else, so... keep it to yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 6938A2014202236589C8999477AB8F39
dialogue.line: Dad always knew how to take care of himself. Even in the vrakhiri prison.

dialogue.speaker: F2FC35A54832231180B3B88DC3C28F6C
dialogue.line: First time I saw him cry...

dialogue.speaker: 038566904B0C4BC22522E2A2306E9D2C
dialogue.line: Glad to see you're helping out with the rebuilding.

dialogue.speaker: 1FF7057F41C54C2C3F4D67A328E41CCF
dialogue.line: Glad to see you're helping out.

dialogue.speaker: 86F1BF374233B6DE8A4D65B0F5AE3B34
dialogue.line: Hah. Anyway, I still have lots of work to do.

dialogue.speaker: 23BCE2574D7298115EBABB9590D11C50
dialogue.line: He was a real bastard.

dialogue.speaker: 2381F3734B2F341328FD29B5A43BE9AF
dialogue.line: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: 187B71DE45E21EAF0F48FC96ADF8CA72
dialogue.line: Honest work, Vasil? You?

dialogue.speaker: 93C761DC4ACA955FF1CF52869B207793
dialogue.line: Honest work? You?

dialogue.speaker: AD26CC824495BC572B7C50BEF5B91A4E
dialogue.line: I didn't give a shit about that. Just wanted him to get what was his. But now...

dialogue.speaker: 88A55B8B4A8D5481E2C3D596AAF77F9B
dialogue.line: I know Atanas wasn't– Well, I'm still sorry he died.

dialogue.speaker: BE53603C4709E301333E50AFFE5CAE80
dialogue.line: I understand. And I really hope you'll find your way.

dialogue.speaker: 82107B0D440928E1AA1AA79453CE61F8
dialogue.line: I'm not.

dialogue.speaker: 8C9D0A1D4D80D624F4FD7A97A7E25704
dialogue.line: I'm sorry he's dead.

dialogue.speaker: DAAAAF404FAEA7259E69D48BDFE3CE81
dialogue.line: I've got calluses all over my hands, but I bet my dad would still find a way to call me a worthless layabout.

dialogue.speaker: DDCEE1804FB5E63401878883DB5906BC
dialogue.line: Jesus, Vasil... I know he didn't treat you right... but he was still your family.

dialogue.speaker: 80325A304B3E4215BEBFFFA16458B0C5
dialogue.line: Not wasting any prayers or tears on him.

dialogue.speaker: 27070CF74C6035D44503E48EFB29E632
dialogue.line: Now I can be my own man. Better than he ever was.

dialogue.speaker: C9D17669441FBA1FA5E8898030E17E8F
dialogue.line: Oh... Hi, Coen. You want something?

dialogue.speaker: A462392A4750A58BFD1E388C8503D0CB
dialogue.line: Shut it, Coen. I just want to help.

dialogue.speaker: 7D5047CD42A3BE1991F1DCB2EB17DBBA
dialogue.line: So I told one of the guards. Next day, they dragged him outside, screaming.

dialogue.speaker: DBC94BB24A3828194BD0AEA48B34C574
dialogue.line: Sure. I'll see you around, Vasil.

dialogue.speaker: 9209A8574E8876C155BC63B67957A3A2
dialogue.line: That he was.

dialogue.speaker: 8C1A06F54B8705833CB25595E61CDC75
dialogue.line: Vasil, how could you?!

dialogue.speaker: 8B3D6E654E300A9B106136A3D6898864
dialogue.line: Want to feel useful, you know?

dialogue.speaker: 1F71106B4200825FF011D7BC86974DFC
dialogue.line: What's so funny?

dialogue.speaker: 9DB53062407805DD203340BA5584FF97
dialogue.line: When they brought food to us, he'd steal from others: women, children. 'Weaklings will die anyway', he said.

dialogue.speaker: B46E3FA842E9C918F99D288C4F779A1D
dialogue.line: Yeah? Well the only thing I ever got from him was beatings.

dialogue.speaker: 713D17964A808D5BF7F4CD82E184C622
dialogue.line: You did the right thing, Vasil. Couldn't have been easy... Really, stealing food from others?

dialogue.speaker: BC0C48724654C75EFAFD2E834C4598DE
dialogue.line: You did the right thing.

dialogue.speaker: F6CF30F641159248CDE571A17DF89756
dialogue.line: [exhale] Atanas... Well, there's no other way to say it - he was a real bastard.

dialogue.speaker: CF04450F48F0E809944C7782E46037D6
dialogue.line: I won't take up a lot of your time – just need a bit of your peat.

dialogue.speaker: 434DD9E94C4B8838513DB8BCBE5DDA74
dialogue.line: Appreciate it, Gavril. I'll see you around.

dialogue.speaker: 87202BC64D325DF89618068301173F7E
dialogue.line: Appreciate it. I'll see you both around.

dialogue.speaker: 20A1E7F24D6D62687E8059A67BC16CC1
dialogue.line: But it turned out to be a happy accident in the end! Didn't it?

dialogue.speaker: 9B59983147569A1870E2F79C40155BDF
dialogue.line: Bye, Coen!

dialogue.speaker: B8AA0F864F22546E82CA11A7F2E53472
dialogue.line: Can't say that I'm looking forward to doing it alone, but... Might not have a choice.

dialogue.speaker: D0EB043348B486ABEEB41EB2F9D4AA15
dialogue.line: Cheer up, brother! Come on, if we put our backs into it, we'll be done before supper!

dialogue.speaker: F8658FC140D043FE21CEB181DDC5FB68
dialogue.line: Coen... you've seen things, right? Travelled a bit?

dialogue.speaker: 2AB0D12040D2A07FEE6AFBA0B944059C
dialogue.line: Found? You fell down a hole.

dialogue.speaker: B5583B0F4062A9C3738326900182F252
dialogue.line: Found? You fell down a hole.

dialogue.speaker: 987C1D624083EE452EB6EA9219657817
dialogue.line: Gavril, you're no looter. Or a treasure hunter, either.

dialogue.speaker: 27460710455BFD5F2FE755B9E30DB6F2
dialogue.line: Hmmm... And if I leave soon, I should be able to make it back before the first snow...

dialogue.speaker: BB789020404ADB9A1E65E5A9C3BBB892
dialogue.line: Hmmm... And if we leave soon, we should be able to make it back before the first snow...

dialogue.speaker: 480CEE094B5BC160936371B08DA9B5F7
dialogue.line: I know it sounds promising, but that's a terrible idea.

dialogue.speaker: 8D476C8147774366F1477BA5ED35B227
dialogue.line: I'll take that peat and be out of your hair.

dialogue.speaker: B35E7E654B2E6687C6141DA8598BDD35
dialogue.line: I'll take the peat and leave you to your work.

dialogue.speaker: 07DACAA249D468B6147479BCCC264277
dialogue.line: Knyaz Brencis forbade anyone from poking around in them, but now... I bet lots of folk will see the opportunity.

dialogue.speaker: A3B6BA244BB4FED0BCB1118DE2C35F09
dialogue.line: Listen, Coen... I hate to be cheeky, but there's something else you could give us a hand with.

dialogue.speaker: D73F9B8B4BAB5573B0F7FD92F408AA83
dialogue.line: Listen, I've been thinking... Times will get tough soon. And since I won't be able to collect any peat...

dialogue.speaker: 3F91B58848A42122C1C3B6BDDE6AD9C1
dialogue.line: Look at you, Coen! Helpful as always!

dialogue.speaker: 8188DE8C4AB821C3317DA799AD4A0C68
dialogue.line: Maybe I can give you a hand? The three of us should make short shrift of it.

dialogue.speaker: 401153DE4CE411298ED80AB36AB0B650
dialogue.line: Maybe I can give you a hand? The two of us should make short shrift of it.

dialogue.speaker: 7E97789F4F3EA9B339BDE8961226F108
dialogue.line: Might be worth it.

dialogue.speaker: DAD6D0934B1BEB8456C743880BE2F9BB
dialogue.line: Might be worth it. There are many risks involved, mind you. But a person can find quite some treasure if they're lucky.

dialogue.speaker: 8A47D30047BF389FFFCFC494ACC3A8BD
dialogue.line: Need to prepare, make a solid plan... but it's something, right?

dialogue.speaker: 50B9B64347B39CA99A9E0DA26A73350D
dialogue.line: Normally Lazar would help me but... Yeah, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: 1122A68E4677381E29993BBF924D9076
dialogue.line: Not to mention all those hidden places, like that tomb we found.

dialogue.speaker: 10AC8D614696242D5BCDB491563C9165
dialogue.line: Oh, and take that peat you wanted. It's not much, but should keep you warm on the coldest nights.

dialogue.speaker: B64B9A0E4A0BC932BF657EA20C352C2F
dialogue.line: Oh, hey Coen. Eh, you need something? Please, make it quick - I'm a little busy with this damned fence.

dialogue.speaker: EFB50E804B98C45F07891EB5690BBED5
dialogue.line: Oh, hey there, Coen! You need something?

dialogue.speaker: 9CCF5E9E4B3C107FF8832EA572C3FD9A
dialogue.line: People say... they say there are still... things to find out there. In all those hovels abandoned during the plague...

dialogue.speaker: D4194701451707E25DFE19A202B598D4
dialogue.line: See? I told you it's a good idea!

dialogue.speaker: AEBAEF394FB403B7991AF3A07D778A8B
dialogue.line: Shit... It'll be spring again before I'm finished...

dialogue.speaker: 4B2A3DC1454CCBCB252E31830FFB4850
dialogue.line: Sure. It's not much, but should keep you warm on the coldest nights.

dialogue.speaker: F99FAB994F365B8B390301B8D6F94A1B
dialogue.line: Sure. There's still some left, dry as bone.

dialogue.speaker: 833CD23648978BEF08D8ABAB716CB34E
dialogue.line: Thanks for the advice, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 502DB55047FA6D85B1A009A09DCE8283
dialogue.line: That should do it. Thanks for the help.

dialogue.speaker: 630BC38B4846EE4FB529FDA1EAEA4730
dialogue.line: That's a terrible idea.

dialogue.speaker: 95D5A218401F5FC00F9B1781FC31C255
dialogue.line: The knyaz forbade anyone from poking around in them, but... It might be worth the risk, eh?

dialogue.speaker: D3A79E73438CD685AE65329C2EF66AF2
dialogue.line: Those places... they can be really dangerous. There are brigands out there. And... other things.

dialogue.speaker: 511782204650A64B4C8A369475379AD5
dialogue.line: Um, sure. You could say that. Why?

dialogue.speaker: E8B282DA4304FA0653F42BA4A67482A1
dialogue.line: We?! So far you've been as useless as –

dialogue.speaker: D06D84E64F63F644E89FE998649CAE02
dialogue.line: Well, yeah. But now I know what's what. And I'd be with Gavril!

dialogue.speaker: 5E42FB134C147BDAF06F839F9D9D6F46
dialogue.line: Won't say no. Here, take my spare hammer.

dialogue.speaker: CE36591049D45734D35F7785A66B8C7F
dialogue.line: Won't say no. Here, take my spare hammer.

dialogue.speaker: 98B6E5A14E3B7C192B8C7EB9CA2F7FAA
dialogue.line: Yeah, you're right. I knew it was a stupid idea.

dialogue.speaker: 0649A9F84C209732020EA8AF4E82E5A7
dialogue.line: Yeah. We've been talking – soon we won't be able to collect any more peat. However...

dialogue.speaker: 70C006E04BF3ABDDC35C3D803328BD42
dialogue.line: You almost died in there, Lazar...

dialogue.speaker: BE510BAD494C315D527ABD823792C20E
dialogue.line: You almost died in there, Lazar...

dialogue.speaker: A91092F94A1361CDBD1BCAB7CE3B04F0
dialogue.line: You need a hand with that?

dialogue.speaker: B3A6DE35473D7F52FBA60B843DE36B25
dialogue.line: You need a hand with that?

dialogue.speaker: 860602484A74B18C5D65C482C75B61C0
dialogue.line: You're no looters. Or treasure hunters either, for that matter.

dialogue.speaker: F3D315EB41DB576C77297380A251C256
dialogue.line: Ah! The hero of the day! How are you faring, Coen?

dialogue.speaker: 9F8E2BB04A43B10B430D70B9DF3F8337
dialogue.line: And that army of his? Not cheap. I bet he owes a favour or two to some of our neighbours...

dialogue.speaker: 478E56EC4806B9572B07828683E0144A
dialogue.line: Brencis is dead, Catalin is dead... Before long, people will start fighting over who'll be the next ruler.

dialogue.speaker: 81B5AB0A42148E3C11F7E48EC9CCDE11
dialogue.line: But it also means the village has to fend for itself. Keep bandits away, forage for food...

dialogue.speaker: 3DFEB2354604BF1A8A3A2196273038DC
dialogue.line: Every time the important people squabble, it's us who ends up in the shit. And go hungry when the times get tough.

dialogue.speaker: 4143A5D4429DEA21656F889BC1E95C68
dialogue.line: Getting ready for the winter, like everyone else. Listen, Rainer – is there any chance you have a blanket to sell? Something warm and durable.

dialogue.speaker: D30CEACD40A9313004B124AAA2BAAB38
dialogue.line: Hah. You can say what you want about the vrakhiri, but they did make sure that everyone had something to put on the table.

dialogue.speaker: 8C8CF42C4C3A09CB4A7D92B8C9CC2CB8
dialogue.line: He'll want to do well by Svartrau first, not the villages.

dialogue.speaker: D81FB4D14EB1BA9F1E7852B72B39E7F4
dialogue.line: Here, this should keep you warm even in the harshest of winters. Got this from a man in Parlita who –

dialogue.speaker: A00BAE6D40A246547491B0A0D2248747
dialogue.line: I can take a look, if you want me to.

dialogue.speaker: F8DD1CF749A26CE854934FB534598D6E
dialogue.line: I can take a look, you know.

dialogue.speaker: 6E73A9A64AF264448F82A496E1FCFF1C
dialogue.line: I'll take that blanket and go.

dialogue.speaker: 5330BC064DBDF1C8D222D496175AE7C7
dialogue.line: I'll take that blanket now.

dialogue.speaker: C0BFF19F47962735C9BFF499DC298910
dialogue.line: I'll take that blanket now.

dialogue.speaker: 0D025F3843F2E4AEBAE4258CF45D63FC
dialogue.line: It's perfect, Rainer. Thank you. Stay safe.
