dialogue.line: Have you seen the outsider?

dialogue.speaker: F753EE5E4FF2ADF3EDB03EB0174D9D41
dialogue.line: I did. Even talked to him for a spell. Seems friendly enough.

dialogue.speaker: 7031781945E78477535ECFA9AEEA7BEB
dialogue.line: I didn't ask him. I know that he comes from some distant land in the south. Who knows if the Lord's gospel is known there?

dialogue.speaker: C4A6D3B3426BFA99CF7C29991D7CF4BA
dialogue.line: Is he a Christian, though?

dialogue.speaker: EEDA6D784D96EB9E168E31BE7104BBD9
dialogue.line: Just a few weeks ago we had to give up our blood and pray to that... that abomination. And now...

dialogue.speaker: 555510B64B09AAD965845A8627C1F862
dialogue.line: Maybe... Why? You need them for something?

dialogue.speaker: 414EF87F42FD28E3CB82DBB844F32551
dialogue.line: No. But God knows Laslea needs as much help as possible.

dialogue.speaker: 5C80E1B24FB3D9A50A735C80CDE6504E
dialogue.line: That it does... I'll talk to the father after the evening prayer, alright?

dialogue.speaker: 341DD3D34957BD8AB7F929AEBC6F1A6C
dialogue.line: The first sermon here, when we're done... I will savour each second.

dialogue.speaker: 09A707524F0141C04D9FB49D617A9E24
dialogue.line: Think we might have some leftover materials after we're done here?

dialogue.speaker: 5BE0B8B14C0383E94AF09DB48A8214D3
dialogue.line: We stayed true to Him. True to his Will. And He delivered us from evil, as promised.

dialogue.speaker: 49FD549D438878A1855FF9958064A798
dialogue.line: And do you have all the materials, son?

dialogue.speaker: E7AE88824F1294C16FF9AD8B326AFADE
dialogue.line: And do you have all the materials, son?

dialogue.speaker: 4E6A82934A473B805AA95BBED5A6A5B8
dialogue.line: Let's pray, and the Lord shall provide.

dialogue.speaker: 247EEDCB4DA9575EBE8A77849C8C8535
dialogue.line: Not quite, father. The stains are still visible.

dialogue.speaker: BB3F9C7E4ED079A04A01379EF1513B4C
dialogue.line: Not quite, father. The stains are still visible.

dialogue.speaker: 36E9967447BB855A9D15218A5C0836E5
dialogue.line: Now, the bapitsmal font... Have you managed to scrub it clean?

dialogue.speaker: CB3E24584E235C0CA438FFBFA4BD46AB
dialogue.line: Now, the baptismal font... Have you managed to scrub it clean?

dialogue.speaker: 1DC2B7DF4560C3267C8E41B652698FAB
dialogue.line: Spare no efforts, then. All traces of the blasphemy need to be eradicated.

dialogue.speaker: 5EE9341F4ABD7E21D86E0692E5245596
dialogue.line: The roof, that needs to be done first, before the snow falls.

dialogue.speaker: 93D54A014AC7D073DFEFFD88FC67DA23
dialogue.line: The roof, that needs to be done first, before the snow falls.

dialogue.speaker: 2527003540D02FAF132765AC789A4914
dialogue.line: We're low on shingles, father.

dialogue.speaker: 93BEA85B4998CD85DBCF27B6A2A788A9
dialogue.line: We're low on shingles, father.

dialogue.speaker: 79D63520492BFFB5021E7EA361BA67E2
dialogue.line: And what if it rains? We should unload the cart first.

dialogue.speaker: 1046944A4ADF0FCA53908D95B51353E0
dialogue.line: Oh, just leave it alone, woman! The priest is waiting inside!

dialogue.speaker: 3B02B08744900FD00851F1BD43A9A6E7
dialogue.line: There he is! Have a moment to spare, friend?

dialogue.speaker: 3161D3564D126240AC5916A1CD606032
dialogue.line: Heh. Saved the valley, now cleaning dirt.

dialogue.speaker: 893AF04A41500D3A7C18C1B0BEFE1A7F
dialogue.line: Quite a lot of dirt caked around the axle... No wonder the wheel can't move properly.

dialogue.speaker: 633A6C1A435F330B1EC2CB924878FA89
dialogue.line: Right. The dirt around the axle seems to be the biggest issue. Cleaning it should be easy.

dialogue.speaker: 083CEE7C475A72D28D809489EB560FA4
dialogue.line: Some of the nails are sticking out. Need hammering, but it's nothing serious.

dialogue.speaker: 599E9FBB4B44D3AECC58158DF89BFC27
dialogue.line: This spoke... Pretty banged up. But shouldn't cause problems just now.

dialogue.speaker: 8A0F51B9480A375BD85EBB9F7252CD7A
dialogue.line: This wheel's seen better days... Let's take a closer look.

dialogue.speaker: 75BDFDE2481C1F2BF2144B85CEDF2B13
dialogue.line: Alright Coen?

dialogue.speaker: 63E959714F56B3B02F346E9A7953D533
dialogue.line: Always good to see you, my friend.

dialogue.speaker: 02E8841642057EDD3E857C9EDC2F18D5
dialogue.line: Coen! Let's play together when you're done with the boring stuff!

dialogue.speaker: 125B4F14496B561434E655B9FFA0FD17
dialogue.line: Don't you have tasks to do?

dialogue.speaker: A822BA10412B02FB0001C48C6D0ABF26
dialogue.line: Go with Christ.

dialogue.speaker: 1CB257DE462C3174C154BCBFD4AD37CF
dialogue.line: Good morrow to you, Coen of Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: A6D45BE4461B5A2A2DEF1094F205F34E
dialogue.line: Good to see you, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 5646C03C4D8D350C77582D9BCD9BBC13
dialogue.line: I don't care what you did... You leave me be, boy.

dialogue.speaker: 51D2566A4806461A23370EBBF9F012D9
dialogue.line: I'll pray for you, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 37BEEED24BC1ED43984313B558D59018
dialogue.line: I'm busy, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 48D800894C87EEA75D0DC2AC7F91A404
dialogue.line: If you need anything else, you know where to find me.

dialogue.speaker: 1B20BE3741E517704DED45928F9AB658
dialogue.line: Just fuck off, Coen...

dialogue.speaker: 29DCC7FE440264CFC14E0B9E75AEC528
dialogue.line: Later, Coen. Got all this work to do, yeah?

dialogue.speaker: 8F0C9C384203413A48B23E8D5A45EF22
dialogue.line: Leave me alone. Please.

dialogue.speaker: BBB1426E48512168D9B059BC88B5AD64
dialogue.line: Let me be, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 4946C63F41DF2BCF79A1EBB43273A11B
dialogue.line: My son - thank you for all you've done for the valley.

dialogue.speaker: F7B57B6342D8B83477D73C975110F8F5
dialogue.line: Almost there...

dialogue.speaker: 3EC202EE4EFEC6C0F8AFC1A9A657E348
dialogue.line: Alright, what's next?

dialogue.speaker: 26A0F8164E06A1DCC9C8809976E41149
dialogue.line: Always amazed by this view... Ah, no time to take in the sights.

dialogue.speaker: 43109C0C4F1935A9E22A98A545BA78EA
dialogue.line: And just a moment ago I was going to get up and worry about fieldwork...

dialogue.speaker: 94E4B3294DE54CF2A36CCD9AD1BA77D6
dialogue.line: Dad is cooking today. Not looking forward to it.

dialogue.speaker: 40ACC9024ACAC14C016565A280961079
dialogue.line: Empty.

dialogue.speaker: 1FE8BDF74CF7842FAA5B9E895BAF999A
dialogue.line: Feels strange... knowing we won't have any more meals together.

dialogue.speaker: DB0F371548FEABE9B307109EB26089F8
dialogue.line: Good. Only one more thing left to do.

dialogue.speaker: DB1A498F45F5484519ED8B945CFBCAA8
dialogue.line: Hm. This needs fixing, too. But dad probably knows it already.

dialogue.speaker: A92A8ED042B0029184F43CB08F24C6E8
dialogue.line: I really should fix this one day. Ah, then again – what's the point.

dialogue.speaker: 07225D6B4EEC0CFA35031B8415E5EF75
dialogue.line: I should hurry.

dialogue.speaker: 4009B82643F4C52618EAF5BEA213EEBE
dialogue.line: It's sure getting colder with each passing day...

dialogue.speaker: 375FC53B415A1FCCBFEB08B5ECBE2402
dialogue.line: Looks like winter will come sooner this year...

dialogue.speaker: AB416FC44A632B75DCF8AEB17F9E3297
dialogue.line: Lots to do, not much time to do it. Where to first?

dialogue.speaker: DE213A014067127150BBCC967014E595
dialogue.line: Lunka...

dialogue.speaker: E60A621F4BCEC3229410888EBE468C44
dialogue.line: Mirto's toy. Good to see he's still able to play like he used to.

dialogue.speaker: 27C8F9BE4E75E7F09274D8AFEF296A44
dialogue.line: Mirto's toy. He loved this one.

dialogue.speaker: 5766B8A143B8E516AA9F4191D09FAE1A
dialogue.line: No luck with this one.

dialogue.speaker: F182B46C413B903CD9FF6489C425A2BF
dialogue.line: No one has prayed here for a long time... But that might change now.

dialogue.speaker: 06B0B2CD48DC0EB377B87EBDA68AE2C6
dialogue.line: Not far now...

dialogue.speaker: 168CA98348970EE0610E42B49C21A54B
dialogue.line: Nothing.

dialogue.speaker: 78033A2248E09705F507D88784D66A81
dialogue.line: Oh, I caught something... A rabbit. Good.

dialogue.speaker: 5AB9A9DF49E233B53284C58E07F145C4
dialogue.line: Oh, Yanna... I'm going to miss you.

dialogue.speaker: 34BA91A44EA2702287FFE9A035D30F65
dialogue.line: Please... Not long now.

dialogue.speaker: A1B766B84A52F98F5CD9C0AA0BF5CE95
dialogue.line: Rest in peace, little brother.

dialogue.speaker: 0BEB9D304F0D03460F73619073420454
dialogue.line: Soon the whole village will be covered in snow...

dialogue.speaker: 4EC8BECD4C5DFAA0F5A79E90A4F42BD8
dialogue.line: Still got some things to do...

dialogue.speaker: 59FAC4D54A7A4F4ADDCE45A3E68037C1
dialogue.line: That's done. What now?

dialogue.speaker: 37A04A644B366BA4BA7551B82A2AD7A9
dialogue.line: That's everything I had to do today.

dialogue.speaker: CDD94F2346754A3CB4A45AB484E90572
dialogue.line: The font dried up quite some time ago...

dialogue.speaker: 8B596943488A577AD38981B142CABF7D
dialogue.line: The pile is getting bigger... How long can we go on like this?

dialogue.speaker: 60BF195C46462BFD2E21BBBD7AA89D21
dialogue.line: Time to do some climbing...

dialogue.speaker: D654354641F4B31A5795C18EE1C15B5D
dialogue.line: Time to see if Anca was able to brew the potion.

dialogue.speaker: 982F2F0D48D8A8C3DAA6678D96979D75
dialogue.line: Time to see if Vesel was able to brew the potion.

dialogue.speaker: EEBA29894C11988ACF52688DCE51A4BA
dialogue.line: What I would give to get scolded by you one more time...

dialogue.speaker: 573C69E14905DB5ED8B82384D2EFD282
dialogue.line: You're with Alin now, mum.

dialogue.speaker: 1FE448D74673B9121396ADA94953026E
dialogue.line: No... Don't... Mmmm.

dialogue.speaker: 2B58F3C54CF3E65892CA22A1CF623044
dialogue.line: The children... where... Oh...

dialogue.speaker: 711DE0E74FB60E11025B98B6F0455CF6
dialogue.line: But I'm hungry now...

dialogue.speaker: C979019C45BA10D3B28246AFF5723C1D
dialogue.line: I see that. And what you should be doing is helping me.

dialogue.speaker: 788682184A46A3B5FAD0DAB047BF47D4
dialogue.line: I've told you already: later. We still have things to do.

dialogue.speaker: FF9B21B948D4582FEBC7E9BFED864459
dialogue.line: Mirto, what are you doing over there?

dialogue.speaker: 5DF1AA964D12ABC4F25EA083666972F3
dialogue.line: Nothing...

dialogue.speaker: EECA89B14DAF12E79AEEEBB30E18BE40
dialogue.line: So...? Can we go out and play now?

dialogue.speaker: 5F7428F74C771AAFEE9F51B1DF88F9F2
dialogue.line: Soon. But first we've got to finish here.

dialogue.speaker: 6030F22747FA9A1662852F91FE284F15
dialogue.line: Well, then you should hurry up and help me, right?

dialogue.speaker: 9A68F8B54186D3BA1EEE018C552D2B74
dialogue.line: Yanna, I'm hungry. When are we going to eat?

dialogue.speaker: 21F685434715212C78AFF7B9D4328130
dialogue.line: Alright, brother.

dialogue.speaker: 752698804321C1418D588FA8A004F12F
dialogue.line: Don't worry, we'll manage.

dialogue.speaker: A082C0A04EDA54004ED729836A97DEC8
dialogue.line: I'll come up with something, don't worry. Just need some time to think.

dialogue.speaker: A3675DB64D194C79974303AD3E06B4E2
dialogue.line: Mm-hm. And a rope, maybe a pickaxe? Anyway, not a word to anyone besides Coen. Understand?

dialogue.speaker: 25B5D7FC4F0DFDEE484FD9B9A4E87DE6
dialogue.line: Right. 'We'.

dialogue.speaker: 11FF49C44C04FAC9EA006CA0DEAC2B16
dialogue.line: So much to do, so little time to do it...

dialogue.speaker: ABDC8F1147B54E39C955939A7D9AEF37
dialogue.line: So much to do, so little time to do it...

dialogue.speaker: 788F82A948CBB95F369E2994C5B7FE20
dialogue.line: Still needs some preparation... but yeah, it could work.

dialogue.speaker: 87AFA7F948894087AD7A5286A63E036E
dialogue.line: Still needs some preparation... but yeah, it could work.

dialogue.speaker: ADC38AFD43BA4A25E420DD846DD10CEF
dialogue.line: Sure, brother. Sure.

dialogue.speaker: 0B71730C441329825AFF13ADA85FC230
dialogue.line: We'll need some weapons.

dialogue.speaker: EE31B0224538748C5CA00E9872224AC2
dialogue.line: Well, if anyone knows what they're talking about, it's Coen...

dialogue.speaker: F5F970294CB05EF0DA7EE1A98816E7C5
dialogue.line: Well, if anyone knows what they're talking about, it's Coen...

dialogue.speaker: 8B53656B4609AF84439609852DC23ED8
dialogue.line: Yeah. But what should we do, then?

dialogue.speaker: 58B3BE974C700FD5832FCFB524D0A836
dialogue.line: And I'm not sure why the two of you are gossiping instead of working. Focus, please.

dialogue.speaker: 509377F3449F1892EB9A55B41D2202BB
dialogue.line: Good to see the whole village working together.

dialogue.speaker: C96229FC4FC5EF5C7F8FF5A4E7AECEBA
dialogue.line: Iorgu, maybe we should take a break soon?

dialogue.speaker: C847F01B44D7A56B6815A4B5C9471726
dialogue.line: Some new faces around here. Hopefully none with bad intentions.

dialogue.speaker: 35E0E9E44D3F23DE8170BD96590D6E09
dialogue.line: Talked to that monk the other day. Seems a nice enough fellow.

dialogue.speaker: A04DFCA149F57E6DCBE96FA38410D345
dialogue.line: That Neberu fellow... He's a bit weird, isn't he? Not sure what he's doing here.

dialogue.speaker: 75156D254426F911F1EE0AA388C4F68C
dialogue.line: We should hurry up. There's still lots to be done.

dialogue.speaker: A37B9ADB4B0E573C038C559A964E03EC
dialogue.line: Winter won't wait. We'll take a break when we're finished here.

dialogue.speaker: 1F30F640499EF575702BF1974B3177DD
dialogue.line: Erm. How do you play it?

dialogue.speaker: 12B7FDFF49C34952DCB41C8D6AB81C4E
dialogue.line: Hey, take it back!

dialogue.speaker: 6EE9112245E3F46A9F64AE90B3DA417D
dialogue.line: How about some tag, then?

dialogue.speaker: BE92924541100ED07958FAB8127BE3F6
dialogue.line: I don't think I like this game...

dialogue.speaker: CB5A42804AFC82E420B9448504C05863
dialogue.line: Let me guess – you'll hit us with the stick?

dialogue.speaker: C67699304E527CF102FDD6AAA964F25C
dialogue.line: Maybe... maybe tug-of-war?

dialogue.speaker: E4F3D3654689478E68EB1CA706B5B8F1
dialogue.line: Nooo. I always lose...

dialogue.speaker: B925E414496C8A57FAC63E8053A7F581
dialogue.line: Oooh! Oh! I know - let's play... Coen of Laslea!

dialogue.speaker: 0F90B7AC43C20508887B1E92C2EDDCFA
dialogue.line: Sooo... what should we play now?

dialogue.speaker: 920C5F08428A7C8F1CED6BA50AD2FE18
dialogue.line: That's because you're too slow.

dialogue.speaker: AB185E4A4D385D2EDE2F56B75219CEC0
dialogue.line: That's dumb...

dialogue.speaker: 26A01F5047656C7C708CDEA613209B93
dialogue.line: Well, I'll find a stick and... and I'll be Coen. And you'll all be monsters.

dialogue.speaker: C3A2CB9D4F97B4889DDBD68C8CEC594B
dialogue.line: Yeah? And you're... you're too ugly!

dialogue.speaker: 9AF222CE4DABC4AA6411A8A01049566E
dialogue.line: You're dumb!

dialogue.speaker: F474BCD848C65BCC5F76F9975919E36B
dialogue.line: Coen! Good see!

dialogue.speaker: 559BEB17453B981732811C8B4CED0360
dialogue.line: Coen! Here!

dialogue.speaker: EDB651E24DE2D38369F8D689642D9F6C
dialogue.line: What, Coen? Not see small Ocha?

dialogue.speaker: BC55B77E40F153EE22220CABB8FBE8F0
dialogue.line: Ah, then it seems I'm lucky our paths haven't crossed.

dialogue.speaker: C2DA22DF4822B604E24A50A800771B69
dialogue.line: Have you been to Prague? My cousin, Dalebor, is an elderman there. Maybe you met him?

dialogue.speaker: BE22BD8F48BB32C24CA6C98DAEFBA4EA
dialogue.line: Honour? He's a scoundrel and a cheat! My whole family's ashamed because of him.

dialogue.speaker: B2A705CA4D611A83CC2C74AEAF1DE323
dialogue.line: I travelled through Bohemia, yes. But I didn't have the honour of meeting your kinsman.

dialogue.speaker: 5D240B7142382AF155ED4C9709C8E49A
dialogue.line: I'm afraid not. This dark harvest has not run its course yet.

dialogue.speaker: 2D0A493E4061FFBFE5F8B49D70F9351D
dialogue.line: Must have seen some strange things on your travels, right?

dialogue.speaker: 98F8FE084B82931F6CAEBBAAEE9154F7
dialogue.line: Not really. Monsters don't ask you to buy them a beer in the tavern.

dialogue.speaker: 4486DB5248524D5378DF2A9B173CCEB4
dialogue.line: Oh, yes. But nothing stranger than those goat people you have here!

dialogue.speaker: D15176EF43A6170F9D0F659751B137C5
dialogue.line: So... what is it like outside now? The plague... is it gone?

dialogue.speaker: 0336005D48013C94228BE28E65396EE2
dialogue.line: That your valley was spared... It's a miracle if ever I've seen one.

dialogue.speaker: 8C305EAE4068C9A1DE86D1AF44A0D033
dialogue.line: The uriashi? Huh. We're used to having them around now, but to you they must seem like monsters of some kind.

dialogue.speaker: E403A3024E311F7246AAA2A6A6596492
dialogue.line: Come, Coen. Need your help with this.

dialogue.speaker: 198364B8432B4A790AB7FCBD66EB1DC9
dialogue.line: Could use your help, son.

dialogue.speaker: A0ED2B3143AD6C61A9B992A89BCB8042
dialogue.line: I have a merchant friend back in Svartrau. Might give us some food on credit.

dialogue.speaker: F4EA1B1F425547A2926C1BABED3111C1
dialogue.line: I've forgotten what it feels like to worry about food...

dialogue.speaker: 62CA66594E9DD41BBB455F8EC5B6B08B
dialogue.line: If we ration it wisely... Better get used to being hungry all the time.

dialogue.speaker: 3966C5264B3F3E9699AF92A36CB3F0E8
dialogue.line: It's not much... But we'll make do.

dialogue.speaker: 37AC3E444C582769466E69B0F77ECC13
dialogue.line: So these are our supplies? Huh, doesn't look good...

dialogue.speaker: EB45ABA54571CC21746A999CE535771A
dialogue.line: So these are our supplies? Huh, doesn't look good...

dialogue.speaker: 315D9D694DA4E445A57D7A8BA43A7A9D
dialogue.line: Think it'll be enough to make it through the winter?

dialogue.speaker: 9C6961D44FCE30224C81A0A8CD447002
dialogue.line: Think it'll be enough to make it through the winter?

dialogue.speaker: AA3E14BE452ACA6B058280B91834BF7E
dialogue.line: We should send out a few hunting parties. Soon.

dialogue.speaker: 88AF0A764A89ADA9F758148F08539013
dialogue.line: Won't hurt to ask. Thanks, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: A10A289C42A0243501D61F965751BF6C
dialogue.line: How much?! Maybe you heard me wrong – I asked for one!

dialogue.speaker: DE8152ED445C3DC00ED245BE484C5B48
dialogue.line: Listen – times are tough. It's not like I make a huge profit here.

dialogue.speaker: 1D5AED2F46E73C535A37CF9BC02B556B
dialogue.line: Well, I'll look elsewhere then! Good day!

dialogue.speaker: FCC5324A45F78DBDB0F842A2BAD26057
dialogue.line: Ah, of course...

dialogue.speaker: 922B83684B4AA4CA3F1724865F339B48
dialogue.line: Ah... It's just so hard to make up your mind, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: C1990BBA45E38C8B580714B97F79F93F
dialogue.line: Dyed linen.

dialogue.speaker: 08C6A7614DBE93B3B0179F8E32ADBAAB
dialogue.line: Hm. That's hemp, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: 4BAA6E57436F29CCDCDFE6B802473DDB
dialogue.line: Hmmm. The colour is nice, I admit. Maybe... No, it wouldn't suit my husband.

dialogue.speaker: 5D2EED694BC79055C03F1AAED7F89DE2
dialogue.line: I want to make a nice shirt for him, you know? Something sturdy, yet comfortable...

dialogue.speaker: 245D48414B98718738BF83A68979419F
dialogue.line: If you say so.

dialogue.speaker: E099943D4224AAA281AA869101A7A6C2
dialogue.line: Oh, that looks nice... what is it?

dialogue.speaker: 3AD1058B45401F37BF7BDC8359FE902D
dialogue.line: Right. Yeah, I can see that.

dialogue.speaker: 65274BBB4357375E47CE1B93EB866985
dialogue.line: Very practical, hemp. But a bit too coarse on the skin, I think. Can you show me that dyed linen again?

dialogue.speaker: 5FFCF0F54D9AEEB2E390CFA25385163A
dialogue.line: Yup.

dialogue.speaker: DB2AEBF34A8B58DCAC71E2BD223B31A4
dialogue.line: Apparently he's a traveller. Crossed the mountains a few weeks ago.

dialogue.speaker: BDDC3DCD4F3A4FB7E16DE4979C91A2C7
dialogue.line: Doing my best, Premysl.

dialogue.speaker: 773ABE18419721139C44DDAD7377CB1E
dialogue.line: I saw you talking to that outsider yesterday. Learnt anything interesting?

dialogue.speaker: C893F7DC4E6379BBAEDED2B2433301FD
dialogue.line: It's alright, Premysl. If you want to rest for a bit, we can manage here alone.

dialogue.speaker: 59FED2C245AB9883E7C28C9C9A47BFB2
dialogue.line: No, no. Someone has to keep an eye on you lads.

dialogue.speaker: E35806494A43D62C63C1FD9047945B91
dialogue.line: Oh? You keep asking about that girl, I might think you're the one who fancies her.

dialogue.speaker: E005D49D4CE2BBE4B55BC2AB600A1CA9
dialogue.line: Really? And did you ask him what is he looking for in Sangora?

dialogue.speaker: 93536A0746DB6FE8B05F96A553D46F4E
dialogue.line: Relax. Kidding. It was good. Really good. Starting to think we might have a future together.

dialogue.speaker: 34FF298148E57D3D505249A1D9F4FA7B
dialogue.line: So? How did it go with Sora yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: 664EABCE42437C701192EA808526A16F
dialogue.line: Well, I think you can do better.

dialogue.speaker: 1000D0C243A5AF2E00F1E5B68FEA9F7D
dialogue.line: What? No, I was just –

dialogue.speaker: F0D0A6D9434AA23D183589838802FB53
dialogue.line: Yeah. He... well... he said... Shit, come to think of it, he didn't really answer me...

dialogue.speaker: 33FD5307499BAEE5A66868B33FC8C67D
dialogue.line: You should really put your back into it, lad.

dialogue.speaker: 1A23C8374D1E2025E84DCFAEA0B926A2
dialogue.line: Come, good people! Come! If you need it, Rainer's got it!

dialogue.speaker: FF7801E448F49AA1862043883314B09F
dialogue.line: Need to prepare for the winter? Don't look further!

dialogue.speaker: ED0F08514F1E24CC7BE35E9A8B4ABC07
dialogue.line: Shit. This won't do...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [leave the valley forever]

dialogue.speaker: B473C67B49200B33465A93894EB161C3
dialogue.line: [stay in the valley]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.006.bystander03
dialogue.line: Who'd do such a thing!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.006.bystander02
dialogue.line: Should've kept that shed locked.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.006.bystander01
dialogue.line: This village has gone to the dogs!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.708_Peasant_02
dialogue.line: Would you, if you were there?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.708_Peasant_01
dialogue.line: They should do something. Take them down. Bury them, for God's sake.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [kill Ambrus]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq708_soldier01
dialogue.line: [db] shot at Ambrus soldiers, who gasp and run away in terror

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq708_soldier01
dialogue.line: Shred him to bits! Hahaha!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq708_soldier02
dialogue.line: What a blow, bloody hell!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq708_soldier03
dialogue.line: That had to hurt...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.709_Commander
dialogue.line: Young women are disappearing without a trace. Have you heard about this?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.XantheDaughter
dialogue.line: [hum]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [exhale] This is pointless...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Xante
dialogue.line: You shall not ruin it!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Your knyaz will find out soon enough.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.709_Commander
dialogue.line: You went inside Xanthe's keep, you got out alive. And the boyaress remains unscathed.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Xante
dialogue.line: You've proven your strength.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [scoff] All right. Let's work together. I can't risk this going wrong.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.XantheDaughter
dialogue.line: [humming]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Xante
dialogue.line: Your sire has betrayed you, leaving you ignorant and stumbling about in the dark.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You had a daughter? A vrakhir, too?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ710.Constanta
dialogue.line: What does it matter to you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh] I'm not trying to be your enemy...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ710.Milan
dialogue.line: You’re trying to trick me.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: We don’t need to be.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ710.Constanta
dialogue.line: Ahh! The beast... look out...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Marten?! What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Your master is still in the treasury. Dead.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.BakirMansionGuard1
dialogue.line: You... you filthy traitor!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.BakirMansionGuard1
dialogue.line: You’ll pay for what you did to our master!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ710.Bodyguard
dialogue.line: You traitor! You die!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ710.Bodyguard
dialogue.line: Your treachery will not go unpunished!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ710.Constanta
dialogue.line: [grunt]

dialogue.speaker: SQ710.Constanta
dialogue.line: Ugh...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ710.Milan
dialogue.line: O Lord, we beseech Thee...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq711_vision_10
dialogue.line: It should've been him, instead.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq711_vision_14
dialogue.line: Maybe it wasn't an accident. Maybe he was jealous?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq711_vision_02
dialogue.line: Negligent. Foolish.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq711_vision_03
dialogue.line: There was always something wrong with this one!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq711_vision_09
dialogue.line: Pushed his mother over the brink.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq711_vision_01
dialogue.line: What a disappointment.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq711_vision_04
dialogue.line: You were the eldest. You should've known better.

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_05
dialogue.line: Bury it! Bury it deep!

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_06
dialogue.line: Deeper! Deeper!

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_07
dialogue.line: Never look at it. Never even think about it!

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_08
dialogue.line: Make it go away! Make it go away!

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_15
dialogue.line: Punish him, o Lord! Make him suffer for his sins!

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_16
dialogue.line: Make him suffer for what he did! Make him pay!

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_17
dialogue.line: He'll go to Hell! Burn for all eternity!

dialogue.speaker: sq711_vision_18
dialogue.line: Killed his own blood! No worse sin than that!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo06
dialogue.line: Keep away! Turn back!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo01
dialogue.line: No! No! Don't go there!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo04
dialogue.line: Not there, not there, not there...

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo07
dialogue.line: Too much pain, too much pain, too much pain...

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo10
dialogue.line: Go back! Go back! Go back!!!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo05
dialogue.line: We don't talk about! We don't think about it!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo02
dialogue.line: Where are you going?! No, no, no!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo08
dialogue.line: Why? Why do you keep clawing at the wound?!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo11
dialogue.line: Better to die than to go there... Relive it all... Feel it all again...

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo09
dialogue.line: Not a step further! Go back! Go back, now!!!

dialogue.speaker: SQ711.Echo03
dialogue.line: Nothing but pain – Nothing but hurt – Nothing but tears –

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ711.Echo_Priest
dialogue.line: While little Alin left this vale of tears, his older brother survived unscathed. Let us show our love to... to... to...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: This boy – It's me...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_1
dialogue.line: I am God's wrath!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_2
dialogue.line: You will burn in hell!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_4
dialogue.line: You'll pay for Father Florin!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_3
dialogue.line: You won't leave here!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_3
dialogue.line: No. When I went there, I only found her broom... and a bit of blood on the ground.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_5
dialogue.line: You... you don't think she was taken by the vrakhiri?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_1
dialogue.line: They just tried to do their duty to Father Florin. And you cut them down.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Yes? What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_8
dialogue.line: Lord, you must have been terrified!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.sq712_christian_4
dialogue.line: Well, he did go deep into the ruins and return in one piece. You've got to respect that.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ713_Brencis_Soldier2
dialogue.line: The rebels, they don't care if they get you in trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ713_Brencis_Soldier3
dialogue.line: The manumits, they'd gladly burn this whole village. You remember that.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier02
dialogue.line: Yeah, caught a glimpse of her. And that'll last me for a lifetime. She's creepy as fuck...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier03
dialogue.line: Sorry, sarge. Is-is that better?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier01
dialogue.line: So, sarge. I hear you were on cathedral duty last week. How was it?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier02
dialogue.line: I heard nothing. Move it.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier03
dialogue.line: What... what was that?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714_Soldier01
dialogue.line: Listen, fresh face. We're at the end of our patrol route. Don't let your eagerness ruin a good evening, alright?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.714.farm.peasant.necrospeak
dialogue.line: [scream]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.715_messenger
dialogue.line: The knyaz demands Coen show his face! He is to come to Shrike's Crag, after sunset, and light a signal atop the watchtower.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.GuardPatrollingStatic
dialogue.line: There's nothing here for you. You better turn around.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ716.FistfightLoser
dialogue.line: You're going... inside? Watch out for that *hrmgh* she-devil...

dialogue.speaker: GuardPatrollingStatic
dialogue.line: What the... Where are you going, you blasted swine! Wait!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ716.FistfightLoser
dialogue.line: Shit... shit... That fucking goat... Out of my way!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ716.FistfightCrowdFemale1
dialogue.line: Ocha! Ocha! Ocha!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ716.FistfightCrowdMale1
dialogue.line: I can't look...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ716.FistfightCrowdMale2
dialogue.line: Yeah! Really get in there, man!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ719.SoldierLeader
dialogue.line: Look at that, still worrying about the old man...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ719.SoldierGrunt
dialogue.line: We'll chain him up first, ask questions later.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Where's Volk?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SQ719.SoldierLeader
dialogue.line: What do you mean, you changed your mind? It doesn't work like that, old man.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ720.burner3
dialogue.line: There's a bear in these woods. Better watch out.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ720.burner2
dialogue.line: My saw's pretty much toothless now.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ720.burner1
dialogue.line: Work, work, work. That's all there is to life.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You work togerher.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.SQ720.LumberjackLeader
dialogue.line: Try talking to the lad, and you'll understand.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_armorer_1
dialogue.line: You better come well armed, then.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Would you mind reforging my current armour?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Blacksmith_1
dialogue.line: Would be a mistake to go elsewhere.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're confident in your work...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_foodMerchant_2
dialogue.line: Yeah. Why?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Show me what you have.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_foodMerchant_3
dialogue.line: Yeah...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Why only dreamt?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're in a good mood...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_foodMerchant_1
dialogue.line: Well, of course! The business is booming, the rivers overflowing with trout. Whatever knyaz Brencis is doing, it's marvellous!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_GeneralStore_2
dialogue.line: You again. What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You've got beautiful things here... Who do you trade with, normally? Nobles?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Medic_2
dialogue.line: Yes? How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're that busy?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Armorer_2
dialogue.line: What can I get you today?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Your trade – it's not easy, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_foodMerchant_5
dialogue.line: Ugh. You again.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You're a bit grumpy, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_SilverTrader
dialogue.line: Yes, yes. Door's that way.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Blacksmith_2
dialogue.line: Yes? What can I do for you today?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: You don't like the vrakhiri?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc_Medic_1
dialogue.line: You know where to find me!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Will this be enough?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.OA113.Alchemist
dialogue.line: Oh, hello! It's always good to see you alive and well.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Working on something new?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.SilberkreisInnKeeper
dialogue.line: You're not exactly the clientele I'm after, are you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Swamp_Medic
dialogue.line: You know where to find me. As long as you can walk.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Tantari_Armorer
dialogue.line: Not sure if I should tell you that, but most of my stock goes straight to the knyaz. Can’t offer much.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Show me what's available.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: Improve what I’ve already got, and I’ll be gone.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Tantari_Blacksmith
dialogue.line: [sigh] I suppose.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.Tantari_GeneralStore
dialogue.line: Yeah, you're all right.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Main.Coen
dialogue.line: People talk about Brencis a lot here?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.DogTrainer
dialogue.line: Rats! You won't listen, will you?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.Administrator
dialogue.line: Now pay up and sod off.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.YoungGirl1
dialogue.line: Yeah! Dance with us!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.YoungGirl2
dialogue.line: Sure you don't want to join us? Have a bit of fun, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.InnkeepersSon
dialogue.line: Sorry, but things get busy around here. I must tend to the other guests, too.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.Merchant1
dialogue.line: What?! A fifth of it all?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.ElderSmoker
dialogue.line: Watched my steps, so the bastard got diddly squat!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.Idler3
dialogue.line: Pshaw! Dumbass...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Background.cc.TavernBySvartrau.Idler5
dialogue.line: Yeah? Heh... Then how I'm still alive, huh?
